“我们能做些什么吗，教授？”小天狼星站起来，皱着眉头问道。弗林特翻了个白眼。

“No, Mr Black, thank you. Simply stay calm and carry on as normal.”
“不，布莱克先生，谢谢。只需保持冷静，照常进行即可。”

“Please, Professor Flitwick,” Tina sobbed, “I need to go home now, it’s my auntie…” Arnold put his arm around her shoulder, and whispered something comforting.
“请，弗利维克教授，”蒂娜哭泣道，“我现在需要回家，是我的姑姑……”阿诺德搂着她的肩膀，低声说了些安慰的话。

“C’mon, Moony,” Sirius murmured, “Let’s see if James knows anything…”
“走吧，月亮，”小天狼星低声说，“看看詹姆斯知道些什么……”

“I don’t know anything!” James said, almost as soon as he opened the mirror to respond to their calling. “Dad’s gone to the ministry with Moody, they let me read the paper, but there’s nothing else. Everyone knows who did it, though - death eaters.”
“我不知道任何事！”詹姆斯几乎在打开镜子回应他们的呼叫时就说。“爸爸跟穆迪去了魔法部，他们让我看了报纸，但没别的了。不过，大家都知道是谁干的——食死徒。”

Sirius nodded, gravely.
小天狼星严肃地点了点头。

“Voldemort?” Remus asked, “Does he have that many followers? Over a hundred, the paper said, all over the country, in one night…”
“伏地魔？”雷穆斯问，“他有那么多追随者吗？报纸上说，整个国家一夜之间有一百多人……”

“Must be more than anyone thought.” James said.
“肯定比任何人想的要多。”詹姆斯说道。

“Well,” Sirius sat up, his mouth a grim line, “My family alone would account for at least twenty.”
“好吧，”小天狼星坐直了身子，嘴巴紧绷，“仅仅是我家就至少有二十个。”

“They’re not your family,” James said, fiercely. He and Sirius stared each other out for a while, and Remus shifted away, slightly, feeling intrusive. Sirius’s temper was rising, Remus didn’t need enhanced senses to work that out.
“他们不是你的家人，”詹姆斯激烈地说。他和小天狼星对视了一会儿，雷穆斯微微移开了，感到有些入侵。小天狼星的怒火在升腾，雷穆斯不需要增强的感官就能明白这一点。

“If Reg was one of then, I’ll…”
“如果雷吉是其中之一，我会……”

“Black!” James hissed, “No one knows who any of them were. Calm down, ok? Moony, you there?”
“布莱克！”詹姆斯低声说，“没人知道他们是谁。冷静点，好吗？月亮，你在吗？”

“Yeah,” Remus shuffled back into the mirror’s view. James looked at him,
“在，”雷穆斯重新挪回了镜子的视野。詹姆斯看着他，

“Don’t let him be a twat about this, right?”
“不要让他在这件事上胡闹，好吗？”

“What do you want me to do?!” Remus asked, nonplussed. Sirius’s family crises were usually James’s job. Remus’s role was different.
“你想让我做什么？！”雷穆斯不解地问。小天狼星的家庭危机通常是詹姆斯的工作。雷穆斯的角色不同。

“Just distract him!”
“只是分散他的注意力！”

Remus personally didn’t think that that sounded like the best idea. It wouldn’t get rid of the problem - and James almost definitely wouldn’t approve of Remus’s distraction techniques. Sirius talked to James for a bit longer, and Remus left them to it. He thought longingly about the final joint, sitting in his bedside table upstairs. Probably not appropriate.
雷穆斯个人认为这听起来不是最好的主意。这并不能解决问题——而且詹姆斯几乎肯定不会赞同雷穆斯的分散注意力技巧。小天狼星和詹姆斯多聊了一会儿，雷穆斯离开了。他渴望地想着在楼上的床头柜里的最后一根烟卷。可能不太合适。

 

Thursday 27th December 1976

Arnold, Tina and Flint went home on Boxing Day, so after that it was just the two of them (and the teachers, of course, but they seemed to be in a never-ending conference, McGonagall's face growing more and more weary every time Remus saw her).
阿諾德、蒂娜和弗林特在節禮日那天回家了，所以之後只剩下他們兩個（當然還有老師們，但他們似乎在進行一個永無止境的會議，每次雷穆斯看到麥格教授的臉，都變得越來越疲憊）。

Sirius sulked. He didn’t want to go out, he didn’t want to stay in. He didn’t want to smoke, or drink, or eat, or play games. He just wanted to stew. Remus would have been quite content to let him, if only it didn’t affect the entire atmosphere of the castle so much.
小天狼星鬱悶不樂。他不想出去，也不想待在裡面。他不想抽煙、喝酒、吃東西，也不想玩遊戲。他只想沉浸在自己的情緒中。雷穆斯會很樂意讓他這樣，若不是這樣會影響到整個城堡的氛圍。

He tried James’s distraction idea.
他嘗試了詹姆斯的分心建議。

“Want to play that game?”
“想玩那個遊戲嗎？”

“Nah, I’m rubbish at it.”
“不，這遊戲我很爛。”

“Yeah, but I’m not.”
“是的，但我不是。”

“You play it, then.” He hunched down into his chair, arms folded. Remus sighed,
“那你來玩吧。”他縮在椅子上，雙臂抱著。雷穆斯嘆了口氣，

“Want to go out on your broom? I’ll go with you and everything.”
“想去外面飛掃帚嗎？我會跟你一起去的。”

“Don’t have my broom here.”
“這裡沒有我的掃帚。”

“We can borrow them from the shed. Hooch won’t mind.”
“我們可以從小屋借來。胡治不會介意的。”

“Nah, don’t like using other people’s brooms.”
“不，討厭用別人的掃帚。”

“Snob.”
“裝腔作勢。”

No response.
沒有回應。

“Chess?”
“下棋？”

“Boring.”
“無聊。”

“Homework?”
“做作業？”

That was just met with a dark look.
這只是得到了一個陰沉的眼神。

“Want a blow job?”
“想要口交嗎？”

“Bloody hell, Moony!”
“天啊，雷穆斯！”

“What?! I’m running out of options, jesus. Just trying to cheer you up.”
“什麼？！我選擇不多了，天啊。只是想讓你高興些。”

“I don’t want to cheer up.”
“我不想高興起來。”

“Yes, that much is clear.” He fiddled with a loose thread on his sleeve, “Do you want to go to the Potters?”
“是的，這點很明顯。”他玩弄著袖子上的一根鬆線，“你想去波特家嗎？”

Sirius looked up,
小天狼星抬起頭，

“What?”
“什麼？”

“I don’t mind,” Remus said, honestly. “If you need to see them. If you… need James.”
“我不介意，”雷穆斯說，誠實地，“如果你需要見他們。如果你……需要詹姆斯。”

For a moment, Remus wasn’t sure what Sirius was going to do. He seemed to consider the idea, and Remus wished he hadn’t suggested it. But he shook his head.
雷穆斯一時不確定小天狼星會怎麼做。他似乎在考慮這個想法，雷穆斯希望他沒提這個建議。但小天狼星搖了搖頭。

“Nah.” He said, “What sort of mate would I be if I left you here by yourself?”
“不。”他說，“如果我把你留在這裡不管，我算什麼朋友？”

That got Remus’s back up. He tugged at the thread on his sleeve, breaking it,
這讓雷穆斯很不高興。他拉扯著袖子上的線，把它弄斷，

“Well you’re not being much of a mate right now, to be honest. I know you’re in a mood, but--”
“說實話，你現在不像個朋友。我知道你心情不好，但——”

“I’m not in a mood.” Sirius spat, angrily, “I’m pissed off. Look, you don’t know what it’s like, having family out there doing merlin knows what - people I’m actually related to, Moony.”
“我不在情緒不好。”小天狼星憤怒地說，“我很生氣。看，你不知道那種感覺，家人在外面做梅林知道的事情——那些我真正相關的家人，雷穆斯。”

“Oh god, change the bloody record, will you?” Remus groaned, getting up to prod the fire, sorry James, he thought, I’m not you. “Poor Sirius Black, the spoilt rich boy with the wicked family.”
“哦，上帝，換一個話題吧？”雷穆斯嘆息著站起來去撥弄火堆，對不起詹姆斯，他想，我不是你。“可憐的小天狼星·布萊克，這個被寵壞的富家子弟有個邪惡的家庭。”

“Oi, watch it.”
“喂，小心點。”

“Well I’m sorry, but we’ve had six years of this, now. No, I don’t know what it’s like, because I don’t have a family, let alone an evil one. You know what I’ve got? A pack of bloody werewolves, waiting for me to come of age so I can finally go and join all the other monsters.”
“抱歉，但我們已經經歷了六年這樣的事。不是，我不知道那種感覺，因為我沒有家人，更別提邪惡的家人了。你知道我有什麼？一群該死的狼人，等著我成年，好讓我去加入其他怪物。”

“Moony…”
“雷穆斯……”

“I’ve got some brutal fucking mass murdering child killer out there waiting for me. And not much else, to be honest. I don’t have the Potters, or an Uncle - I don’t even have a flipping future. So, if you don’t mind, I’d rather not sit around here listening you whinge about how hard you’ve got it.”
“外面有個殘忍的殺人兇手在等著我。說實話，還沒有什麼其他的。我沒有波特家族，沒有叔叔——我甚至沒有未來。所以，如果你不介意，我寧願不在這裡聽你抱怨你的困境。”

He’d only decided halfway through speaking that he was going to storm out, but he hoped it didn’t look that way. He hadn’t let himself get that angry in a very long time - and, as ever, it had been Sirius who’d brought it out. He went to the library, because there was nowhere else, and because Sirius would almost definitely look there first. It was weird, walking through the empty halls and staircases. He could hear the portraits whispering as he passed, and didn’t like it.
他在說話過程中才決定要沖出去，但他希望看起來不是那樣。他很久沒有讓自己如此生氣了——一如既往，是小天狼星引發了這種情緒。他去了圖書館，因為沒有其他地方可以去，並且小天狼星幾乎肯定會首先去那裡。走過空曠的走廊和樓梯有些奇怪。他能聽到畫中的人們在竊竊私語，他不喜歡這種感覺。

When he got to the library, he realised that he didn’t have a next step planned. He’d left all of his homework back in the dorm, so he couldn’t check his notes. He could summon them, he supposed - but that somehow defeated the point of storming off.
當他到了圖書館時，他意識到自己沒有下一步的計劃。他把所有的作業留在了宿舍，所以無法查看筆記。他可以召喚它們，他想——但這樣會違背沖出去的目的。

Remus just went to the nearest shelf and pulled out a random book, sitting in the most comfortable chair he could find with it. It was on potions. Just his luck. Friday 28th December 1976

“Do you want to talk about it?” Sirius asked, late in the afternoon. He had finally allowed Sirius to get on with his homework, and was playing a game of solitaire with a deck of cards he’d found. Remus had never seen Sirius occupied in such a quiet activity before, and kept sneaking glances.
“你想談談嗎？”小天狼星問，下午晚些時候。他終於允許小天狼星繼續做作業，而自己則在玩一副他找到的紙牌接龍。雷穆斯從未見過小天狼星這麼安靜地做事，不斷偷偷瞄他。

雷穆斯回以微笑，感到對小天狼星·布萊克的愛意湧上心頭，讓他感到頭暈。

“我不是。我只是希望你不要錯過那些事。”小天狼星把蘋果送進了最大的洞裡，揮拳慶祝，“是的！”

“Five points.” Remus returned, dryly, “You’re still twenty down.” He cleared his throat, “And I’m not missing out on anything.”
“五分。”雷穆斯冷冷地回道，“你還差二十分。”他清了清喉嚨，“而且我不會錯過任何東西。”

“I know you don’t think you are, Moony, but I’m just saying--”
“我知道你覺得你沒錯過什麼，雷穆斯，但我只是想說——”

“Well, don’t.”
“那就別說了。”

“Don’t be angry with me.”
“別對我生氣。”

“I’m not.” Remus fired an inkwell at the sheets so hard that he missed, and splattered the white fabric with a bright blue splodge.
“我不生氣。”雷穆斯用力地將一瓶墨水扔向床單，結果沒打中，將白色布料弄成了明亮的藍色斑點。

“You seem pretty angry.” Sirius lowered his own wand, turning to Remus. Remus didn’t look at him.
“你看起來很生氣。”小天狼星放下自己的魔杖，轉向雷穆斯。雷穆斯沒有看他。

“I don’t want a girlfriend, how many times?”
“我不想要女朋友，說了多少次？”

“I know you say that, but… I can’t help but think there must be a reason behind it… I think I know why.” Sirius shifted, awkwardly, and Remus looked at him, sideways, his heart pounding in his chest. He should have expected this, eventually. “It’s because of the werewolf thing, isn’t it?” Sirius said.
“我知道你這麼說，但……我忍不住覺得一定有原因在後面……我想我知道為什麼。”小天狼星局促地動了一下，雷穆斯側目看著他，心臟在胸口猛烈跳動。他應該早就預料到這一點。“這是因為狼人那件事，是吧？”小天狼星說。

Remus opened his mouth, then closed it again. Really? Really?! He sat down, head in his hands, and tried not to laugh. Sirius mistook this for something else, and said, gently, “You’re worried about a girl finding out, right? But, I mean, Evans knows, and she’s fine about it, so I don’t see why you wouldn’t find someone else… and your scars aren’t as bad as you think they are.”
雷穆斯張了張嘴，又閉上了。真的？真的？！他坐下來，頭埋在雙手中，試著不笑出聲來。小天狼星誤以為他是因為別的事，輕聲說道：“你擔心女生會發現，是吧？但，我的意思是，埃文斯知道了，她覺得沒問題，所以我不明白為什麼你不能找到其他人……而且你的傷疤其實沒有你想的那麼糟糕。”

“Oh really?” Remus snorted.
“哦，真的嗎？”雷穆斯嗤之以鼻。

“Yeah,” Sirius nodded, encouragingly, “They’re cool. And you… I mean, y’know, you’re quite good looking. You’re tall and you’re um...”
“是啊，”小天狼星鼓勵地點頭，“它們很酷。還有你……我的意思是，你知道，你其實挺好看的。你高大，然後你……”

Remus looked up at him, curiously. Sirius Black was blushing.
雷穆斯好奇地抬頭看他。小天狼星·布萊克在臉紅。

Jesus Christ, Remus thought, what have we got ourselves into?
“天啊，”雷穆斯心想，“我們到底陷入了什麼困境？”

Sunday 30th December 1976

“How far do you reckon Pete and Desdemona have gone?”
“你覺得彼得和德斯德莫娜已經走了多遠？”

“Ugh, why are you thinking about that?” Remus wrinkled his nose in the dark.
“唔，你為什麼在想這個？”雷穆斯在黑暗中皺起了鼻子。

“I dunno,” Sirius replied, “Can’t sleep.”
“我不知道，”小天狼星回答，“睡不著。”

Remus rolled onto his side, and peered across the bedroom, to where Sirius lay in his bed. He could clearly make out his pale outline, he was lying on his back, staring up at the canopy, arms behind his head.
雷穆斯側身，瞄向臥室的另一邊，那裡小天狼星躺在床上。他清楚地看見他的蒼白輪廓，他仰臥在床上，盯著天棚，雙臂放在頭後面。

“Not tired?” Remus asked. They’d both been in his bed, only an hour before. He felt the absence keenly, but there was nothing to be done about it.
“還不累嗎？”雷穆斯問。他們一小時前還在他的床上。他深刻地感受到這種缺失，但無可奈何。

“S’pose not. Keep thinking about tomorrow.”
“我想還好。一直在想明天的事。”

“Tomorrow?”
“明天？”

“Last day of the year.”
“今年的最後一天。”

“Yep.” It would be their last day alone, too. Everyone was due back on the first of January, and the bubble they had lived in for the past eleven days would burst. “Making resolutions?” Remus asked, yawning.
“是的。”這也會是他們最後一天獨處的時候。所有人預計在一月一號回來，過去十一天他們的泡沫生活將會破裂。“制定新年計劃？”雷穆斯問，打著哈欠。

“Not really. Just the usual stuff.” He sounded sad. “Stuff I should stop doing.”
“不太是。只是一些常規的東西。”他聽起來有點悲傷。“我應該停止做的事。”

“Well.” Remus thought quickly, “Why don’t you think about the stuff you want to do?”
“那麼。”雷穆斯迅速思考，“為什麼不考慮一下你想做的事呢？”

“Like what?”
“像什麼？”

“Oh, I dunno,” Remus stifled another yawn, “Like how you’re always talking about going to London? Muggle London. Properly, I mean, not just a dodgy squat in Mile End.”
“哦，我不知道，”雷穆斯壓抑著另一個哈欠，“像你總是說想去倫敦？麻瓜倫敦。我是說，真正地去，不只是去邊緣區的爛地方。”

“Oh yeah!” Sirius said, cheering up, “We should do that, in the summer. Can we go to Carnaby Street?”
“哦，是的！”小天狼星說，心情變得愉快，“我們應該在夏天去做這件事。我們可以去Carnaby Street嗎？”

“Don’t see why not.”
“我看沒什麼問題。”

“I want to learn to play guitar.”
“我想學彈吉他。”

“Of course you do…”
“當然你想……”

“And go camping.”
“還有去露營。”

“Mmm.”
“嗯。”

“And see Bowie in concert.”
“還有去看鮑伊的音樂會。”

Remus smiled, softly, listening to Sirius’s dreams as he drifted to sleep.
雷穆斯輕輕地微笑，聆聽著小天狼星的夢想，隨著他進入睡眠。

Monday 31st December 1976

“Do you know any sewing spells?” Remus asked, thoughtfully, sipping a mug of tea from his favourite armchair and looking up at the bedsheets which would have to come down today.
“你知道什麼縫紉魔咒嗎？”雷穆斯思索地問，一邊喝著他最喜歡的扶手椅上的一杯茶，一邊看著今天必須拆下的床單。

“Why would I know sewing spells?” Sirius asked, from the floor. He was sitting over a cauldron with a book beside him, trying to create his own fireworks to celebrate New Year’s Eve.
“我為什麼會知道縫紉魔咒？”小天狼星問，坐在地上。他正坐在一個鍋爐上，旁邊放著一本書，試圖創造自己的煙火來慶祝除夕夜。

“I was just thinking about the sheets…”
“我只是想到那些床單……”

“Pfft,” Sirius waved a hand, “They won’t even notice.”
“噗，”小天狼星揮了揮手，“他們甚至不會注意到。”

“Ought to fix that crystal ball we broke, too.”
“還應該修理一下我們打破的水晶球。”

“Nah.”
“不用。”

“And probably should look for those chess pieces that went- er - missing…” Two days ago they had accidently fired an entire set out of the window. They’d summoned most of the pieces back, but the queen and two knights were still in the bushes somewhere below.
“還有，可能應該去找那些棋子，它們……呃，丟了……”兩天前他們不小心把一整副棋子從窗戶裡射了出去。他們召回了大多數棋子，但皇后和兩個騎士仍然在下面的灌木叢中。

“Look, everyone knew it was just going to be the two of us here for Christmas,” Sirius replied, waving his wand carefully over the cauldron, “It was their responsibility to lock up anything they didn’t want to get shot out of the window.”
“看，大家都知道聖誕節只有我們兩個在這裡，”小天狼星回應道，小心地揮動著他的魔杖在鍋爐上，“這是他們的責任，把任何不希望被射出窗外的東西鎖起來。”

“And Peter’s bed?”
“彼得的床呢？”

“It’s stopped making that weird noise, now.”
“它現在不再發出那種奇怪的聲音了。”

“Yeah, but it still giggles when you sit on it.”
“是的，但坐上去還是會發出笑聲。”

“He’ll work out how to fix it, or get Desdemona to help him. You worry too much.”
“他會想辦法修好它，或者讓德斯德莫娜幫他。你太擔心了。”

BANG
砰

The contents of the cauldron exploded in Sirius’s face, knocking him backwards and filling the room with a plume of lime green smoke. Remus ran for the window, coughing, trying not to laugh at Sirius’s startled expression, face black with soot.
鍋爐中的內容物在小天狼星的臉上爆炸，把他向後推去，並充滿了整個房間的石灰綠煙霧。雷穆斯跑向窗戶，咳嗽著，試圖不笑出聲來，看著小天狼星驚訝的表情，臉上全是煙塵。

“I told you we should just ask Flitwick.”
“我早就說過我們應該去問弗利特維克。”

The dust settled, and now the whole room was covered with a fine green film. Remus raised an eyebrow. Sirius smirked,
灰塵沉降下來，整個房間現在覆蓋了一層細綠色的薄膜。雷穆斯抬起了眉毛。小天狼星得意地笑了，

“Leave it to the house elves? I’m having a shower.”
“把這個交給家養小精靈處理吧？我要去洗個澡。”

He did go to Flitwick, in the end, and the tiny Charms professor was only too pleased to impart some advice on creating the perfect fireworks – without any messy potions or cauldrons. “He made me promise not to tell McGonagall that he taught me, though,” Sirius laughed, “He’s really gone up in my estimation, ol’ Flitters.”
他最後確實去找了弗利特維克，那位小小的咒語教授很高興地提供了一些製作完美煙火的建議——而不需要任何麻煩的藥水或鍋爐。“不過他讓我答應不告訴麥格教授他教過我，”小天狼星笑著說，“老弗利特的形象在我心中真的是提升了不少。”

“Can’t believe you went without me. I’m best at Charms.” Remus muttered, as he climbed out of their bedroom window to sit on the ledge beside Sirius.
“真不敢相信你在我不在的時候去找了他。我在咒語方面最好。”雷穆斯咕噥著，一邊從他們的臥室窗戶爬出去，坐在小天狼星旁邊的窗台上。

“You were sleeping!” Sirius nudged him jovially.
“你當時在睡覺！”小天狼星愉快地撞了撞他。

“Still.” Remus grumbled, folding his arms against the cold. Their legs dangled precariously over the edge, but he wasn’t as afraid of heights as he had once been. Thank James’s relentless broom training for that. He’d only taken a nap earlier to ensure he would be able to stay up until midnight - which was now only minutes away.
“還是。”雷穆斯嘟囔著，雙臂抱著冷風。他們的腿在邊緣懸空，但他已經不再像以前那樣怕高了。多虧了詹姆斯那無情的掃帚訓練。他剛剛打了個小盹，確保自己能夠熬到午夜——而現在只剩幾分鐘了。

It was very quiet, outside, and other than the occasional animal noise rising from the Forbidden Forest, or the soft hooting of the owls in the owlery they might have been completely alone in the world. They were content to sit in this silence, as the last moments of 1976 slipped away under a frozen winter sky. Remus felt a deep sense of satisfaction and contentment. It was bittersweet. He was looking forward to seeing James, Peter and the girls again. He was looking forward to the spring term. But still, as soon as the Hogwarts Express pulled into the station the next afternoon, everything he and Sirius had shared over the past twelve nights would have to be tidied away and locked up until it was safe to resurface.
外面非常安靜，除了偶爾從禁忌森林傳來的動物聲音，或者貓頭鷹塔裡傳來的輕柔的貓頭鷹叫聲，他們可能感覺自己完全與世隔絕。他們滿足於在這份寂靜中坐著，直到1976年的最後時刻在冰凍的冬季天空下消逝。雷穆斯感受到深深的滿足和愉悅。這是苦樂參半的。他期待著再次見到詹姆斯、彼得和女孩們。他期待著春季學期。但即便如此，當霍格華茲快車在第二天下午進站時，他和小天狼星在過去十二夜間共享的一切，都必須收拾起來鎖起來，直到安全地重現。

Sirius raised his pocket watch - one he had received for his seventeenth birthday from the Potters. He held it up so that Remus could read it too. Five seconds to go. Sirius smiled at him, and squeezed his knee.
小天狼星舉起了他的懷錶——那是他從波特夫婦那裡收到的十七歲生日禮物。他舉起懷錶讓雷穆斯也能看到。還有五秒鐘。小天狼星對他微笑，並擠了擠他的膝蓋。

“Ready?” He lifted his wand.
“準備好了嗎？”他舉起了他的魔杖。

Remus grinned back, and nodded,
雷穆斯回以微笑，點了點頭，

“Ready.”
“準備好了。”

 

Chapter 104: Sixth Year: Bad Moon Rising 

Gather 'round all you people

Watch me while you can

Been trawling too long, I've been losing out strong

For the strength of another man

 

I've been hasty, wasty standing on the backstep

Waiting for the phone to ring

But this semi-acoustic love affair

Is driving me to the brink

 

I'm just looking for a friend

I'm just looking for a friend

You don't have to be a big wheel, you don't have to be the end

I'm just looking for, looking for a friend

 

 

 

Tuesday 1st January 1977
1977年1月1日，星期二

“Here they come!” Sirius was practically bouncing next to Remus as they watched the horseless carriages approaching the castle gates.
“他們來了！”小天狼星幾乎在雷穆斯旁邊跳躍著，看著無馬馬車接近城堡大門。

“Thank god.” Remus joked, “Some intelligent conversation.”
“謝天謝地。”雷穆斯開玩笑道，“終於可以有些聰明的對話了。”

“Oh shut up, you love me really.” Sirius kicked him in the shin.
“哦，閉嘴吧，你其實很愛我。”小天狼星踢了他的小腿。

I do, Remus thought, pitifully, I really bloody do. But of course, that was not what Sirius had meant.
“我確實愛你，”雷穆斯悲哀地想，“我真的非常愛你。”但當然，小天狼星並不是那個意思。

James disembarked from the mysteriously drawn carriages like a soldier returning from war. He and Sirius beamed at each other, until Remus thought that the two of them ought to be snogging, not Sirius and Remus. Lily and Peter climbed out of the carriage behind, and Remus hugged her and nodded to him.
詹姆斯從神秘驅動的馬車上下來，像是戰爭歸來的士兵。他和小天狼星對視而笑，直到雷穆斯覺得他們兩個應該接吻，而不是小天狼星和雷穆斯。莉莉和彼得從後面的馬車上下來，雷穆斯擁抱了她，並向他點了點頭。

“Good Christmas?” Lily asked, “Thanks for the chocolates!”
“聖誕節過得好嗎？”莉莉問道，“謝謝你的巧克力！”

“Thanks for the gloves,” he replied waving them at her to demonstrate, “Really warm.”
“謝謝你的手套，”他回應道，揮舞著手套示範，“真的很暖和。”

“Yeah, cheers for the gloves, Evans,” James waved his own wool covered hands.
“是的，謝謝你的手套，埃文斯，”詹姆斯揮舞著自己的毛線手。

Lily blushed deeply, and mumbled something about not wanting to leave anyone out.
莉莉深深地紅了臉，喃喃地說不想遺漏任何人。

Earlier, Remus and Sirius had walked alone through a castle of empty halls echoing and hushed with the whispers of the portraits and the eerie drifting ghosts. But as they all returned together, it was as if the school was transformed in an instant. The flagstones rattled with the busy chatter of friends reuniting, every arch and column filled with black robed students. Remus felt he was awakening from a strange and quiet dream.
早些時候，雷穆斯和小天狼星單獨走過空蕩的城堡，回響著肖像畫的低語和陰森的漂浮幽靈。但當他們一起回來時，學校彷彿瞬間變了樣。石板路上響起了朋友重逢的忙碌聊天聲，每個拱門和柱子都充滿了穿著黑袍的學生。雷穆斯感覺自己從一個奇怪而寂靜的夢中醒來。

It was incredible how quickly everything settled back to normal - Peter and Desdemona started a fight almost immediately, Lily hexed James halfway through dinner, Mary had tales of her newest boyfriend, which Marlene was rolling her eyes at. Sirius had eyes only for James, of course, but Remus was keenly aware of the looks he was getting from other quarters - all of the unanswered Christmas cards would be coming home to roost.
一切恢復正常的速度真是難以置信——彼得和德斯德莫娜幾乎立刻開始吵架，莉莉在晚餐中途對詹姆斯施了咒，瑪麗講述著她最新的男朋友，而瑪琳則翻了翻白眼。小天狼星當然只盯著詹姆斯，但雷穆斯敏銳地意識到自己從其他角度得到的目光——所有未回復的聖誕卡都將回來。

“So, what did you two get up to?” James asked, mouth full of roast beef, “You didn’t give much away when we spoke…”
“所以，你們兩個幹了什麼？”詹姆斯問道，嘴裡塞滿了烤牛肉，“我們談話時你們沒透露太多……”

Sirius and Remus looked at each other only for the tiniest moment, long enough for Remus to note the spark of panic in Sirius and grin at James,
小天狼星和雷穆斯僅僅對視了一小會兒，足夠雷穆斯注意到小天狼星眼中的恐慌火花，並對詹姆斯笑了笑，

“Spent most of it trying to keep Padfoot out of trouble, obviously.”
“顯然，大部分時間都在努力讓帕丁福特遠離麻煩。”

James and Peter laughed, and that was all anyone needed. Sirius settled back, shoulders lowering, and Remus watched him from underneath his eyelashes. This wasn’t going to work. It was all too impossible.
詹姆斯和彼得笑了，這就是大家所需的一切。小天狼星靠回去，放鬆了肩膀，雷穆斯從睫毛下看著他。這行不通。這一切太不可能了。

The night before, just before he drifted to sleep, Remus had made a decision. He had to talk to Sirius. The irony was not lost on him, that after days and days of nothing but talking, the solution seemed to be more talking. But this time he would make Sirius listen.
前一天晚上，就在他快要入睡時，雷穆斯做出了決定。他必須和小天狼星談談。諷刺的是，經過這麼多天的談話後，解決辦法似乎還是更多的談話。但這次他會讓小天狼星聽。

He only needed an opportunity, which he accepted would not be easy. Opportunity, and just a bit more time. He wasn’t brave enough just yet. Just now, every song he heard reminded him of Sirius; every soppy sentence in every novel. Maybe he wasn’t quite ready to give it all up.
他只需要一個機會，這並不容易。他需要機會，還有一點時間。他現在還不夠勇敢。此刻，每一首聽到的歌曲都讓他想起小天狼星；每本小說中的每一句肉麻話。也許他還沒準備好放棄這一切。

Sirius certainly wasn’t. Remus had tried questioning him, after everyone had been back for a few days, and Sirius had accepted an invitation to Hogsmeade from Emmeline Vance.
小天狼星肯定還沒準備好。大家回來幾天後，雷穆斯試著質問他，而小天狼星接受了艾米琳·凡斯的霍格莫德邀請。

“Don’t you think we ought to stop? Isn’t it a bit confusing for you?”
“你不覺得我們應該停止嗎？這對你來說不會有點混亂嗎？”

“Why would it be confusing? It’s not the same thing.” Sirius raised his eyebrows in genuine surprise.
“為什麼會混亂？這不是一回事。”小天狼星真誠地驚訝地揚起眉毛。

“Oh.” Remus said, quietly. He was glad they were in a cupboard, and it was dark, “Oh, isn’t it?”
“哦。”雷穆斯輕聲說。他慶幸他們在一個黑暗的櫥櫃裡，“哦，不是嗎？”

“Well, no. She’s a girl. You’re Moony.”
“嗯，不是的。她是個女孩。你是月亮臉。”

“What does that mean?”
“那是什麼意思？”

“It just means… you know. You and me… we’re not… and she… erm... oh, for goodness sake,” he got irritated, and gave up explaining, “I just can’t see any reason to stop, ok? It’s fun, isn’t it?”
“這只是意味著……你懂的。你和我……我們不是……而她……呃……哦，天哪，”他煩躁起來，放棄了解釋，“我只是看不到任何停止的理由，好嗎？這不是很有趣嗎？”

“Yeah.” Remus sighed.
“是的。”雷穆斯嘆了口氣。

“Look, if someone asked you out, that would be fine, obviously.”
“看，如果有人約你出去，那也沒問題，顯然。”

“Right.” Remus nodded, “That’s nice of you.”
“對。”雷穆斯點點頭，“你真好。”

“Oh, c’mon, don’t be like that…” Sirius started kissing his neck, and Remus was in no position to argue, after that.
“哦，拜託，別這樣……”小天狼星開始親吻他的脖子，雷穆斯此後無法再爭辯。

He’d had plenty of opportunities, really. He was as weak as Sirius, when all was said and done.
事實上，他有很多機會。他和小天狼星一樣軟弱，說到底。

Besides, it was just a secret – as Sirius had once said, long before everything got complicated; ‘you’re not Moony if you don’t have a secret’. He could do secrets. Except. It was getting harder – especially around the full moon, when his nerves were thinnest and every emotion burned just beneath the surface. Then he would see Sirius with some girl or another, watch as she picked fluff from his school jumper or straighten his tie or wrap her arms around his waist and he would want to tear her to pieces.
此外，這只是個秘密——就像小天狼星曾經說過的，早在一切變得複雜之前；“如果你沒有秘密，你就不是月亮臉。”他可以保守秘密。除了。這變得越來越困難——特別是在滿月前後，當他的神經最薄弱，每一種情感都在表面下燃燒。然後他會看到小天狼星和某個女孩在一起，看著她從他的校服毛衣上摘掉絨毛，或整理他的領帶，或把手臂圍在他的腰上，他會想要撕碎她。

Sometimes he thought it must be so obvious, surely everyone could tell – surely James could tell? Remus would be sitting with them, or walking beside them, or eating breakfast, and his eyes would catch Sirius’s, and how could no one else feel it?
有時候他覺得這一定很明顯，肯定每個人都能看出來——肯定詹姆斯能看出來？雷穆斯會坐在他們旁邊，或走在他們旁邊，或吃早餐，他的眼睛會捕捉到小天狼星的目光，怎麼可能沒有人感受到呢？

It made him feel guilty. Remus wondered if he was lying to Sirius even more than Sirius was lying to himself. Remus was being dishonest about what he wanted, about how much everything meant to him, and in the end he could see that he was confusing Sirius even more. The best thing was to lay everything out, then deal with the consequences.
這讓他感到內疚。雷穆斯想知道他是否比小天狼星對自己撒的謊更多。雷穆斯對自己想要的東西不誠實，對一切對他的意義不誠實，最終他可以看到，他讓小天狼星更加困惑。最好的辦法是把一切攤開來，然後處理後果。

Not yet, though. Maybe after the full moon.
不過還沒到那時候。也許在滿月之後。

 

星期四 1977年1月6日

Remus woke up outside. This was very wrong. The sky above was blue and cracked with clouds. There were trees, black, crooked branches. The breeze was cool on his skin, and the leaf litter soft and mulchy beneath him. Not right, but more pleasant than usual. He blinked against the morning light, and looked around, to see his three friends watching him cautiously. Sirius pulled off his cloak quickly, and handed it to Remus,
雷穆斯醒來時在外面。這很不對。頭頂的天空藍得裂開，佈滿雲朵。周圍有黑色的、扭曲的樹枝。微風在他的皮膚上輕拂，腳下的落葉柔軟而鬆軟。不對，但比平時愉快些。他眨眨眼，迎著晨光四下張望，看到三個朋友謹慎地看著他。小天狼星迅速脫下他的斗篷，遞給雷穆斯，

“Here, it’s chilly…”
“拿著，天有點冷……”

“What happened? Why aren’t we back in the shack?” Remus frowned, pulling the cloak around himself. He noticed that James was panting hard, and holding his arm in a strange way, “Did I hurt you, Prongs?”
“發生什麼事了？我們怎麼沒回到小屋？”雷穆斯皺眉，拉緊斗篷。他注意到詹姆斯喘得厲害，還用奇怪的方式握著胳膊，“我傷到你了嗎，叉子？”

“Not on purpose,” James shook his head, obviously keen to keep Remus calm, “You were… you kept trying to get away from us, that’s all. We couldn’t get you to follow us like normal, not even Padfoot.”
“不是故意的，”詹姆斯搖頭，顯然是想讓雷穆斯保持冷靜，“你……你一直在試圖逃離我們，就是這樣。我們無法像平時那樣讓你跟著我們，連帕丁福特也不行。”

“I remember…” Remus frowned, and climbed to his feet, “Were we hunting?”
“我記得……”雷穆斯皺眉，站起來，“我們在狩獵嗎？”

“You were.” Sirius said, looking at him oddly, “There was something you really wanted to get at. In Hogsmeade.”
“是你。”小天狼星奇怪地看著他，“你真的很想得到某樣東西。在霍格莫德。”

“In Hogsmeade..?” It all came flooding back like a bad dream. That scent. He’d smelled it first on Christmas Eve in the Hog’s Head, and even then he had known what it was. How could he be so stupid? “You’re sure you’re not hurt?” Remus asked, again, looking at James.
“在霍格莫德……？”一切如噩夢般湧上心頭。那股氣味。他第一次聞到是在聖誕夜的豬頭酒吧，甚至那時他就知道那是什麼。他怎麼能這麼愚蠢？“你確定沒受傷？”雷穆斯再次問道，看著詹姆斯。

James nodded fervently, his messy hair bobbing in the morning breeze.
詹姆斯熱切地點點頭，他凌亂的頭髮在晨風中擺動。

“Come on,” he jerked his head, “We’ve got to get you back to the shack before Madam Pomfrey gets there…”
“來吧，”他搖搖頭，“我們得在龐弗雷夫人到達之前把你帶回小屋……”

He followed them, treading gingerly over the stony forest floor in bare feet.
他光著腳小心翼翼地踩過石頭鋪成的森林地面，跟著他們走。

“We’re not too far,” Sirius said, walking slowly beside him, “We managed to sort of… shepherd you in the right direction... but you kept trying to give us the slip.”
“我們離得不遠了，”小天狼星慢慢地走在他旁邊說，“我們設法……把你引向正確的方向……但你一直試圖甩開我們。”

“You all have to go back to the castle,” Remus said, unable to meet their eyes, “I think… I think something might have happened last night.”
“你們都得回城堡，”雷穆斯說，無法直視他們的眼睛，“我覺得……我覺得昨晚可能發生了什麼事。”

“Nothing happened, Moony,” Peter said, “We didn’t lose sight of you once, honestly.”
“沒發生什麼事，月亮臉，”彼得說，“我們一次都沒失去對你的視線，真的。”

“That’s good,” Remus nodded. The shack was in sight now, “But you still ought to go. Trust me.”
“那很好，”雷穆斯點點頭。小屋現在已經看得見了，“但你們還是得走。相信我。”

Thankfully, they did; all still shaken by whatever had taken place just before Remus returned to his human body. Remus entered the shack, dressed and sat quietly on the bed to wait for Madam Pomfrey. She did not come. Instead, it was McGonagall who opened the trap door, almost an hour after daybreak.
幸運的是，他們照做了；所有人仍然因雷穆斯變回人形前發生的事情而感到震驚。雷穆斯進入小屋，穿好衣服，靜靜地坐在床上等龐弗雷夫人。她沒有來。取而代之的是麥格教授，她在天亮後將近一小時打開了暗門。

“Mr Lupin,” she said, in the usual brisk manner she used when a detention was forthcoming.
“盧平先生，”她用通常宣布留堂時的簡潔語氣說道。

“Where’s Madam Pomfrey?” He asked, feeling very cold all of a sudden.
“龐弗雷夫人在哪裡？”他問道，突然感到很冷。

“She’s on other business this morning, in Hogsmeade,” The professor said, her face lined with concern, “She asked me to attend you. Are you injured?”
“她今早有別的事，在霍格莫德，”教授說道，臉上滿是擔憂，“她讓我來照顧你。你受傷了嗎？”

“No, I’m fine. What happened in Hogsmeade?”
“不，我很好。霍格莫德發生了什麼事？”

“Come along, Lupin,” his teacher said, turning quickly back into the tunnel, “If you’re quite well, then we should be getting back to the castle as quickly as possible.”
“跟我來，盧平，”他的老師說，迅速轉回隧道，“如果你沒事，那我們應該盡快回到城堡。”

“Please,” he had to walk quickly to keep up with her, which wasn’t easy when your bones were still settling back into their usual positions, “Please, professor, what happened in Hogsmeade?”
“拜託，”他不得不快步走才能跟上她，這對骨骼還在回到原位的他來說並不容易，“拜託，教授，霍格莫德發生了什麼事？”

“I’m afraid I can’t--”
“恐怕我不能——”

“It was a werewolf, wasn’t it? An attack?”
“那是一隻狼人，對嗎？襲擊？”

“Remus.” She turned and looked at him. They were eye level, these days, and he was still growing. “How do you know?” She asked, sharply.
“雷穆斯。”她轉過身看著他。現在他們的視線在同一水平線上，而且他還在長高。“你怎麼知道的？”她尖銳地問道。

“I could smell it - the other one. I knew they were nearby. It wasn’t me! I swear.”
“我能聞到它——另一個。我知道他們在附近。不是我！我發誓。”

“No, we would know if you had escaped.” She seemed very sure about that, so he didn’t object.
“不是，我們會知道你是否逃脫。”她似乎非常肯定，所以他沒有反對。

“Was it bad?”
“情況很糟嗎？”

“...Yes.”
“……是的。”

“Someone’s dead?”
“有人死了？”

“I’m afraid so. Now I really can’t talk about it, so let’s just get you back to the castle, all right? I know that Poppy usually keeps you in the infirmary for a day or so to rest, but do you think you could go to your lessons as usual today? I think it might be best to avoid any suspicion.”
“恐怕是的。現在我真的不能談論這個，所以我們還是回到城堡，好嗎？我知道波比通常會讓你在醫院休息一兩天，但你認為你今天能像往常一樣上課嗎？我認為這可能是避免任何懷疑的最好方法。”

“Of course.”
“當然。”

“You can come to me if you feel unwell at any point.”
“如果你感到不適，可以隨時來找我。”

“I’ll be fine.” His voice was low and empty. He had never met another one. Now he knew there was one close by.
“我會沒事的。”他的聲音低沉而空洞。他從未見過其他狼人。現在他知道附近有一個。

“Remus,” McGonagall said, giving him a severe look, “This was not your fault. This was nobody's fault. Do you understand?”
“雷穆斯，”麥格教授嚴厲地看著他說，“這不是你的錯。這不是任何人的錯。你明白嗎？”

“Yes, professor.” It was better just to tell adults what they wanted to hear, most of the time. Perhaps he could write to Ferox, or even Moody. Remus desperately wanted to talk to Sirius about it privately, but he supposed he might have to wait a little while.
“是的，教授。”大多數時候，最好告訴成年人他們想聽的話。也許他可以寫信給菲羅克斯，甚至穆迪。雷穆斯迫切想私下跟小天狼星談談，但他猜他可能要等一會兒。

He knew it all, now. There had been another wolf in Hogsmeade over Christmas, and it had been waiting for the full moon. They had to be on Voldemort’s side – on Greyback’s side – because, in Remus’s opinion at least, you’d have to be mad or evil or both to place yourself near other people during a full moon. Ought he to have told somebody that he’d recognised the smell on Christmas eve? Could he have saved a life? He hadn’t been sure, and he hadn’t wanted to get in trouble for sneaking out.
現在他全都知道了。聖誕節期間霍格莫德有另一隻狼人，它一直在等待滿月。他們必須站在伏地魔的一邊——在格雷貝克的一邊——因為至少在雷穆斯看來，只有瘋子、惡棍或兩者兼而有之的人才會在滿月時將自己置於他人附近。他應該告訴別人他在聖誕夜認出了那股氣味嗎？他能救一條命嗎？他不確定，而且他也不想因為偷偷溜出來而惹上麻煩。

The breakfast hall was buzzing with the news; owls were flying back and forth. Lily sat deliberately next to Remus and squeezed his hand under the table. He squeezed back, gratefully, and thought how easy it would be to fall in love with her if he was that type of man.
早餐廳充滿了這個消息的嗡嗡聲；貓頭鷹來回飛行。莉莉故意坐在雷穆斯旁邊，在桌子下握住他的手。他感激地回握，想著如果他是那種人，愛上她會是多麼容易。

“It’s horrible,” Marlene said, tearfully, reading the paper over Mary’s shoulder. “That poor woman, murdered in her bed…”
“太可怕了，”馬琳含淚說，從瑪麗肩膀上看報紙。“那個可憐的女人，被謀殺在床上……”

It had been a young couple, who had moved to Hogsmeade in November. Both magical, but she was muggle born. She was dead, her husband bitten and apparently at St. Mungo’s. Their wedding photo graced the front page of the Prophet, and made Remus sick to look at.
那是一對年輕夫婦，十一月搬到霍格莫德。兩人都是巫師，但她是麻瓜出生。她死了，她的丈夫被咬，顯然在聖芒戈醫院。他們的婚禮照片登上了《預言家日報》的頭版，雷穆斯看了就覺得噁心。

“Is it still on the loose?” Remus asked, keeping the hand which was not holding Lily’s flat on the table, so nobody could see him trembling.
“它還在逃嗎？”雷穆斯問，將沒有握著莉莉的手平放在桌子上，這樣沒人能看到他在顫抖。

“Looks like,” Mary confirmed, still engrossed in the article, “No one could catch it. Tonight’s not a full moon, so we’re all safe for at least another month, I suppose… that’s the trouble with werewolves, if you don’t catch them on the moon, then how are you supposed to catch them at all?”
“看起來是的，”瑪麗確認道，仍然全神貫注於文章，“沒人能抓住它。今晚不是滿月，所以我猜我們至少再安全一個月……這就是狼人問題，如果你不在滿月時抓住他們，那你根本就抓不住他們？”

“There must be a test, or something,” Marlene frowned, “A revealing charm.”
“一定有什麼測試，或者其他東西，”馬琳皺眉道，“一個揭示咒語。”

“Yeah,” Mary replied, thoughtfully, “Maybe… but then you might end up finding the wrong one…”
“是啊，”瑪麗若有所思地回答，“也許……但這樣你可能會找到錯的那個……”

“Well, it sounds like they’re all on you-know-who’s side anyway, so I don’t think it matters—”
“嗯，聽起來他們都站在你知道的那個人那邊，所以我覺得無所謂——”

“Let’s talk about something else.” Lily said, loudly.
“我們聊點別的吧。”莉莉大聲說。

“Yeah,” James nodded, “Defence Against the Darks Arts next – anyone had any luck with their patronus, yet?”
“好吧，”詹姆斯點頭，“下一節是黑魔法防禦術——有人成功召喚出護法了嗎？”

Only James had, so far. Half an hour later, the class stood slack-jawed and watched James produce a spectacular silver stag, which galloped ghostly around the room. The teacher applauded, and invited everyone else to try – with varying levels of success. Lily managed a wisp of something, but it wasn’t clear yet what it was. Peter had no luck at all, and (to the surprise of nobody) Sirius cast something distinctly dog-shaped, but without the solid brightness of James’s creation.
目前為止只有詹姆斯成功了。半小時後，全班目瞪口呆地看著詹姆斯召喚出一隻壯觀的銀色雄鹿，它如幽靈般在房間裡奔跑。老師鼓掌，邀請其他人嘗試——成功程度不一。莉莉召喚出一縷東西，但尚不清楚那是什麼。彼得完全沒有成功，（沒人驚訝）小天狼星召喚出明顯是狗形的東西，但沒有詹姆斯的護法那麼明亮。

Remus didn’t so much as feel his wand flinch. He oughtn’t to have been surprised – on a morning like that it was impossible to pin down a happy thought for very long, besides which, he was exhausted from the full moon.
雷穆斯的魔杖連動都沒有動。他不應該感到驚訝——在那樣的早晨，根本無法長時間抓住一個快樂的念頭，況且，他因滿月而筋疲力盡。

“You’ll get, it, Moony,” Sirius encouraged, patting him awkwardly on the back as they left the classroom. “You always do.”
“你會成功的，月亮臉，”小天狼星鼓勵道，當他們離開教室時尷尬地拍了拍他的背。“你總是能做到的。”

Remus nodded, wondering what Sirius’s happy thought was. Remus had been using various memories of their Christmas together, though with poor results.
雷穆斯點點頭，想知道小天狼星的快樂念頭是什麼。雷穆斯一直在用他們一起過聖誕節的各種回憶，儘管效果不佳。

“My mind’s elsewhere, to be honest,” he said, quietly, so that only Sirius could hear him.
“說實話，我的心思在別處，”他輕聲說，只有小天狼星能聽見。

“Of course,” Sirius replied, just as quietly, “That’s to be expected.”
“當然，”小天狼星同樣輕聲回答，“這是意料之中的。”

“I knew about it.” Remus whispered, quickly, as the last few students left the room. Sirius stopped, staring at him with that awful look he’d had that morning. Remus grabbed his arm, “I mean, not exactly, I didn’t know that would happen, but…”
“我知道這件事。”雷穆斯迅速低聲說，當最後幾個學生離開房間時。小天狼星停下來，用早上那種可怕的眼神盯著他。雷穆斯抓住他的手臂，“我是說，不完全是，我不知道會發生那件事，但……”

Sirius closed the door behind the last student, and whispered a silencing spell.
小天狼星在最後一個學生身後關上門，低聲施了一個靜音咒。

“But what?”
“但什麼？”

“Remember when we went to the Hog’s Head?” Remus said, quickly, and still whispering because he couldn’t seem to raise his voice. Sirius nodded, “I smelled something.”
“記得我們去豬頭酒吧的時候嗎？”雷穆斯迅速說，仍然低聲說，因為他似乎無法提高聲音。小天狼星點點頭，“我聞到了一些東西。”

“I thought you were just pissed…”
“我以為你只是喝醉了……”

“Yeah,” Remus nodded, “I think maybe I did too – or I thought it was… um… well, you, because I wanted…” he cleared his throat, “Anyway, it was definitely another one. A werewolf. I think it was female.”
“是啊，”雷穆斯點點頭，“我想也許我也是這麼想的——或者我以為那是……嗯……好吧，是你，因為我想……”他清了清喉嚨，“總之，那絕對是另一個。狼人。我想她是女性。”

“Not Greyback, then.” Sirius said, with a look of immense relief.
“那就不是格雷貝克了。”小天狼星說，顯得極為鬆了口氣。

“No.” Remus said.
“不。”雷穆斯說。

“Well, thank Godric for that.” Sirius grasped Remus’s shoulder. His face turned to worry again, just as quickly, “But Moony, if you could smell them, do you think that they could…”
“那真是太好了。”小天狼星抓住雷穆斯的肩膀。他的臉又迅速變得擔憂，“但月亮臉，如果你能聞到他們，你認為他們可以……”

“I don’t know. I think so.”
“我不知道。我想是的。”

“Ok. Ok, well they didn’t come after you, so… Everything will be fine.” He was still holding Remus by the shoulder, keeping him in place, like an anchor. It was desperately needed, Remus thought. Every instinct in him said to run.
“好吧。好吧，他們沒來找你，所以……一切都會好的。”他還是抓著雷穆斯的肩膀，把他固定在原地，像一個錨。雷穆斯想，這是非常需要的。他的每一個本能都在說要逃跑。

Remus thought for a moment Sirius might kiss him, but they had another lesson to go to, and the DADA teacher had returned, knocking on his own classroom door in confusion. Sirius looked disappointed (or at least, Remus thought so – it might have been wishful thinking) and gave a final squeeze before they parted.
雷穆斯想了一會兒，小天狼星可能會吻他，但他們還有另一節課要上，而且黑魔法防禦術老師已經回來了，困惑地敲著自己的教室門。小天狼星看起來很失望（至少，雷穆斯這麼想——這可能是他的一廂情願），在他們分開前最後擠了一下。

“Don’t tell James!” Remus said, hurriedly, as they unlocked the door, “Please, don’t tell anyone.”
“不要告訴詹姆斯！”雷穆斯匆忙說，當他們打開門時，“拜託，不要告訴任何人。”

“Ok, Moony,” Sirius nodded slowly, “Anything you want.”
“好的，月亮臉，”小天狼星慢慢點頭，“你要什麼我都會做。”

 

 

 

Chapter 105: Sixth Year: Spilling Secrets 

Friday 14th January 1977

Remus tossed and turned under his bedsheets, unable to settle. His bed at Hogwarts rated as one of the most comfortable he had ever slept in – a close second to the one he used at the Potter’s, anyway. Rarely had he ever struggled to sleep in it. But the past few nights had been almost entirely sleepless.
雷木斯在床上翻來覆去，無法入睡。他在霍格華茲的床被評為他睡過的最舒適的床之一——至少與他在波特家用的床相比接近第二名。他很少在這張床上難以入睡。但過去幾晚幾乎完全無法入睡。

He couldn’t stop thinking about the werewolf in Hogsmeade, about the poor dead woman, and the man who would wake up in St Mungo’s to find that his entire life had been destroyed. Remus had been afflicted for as long as he could remember – the thought of this man being forced to transform for the first time – probably alone, probably still grieving. It was unbearable. He felt a horrible, unmoveable sense of guilt.
他無法停止思考霍格斯密的狼人、那個可憐的死去的女人，以及那個會在聖蒙戈醫院醒來發現整個生活被摧毀的男人。雷木斯從記憶開始就一直受到詛咒——想到這個男人第一次被迫變身——可能是獨自一人，可能還在哀悼。這讓人無法忍受。他感到一種可怕的、無法移動的內疚感。

So Remus did not sleep. He had been resorting to reading most of the night, until he couldn’t keep his eyes open any longer. Tonight, he couldn’t even concentrate on a book.
所以雷木斯沒有睡覺。他幾乎整晚都在讀書，直到他再也無法睜開眼睛。今晚，他甚至無法專注於一本書。

He rolled onto his front, to see if that would help. No, his face was all squashed in his pillow that way. He rolled on his side, but this made his hip hurt. The other side made his ear too hot. He groaned under his breath.
他翻到身子的一側，看看是否會有幫助。不，這樣他的臉被擠壓在枕頭上。他側身，卻使他的臀部感到疼痛。另一邊則使他的耳朵太熱。他低聲呻吟。

“Oi, Moony,” Sirius whispered, as the curtains parted, “What’s wrong?” He crawled inside silently, with a quick lumos and a silencing spell. He knelt at the end of the bed, looking at Remus.
“喂，月亮狼，”小天狼星低聲說，拉開窗簾，“怎麼了？”他靜靜地爬了進來，施了個光明咒和靜音咒。他跪在床邊，看著雷木斯。

“Sorry, did I wake you up?” Remus squinted at the unnecessary brightness.
“對不起，我把你吵醒了嗎？”雷木斯瞇著眼看著那不必要的亮光。

“Yeah, but it’s ok.” Sirius shifted and plonked himself down next to Remus.
“是的，但沒關係。”小天狼星移了移身體，重重地坐在雷木斯旁邊。

“Oh,” Remus twisted his mouth, embarrassed, “Look, I’m not really in the mood for…”
“哦，”雷木斯扭了扭嘴巴，感到尷尬，“看，我現在真的沒心情……”

“Oh, no, me neither! I mean… well, actually, now you mention it… but no, not why I came over.”
“哦，不，我也沒有！我的意思是……其實，現在你提到這個……但不是我過來的原因。”

“Right.”
“對。”

“So, what’s up?”
“那麼，怎麼了？”

“Can’t sleep.”
“無法入睡。”

“I can tell. Want a fag?”
“我能看出來。要抽根煙嗎？”

“Run out.”
“沒有了。”

“It’s ok, I’ve got some off Emmeline. C’mon, shall we go downstairs? It's late, no one’ll be there and Prongs’ll give us shit if we smoke here.”
“沒關係，我有一些是從艾美琳那裡弄來的。來吧，我們下樓去吧？現在很晚了，沒人會在那裡，還有，如果我們在這裡抽煙，角狼會給我們麻煩的。”

“Ok.” Remus pretended to go reluctantly. Secretly he was thrilled that:
“好的。”雷木斯假裝不情願地去。秘密裡他很興奮的是：

Sirius was worried about him, and;
小天狼星擔心他，並且；

Sirius wanted to spend time alone with him without waking up James.
小天狼星想和他單獨待會兒而不吵醒詹姆斯。

The fact that the offered cigarettes came from Sirius’s current girlfriend was a fact Remus was willing to overlook for now. Downstairs, they settled by the window, on the little loveseat there. Both drew their knees up and sat facing each other, so that if Remus stretched just a little their toes would touch.
提供的香煙來自小天狼星現在的女朋友，這一點雷木斯現在願意忽略。下樓後，他們在那裡的小沙發旁坐下了。兩人都把膝蓋縮起來，面對面坐著，以便雷木斯稍微伸展一下腳趾就能碰到對方。

“So,” Sirius sucked in, lighting a cigarette wordlessly then passing it to Remus, before lighting his own. It was probably something that impressed girls. It impressed Remus too, but he wasn't going to show it. “What's the plan?”
“那麼，”小天狼星吸了一口，無言點燃一支香煙，然後把它遞給雷木斯，接著點燃自己的香煙。這可能是會讓女孩印象深刻的事。雷木斯也覺得印象深刻，但他不打算表現出來。“計劃是什麼？”

“Plan?” Remus frowned.
“計劃？”雷木斯皺著眉頭。

“You’ve been up all night for the past three nights and you haven’t got a plan?! Are you sure you’re Moony??”
“你這幾晚都沒睡過，你還沒有計劃？！你確定你是月亮狼嗎？”

“I want to go back to The Hog’s Head.” Remus said, promptly.
“我想回到酒吧頭。”雷木斯迅速地說。

Sirius let his eyes flicker, but took this news in slowly. He exhaled smoke, looking out of the dark window at the waning moon above them before returning to Remus to speak.
小天狼星的眼神閃爍了一下，但慢慢接受了這個消息。他吐了口煙，望向窗外那微弱的月亮，然後回頭對雷木斯說話。

“Right. Ok, I think I can understand why.” He took a hard drag on his cigarette, “Invisible?”
“對。好的，我想我能理解為什麼。”他狠狠地抽了一口煙，“隱形？”

“No.” Remus shook his head, taking short, nervous pulls on his fag, “No, if they’re there – if she’s there, then I want to meet her.”
“不。”雷木斯搖頭，短暫而緊張地抽了一口煙，“不，如果他們在那裡——如果她在那裡，那麼我想見她。”

“Remus. No.”
“雷木斯。不行。”

“Why not?” Remus shot back, hotly. He was ready for a fight, if Sirius wanted one. That would feel good; that would be something.
“為什麼不？”雷木斯激烈地反駁。如果小天狼星想打架，他已經準備好了。那會讓人感覺好一些；那會是什麼。

“Because it's dangerous?! Because you’ve never met them before and you don’t know what they’re like except that they murdered a woman the other night?! Because you’re not even seventeen yet and if you have to defend yourself with magic you could get kicked out of school??”
“因為這很危險？！因為你從未見過他們，你不知道他們是什麼樣的人，只知道他們前晚殺了一個女人？！因為你還不到十七歲，如果你必須用魔法自衛，你可能會被開除？”

Sirius was staring at him as he said all of this, incredulous. Remus blinked in shock. He stubbed out his cigarette and stood up, using his height against Sirius,
小天狼星在說這些話時盯著他，感到不可置信。雷木斯震驚地眨了眨眼。他熄滅了香煙，站起來，利用自己的身高對抗小天狼星，

“You can’t tell me what to do. Just don’t get in my way.”
“你不能告訴我該怎麼做。只要別擋我路就行了。”

“Don’t be like that! Look, I understand how you feel--”
“別這樣！看，我理解你的感受——”

“Ha.”
“哈。”

“Ok, I don’t understand,” Sirius shook his head impatiently, “but I want you to be safe!”
“好的，我不理解，”小天狼星不耐煩地搖頭，“但我希望你安全！”

“I will be - it’s ages until the next full moon, she won’t have any advantage over me--”
“我會的——下次滿月還有很久，她不會對我有任何優勢——”

“Don’t you think this is exactly what Greyback wants?!”
“你不覺得這正是格雷巴克想要的嗎？！”

“What are you saying?” Remus growled. “That I’m being stupid?”
“你在說什麼？”雷木斯低聲咆哮。“你是說我很愚蠢嗎？”

“No, not stupid, just… reckless.”
“不，不是愚蠢，只是……魯莽。”

“Sirius Black, lecturing me on recklessness? Very bloody funny, that.”
“小天狼星·布萊克，給我講授魯莽？真是特別好笑。”

“Oi.” Sirius stood up now, angry.
“喂。”小天狼星現在站起來，生氣。

Yes, here we go, something in Remus said, go on, try it.
是的，來了，雷木斯心裡想，來吧，試試吧。

“Well it’s pretty rich of you to tell me not to put myself in danger.” Remus continued, knowing he was being cruel, “You weren’t so concerned about my safety this time last year!”
“嗯，你告訴我不要把自己置於危險中，這真是夠有錢的。”雷木斯繼續說，知道自己有些殘忍，“去年這個時候你可沒那麼擔心我的安全！”

Sirius’s face fell, he looked down at the carpet and Remus saw what he had done.
小天狼星的臉色變了，他看向地毯，雷木斯看到了他所做的事。

“That’s… that’s not fair, Moony.” Sirius said, quietly.
“那……那不公平，月亮狼。”小天狼星低聲說。

Life’s not fair, Remus wanted to say - but he knew how childish and petulant that would sound. This wasn’t an argument either of them was going to win, and he was tired, so exhausted from worrying and thinking and imagining and not sleeping.
雷木斯想說，生活不公平——但他知道那聽起來會多麼幼稚和任性。這不是他們任何一方能贏得的爭論，而且他很累，因為擔心、思考、想像和無法入睡而感到疲憊。

“I have to meet them.” He said, finally. “I think I’ll go mad otherwise. I think I’m already going mad.”
“我必須見他們。”他最終說，“否則我覺得我會瘋掉。我覺得我已經快瘋了。”

“Ok.” Sirius recovered, and ran his hand through his hair. “Ok, what about Ferox, have you tried talking to him?”
“好的。”小天狼星恢復了過來，手插進頭髮裡。“好的，那費羅克斯怎麼樣，你試過和他談談嗎？”

“Thought about it. He’ll try to stop me. Moody too. It’s their idea not to let me go to Hogsmeade in the first place.”
“考慮過了。他會試圖阻止我。穆迪也是。他們的主意是不讓我去霍格斯密。”

“All right… all right, we’ll go, ok? Together. We’ll tell James, and--”
“好吧……好吧，我們去，好嗎？一起去。我們會告訴詹姆斯，然後——”

“I don’t want anyone else to know.” Remus said, fiercely, “It’s private.”
“我不想讓其他人知道。”雷木斯激烈地說，“這是私事。”

“Merlin, Moony, you’re not making this easy--”
“梅林啊，月亮狼，你讓這事變得不容易——”

“It’s not easy! It’s fucking difficult, ok, but I have to do it!”
“這不容易！這他媽的很難，好吧，但我必須做到！”

“Ok!” Sirius raised both hands in a peace-making gesture.
“好的！”小天狼星雙手舉起，表示和解。

We’re fighting, Remus thought, we’re fighting and he’s the one trying to calm me down. That made him feel a bit dizzy, and he sat down on the nearest sofa. He leaned forward, head in his hands.
我們在爭吵，雷木斯想，我們在爭吵，而他卻在試圖讓我冷靜下來。這讓他有點暈眩，他坐在最近的沙發上，身子前傾，頭埋在雙手裡。

“I’m sorry,” he said, in a small voice, “I know I’m being… it’s just all so…”
“對不起，”他小聲說，“我知道我很……這一切都……”

“I do understand, Moony.” Sirius sat next to him. “I’m trying to help.”
“我理解的，月亮狼。”小天狼星坐在他旁邊。“我在試圖幫助。”

“You can’t help,” Remus said, “I have to do this on my own, I can’t risk anyone else, it has to be me, I have to…” Remus began talking, and it all came out in a jumble of sleep-deprived babble. “If I can meet her, then maybe… I have to meet Greyback, one day. I just know I have to. And I want to - not to join him, or anything like that, just to - to know him. And to understand. Why he did what he did and why… why he made me who I am.”
“你不能幫忙，”雷木斯說，“我必須自己做這事，我不能冒其他人的風險，必須是我，我必須……”雷木斯開始說話，所有話語都在睡眠不足的胡言亂語中湧出。“如果我能見到她，那也許……我有一天必須見到格雷巴克。我知道我必須這樣做。而且我想——不是要加入他，或其他那樣的事，只是——了解他。並理解。他為什麼做了他所做的事，以及為什麼……為什麼他讓我成為我現在的樣子。”

Tears had sprung out of nowhere, and he covered his face, ashamed. Sirius was quiet beside him.
淚水突然湧出，他捂住臉，感到羞愧。小天狼星在他旁邊安靜地坐著。

“Moony…” he laid a cool, tentative hand on Remus’s shoulder, lightly, as if Remus might spin around and snap at him like a wild animal, “He didn’t make you who you are.”
“月亮狼……”他輕輕地把冰涼的手放在雷木斯的肩上，像是雷木斯會突然轉身像野獸一樣咬他，“他沒有讓你成為你現在的樣子。”

“He made me what I am.” Oh god, he was sobbing, now. He wished he hadn’t started this whole conversation, wished he’d just sent Sirius back to bed.
“他把我變成了現在的樣子。”哦天啊，他現在哭得很厲害。他希望自己沒開始這整個對話，希望自己只是把小天狼星送回床上。

The last time he’d cried had been a similar situation - he had been sitting next to a boy he loved, saying something which hurt to say. Grant had held him, and made him feel like everything would be all right. Remus knew he had no right to expect the same from Sirius.
上次他哭的時候是類似的情況——他坐在他愛的男孩旁邊，說出一些傷人的話。格蘭特擁抱了他，讓他覺得一切都會好起來。雷木斯知道他無權期望小天狼星能給予同樣的安慰。

As Remus’s shoulders began to shake with emotion, Sirius moved slightly, but he didn’t go anywhere. Remus heard him give a strange little noise – which might have been sympathetic, or just confused, but he shifted closer and slid his hand down into Remus’s and squeezed his fingers. Pathetically, Remus squeezed back as he wept angrily about Greyback, and the poor murdered woman, and the dreadful unfairness of everything.
當雷木斯的肩膀開始因情緒而顫抖時，小天狼星稍微移動了一下，但他沒有離開。雷木斯聽到他發出了一聲奇怪的小聲音——可能是同情，也可能是困惑，但他向雷木斯靠近，把手滑進雷木斯的手中，緊緊握住他的手指。可憐的是，雷木斯在憤怒地哭泣關於格雷巴克、那個可憐的被殺女人，以及一切的可怕不公平時，手指也回握住小天狼星。

Saturday 15th January 1977

Remus woke up at dawn, still curled up on the couch, covered in a woollen blanket from the dresser kept in the corner of the common room. He frowned against the sunlight, blinking and confused while he slowly remembered where he was. Sirius was still there, at the other end, sitting up with his head lolling back in sleep, mouth open. Of course Sirius didn’t snore.
雷木斯在黎明時分醒來，仍然蜷縮在沙發上，裹著一條從公共休息室角落的衣櫃裡拿出來的毛毯。他皺起眉頭對抗陽光，眨眼且困惑地慢慢記起自己身在何處。小天狼星仍然在那邊，坐著，頭靠在後面睡著了，嘴巴張開。當然，小天狼星不打鼾。

Remus wished he could watch him for a bit longer in the dim early light, but he had been scrunched up all night and desperately needed to stretch. He moved carefully, his stiff limbs creaking like the branches of an ancient yew. Sirius stirred, coughed lightly and opened his eyes.
雷木斯希望能在昏暗的清晨光線中多看一會兒他，但他整夜蜷縮著，急需伸展。他小心翼翼地移動，僵硬的四肢像古老的紫杉樹枝一樣發出吱吱聲。小天狼星醒來了，輕輕咳嗽了一下，睜開了眼睛。

“Morning,” he grunted, straightening up. “What time is it?”
“早安，”他咕噥道，挺直身子。“現在幾點？”

“Nearly seven.” Remus replied, after a quick glance at the grandfather clock.
“差不多七點。”雷木斯回答道，快速瞥了一眼落地鐘。

“James’ll be up for quidditch in a minute.”
“詹姆斯一會兒就要起來打魁地奇了。”

“Yeah.”
“是的。”

“You ok?”
“你還好嗎？”

Remus set his bare feet down on the carpet and rubbed the pins and needles out of his left leg.
雷木斯把赤腳放在地毯上，揉搓著左腿上的刺痛感。

“I slept, at least.” He replied. “Sorry for last night.”
“至少我睡了。”他回答說。“對不起昨晚。”

“Pff.” Sirius waved his hand, yawning, “It was nothing. I’ve had much worse meltdowns.”
“噗。”小天狼星揮了揮手，打著哈欠，“沒什麼。我以前經歷過更糟糕的崩潰。”

“What are you two tossers doing down here at this hour?” James came bounding down the stairs, broom in hand. He looked at them both, took in their pyjamas and Remus’s blanket. “Did you sleep here?”
“你們這兩個傢伙在這個時候在這裡幹什麼？”詹姆斯拿著掃帚奔下樓梯。他看著他們倆，注意到他們穿著睡衣和雷木斯的毛毯。“你們在這裡睡了嗎？”

“Had to,” Sirius replied, stretching, “Anything to get away from your snoring.”
“不得不這樣，”小天狼星回答，伸展身體，“無論如何都要逃離你的鼾聲。”

James grinned, shaking his head.
詹姆斯咧嘴笑了，搖了搖頭。

“Weirdos. Don’t fancy joining me for a quick go around the pitch before practice, Padfoot?”
“一群怪胎。想不想跟我一起在練習前快速繞場地一圈，帕德腳？”

“Nah,” Sirius yawned again, “I’m going back to bed. It’s Saturday, Potter, you lunatic.”
“不，”小天狼星再次打著哈欠，“我要回去睡覺。今天是星期六，波特，你這個瘋子。”

“It’s Hogsmeade, later, don’t oversleep.” James warned, “Sorry, Moony.” He gave an apologetic glance.
“稍後要去霍格斯密，別睡過頭了。”詹姆斯警告說，“對不起，月亮狼。”他給了雷木斯一個抱歉的眼神。

“S’ok,” Remus replied, “You lot go and have fun. I’ve got homework. Obviously. The common room will be nice and quiet.”
“沒關係，”雷木斯回答，“你們去玩吧。我有作業要做。顯然。公共休息室會很安靜。”

“See you both for breakfast, then?” James asked, halfway out of the room already, eager to be the first on the pitch.
“那早餐見吧？”詹姆斯問，已經半出房間，急於成為第一個到達場地的人。

The common room would start filling up, soon - the Gryffindor quidditch team first, then some of the keener students looking to get their homework out of the way before the trip into the village scheduled for later. Remus looked at Sirius,
公共休息室很快就會開始熱鬧起來——首先是格蘭芬多的魁地奇隊，然後是一些急於在稍後的村莊之行之前完成作業的學生。雷木斯看向小天狼星，

“Are you really going back to bed?”
“你真的要回去睡覺嗎？”

Sirius raised an eyebrow.
小天狼星挑了挑眉。

“Yeah. Want to come?”
“是的。想來嗎？”

For the first time in days, Remus laughed.
幾天來第一次，雷木斯笑了。

“Hi Remus, can I sit here?”
“嗨，雷木斯，我可以坐這裡嗎？”

Remus looked up with a small frown that had more to do with a complex Astronomy chart than being interrupted. He smiled as soon as he saw who it was, and nodded,
雷木斯抬頭時皺起了小眉頭，這更多是因為複雜的天文圖表而不是被打擾。他一看到對方是誰就笑了起來，點了點頭，

“Of course, Chris, take your pick.” He motioned to the five empty chairs at the table he was using. Christopher sat just one seat away from Remus. “Didn’t fancy Hogsmeade?”
“當然，克里斯，隨便選吧。”他示意那張桌子上的五把空椅子。克里斯多坐在雷木斯旁邊一個座位上。“不想去霍格斯密嗎？”

“Oh, well, I knew you couldn’t go, and I’m behind on a few things, so…” Christopher looked slightly nervous. He sat with his notebooks and parchment clutched in his lap, eyeing Remus shiftily.
“哦，我知道你不能去，而且我還有一些事情沒做完，所以……”克里斯托弗看起來有點緊張。他坐著，膝蓋上放著筆記本和羊皮紙，警惕地看著雷木斯。

“Er… did you want to get your work out?” Remus prompted, vaguely amused.
“呃……你想做你的作業嗎？”雷木斯提示道，有些好笑。

“Yeah! Sorry…” Christopher quickly started spreading out his notes, awkwardly, blushing fiercely.
“是的！對不起……”克里斯托弗迅速地把筆記展開，尷尬地臉紅。

“You ok, Chris?”
“你還好嗎，克里斯？”

“Mm hmm, yep…”
“嗯嗯，是的……”

“Ok. Well, I’m doing Astronomy and making a proper mess of it. You’re quite good at stars and stuff, aren’t you?”
“好吧。我在做天文作業，搞得一團糟。你對星星之類的東西很在行，不是嗎？”

“Yeah. I mean not brilliant. But ok, yeah, er… want me to look?”
“是的。我的意思是還不是很出色。但還好，是的，呃……要我看看嗎？”

“Thanks,” Remus slid over his chart.
“謝謝，”雷木斯把他的圖表滑過去。

“Oh right, I can see where you’ve gone wrong, you’re a few degrees out…” Christopher pulled out his compass and began plotting a new trajectory for Venus. Remus was quite happy to let him get on with it, and started flicking through his planner. He had History to do, but had perversely planned to save it for last as a treat. He could probably tell Christopher that to lighten the mood; it was the sort of thing Chris did too. Sirius would only shake his head in bafflement and call him a swot.
“哦，我看到你哪裡搞錯了，你偏差了幾度……”克里斯托弗拿出他的羅盤，開始為金星繪製新的軌跡。雷木斯很樂意讓他繼續進行，並開始翻看他的計劃本。他有歷史作業要做，但出於一種逆反心理計劃把它留到最後當作獎勳。他可以告訴克里斯托弗來輕鬆一下心情；這也是克里斯做的事。小天狼星只會困惑地搖搖頭，叫他書呆子。

He was just about to say something, when Christopher beat him to it.
他正要說些什麼時，克里斯托弗搶先了。

“I started reading some muggle books.” He said, in a rush, as if he had been building up to it for a while. “Over Christmas.”
“我開始讀一些麻瓜書了。”他匆忙地說，好像他已經酝酿了一段時間。“在聖誕節期間。”

“Did you?” Remus smiled, politely. He’d been telling Christopher for ages that he was limiting himself by not reading books by non-magical authors. “How’d you get on?”
“是嗎？”雷木斯禮貌地笑了笑。他已經告訴克里斯托弗很久了，不讀非魔法作者的書是在限制自己。“你讀得怎麼樣？”

“Yeah! It’s been great. I like poetry best…” It was a fairly innocuous statement, but Christopher looked as though he was spilling his very darkest secret. His cheeks were crimson now, and he wasn’t looking at Remus when he spoke. “I er… I like Oscar Wilde, a lot.”
“是的！讀得很好。我最喜歡詩……”這是一個相當無害的聲明，但克里斯托弗看起來好像在洩露他最黑暗的秘密。他的臉頰現在紅得像火一樣，說話時不看雷木斯。“我呃……我非常喜歡奧斯卡·王爾德。”

“Oh?” Remus replied, steadily, wondering where this was going.
“哦？”雷木斯穩定地回答，想知道接下來會怎樣。

He thought he had a pretty good idea what Christopher was getting at, actually, but he needed to stall for time while he worked out how to react. Surely they weren’t going to talk about this here and now, at three o’clock on a Saturday in an only half empty common room? There were first years playing gobstones on the carpet, for goodness sake!
他其實對克里斯托弗想表達的內容有了相當清楚的想法，但他需要拖延時間，以便弄清楚如何反應。他們不會在這裡、現在，星期六下午三點，僅半滿的公共休息室裡討論這個話題吧？天哪，地毯上還有一年級學生在玩石子！

“Yes, and… and Christopher Isherwood.” Chris continued, valiantly. It was brave, Remus decided. It was maybe the bravest thing he had ever witnessed.
“是的，還有……還有克里斯托弗·伊舍伍德。”克里斯勇敢地繼續說。雷木斯決定這是勇敢的。這可能是他見過的最勇敢的事情。

“Right, yeah…” He cleared his throat, wishing he knew the right way to respond. “You might like Truman Capote, too.”
“對，是的……”他清了清喉嚨，希望自己知道如何正確回應。“你也許會喜歡特魯曼·卡波特。”

Christopher looked at him, half eager, half afraid.
克里斯托弗看著他，半期待半害怕。

“They’re er… they’re your sort of writers too, then?” Christopher was gnawing his lip very hard now, Remus was worried he would bite through the skin.
“他們呃……他們也是你喜歡的作家嗎？”克里斯托弗現在非常用力地咬著嘴唇，雷木斯擔心他會咬破皮膚。

“Um… yeah.”
“嗯……是的。”

He didn’t know how he felt about it really. He’d had an inkling – more than an inkling – about Christopher for quite some time. But he hadn’t expected this in a million years. Christopher looked incredibly relieved, and leaned in,
他真的不知道自己對此有什麼感覺。他對克里斯托弗早有些預感——不只是預感。但他萬萬沒想到會是這樣。克里斯托弗看起來非常放鬆，向他靠近，

“How long have you known?” He whispered.
“你知道了多久？”他低聲問道。

Remus leaned back, panicking over who might be listening. He glanced around quickly, then rubbed the back of his head.
雷木斯向後靠去，驚慌地擔心會有人在偷聽。他迅速地掃視了一下四周，然後揉了揉頭後。

“Christ.” He breathed, “I really need a cigarette. Want to go for a walk?”
“天哪。”他嘆了口氣，“我真的需要一根香煙。想去散步嗎？”

This was perhaps the worst possible time to talk about this. But that wasn’t Christopher’s fault. Christopher didn’t know about the werewolf situation, or Greyback, or Sirius’s nonsensical attitude to sexuality, or even that the marauders were planning to go to war in just a year’s time. Christopher only knew one thing, and Remus knew that he needed a friend.
這也許是談論這個話題的最糟糕時機。但這不是克里斯托弗的錯。克里斯托弗不知道狼人情況，或格雷巴克，或小天狼星對性取向的荒謬態度，甚至不知道調皮鬼們計劃在一年後開戰。克里斯托弗只知道一件事，雷木斯知道他需要一位朋友。

They went to the Astronomy Tower, knowing it was likely to be empty – all of the couples were in Hogsmeade today. They sat outside, backs against the parapet, and Remus smoked and Christopher twisted his hands in his lap.
他們去了天文塔，知道那裡可能會空蕩蕩的——所有的情侶今天都在霍格斯密。他們坐在外面，背靠著欄杆，雷木斯抽煙，而克里斯托弗在腿上扭動著手。

“How long have you known?” He asked again.
“你知道了多久？”他再次問道。

“Since I was fifteen.” Remus replied. “Summer before last. You?”
“從我十五歲時開始。”雷木斯回答。“前年的夏天。你呢？”

“Um… I think I sort of always had an idea. But. Yeah, maybe only for a few months.”
“嗯……我想我一直都有這樣的想法。但。是的，也許只有幾個月。”

“It’s going to be ok, you know.” Remus said, hoping he sounded believable. It wasn’t exactly a lie - but he didn’t know for sure.
“你知道的，一切會好的。”雷木斯說，希望自己聽起來可信。這不完全是一個謊言——但他不確定。

“Do the other marauders know? About you?”
“其他的調皮鬼知道嗎？關於你？”

Remus flinched, remembering the heat of Sirius’s skin against him from earlier that morning. How he had held his hand as he cried. How he had left breakfast early to meet Emmeline. He shook his head,
雷木斯畏縮了一下，記起了早晨小天狼星肌膚的溫熱。他如何在他哭泣時握住他的手。他如何提前離開早餐去見艾梅琳。他搖了搖頭，

“Nah. Not yet.”
“不，還沒有。”

“None of my friends know. You’re the only person I’ve told.”
“我所有的朋友都不知道。你是我唯一告訴過的人。”

Remus didn’t know what to say about that. Not everybody had a Grant, he supposed. He half laughed, half sighed.
雷木斯不知道該怎麼說。不每個人都有格蘭特，他猜想。他一半笑著，一半嘆了口氣。

“Sorry, Chris. Wish I had some advice or something, but I’m just muddling through.”
“對不起，克里斯。希望我能給點建議，但我也只是勉強過日子。”

“That’s ok. It’s just good to know there’s someone else… is it like this with muggles?”
“沒關係。知道還有別人也很好……這樣對麻瓜也是這樣嗎？”

“Hm? Oh, well… I mean there are queer muggles, yeah. Obviously, Oscar Wilde and that. They used to be able to send you to prison, but it’s ok now. Well. Not ok. It’s not… I mean, it’s still better not to be queer, I suppose. What about with wizards?”
“嗯？哦，嗯……我的意思是有奇怪的麻瓜，對，奧斯卡·王爾德之類的。他們以前能把你送進監獄，但現在已經沒事了。嗯。不是完全的好。我的意思是……我想，還是最好不要是奇怪的。我想，巫師呢？”

“Same,” Christopher replied, glumly, “Better not to be.”
“一樣。”克里斯托弗沮喪地回答，“最好不要是。”

They were quiet for a bit. Remus started another cigarette. It was becoming a dreadful habit; he struggled to climb the stairs any more without wheezing.
他們沉默了一會兒。雷木斯點燃了另一根香煙。這已經變成了一個可怕的習慣；他爬樓梯時再也無法不喘氣了。

“Remus?” Christopher said.
“雷木斯？”克里斯托弗說。

“Yeah?”
“嗯？”

“I’m glad… er, I’m glad that if there was anyone else who… knew… then I’m glad it’s you.”
“我很高興……呃，我很高興如果還有其他人……知道……那我很高興是你。”

God. Remus thought, why’d you have to be so bloody sweet?
天哪。雷木斯想，為什麼你要如此甜美？

All in all, it had been a very busy Saturday. And it wasn’t over yet, Remus told himself as he lay in the dark, still as possible, waiting for his friends’ breathing to level out, to tell him they were all asleep. He was keeping still and quiet to try and trick Sirius - he couldn’t afford an interruption tonight. He had places to be.
總的來說，這是一個非常忙碌的星期六。雷木斯告訴自己，當他在黑暗中躺著，儘量保持靜止，等待朋友們的呼吸變得平穩，告訴他們已經都睡著了。他保持靜止和安靜，試圖欺騙小天狼星——他今晚不能承擔打擾。他有地方要去。

Yes, ok; he had told Sirius he wouldn’t go to The Hog’s Head. Or at least that he wouldn’t go without him. But, Remus justified to himself, this was too important, and he had to go alone. He couldn’t be responsible for putting any more people in danger than he already had. And, actually, he thought, grumpily, as he began to creep out of the room, James’s cloak stuffed under his robes, who was Sirius to demand anything from Remus? Tossing each other off every now and then clearly didn’t mean they had any special claim on each other. Sirius couldn’t have everything his way.
是的，好吧；他曾告訴小天狼星他不會去“豬頭酒吧”。或者至少說他不會在沒有他的情況下去。但雷木斯告訴自己，這太重要了，他必須獨自去。他不能再讓更多的人陷入危險。其實，他心情不好地想到，當他開始悄悄地離開房間，詹姆斯的斗篷塞在他的袍子下時，小天狼星憑什麼要求雷木斯做什麼？偶爾互相擺弄顯然並不意味著他們對彼此有任何特殊的要求。小天狼星不能總是按自己的方式來。

He covered himself with the invisibility cloak in the darkness of the stairway, and then stole quietly through the half empty common room and out of the portrait hole. He had the map and he had his wand, and nothing else.
他在樓梯的黑暗中披上了隱形斗篷，然後悄悄地穿過半滿的公共休息室，走出畫像洞。他有地圖，有魔杖，別無他物。

Sooner than he had expected, Remus found himself already outside the statue of the humpbacked witch, and then he was in the tunnel, walking at a speed he rarely managed. He didn’t need to light his wand, as he usually did when the others were with him. He just ploughed on through the cold air, the smell of chocolate was getting stronger by the minute and it had never been less appetising.
比他預期的更快，雷木斯發現自己已經在駝背女巫的雕像外，然後他進入了隧道，以他罕見的速度行走。他不需要像平時和其他人一起時那樣點燃魔杖。他只是迎著寒冷的空氣前進，巧克力的氣味變得越來越濃，從未像現在這樣讓人不感興趣。

In Honeyduke’s, he was able to get through to the front of the shop with little trouble, though he had a hairpin he’d pinched off Mary just in case. And all of a sudden, he was there; standing alone in Hogsmeade. He kept going, it was the only option. He could smell her already, she was still there, or had been recently. Remus’s heart began to pound. He was more frightened than he ever had been in his life – more frightened than he had been last year, waking up to find out what Sirius had done.
在霍尼杜克糖果店，他能夠毫不費力地走到店前，儘管他有一根從瑪麗那裡偷來的髮夾以防萬一。突然間，他來到了那裡；獨自在霍格斯密站著。他繼續前進，這是唯一的選擇。他已經能聞到她的氣味了，她仍然在那裡，或者最近在那裡。雷木斯的心開始狂跳。他比自己一生中任何時候都更害怕——比去年更害怕，當時他醒來發現小天狼星做了什麼。

Outside The Hog’s Head he finally stopped for breath. The scent was very strong now. Light glowed through the dirty pub windows, and Remus could see that it was not busy inside, though there were customers. He pulled back the cloak, breathing in the chill January air.
在“豬頭酒吧”外，他終於停下來喘息。氣味現在非常強烈。燈光透過髒兮兮的酒吧窗戶，雷木斯可以看到裡面不擁擠，雖然有顧客。他收回了斗篷，呼吸著寒冷的1月空氣。

There was movement behind him; a noise like a gasp of delight.
他身後有動靜；像是欣喜的驚呼聲。

“There you are! Who’s a pretty boy, then?”
“你來了！誰是乖寶貝呢？”

Chapter 106: Sixth Year: The Long Night 

 

She was not what he had expected. Well, he had not known what to expect - but it was certainly not this. She was small bodied, but had the bearing of someone much taller. Her sharp angular features were made more severe by her shaved head and huge fog grey eyes which focussed on him with a predator’s glint. She had a wide mouth, and her lip had been split at some point, and healed badly. She had scars too; as many as he did, but almost invisible under a complex lacework of small circular tattoos, spiralling across her weatherbeaten skin in untraceable sequences.
她不是他預期中的樣子。嗯，他不知道應該期待什麼——但肯定不是這樣。她身材瘦小，但舉止卻像是比她高得多。她的鋭利的棱角特徵因為剃光的頭和巨大的霧灰色眼睛而顯得更加嚴厲，那雙眼睛以掠食者的光芒盯著他。她有一張寬大的嘴，嘴唇曾經裂開過，愈合得很糟糕。她還有傷疤；跟他一樣多，但幾乎被複雜的圓形紋身遮掩，紋身在她被風霜侵蝕的皮膚上以無法追踪的序列螺旋分布。

“Remus Lupin,” she said, in a low, gravelly voice. She had a horrible, menacing smile. She showed all of her teeth - which were in bad condition, discoloured and uneven. “I’ve been waiting for you, my dear.”
“雷木斯·盧平，”她用低沉、沙啞的聲音說。她有一個可怕、威脅的微笑。她露出了所有的牙齒——那些牙齒狀況很差，變色且不均勻。“我一直在等你，我的親愛的。”

He pulled out his wand at once, adopting a duelling stance.
他立刻拔出魔杖，採取了決鬥的姿勢。

“Drop that!” She snarled, raising a hand - her nails were long, yellow and clawed, filthy with dirt.
“放下它！”她咆哮道，抬起一隻手——她的指甲又長又黃，像爪子一樣，髒兮兮的。

His wand clattered to the ground, and he gasped. Remus was frozen to the spot. She stood only meters away, and his wand was within reach, but he couldn’t move a muscle. She laughed, her breath stark and white in the winter air, “I saw you here on Christmas Eve,” she said. She pointed to the dark alley, “I saw you there, with the human. I followed you both.”
他的魔杖掉落在地，他喘了口氣。雷木斯僵硬地站在原地。她只距離他幾米遠，而他的魔杖就在觸手可及之處，但他動不了一根手指。她笑了，冬天的空氣中她的呼吸清晰而白皙，“我在聖誕夜看到了你，”她說。她指向那條黑暗的小巷，“我看到你和那個人類在那裡。我跟蹤了你們倆。”

“What do you want?” He asked, steadily, staring her down. She was repulsive, unclean - her cloak was heavy matted animal fur, crawling with lice and other vermin. She stank of the forest, and rot, and blood. Despite this, something drew him in - something familiar, safe and welcoming. Pack, the wolf told him, a low growl from somewhere inside. Pack.
“你想要什麼？”他穩定地問道，盯著她看。她令人厭惡，不潔——她的斗篷是厚重的蓋滿絨毛的動物皮，裡面爬滿了蝨子和其他害蟲。她散發著森林、腐爛和血腥的氣味。儘管如此，有些東西吸引了他——一些熟悉的、安全的、令人歡迎的東西。狼告訴他，包裹，內心深處傳來低沉的咆哮。包裹。

“We want you, brother.” She said, stepping forward.
“我們要你，兄弟。”她說，向前走了一步。

She lowered her hand, and he felt a sort of un-clicking in his muscles, and stepped back, automatically.
她放下了手，他感覺到肌肉中有一種解除僵硬的感覺，自動地後退了一步。

“We?” He asked, finding courage now that he could move again. He snatched up his wand and she allowed it.
“我們？”他問道，現在他能再次移動時找到了勇氣。他抓起了魔杖，她允許了。

“We. Us.” She said, stepping forward again. She walked with one foot in front of the other, like an animal. Her feet were bare on the cobbles, black with filth.
“我們。我們。”她說，再次向前走。她的步伐像動物一樣，一腳在前，一腳在後。她的腳裸露在鵝卵石上，黑乎乎的，沾滿了污垢。

“Who’s ‘us’?” He asked, glancing back, quickly. He was almost at the door. If he backed away far enough, he’d be visible from inside the pub windows.
“‘我們’是誰？”他問道，快速地回頭看。他已經快到門口了。如果他後退得足夠遠，他會從酒吧窗戶裡被看到。

“Your family, Remus Lupin.”
“你的家人，雷木斯·盧平。”

“Oh, right?” He asked, still distracted by his progress towards the pub. He had to get closer to people. “Well,” he tried smiling, “If we’re family, I’d better buy you a drink…”
“哦，是嗎？”他問道，仍然分心地看向酒吧的進展。他必須接近一些人。“嗯，”他試著微笑，“如果我們是家人，我最好請你喝一杯……”

“You reek of human terror, Remus Lupin.” She said, tilting her head to one side.
“你身上散發著人類的恐懼氣味，雷木斯·盧平。”她說，將頭歪向一邊。

“抱歉，”他說，耸耸肩。“你要喝酒嗎？”

“如果你願意。”

“Great…” he pushed open the door with some relief, and stepped into the grimy pub. He had never really felt ‘safe’ in The Hog’s Head, but he had never been quite so glad to be surrounded by other wizards; dark or not. A few patrons glanced up from under their hoods as the two werewolves entered - but if they had any clue about the situation, they made no sign of it.

She laughed,
她笑了，

這讓雷木斯感到一陣寒意。她再次微笑，像讀書一樣讀懂了他。雷木斯乾澀地吞了口水，現在不再關心奶油啤酒，

“Fine.” Remus nodded, so, so grateful to James Potter.

“I’m already one of them!” Remus shouted, standing up so fast his stool flew backwards, clattering on the dirty pub floor and attracting everyone’s attention. Remus didn’t care. He started for the door. Ferox followed him outside. Remus walked faster, heading for Honeyduke’s, “You’re not my dad. You’re not even my teacher anymore, so piss off and leave me alone!”
“我已經是他們中的一員了！”雷木斯大喊，迅速站起來，椅子向後飛去，在骯髒的酒吧地板上發出響聲，吸引了所有人的注意。雷木斯不在乎。他向門口走去。費洛克斯跟在他身後。雷木斯走得更快，朝霍尼杜克走去，“你不是我的父親。你甚至不再是我的老師了，所以滾開，讓我一個人待著！”

His terror had turned to rage so quickly, his head still throbbing from the silver, and from being slapped (just like bloody Matron, bloody adults are all the bloody same), his arm hurting and itching more than ever. And Remus was not quick on his feet at the best of times. Ferox caught up easily. He grabbed his shoulder,
他的恐懼轉瞬間變成了憤怒，他的頭仍然因銀子的影響而疼痛，還有被打了一巴掌（就像該死的護理員，該死的成年人都是一樣的），他的手臂比以往更加痛苦和癢。雷木斯本來腳步就不快。費洛克斯很容易追上來。他抓住了雷木斯的肩膀，

“Oi! Look, maybe I was a bit harsh, but… Jesus christ, Lupin! You gave us all such a fright.”
“喂！看看，或許我有點過於苛刻，但……天啊，雷木斯！你給我們所有人都帶來了巨大的驚嚇。”

Remus stopped at that,
雷木斯聽到這句話停下了，

“All?”
“所有人？”

Ferox sighed again.
費洛克斯再次嘆了口氣。

“Come on. I’d better take you back to the castle. There are some people waiting for you.”
“走吧。我還是把你帶回城堡吧。有人在等你。”

Before they began to walk back, Ferox cast a patronus, a huge, long legged bird, to send a message up to Hogwarts that they were both safe.
在他們開始回去之前，費洛克斯施了一個護法咒，一隻巨大的長腿鳥，向霍格華茲發送了一個他們都安全的消息。

“Dumbledore knows, then.” Remus sighed.
“那麼，鄧布利多知道了。”雷木斯嘆了口氣。

“‘Fraid so.”
“怕是如此。”

“And McGonagall, I s’pose.”
“還有麥格教授，我想。”

“You’re looking at a lot of detention, Remus, I won’t lie to you.”
“雷木斯，你要面對很多的拘留，我不會對你撒謊。”

Remus snorted, and looked up at Ferox properly for the first time. Actually - he didn’t have to look up. In the two years since they had last met, Remus had caught up in height. They were eye to eye. Ferox was still golden haired, ruggedly handsome and weather beaten, but he was no longer the hero Remus had worshipped at thirteen. He was just a man – a soldier in a war, like all of them.
雷木斯哼了一聲，第一次正眼看著費洛克斯。實際上——他不必仰視。在他們上次見面後的兩年中，雷木斯的身高已經追上來了。他們平視而坐。費洛克斯仍然是金色的頭髮，粗獷英俊，饱经风霜，但他不再是雷木斯在十三歲時崇拜的英雄。他只是一個人——一場戰爭中的士兵，就像他們所有人一樣。

“I’m really sorry.” Remus said, “I knew it was stupid, I can’t even explain myself.”
“我真的很抱歉。”雷木斯說，“我知道這很愚蠢，我甚至無法解釋自己。”

“Ah, you don’t have to, lad,” Ferox clapped a hand to his shoulder, “It’s only natural, knowing what you know about him.”
“啊，你不必這麼做，孩子，”費洛克斯拍了拍他的肩膀，“知道你對他了解的情況下，這是很自然的。”

“I’ve never met another… werewolf… before.” He said. “Are they all like that?”
“我從未見過其他……狼人……”他說。“他們都那樣嗎？”

Ferox glanced at him sideways,
費洛克斯側眼看了看他，

“What do you think?”
“你怎麼認為？”

Remus thought about this while they walked, and eventually shook his head.
雷木斯在他們走路的時候思考了這個問題，最後搖了搖頭。

“No, I suppose they can’t be.” He sighed, “There are good and bad people. Good and bad wizards. Why should monsters be any different?”
“不，我想他們不能都這樣。”他嘆了口氣，“有好人也有壞人。好巫師和壞巫師。為什麼怪物會有什麼不同呢？”

“Remus me old pal, if you could get everyone else to understand that then I don’t think there would be a war on.”
“雷木斯，我的老朋友，如果你能讓其他人明白這一點，那我想就不會有戰爭了。”

He was brought straight to Dumbledore’s office. Remus had never been inside it before, and it was almost as anxiety inducing as meeting Livia. It was a high ceilinged airy room with portraits covering the walls and cabinets full of strange curiosities. Terrifyingly, Dumbledore was alone, sitting at his desk, writing on a long piece of parchment. Remus stood in silence for at least five minutes.
他被直接帶到鄧布利多的辦公室。雷木斯以前從未進入過這裡，這幾乎讓他像見到莉維亞一樣感到焦慮。這是一個高挑的明亮房間，牆壁上掛滿了肖像，櫥櫃裡擺滿了奇怪的好奇物品。令人恐懼的是，鄧布利多獨自坐在辦公桌前，正在寫一張長長的羊皮紙。雷木斯沉默地站了至少五分鐘。

“Mr Lupin.” The headmaster said, finally. “We seem always to meet under the most unpleasant conditions.”
“雷木斯先生。”校長終於說道，“我們似乎總是在最不愉快的情況下見面。”

“Yeah. Fair enough.” Remus nodded. He’d had too much of a night to care much about what Dumbledore had to say. I said I’d fight for your bloody cause, old man, what more do you want?
“是的。公平。”雷木斯點了點頭。他已經經歷了太多的一夜，對鄧布利多要說什麼不太在意。我說過我會為你的該死的事業而戰，老頭子，你還想要什麼？

Dumbledore watched his nonchalance carefully.
鄧布利多仔細觀察著他的漠不關心。

“You have done a very dangerous thing, tonight.”
“今晚你做了一件非常危險的事情。”

“Yeah,” he raised his bandaged arm.
“是的，”他舉起了包紮過的手臂。

“You know that is not what I am referring to.”
“你知道我不是在說這個。”

“I know.” Remus replied, hanging his head, trying to look remorseful. If he hadn’t had the chance to cool off with Ferox, then he might have a lot more to say. I know, professor, you aren’t referring to any bodily harm I might have come to. That is clearly the least of your concerns, considering I had been tearing myself apart for eight years before anyone decided to intervene.
“我知道。”雷木斯回答，低下頭，試圖表現出悔恨。如果他沒有機會在費洛克斯那裡冷靜下來，他可能會有更多要說的。我知道，教授，你不是在說我可能遭遇的身體傷害。顯然，這是你最不擔心的，考慮到在任何人決定介入之前，我已經折磨了自己八年。

Dumbledore, of course, didn’t know about the marauder’s secret. He may well have known about Madam Pomfrey’s efforts to help Remus, but if he did, he showed no interest.
鄧布利多當然不知道掠奪者的秘密。他可能知道波莫弗雷夫人的努力幫助雷木斯，但如果他知道，他卻表現出沒有興趣。

So Remus shut up and took his punishment, hoping that eventually Dumbledore would release him and he could just go back to bed. There was a lecture on responsibility and maturity. A stern reminder that the war is bigger than him, and that his own personal motives did not matter. “We all have to make sacrifices…” (yeah, Remus scoffed, inwardly, some more than others, presumably.)
所以雷木斯閉嘴接受了懲罰，希望最終鄧布利多會釋放他，他可以回去睡覺了。校長講了關於責任和成熟的講座。嚴厲地提醒他，戰爭比他本人更大，他自己的個人動機不重要。“我們都必須做出犧牲……”（是的，雷木斯在心裡嗤之以鼻，大概有些人比其他人更多。）

“Do you understand, Remus?”
“你明白了嗎，雷木斯？”

“Yes, headmaster.”
“是的，校長。”

After that, he had to give Dumbledore a detailed account of everything he and Livia had discussed. It wasn’t much – Remus couldn’t help feeling a little bit disappointed by how little he had learnt himself. Dumbledore seemed pleased, however – as much as Dumbledore ever seemed to be one thing or another. Several of the clocks in one of the glass cabinets began to chime, and Remus realised that it was three o’clock in the morning. He stifled a yawn.
之後，他不得不向鄧布利多詳細描述他和莉維亞討論的所有內容。沒什麼——雷木斯不禁感到有些失望，因為他自己學到的東西太少了。然而，鄧布利多似乎很高興——至於鄧布利多是否真的對某一件事情感到高興。玻璃櫃中的幾個時鐘開始敲響，雷木斯意識到已經是凌晨三點了。他抑制住了哈欠。

“Yes,” Dumbledore nodded, as if Remus had just made a very interesting point, “Perhaps that is enough for tonight. You may go to bed, Mr Lupin.”
“是的，”鄧布利多點了點頭，就像雷木斯剛剛提出了一個非常有趣的觀點，“也許今晚到此為止。雷木斯先生，你可以去睡覺了。”

Remus nodded dozily and stood up, rubbing his hip which was stiff from sitting on hard wooden seats all evening.
雷木斯昏昏欲睡地點了點頭，站起來，揉了揉因整晚坐在硬木椅子上而僵硬的臀部。

“Professor?” He asked, just before leaving. Dumbledore had returned to his letter writing, and made no sign he had heard the boy, so Remus just continued anyway, “Livia said that I didn’t know half the power I had. And she could do wandless magic, and wordless magic, and—“
“教授？”他在離開前問道。鄧布利多已經回到寫信中，沒有表示他聽到了男孩的話，所以雷木斯繼續說，“莉維亞說我不知道自己擁有一半的力量。她能夠做沒有魔杖的魔法，還有無聲的魔法，還有——”

“Her talents were nothing out of the ordinary, Mr Lupin,” Dumbledore replied, not looking up, “She has clearly studied the dark arts, and may be particularly gifted. Do not dwell on it.”
“她的才能並不尋常，雷木斯先生，”鄧布利多回答，沒有抬頭，“她顯然研究過黑魔法，可能特別有天賦。不要過於糾結於此。”

“Ok then.” Remus replied, even more disappointed. “Is er… is Professor Ferox still here?”
“好吧。”雷木斯回答，更加失望。“那……費洛克斯教授還在這裡嗎？”

“Mr Ferox is staying in Hogsmeade for a few more days. Good night, Remus.”
“費洛克斯先生在霍格斯米德再待幾天。晚安，雷木斯。”

“Um… goodnight, headmaster.”
“嗯……晚安，校長。”

Professor McGonagall was waiting for him outside the office. She looked furious, but she didn’t say anything.
麥格教授在辦公室外等他。她看起來很生氣，但沒有說什麼。

“I’m sure you’ve had enough of a telling off for one night.” She said, stiffly.
“我敢肯定你已經受夠了一晚的斥責。”她生硬地說。

“Oh,” Remus sighed, “I can take a bit more, if it’ll make you feel better.”
“哦，”雷木斯嘆了口氣，“如果這會讓你感覺好一些，我還能再承受一點。”

She raised an eyebrow at him, tutted, but kept walking. When they arrived at the portrait hole, she stopped and said,
她對他挑了挑眉，發出輕蔑的聲音，但仍然繼續走。在他們到達畫像洞口時，她停下來說，

“Two month’s detention, every night except full moons. And tell those boys to get to bed at once.”
“兩個月的拘留，除了滿月之夜之外的每晚都要。還有，讓那些男孩們立刻上床睡覺。”

He crawled through to the common room and found James, Sirius and Peter there, waiting in their pyjamas. James was pacing by the fireplace, Peter was trying not to fall sleep, leaning on his elbow, and Sirius, who had been sitting bolt upright in an armchair, leapt to his feet the moment he saw Remus.
他爬過畫像洞口進入公共休息室，發現詹姆斯、獵狐和彼得在那裡，穿著睡衣等他。詹姆斯在壁爐旁徘徊，彼得靠在手肘上，努力不讓自己入睡，而獵狐一看到雷木斯，就立刻從扶手椅上跳了起來。

“What do you think you’re playing at?!” He shouted, striding across the room, “Running off on your own!”
“你以為自己在玩什麼？！”他大喊著，跨步走向房間，“自己跑掉了！”

“Please don’t, Padfoot, I’m knackered…” Remus sighed, wincing. He was getting a headache. He just wanted to go to sleep – enough talking tonight.
“別這麼做，帕德腳，我累壞了……”雷木斯嘆了口氣，皺著眉頭。他頭疼得厲害。他只想去睡覺——今晚夠多了。

“Do you have any idea what it was like finding out you’d sneaked off?!” Sirius shouted. Remus raised an eyebrow at him.
“你知道發現你偷偷溜走是什麼感覺嗎？！”獵狐大喊。雷木斯對他挑了挑眉。

Sirius blinked, and stepped back, slightly, looking down. “For all of us, I mean.”
獵狐眨了眨眼，稍微退後了一步，低下頭。“我是說，對我們所有人來說。”

“I can imagine.” Remus said, “And I’m sorry, but please can I just go to bed? You can have a go at me in the morning.”
“我可以想像。”雷木斯說，“而且我很抱歉，但請我現在可以去睡覺了嗎？你們可以在早上再批評我。”

“Yeah, back off, Black.” James came over, and placed a hand on Sirius’s shoulder. Sirius shrugged it off, agitated. James sighed, taking his glasses off. “It’s late, we’re all tired. You sure you’re ok, Moony?”
“對，別再這樣了，布萊克。”詹姆斯走過來，拍了拍獵狐的肩膀。獵狐擺脫了詹姆斯，顯得有些焦躁。詹姆斯嘆了口氣，摘下眼鏡。“已經很晚了，我們都累了。你確定沒事嗎，月亮？”

“Fine.” Remus nodded, so, so grateful to James Potter.
“沒事。”雷木斯點了點頭，非常感激詹姆斯·波特。

 

Chapter 107: Sixth Year: Negotiations

 

Sunday 15th January 1977

He slept as late as possible the next morning, to put off further confrontation. He couldn't talk to them, not yet, not until his head was straight. They’d have so many questions – some he couldn’t answer, some he didn’t want to. He showered for longer than usual – something of Livia seemed to cling to him, and he turned the tap right up, trying to scald it off. The claw marks she had left were healing already, but still itched under Remus’s scratchy wool jumper.
他睡到盡可能晚，以推遲進一步的對峙。他不能現在就和他們談，至少在他的頭腦清醒之前不能。他們會有很多問題——一些他無法回答，一些他不想回答。他洗澡洗得比平時久——莉維亞的某些東西似乎黏在他身上，他把水龍頭調到最大，試圖把它燙掉。她留下的爪痕已經在癒合，但仍然在雷木斯的粗毛衣下癢得難忍。

Washed and dressed, Remus went to his trunk and looked for a spare bit of parchment, before scrawling an untidy note:

If you’re still in the village, I’d like to talk to you again.

He folded it in a hurry, shoved it in his pocket and headed for the owlery. The marauders were all in the common room, in much the same state as they had been the night before. Remus looked at them, panicked, then bent his head and kept walking.
洗漱完畢，雷木斯走到他的行李箱前，找了張多餘的羊皮紙，草草寫了一張不整潔的便條：

如果你還在村子裡，我想再和你談談。

他匆忙地把便條折好，塞進口袋，前往貓頭鷹廳。四個麻瓜流氓都在公共休息室，狀態和前一晚差不多。雷木斯看了看他們，驚慌地低下頭，繼續走著。

“Moony, wait…” they followed him, all three, through the portrait hole. No matter, they couldn’t discuss it in the open, he knew this and they knew it.

“I’m going to the owlery.” He said, marching ahead.

“Don’t you want breakfast?” Peter asked.

“After.”

“Moony, can we talk about what happened last night?” James asked, sounding very tired still. Remus supposed he’d been bearing the brunt of Sirius’s frustration. Good; let someone else do that for a bit.

“Not here.”

Unfortunately, they all followed him to the owlery – which happened to be completely empty – except for owls, of course, most of which were sleeping.
“月亮，等一下……”他們三個跟著他穿過畫像洞口。不管怎麼樣，他們知道這件事不能在公開場合討論，他也知道。他說道：“我要去貓頭鷹廳。”

“你不想吃早餐嗎？”彼得問道。

“等會再說。”

“月亮，我們能談談昨晚發生的事嗎？”詹姆斯問道，聽起來仍然很疲倦。雷木斯推測他一定承擔了獵狐的沮喪。好吧，讓別人來擔當一下吧。

“這裡不行。”

不幸的是，他們都跟到了貓頭鷹廳——那裡碰巧完全空無一人——當然，貓頭鷹除外，大部分都在睡覺。

“Who are you writing to?” Sirius asked at once. Remus closed his eyes, sighed, and resumed tying his note to the nearest owl.

“Ferox. My old professor.”

“Why?!”

Remus dropped the string he was using and tutted as he had to bend to pick it up. He continued to explain, calmly.

“He’s in Hogsmeade. I saw him last night, but I want to see him again.”

“What was he doing in--”

Remus tutted again, fumbling with his third attempt to tie the note to the agitated owl’s leg. Sirius was standing much too close, leaning over him, demanding answers, and Remus could barely concentrate.
“你在寫信給誰？”獵狐立刻問道。雷木斯閉上眼睛，嘆了口氣，繼續把便條綁在最近的貓頭鷹身上。

“費洛克斯。我的舊教授。”

“為什麼？！”

雷木斯放下了他正在使用的繩子，嘖了一聲，彎下腰撿起來。他繼續平靜地解釋。

“他在霍格斯米德。我昨晚見過他，但我想再見他一次。”

“他在做什麼——”

雷木斯再次嘖了一聲，試圖第三次把便條綁在焦躁的貓頭鷹腿上。獵狐站得太近，俯身過來，要求答案，雷木斯幾乎無法集中精力。

“He’s working with Moody, and he got summoned there to bring me back--”

“Summoned by who?”

“Fucking hell, give me a minute, will you?!” Remus snapped.

Sirius stood back, looking as if he’d very much like to say something else, but was biting his tongue. James touched his shoulder again. Remus ignored them both and tied the letter to the bird - maybe a bit too tight, because it pecked him angrily before flying off, down towards the village. He could stay there, maybe, it might not take very long. But his stomach growled. He turned to look at his friends.
“他和穆迪一起工作，他被召喚去把我帶回來——”

“被誰召喚？”

“該死的，給我一分鐘，好嗎？！”雷木斯怒聲說道。

獵狐退後一步，看起來很想說些別的話，但咬著舌頭。詹姆斯再次拍了拍他的肩膀。雷木斯忽視了他們兩個，把信綁在鳥身上——也許綁得有點緊，因為鳥在飛走之前氣憤地啄了他一口，朝村莊方向飛去。他可以待在那裡，也許不會花太長時間。但他的胃在咕嚕咕嚕叫。他轉過身看著他的朋友們。

“Ok. Breakfast?”

“Are you going to tell--”

“Yes, Padfoot, fine. Let’s um… get some toast and go for a walk or something, ok?”

So that’s what they did. Remus buttered at least five slices of toast in the Great Hall, wrapped them in napkins and stuffed them into the pockets of his robes. The other three marauders followed him, watching cautiously as if they weren’t quite sure what to make of him yet.
“好的。早餐？”

“你要告訴——”

“是的，帕德腳，好吧。讓我們……去拿點吐司，去散步或做點別的事，好嗎？”

於是他們這麼做了。雷木斯在大禮堂裡抹了至少五片吐司，包裹在餐巾裡，塞進袍子的口袋裡。其他三個麻瓜流氓跟在他身後，謹慎地看著他，好像還不太確定該怎麼看待他。

“Right.” He said, once they were outside, “You all need to shut up and let me tell it to you, ok? No interruptions.”

They nodded solemnly as they walked. He saw Sirius purse his lips. Tough, Remus thought, spitefully. You can listen to me, for once. So, he talked.

He found it much easier than telling Dumbledore – at least he knew for sure that the marauders were on his side. He tried to explain everything with as little emotional context as possible. He had known there was a werewolf nearby. He went to find them, he met Livia, Ferox intervened.
“好了。”他說，一旦他們在外面，“你們都需要閉嘴，讓我告訴你們，好嗎？不要打斷。”

他們在走路的時候嚴肅地點了點頭。他看到獵狐抿了抿嘴唇。雷木斯心裡想，這很艱難，你可以聽我說話，這一次。因此，他開始講述。

“Moody talked to me last summer,” he explained, finally, “He said something to me, and it made me… it just made me think about how useful I can be, that’s all. I have to stop looking at my furry little problem as… well, as a problem. If we’re going to war with dark creatures, then as a dark creature I ought to be--”

“You’re not a dark creature.” James said, suddenly, “You’re our Moony.”

Remus shrugged. He wouldn’t have put money on James being the first to interrupt, but now he was pretty glad he had. He left a pause; there was nothing more to tell. He was staring at his feet, rubbing his hands together. Remus didn’t look at Sirius. He looked for his fags instead.

雷木斯聳了聳肩。他原本不會賭詹姆斯會是第一個打斷的人，但現在他很高興他這樣做了。他留下了一個暫停；沒有更多的事情可以告訴了。詹姆斯仍然看著他，眉頭微微皺起。他把眼鏡推上鼻樑，顯然在深思。彼得當然看起來很焦慮。他盯著自己的腳，揉著雙手。雷木斯沒有看獵狐，而是找他的香煙。
