格蘭特突然抬頭，直視雷木斯。他完全清醒了，眼睛銳利而睜大，就像雷木斯的臉是鏡子，他第一次看見自己一樣。他用髒兮兮的手指碰了碰他臉上的傷痕。

“Got into an altercation few days ago.” He said, “But fuck it, I’m off tomorrow, going down Brighton. Sick of bloody London. Sick of bloody miserable fucking London. Everyone wants to get at ya, do you over, any way they can. D’you know what I mean?”
「幾天前發生了一場爭執。」他說，「但去他媽的，我明天就走，去布賴頓。我厭倦了該死的倫敦。厭倦了該死的悲慘倫敦。每個人都想整你，想法子弄你。你明白我的意思嗎？」

“Yeah,” Remus breathed. He felt so helpless. He wanted to look to Sirius for reassurance, but it seemed somehow disrespectful to Grant.
「是的，」雷木斯輕聲說。他感到無比無助。他想向小天狼星尋求安慰，但這樣似乎對格蘭特不太尊重。

“‘ow’s school, poshnob?” Grant asked, slurping his tea like a builder.
「學校怎麼樣，老高尚？」格蘭特邊喝茶邊問，像個工人一樣啜飲。

“Oh.. ok, you know. Fine. What’s in Brighton? Somewhere to live? A job? How are you getting there?”
「哦……還好，你知道的。沒問題。布賴頓有什麼？住的地方？工作？你打算怎麼去那裡？」

“Got friends,” Grant shrugged, then winced. He’d broken a rib, Remus realised, and scolded himself for not having noticed earlier.
「有朋友，」格蘭特耸了耸肩，然後皺了皺眉。他的肋骨斷了，雷木斯意識到這點，並責怪自己之前沒有注意到。

“Do you need to go to a hospital? How long have you been like this?”
「你需要去醫院嗎？你這樣有多久了？」

“No hospitals,” Grant grumbled, curling up in his seat protectively, “They fink I’m a skag head. Probably look like one, do I?”
「不去醫院，」格蘭特嘟囔道，保護性地縮在座位上，「他們以為我是個毒品成癮者。我看起來像嗎？」

“I went to Mile End, I saw Adz.”
「我去了邁爾恩德，我見過阿茲。」

“That cunt. He can fuck right off ‘n all. Look, lend me a tenner will ya? I’m good for it, gimme your address an’ I’ll pay ya back.”
「那混蛋。他也可以去他媽的。看，借我十鎊，好嗎？我會還你的，給我你的地址，我會還給你的。」

“Not if you’re just going to get drunk on it.”
「如果你只是拿來喝酒，那可不行。」

“Oi, Mr high an’ mighty! I’ll ‘ave you know I deserve a good drink. I’ve ‘ad me heart broken. You remember what that’s like.”
「喂，高高在上的先生！我要讓你知道我值得好好喝一杯。我心都碎了。你還記得那種感覺嗎？」

He gave Sirius a less than subtle glare. Sirius, to his credit, did not react, but stared at the sugar bowl. Someone had put their cigarette out in it.
他給了小天狼星一個不太含蓄的瞪視。小天狼星倒是沒有反應，只是盯著糖罐看。有人把煙頭熄在裡面。

“I’m really sorry, Grant.” Remus said, sincerely, “Look… where are you sleeping at the moment?”
「我真的很抱歉，格蘭特。」雷木斯真誠地說，「你現在在哪裡睡覺？」

“Up the road,”
「就在上面的路上。」

“Is it safe there?”
「那裡安全嗎？」

“Lost my key.”
「丟了鑰匙。」

Well, Remus thought to himself. At least there's a lock. He’d been halfway to deciding to smuggle Grant back to Diagon Alley and just facing the consequences when they got caught.
雷木斯在心裡想。至少那裡有鎖。他已經考慮到一半，決定把格蘭特偷偷帶回對角巷，然後面對被抓到的後果。

They ordered more tea and Grant ate some more. Once he’d finished, he had grown agreeably soft and sleepy; drunk on a full stomach. Sirius and Remus helped him back to his room, in an old Edwardian terrace which looked as though it had been abandoned for years. Still, inside was busy and homelier than the condemned Mile End building. A young woman peered out if the next room along, mousy, freckled face at odds with her gunge green Mohawk.
他們又點了些茶，格蘭特也多吃了一些。吃完後，他變得舒服而昏昏欲睡；酒醉於飽腹。小天狼星和雷木斯幫他回到他的房間，那是一個看起來已經被廢棄多年的古老愛德華時期的排屋。不過，裡面雖然擁擠，但比被拆除的邁爾恩德建築更像家。一個年輕的女人從隔壁的房間探出頭來，臉上有雀斑，與她的泥綠色莫霍克頭髮形成了鮮明對比。

“Grant? Gawd, you pissed again? I told you vodka’s not a fucking painkiller, go to a bloody doctor!” She looked up at Remus, “Who’re you?”
「格蘭特？天啊，你又喝醉了？我告訴過你伏特加不是他媽的止痛藥，去看個該死的醫生！」她抬頭看著雷木斯，「你是誰？」

“A friend, I’m just trying to make sure he's ok…”
「一個朋友，我只是想確保他沒事……」

“He’ll be fine, he gets like this.”
「他會好的，他就是這樣。」

Sirius performed a silent unlocking charm on Grant’s door and Remus half carried Grant inside, settling him as carefully as he could onto the single mattress on the floor. It was a small room, with one tiny round window. Unfurnished, there was a stack of magazines in one corner with a lamp perched on top, a rucksack stuffed with clothes, a mirror which was rusting around the edges, and what looked like a small washing station - a bar of soap, a toothbrush and empty bowl.
小天狼星對格蘭特的門施了個靜音開鎖咒，雷木斯半抱著格蘭特進了屋，把他儘可能小心地放在地上的單人床墊上。這是一個小房間，只有一個小圓窗。沒有家具，一角堆放著一疊雜誌，上面擱著一盞燈，一個裝滿衣物的背包，一面鏡子邊緣已經生銹，還有一個看起來像是小洗漱區的東西——一塊肥皂、一把牙刷和一個空碗。

Grant curled up on the mattress and began to snore softly. Remus knelt beside him, frowning. The punk girl stood in the doorway, arms folded, looking Sirius up and down.
格蘭特蜷縮在床墊上，開始輕輕打鼾。雷木斯跪在他旁邊，皺著眉頭。朋克女孩站在門口，雙臂交叉，打量著小天狼星。

“He said he was going to Brighton tomorrow,” Remus said to her, “Is that true?”
「他說他明天要去布賴頓，」雷木斯對她說，「這是真的嗎？」

“If he got the money together for his train fare,” she shrugged, “Said it got nicked, last week. He was seeing this really rough type. Treated him like shit, poor love.”
「如果他湊齊了火車票錢，」她耸了耸肩，「他說上週被偷了。他和這個非常粗暴的人在一起。對他不好，真可憐。」

“He’ll have the money.” Remus said, firmly. “Will you make sure he goes? It will be safe?”
「他會有錢的。」雷木斯堅定地說，「你能確保他會去嗎？那裡會安全嗎？」

“I’m not his keeper,” she shrugged, backing out, “Got enough problems.”
「我不是他的看護人，」她耸了耸肩，退回房間，「我有自己的麻煩。」

“Charming.” Sirius said with a raised eyebrow as she vanished back into her room.
「真有魅力。」小天狼星 raised his eyebrow 說道，當她消失回到她的房間裡。

“Shut the door,” Remus said, pulling out his wand. He wanted to fix as much as he could while Grant was still sleeping. He ran through his list of healing spells - he’d only done them on himself, so far, but nothing had gone very badly wrong…
「關上門，」雷木斯說，掏出他的魔杖。他想在格蘭特還在睡覺的時候盡可能修復。 他回顧了他的治療咒語清單——到目前為止，只是對自己做過，但沒有出現嚴重錯誤……

“What the hell are you doing?!” Sirius came over, as Remus aimed his wand at Grant’s chest. “What about the Statute of Secrecy?!”
「你到底在幹什麼？！」小天狼星走過來，看到雷木斯將魔杖對準格蘭特的胸口。「《保密法》怎麼辦？！」

“Bugger that,” Remus grunted, “I can’t just leave him like this.”
「管它呢，」雷木斯咕噥道，「我不能就這樣放著他不管。」

Sirius stepped back and watched as Remus did his best to heal Grant’s ribs, then clear up the bruises and blackened eye. Afterwards he leaned back, mind racing. He turned to Sirius, “Right, I think I need to stay here tonight.” He said, “I could leave him some money, but… I think it’s better if I make sure he gets to Brighton tomorrow, if that’s still what he wants to do, when he’s sober.”
小天狼星退後一步，看著雷木斯盡力治療格蘭特的肋骨，然後清理瘀傷和黑眼圈。之後，他靠回去，心思飛速轉動。他轉向小天狼星，「對，我想我今晚需要留下來。」他說，「我可以留下點錢，但……我覺得最好還是確保他明天能去布賴頓，如果他還想去的話，等他清醒了再說。」

“Right,” Sirius nodded, “We’ve got to get to King’s Cross, though…”
「好，」小天狼星點頭說，「不過我們得去國王十字車站……」

“Yeah, I’ll be on time. I can just apparate from Victoria.”
「是的，我會準時的。我可以從維多利亞瞬移過去。」

“Ok.” Sirius nodded again. He sat down, leaning against the opposite wall. He took off his jacket and folded it underneath himself.
「好的。」小天狼星再次點頭。他坐下，靠在對面的牆上。他脫下外套，摺好放在自己下面。

 

 

“What are you doing?” Remus asked, “You need to go back to Diagon Alley.”
「你在幹什麼？」雷木斯問，「你需要回到對角巷。」

“No I don’t.” Sirius shrugged. “I can stay.”
「不需要。」小天狼星耸耸肩。「我可以留下來。」

“But James…”
「但是詹姆斯……」

“Oh right, yeah, hang on…” Sirius reached into his pocket and pulled out the compact mirror. Remus gazed at it enviously. He wished he had one. He’d give it to Grant, and never lose him again. “Oi, Potter, you there? Prongs?” Sirius was speaking into the device, “Hiya… look, me and Moony are going to a gig here, we’ll be in late… don’t tell anyone, ok? See you tomorrow… yeah… yeah… no, I promise. Ok. Cheers.” He snapped it closed and looked at Remus, “There, done.”
「哦對，對，等一下……」小天狼星從口袋裡拿出那個小鏡子。雷木斯嫉妒地看著它。他希望自己也有一個。他會把它給格蘭特，再也不會丟失他。「喂，波特，你在嗎？小鹿？」小天狼星對著裝置說，「嗨……看，我和穆尼要去參加一個演出，我們會晚點回去……別告訴別人，好的？明天見……對……對……不，我保證。好了。謝謝。」他把鏡子合上，看著雷木斯，「好了，搞定。」

“You didn’t have to do that. If you’re worried about leaving me here with him, I’m really just making sure he’s ok.”
「你不必這麼做。如果你擔心把我留在這裡，我只是確保他沒事。」

“And I’m making sure you’re ok, Remus.” Sirius replied coolly. “I’m not leaving you to spend all night alone in this place. C’mon, let’s get comfortable. Plenty of floor to go around…”
「而我則是確保你沒事，雷木斯。」小天狼星冷冷地說。「我不會讓你在這裡孤單過夜的。來吧，我們找個地方舒服一下。地板夠用的……」

Remus’s guilt soared even higher then, as Sirius gave him a bright grin and extended an arm towards him. His last night before school, spent on the floor of some muggle halfway house, and he wasn’t even complaining about it. Remus sat down too, and slouched down to settle under Sirius’s arm. At least they were together now. Sirius kissed his head, and they both watched Grant, sleeping like a child.
雷木斯的內疚感更加升高了，小天狼星給了他一個燦爛的笑容，伸出手臂。學校開學前的最後一晚，他就在某個麻瓜中途之家地板上度過，甚至沒有抱怨。雷木斯也坐下來，靠在小天狼星的手臂下。至少他們現在在一起了。小天狼星親吻了他的頭，他們兩人看著格蘭特，像孩子般熟睡著。

“I’m sorry.” Remus said, exhausted, “He’s not… I don’t want you to think he usually acts this way. He’s obviously had a bad time.”
「對不起。」雷木斯疲憊地說，「他不是……我不想讓你覺得他平時是這樣的。他顯然經歷了艱難時期。」

“What happened to him?” Sirius asked, very quietly, “What happened to make him end up here, like this?”
「他發生了什麼事？」小天狼星非常輕聲地問，「發生了什麼事讓他變成這樣？」

“He got kicked out of St Edmund’s, two years ago,” Remus yawned, his eyes growing heavy. “Didn’t have anywhere else to go… can’t get a job because he didn’t do his exams at school. And I’m guessing he hasn’t got a proper address.”
「他兩年前被從聖愛德蒙德學校開除了，」雷木斯打了個哈欠，眼睛變得沉重。「沒有其他地方去……找不到工作，因為他沒做學校的考試。我猜他也沒有一個合適的地址。」

“Remus?”
「雷木斯？」

“Mm?”
「嗯？」

“This wouldn’t happen to you, would it? Because you’ve got us.”
「這不會發生在你身上吧？因為你有我們。」

“Yeah,” he murmured sleepily, only half paying attention, “I’ve got you, Padfoot. Don’t worry about me.”
「是的，」他迷迷糊糊地低語，只有一半注意，「我有你，天狼星。別擔心我。」

 

Chapter 119: Seventh Year: Back to School 

 

For a horrible moment just as he woke up, Remus forgot where he was. He took in the stuffy air, the faint whiff of rotten newspaper, body odour and urine. He took in the hard floor, which had exacerbated his various aches and pains overnight. Then he opened his eyes and saw Grant, lying on the mattress opposite, staring back at him. He looked a bit better.
在他醒來的那一刻，雷木斯一度忘記了自己身在何處。他感受到悶熱的空氣，隱約的腐爛報紙氣味、體味和尿味。他感覺到硬邦邦的地板，這讓他一夜之間的各種疼痛更加加劇。然後他睜開眼睛，看見對面的格蘭特躺在床墊上，盯著他。他看起來好了一點。

“Morning.” Grant mouthed,
「早安。」格蘭特張嘴說道，

“Morning,” Remus replied, moving against Sirius, who was still fast asleep, head back against the wall. He peeled himself away carefully and whispered to Grant, “Don’t worry, he sleeps like the dead. I’ll wake him up in a bit.”
「早安，」雷木斯回答，靠在仍然熟睡的小天狼星身上，小天狼星的頭靠在牆上。他小心地脫離開來，對格蘭特低聲說，「別擔心，他睡得像死了一樣。我會稍後叫醒他的。」

“I can’t remember much.” Grant whispered, lying on his side, head resting on a pillow which looked dirty and stained. “Sorry if I was a knob. I think I am a bit of a knob, these days.”
「我不太記得了。」格蘭特低聲說，側躺著，頭靠在看起來髒兮兮的枕頭上。「如果我當時很討厭，我很抱歉。我覺得我這些天有點像個混蛋。」

“You were fine,” Remus shook his head, “Just… sad, maybe.”
「你沒事，」雷木斯搖搖頭，「只是……可能有點悲傷。」

Grant looked stricken, so Remus moved to get up.
格蘭特看起來很痛苦，於是雷木斯站起來了。

“Loo?” He asked.
「廁所？」他問。

“Downstairs. I’ll show you.” Grant pulled himself up, gingerly, then looked amazed, “Blimey,” he said, patting his side, “Must’ve just been a bruise, after all. Knew I didn’t need no doctor.”
「在樓下。我帶你去。」格蘭特小心翼翼地爬起來，然後驚訝地說，「天啊，」他拍了拍自己的側面，「果然只是淤傷。我知道我不需要看醫生。」

Remus pursed his lips and followed Grant out. Downstairs was already alive with activity, despite the early hour. The house seemed to be a kind of commune, full of all kinds of different people. There was an outhouse in the back garden (more like a yard that had been turned into an allotment) and an outdoor shower, which Remus couldn’t imagine was much fun in the winter.
雷木斯抿了抿嘴唇，跟在格蘭特身後。樓下已經熱鬧非凡，儘管時間很早。這所房子似乎是一種公社，裡面充滿了各種各樣的人。後花園裡有個外屋（更像是一個被改造成菜地的院子），還有一個戶外淋浴，雷木斯無法想像在冬天用它會有多麼愉快。

Still, the people were friendly and all said hello to the two boys as they passed - which Remus remarked upon.
不過，人們都很友善，當兩個男孩經過時都向他們打招呼——這讓雷木斯注意到。

“Everyone seems nice?”
「每個人都很友善？」

“They’re all right,” Grant replied from inside the loo, “Only been ‘ere a few days. Leaving soon as I can.”
「還好，」格蘭特在廁所裡回答，「我只在這裡待了幾天。我會盡快離開。」

“For Brighton? You mentioned last night…”
「去布萊頓？你昨晚提到過……」

“Oh, did I? Yeah, that was the plan…” Grant came out of the outhouse, looking sheepish, “Maybe next month, though.”
「哦，我提到了嗎？對，那是計劃……不過，也許要到下個月。」

“What’s there? Friends?”
「那裡有什麼？朋友？」

Grant nodded,
格蘭特點點頭，

“Yeah - one of the nicer lads from the Mile End place. Got a cousin there too - the last Chapman who don’t hate me. She owns a pub, said she’d hire me if I could get my shit together and pay the train fare.” He sighed, heavily, washing his hands, then face in a bucket of water taken from a big green water butt standing by the back door. “S’posed to ‘prove myself’.”
「對——那裡有一個來自米爾恩德地方的比較好的人。我那裡還有一個表親——最後一個不恨我的查普曼。她有一家酒吧，說如果我能整理好自己的事，並支付火車票費用，她會雇用我。」他重重地嘆了口氣，洗手，然後在一個放在後門旁的大綠水桶裡洗臉。「說是要‘證明自己’。」

“That doesn’t seem very…” What did Remus want to say? Familial? Kind? Grant had clearly experienced very little of either.
「這看起來不太像……」雷木斯想說什麼？家庭？善良？顯然格蘭特幾乎沒有經歷過這些。

“Nah, she’s fair enough,” Grant replied, feeling in his pockets and coming up empty. Remus handed over his own tin of roll ups, and the lighter. Grant nodded appreciatively, and continued explaining as he lit up, “I’ve let ‘er down a few times before. Mostly if Grandad was involved - you know I can’t stick him.”
「不，她還算公平，」格蘭特回答，摸了摸口袋，結果什麼都沒有。雷木斯遞給他自己的捲煙罐和打火機。格蘭特感激地點點頭，點燃香煙繼續解釋，「我之前讓她失望過幾次。主要是如果祖父參與其中——你知道我受不了他。」

Remus nodded, trying to be understanding. Grant had a huge family - Irish Catholic, he’d said once - but relations between them was often fraught, particularly where his patriarchal grandfather was concerned.
雷木斯點點頭，試圖理解。格蘭特有一個龐大的家庭——他曾經說過是愛爾蘭天主教徒——但他們之間的關係往往緊張，尤其是與他那個權威的祖父有關。

“Don’t get me wrong,” Grant was saying, “I really was going, this time, I was… but it just turned out wrong again. A lot’s turned out wrong, to be honest.”
「別誤會我的意思，」格蘭特說，「這次我真的打算去的，我……但結果又變得不對。說實話，很多事情都變得不對。」

Remus wanted to hug him, but he looked so thin, so wiry and prickly, it made him afraid to.
雷木斯想擁抱他，但他看起來如此瘦弱、精瘦而刺手，讓他感到害怕。

“How much is it?” He asked, digging into his pockets, “I’ve got a bit of money, left by my dad, you can have the fare, I’ll take you to the station today.”
「多少錢？」他問，挖掘自己的口袋，「我有一點錢，是我爸爸留給我的，你可以用來買票，今天我帶你去車站。」

“Couldn’t do that,” Grant held up his hands.
「不能這樣做，」格蘭特舉起雙手。

“Not to keep, obviously,” Remus said quickly, “You’d owe me. Look, I’ve got one more year of school, then I’ll come and find you - and you’ll have been working in your cousin’s pub, right? So you can pay me back - how much? Tenner?”
「顯然不是讓你留下來，」雷木斯迅速說道，「你會欠我一筆錢。看看，我還有一年的學校生活，然後我會來找你——你會在你表親的酒吧工作對吧？所以你可以還我——多少？十鎊？」

“Four quid.” Grant sighed. “I had four quid last week too, but I… I lost it. I didn’t drink it, promise.”
「四鎊。」格蘭特嘆了口氣。「我上週也有四鎊，但我……我丟了。我沒有花掉，保證。」

“Four quid?! I can lend you that. That’s fine.”
「四鎊？！我可以借給你。沒問題。」

“Are you serious?!” Grant stared at him, blinking.
「你認真的嗎？！」格蘭特瞪大眼睛盯著他。

“Of course,” Remus nodded, frowning slightly, “Why not? You’d do the same for me.”
「當然，」雷木斯點點頭，微微皺眉，「為什麼不？你會對我這樣做的。」

“I…” Grant shook his head, then pressed the heel of his hand into one eye, as if overcome with emotion. “Thanks, Remus. You’re such a good mate.”
「我……」格蘭特搖搖頭，然後把手掌的跟部按在一隻眼睛上，彷彿情緒被打動了。「謝謝，雷木斯。你真是個好夥伴。」

“You’d do the same for me,” Remus repeated.
「你會對我這樣做的，」雷木斯重複道。

It occurred to him for the first time that he and Grant were actually the same age. Grant had always been so knowing, so streetwise and protective, that Remus had considered him older; more mature. But he was only seventeen, and life had been as cruel to Grant as it had to Remus. Perhaps even more cruel, because after all, Remus knew in his heart he would never be homeless; he could never be alone while the marauders were there. He needed to learn to stop putting people on pedestals; stop expecting so much of everybody.
他第一次意識到他和格蘭特其實是同齡的。格蘭特一直非常成熟，街頭智慧和保護欲強，讓雷木斯覺得他年紀更大；更成熟。但他才十七歲，生活對格蘭特的殘酷程度和對雷木斯的一樣。甚至可能更殘酷，因為畢竟，雷木斯在心底知道自己永遠不會無家可歸；只要有麻瓜四人組在，他就不會孤單。他需要學會停止把人擺在神壇上；停止對每個人期望過高。

He stepped forward then, and hugged the other boy, minding not to burn himself on the cigarette.
他隨後走上前，擁抱了另一個男孩，注意不要燙到香煙。

“When’d you get so tall, anyway?” Grant laughed, muffled under Remus’s arm.
「你什麼時候變這麼高的？」格蘭特在雷木斯的手臂下笑著說。

“Don’t,” Remus chuckled, pulling back, “Sirius teases me all the time.”
「別這麼說，」雷木斯笑著，退後，「小天狼星總是取笑我。」

“Sirius.” Grant shook his head in amazement, “ Sirius and Remus. Bloody hell. It is him? The posh lad what broke your heart?”
「小天狼星。」格蘭特驚訝地搖搖頭，「小天狼星和雷木斯。天啊。真的是他？那個破壞了你心的人？」

“Er… yeah. It’s ok now, though.”
「嗯……對。現在沒事了。」

“I ‘ope so, Remus mate.”
「我希望如此，雷木斯。」

 

There was time for Grant to pack his meagre possessions, and for Sirius and Remus to take him for breakfast at a small cafe in Victoria station.
格蘭特有時間打包他那微不足道的財物，然後小天狼星和雷木斯帶他去維多利亞車站的一家小咖啡館吃早餐。

“You’re going to make me fat,” he said to Remus, as he scoffed down his second bacon butty.
「你會讓我變胖的，」他對雷木斯說，邊吃下第二個培根三明治邊說。

“No chance,” Remus said, prodding him in the ribs.
「不可能，」雷木斯說，捅了捅他的肋骨。

Sirius had been quiet all morning - but then he never did function well on a poor night’s sleep. He looked only slightly rumpled, his hair a little less lustrous than usual, his eyes a bit foggy. Remus could tell that he was still fascinated by the sights and sounds of muggle London - only of course he couldn’t explain that to Grant.
小天狼星整個早晨都很安靜——但他在睡不好的一夜後總是不怎麼運作良好。他看起來有點凌亂，頭髮比平時稍微少了些光澤，眼睛有點模糊。雷木斯能看出他仍然對麻瓜倫敦的景象和聲音充滿著好奇——只不過他當然無法向格蘭特解釋這一點。

Grant regarded Sirius with a similar wariness. He apologised for his behaviour the night before, and tried to explain that they’d caught him on a ‘bad night’. He seemed meeker in front of Sirius, less cheeky - perhaps perceiving him as a social superior, and therefore mildly dangerous. Remus well remembered how alien Potter and Black had been to him, once upon a time.
格蘭特對小天狼星也顯得同樣的謹慎。他為前一晚的行為道歉，並試圖解釋他們遇到他時正值「糟糕的夜晚」。在小天狼星面前，他顯得更為溫順，不那麼傲慢——也許是把他看作社會上的上層，因而略顯危險。雷木斯清楚地記得，曾經波特和布萊克對他來說是多麼陌生。

“You two got ya own train to catch, eh?” Grant said, eyes flicking to Sirius, then Remus, then back again.
「你們兩個得趕自己的火車吧？」格蘭特說，目光一會兒看向小天狼星，一會兒看向雷木斯，然後又回來。

“Yeah, but we’ve got time.” Remus said. “Here, I want to give you this…” he handed Grant a scrap of paper which had the Potter’s address on it, “It’s where I’m living when I‘m not at school. Will you send me a letter when you’re settled? A postcard? Promise.”
「是的，但我們還有時間。」雷木斯說。「來，我想給你這個……」他遞給格蘭特一張寫有波特地址的紙條，「這是我不在學校時住的地方。你定居後能給我寫封信嗎？明信片也行？答應我。」

“Yeah, ok,” Grant nodded, tucking it away, “Warning you, my handwriting’s shit an’ I can’t spell for toffee.”
「好的，」格蘭特點點頭，把紙條收好，「警告你，我的字跡很差，拼寫也很爛。」

“I don’t care about that. I just want to know where you are, next time. Do you need stamps? I should have bought stamps…”
「我不在乎那些。我只是想知道你下次在哪裡。你需要郵票嗎？我應該買些郵票……」

“I can get stamps,” Grant touched his arm, “You’ve done enough. Honest.”
「我可以弄到郵票，」格蘭特摸了摸他的手臂，「你已經做得夠多了。說真的。」

They hugged again on the platform. Grant shook Sirius’s hand, which was weird, but polite of him.
他們在月台上再次擁抱。格蘭特握了握小天狼星的手，這有點奇怪，但他這樣做是禮貌的。

“I’ll come and visit, at Christmas maybe, or next summer,” Remus said.
「我會來看你的，可能在聖誕節，或者明年夏天，」雷木斯說。

“I bloody well believe you, too - can’t get rid of ya, can I?” Grant grinned. His first genuine smile so far - it made Remus feel somewhat easier. “Like magnets, you and me, eh? Always snap right back together.”
「我也真他媽相信你——我不能擺脫你，不是嗎？」格蘭特笑了。他迄今為止的第一次真心微笑，讓雷木斯感到稍微放鬆。「像磁鐵一樣，你我，對吧？總是會立刻再聚在一起。」

This hit Remus in such a way that he had to hug Grant again, until the other boy laughed and pushed him away, “All right, all right - I’ve got a train to catch, y’know…”
這話讓雷木斯感受到一種情感，他不得不再次擁抱格蘭特，直到對方笑了起來，把他推開，「好了，好了——我得趕火車了，你知道的……」

And of course, so did Remus and Sirius. As soon as Grant had disappeared through the train doors, they bolted towards the Gentlemen’s toilets to apparate to King’s Cross. Inside the cubicle Sirius finally spoke. He touched Remus’s arm, where Grant had only minutes before,
當然，雷木斯和小天狼星也是如此。格蘭特一旦消失在火車門後，他們就衝向男廁，準備用瞬間移動到國王十字車站。小天狼星在隔間裡終於開口了。他摸了摸雷木斯的手臂，正是格蘭特剛才觸碰的地方，

“You look exhausted. Let me do it, you can side-along.”
「你看起來很累。讓我來做，你可以跟著我。」

“Really?” Remus could have said that he was no more tired than Sirius, who had put up with just as much as he had - but that would have been a lie. He was too tired to argue, even.
「真的？」雷木斯本來可以說他並不比小天狼星更累，小天狼星承受的也一樣多——但那會是一個謊言。他甚至太累了，不想爭論。

“Really.” Sirius nodded, taking his arm.
「真的。」小天狼星點點頭，拉住他的手臂。

“Thank you for staying with me. Thank you for helping him.”
「謝謝你陪著我。謝謝你幫助他。」

“Don’t be silly.” Sirius gave him a small smile. “He obviously… he loves you.”
「別傻了。」小天狼星給了他一個小微笑。「他顯然……他愛你。」

“He--” But Remus had no chance to finish his thought; he was spinning through space, noise and colour blurring as he and Sirius left Victoria and landed - fairly gracefully - just outside King’s Cross.
「他——」但雷木斯沒有機會完成他的想法；他正在穿越空間，噪音和顏色模糊不清，當他和小天狼星離開維多利亞車站，優雅地降落在國王十字車站外。

They had no choice but to run for the platform - and found James hanging out of the train door waving frantically,
他們別無選擇，只能跑向月台——發現詹姆斯正急切地從火車門裡伸出身子揮手，

“Fucking hell! Where have you two been ?!”
「他媽的！你們倆去哪兒了？！」

“Language!” Lily’s face poked out if the next window along, “You’re Head Boy now, you should be setting an example!”
「說話注意點！」莉莉的臉從旁邊的窗戶伸出來，「你現在是學長了，你應該樹立一個榜樣！」

“I am setting an example, telling these wankers off!” James retorted as Sirius and Remus clambered onto the train just as the guard’s whistle blew.
「我在樹立榜樣，對這些混蛋們發火！」詹姆斯回嘴道，當雷木斯和小天狼星剛上車，警衛的哨音響起。

“Language!” Lily said again, “Honestly, James, you really need to start growing up this year, you’re of age, you need to start acting…”
「說話注意點！」莉莉再次說，「說真的，詹姆斯，你今年真的需要開始成熟了，你已經成年了，你需要開始行為得體……」

“Isn’t she brilliant?!” James beamed at Remus, who was now sitting on the floor of the carriage, catching his breath. Sirius was bent over, hands on his knees, looking shockingly un-Sirius; red in the face, hair everywhere. James regarded them both, folding his arms, gold Head Boy and Quidditch Captain badges glinting on his dark robes. “So where were you?”
「她不是很棒嗎？！」詹姆斯對雷木斯笑了，雷木斯現在坐在車廂的地板上，喘著氣。小天狼星彎著腰，雙手撐在膝蓋上，看起來完全不像小天狼星；臉紅紅的，頭髮亂七八糟。詹姆斯打量著他們倆，雙臂交叉，金色的學長和魁地奇隊長徽章在他的深色袍子上閃爍。「你們去哪了？」

“Told you. Gig.” Sirius huffed.
「告訴過你了。音樂會。」小天狼星喘氣道。

“Which band?”
「哪個樂隊？」

“You don’t know them. Muggle band.”
「你不認識他們。麻瓜樂隊。」

“Why didn’t you come back last night? Where did you sleep ?!”
「你們為什麼昨晚不回來？你們睡在哪裡？！」

Sirius flashed a nervous look at Remus, and Remus could see that he was on the verge of spilling everything. He stood up quickly,
小天狼星焦急地瞟了雷木斯一眼，雷木斯能看出他快要說漏了。他迅速站起來，

“We didn’t sleep. It went on all night. We had breakfast then came straight here.”
「我們沒有睡。整晚都在活動。我們吃了早餐，然後直接來這裡。」

Sirius stared at him in amazement before nodding along. James shook his head.
小天狼星驚訝地盯著他，然後點了點頭。詹姆斯搖了搖頭。

“Mental. And dangerous. Seriously, lads, don’t do that again.”
「瘋了。還很危險。說真的，夥計們，別再這樣做了。」

“Won’t.” Sirius murmured, looking at his feet.
「不會的。」小天狼星低聲說，看著自己的腳。

Lily appeared in the corridor, hands on her hips, looking beautiful and terrifying.
莉莉出現在走廊上，雙手插腰，看起來既美麗又可怕。

“Potter.” She said, “We’ve got to lead the meeting.”
「波特。」她說，「我們得去主持會議。」

“Right you are!” James grinned, forgetting all about his two out of breath friends, following the redhead away towards the prefect’s carriage. “See you later, boys!” He called, absent mindedly.
「正是！」詹姆斯笑著，忘了他那兩個氣喘吁吁的朋友，跟著紅頭髮的莉莉離開，朝著學監車廂走去。「待會見，伙計們！」他心不在焉地喊道。

“You’re a really good liar,” Sirius said to Remus. Maybe it was the lack of sleep, or the pain in his hip, but this statement rubbed Remus the wrong way.
「你真是個很好的謊言者，」小天狼星對雷木斯說。也許是因為缺乏睡眠，或者是臀部的疼痛，但這句話讓雷木斯不舒服。

“What’s that supposed to mean?!” He snapped.
「這話什麼意思？！」他斥責道。

“Nothing.” Sirius looked down again. “C’mon, let’s find Pete.”
「沒什麼。」小天狼星再次低下頭。「來吧，我們去找彼得。」

Peter was sitting with Mary, Marlene and Dorcas in the carriage Lily had just exited. He looked a bit outnumbered, as the girls were swapping tips for fingernail strengthening charms.
彼得和瑪麗、瑪琳、道卡斯一起坐在莉莉剛離開的車廂裡。他看起來有點被人數壓倒，因為那些女孩正在交換增強指甲的咒語技巧。

“We thought you’d miss the train!” Marlene said, as Remus and Sirius entered.
「我們以為你們會錯過火車！」瑪琳說，當雷木斯和小天狼星進來時。

“You know me, McKinnon,” Sirius gave his most charming grin, “Like to make an entrance.”
「你知道我，麥金農，」小天狼星展現出他最迷人的笑容，「喜歡出場。」

“And now you’re dragging poor Remus down with you,” Mary laughed, “Come and sit here, Lupin, I’ll protect you from that delinquent.” She budged up in her seat to make room by the window. Remus took the space gratefully.
「而且你現在還拖累了可憐的雷木斯，」瑪麗笑著說，「過來坐這裡，盧平，我會保護你免受那個惡棍的侵擾。」她挪了挪座位，讓出窗邊的位置。雷木斯感激地坐下了。

“Where were you?” Peter asked, “You left me alone with Lily and James. I might as well have been a ghost.”
「你們去哪了？」彼得問，「你們把我一個人留給莉莉和詹姆斯。我簡直像是幽靈。」

“Gig. Stayed out late. Didn’t sleep.” Sirius waved a hand, yawning. He sat opposite Remus, and folded his arms, leaning tiredly against the window.
「音樂會。待到很晚。沒睡。」小天狼星揮了揮手，打了個哈欠。他坐在雷木斯對面，雙臂交叉，疲倦地靠在窗戶上。

The train began to move, and Remus closed his eyes - because he was exhausted, but also because that way he didn’t have to answer any more questions about where he’d been. The girls began to speak more quietly, and he eventually drifted to sleep.
火車開始啟動，雷木斯閉上了眼睛——因為他很累，但也因為這樣他就不用再回答任何關於他去過哪裡的問題了。女孩們開始低聲交談，他最終漸漸入睡。

When he woke up, they were already in Scotland, the dark rolling hills whooshing past, a smattering of rain hitting the windows.
當他醒來時，他們已經在蘇格蘭，黑暗的滾滾山丘快速掠過，窗戶上有點點雨珠。

Sirius was curled up on the seat opposite him, completely hidden under everyone else's cloaks. Remus could hear him breathing evenly; fast asleep.
小天狼星蜷縮在他對面的座位上，完全隱藏在其他人的斗篷下。雷木斯能聽到他均勻的呼吸聲；熟睡中。

Mary was just sliding the door open as Remus stretched, waving at her sleepily. She smiled and waved back but looked serious. Marlene frowned,
瑪麗正推開門，雷木斯伸展身體，睡意朦朧地向她揮手。她微笑著回揮手，但神情嚴肅。瑪琳皺起了眉頭，

“What’s up?”
「怎麼了？」

“I just saw Lily,” Mary whispered, “Something happened in the prefect carriage,” she glanced over at Sirius, still just a lump underneath the cloaks, and lowered her voice even further so that Remus and Marlene had to lean in, “James and Regulus got into a fight. They’re both ok, but it got quite nasty, by the sounds of it… Regulus was saying some really crazy stuff, Lily was really shaken.”
「我剛看到莉莉，」瑪麗低聲說，「在學監車廂裡發生了點事，」她瞥了一眼仍然在斗篷下的動靜不明的小天狼星，聲音更低，以便雷木斯和瑪琳能夠靠近，「詹姆斯和雷古勒斯打了起來。他們都沒事，但聽起來變得相當激烈……雷古勒斯說了一些非常瘋狂的話，莉莉被嚇壞了。」

“He’s one of them,” Marlene whispered, looking anxious, “The Black family are you-know-who’s strongest supporters, everyone knows it.”
「他是其中之一，」瑪琳低聲說，顯得焦慮，「布萊克家族是你知道的那個人的最強支持者，每個人都知道。」

“Sh.” Remus said, quickly, “We don’t know what it was about. It could be anything.”
「安靜。」雷木斯迅速說，「我們不知道是關於什麼的。可能是任何事。」

The girls fell quiet after that, but exchanged concerned looks with each other and Remus could tell they thought he was being naive.
之後女孩們靜默了，但彼此之間交換著擔憂的眼神，雷木斯能看出她們覺得他過於天真。

He leaned back and looked out of the window for a while, listening to Sirius’s relaxed heartbeat and worrying about Grant and wishing more than anything that the worst was already behind them.
他靠著，望向窗外一會兒，聽著小天狼星放鬆的心跳，擔心著格蘭特，並希望最壞的情況已經過去。

 

Chapter 120: Seventh Year: Thunder 

Neither Remus, nor Peter - who had also been in the carriage - said anything to Sirius about Mary’s intel. Peter probably kept quiet because he wasn’t sure how valuable the information was. Remus kept quiet because he was a coward, and if there had to be bad news, he’d prefer that James delivered it.
雷木斯和彼得——彼得也在車廂裡——對小天狼星提到瑪麗的情報時什麼也沒說。彼得可能是因為不確定這些信息的價值才保持沉默。雷木斯保持沉默是因為他是個膽小鬼，如果有壞消息，他更希望由詹姆斯來傳達。

And sure enough, James appeared to meet them all on the train platform with a very red looking eye, and a rumpled school uniform.
果然，詹姆斯出現在火車站台上，眼睛紅得很，校服也皺皺巴巴的。

“What happened to you?” Sirius yawned, oblivious.
「你發生了什麼事？」小天狼星打了個哈欠，完全無視。

“Tell you later.” James murmured, before jogging over to join Lily in herding the first years in the right direction.
「等會告訴你。」詹姆斯低聲說，然後小跑過去，和莉莉一起把新生引導到正確的方向。

It was still raining lightly, and growing dark already - Remus was very glad not to be crossing the lake. Still, it was bittersweet, climbing into the horseless carriages one last time with Sirius, Mary and Marlene (Peter had decided to follow the honey and get in with Dorcas and her friends). As they pulled into the castle courtyard Remus looked up at the towering stone and wondered if this would be his final memory of arriving at Hogwarts. Perhaps they would all be back for a reunion party in ten years. That was a pleasant thought, though 1987 seemed completely impossible right then.
雨還在細細地下，天色已經變暗——雷木斯很高興不必再渡湖。然而，登上無馬車廂的最後一次，和小天狼星、瑪麗以及瑪琳一起，還是讓人感到有點甜蜜的苦澀（彼得決定跟隨蜜糖，和道卡斯及她的朋友們一起上了車）。當他們進入城堡庭院時，雷木斯仰望那高聳的石頭，想知道這是否會成為他抵達霍格華茲的最後記憶。也許十年後他們都會回來參加一次重聚派對。那是一個愉快的想法，雖然1987年當時看起來完全不可能。

Remus tried to pay close attention to the sorting ceremony, the nervous line of tiny first years, the battered old hat, McGonagall’s stern but caring countenance. He tried to imprint every moment in his memory - but it wasn’t easy; there were so many distractions.
雷木斯試著專心致志地觀察分院儀式，小小的新生們緊張的隊伍，那頂破舊的帽子，麥格教授嚴厲但關懷的神情。他試圖把每一刻都印在記憶中——但這並不容易；有太多分心的事物。

First, there was James’s eye, which he still had not explained. Then there was Regulus, who was conspicuously absent. Snape, glowering as always, his eyes never leaving the back of Lily Evans’ head. Christopher, who kept trying to catch Remus’s eye, and Sirius, who was completely unaware of everything else, and simply thrilled to be back at Hogwarts; his true home. Remus was trying to enjoy Sirius’s good mood without looking too much like he was staring. It was a real art.
首先是詹姆斯的眼睛，他至今仍未解釋。接著是雷古勒斯，他顯然缺席了。斯內普，像往常一樣陰沉，目光緊盯莉莉·艾文斯的背部。克里斯托弗，試圖引起雷木斯的注意，小天狼星則完全無視其他一切，單純地為回到霍格華茲感到興奮；那是他的真正家園。雷木斯試圖享受小天狼星的好心情，同時不讓自己看起來過於盯著他。這是一門真正的藝術。

Just as Dumbledore announced that dinner was served, the doors at the back of the hall flew open. All heads turned to see - except for Remus, who only needed to see the smile die on Sirius’s face to know who it was.
正當鄧布利多宣布晚餐已經準備好時，禮堂後面的門突然打開了。所有人都轉過頭去看——除了雷木斯，他只需要看到小天狼星臉上的笑容消失，就知道那是誰。

Regulus did not hurry to his seat, as Remus probably would have, embarrassed to draw attention. No, Regulus was a Black through and through, and walked with his usual regal bearing, slowly and with purpose, head held high. There was no evidence that James had done any damage, but Remus thought that Reg was looking even paler than usual, and dark around the eyes as if he had lost a lot of sleep lately. The sixth year Slytherins made a big show of making room for him, as if he was a guest of honour, rather than their school mate. Even Snape’s attention was momentarily diverted, as he leaned across to shake Regulus’s hand.
雷古勒斯並沒有像雷木斯可能會那樣匆忙找座位，因為他尷尬地引起注意。不，雷古勒斯徹底是個布萊克，他以一貫的威嚴步伐，慢慢而有目的地走著，昂首闊步。沒有證據表明詹姆斯造成了什麼傷害，但雷木斯覺得雷古勒斯看起來比平時更蒼白，眼睛周圍發黑，好像最近失眠了很多。第六年的斯萊特林們大肆展示出為他騰出位置的樣子，好像他是貴賓，而不是他們的同學。甚至斯內普的注意力也短暫地轉移了，向雷古勒斯伸出了手。

All of this took up only a few moments, but it left an indelible mark on the Gryffindor seventh years, as they all eyed Sirius warily.
這一切只花了幾分鐘，但對於格蘭芬多七年級的學生來說，留下了深刻的印記，他們都警惕地盯著小天狼星。

“Mate,” James said, very quietly, “I need to tell you something, later. In private.” He glanced up at Remus and Peter as he said this, so that they knew they were included in this.
「夥計，」詹姆斯低聲說，「我需要跟你說點事，稍後。私下裡。」他在說這話時瞥了一眼雷木斯和彼得，讓他們知道他們也被包括在內。

Sirius just nodded, and kept his head down for the rest of the meal, only picking at his food. Remus’s heart ached, but there was nothing he could do. His sense of separation was inadvertently exacerbated by Lily and James, who kept squeezing each other’s hands under the table. Remus didn’t know when he and Sirius would next have the chance to be alone.
小天狼星只是點了點頭，整個用餐過程中都低著頭，只是挑挑食物。雷木斯的心感到疼痛，但他無能為力。他的隔閡感在莉莉和詹姆斯無意中加劇了，他們在桌子下不斷握著對方的手。雷木斯不知道他和小天狼星下一次何時能有單獨的機會。

After dinner it was an almost unbearable wait for Lily and James to finish up with their new duties as Head Boy and Girl. Remus was nodding in his armchair, failing to focus on his Care of Magical Creatures NEWT text, eyelids growing heavier and heavier.
晚餐後，雷木斯幾乎無法忍受地等待莉莉和詹姆斯完成他們作為學長和學姐的新職責。雷木斯在扶手椅上打盹，無法集中注意力在他的神奇生物護理NEWt課本上，眼瞼越來越沉重。

“Psst, Moony,” James woke him, finally, with a gentle shake, “C’mon, we’re all heading up.”
「噓，穆尼，」詹姆斯最終輕輕搖醒他，「來吧，我們都要上樓了。」

Remus blinked, staring about himself in surprise - the common room was almost empty.
雷木斯眨了眨眼，驚訝地四處張望——公共休息室幾乎空蕩蕩的。

Upstairs in their bedroom, all of their trunks had arrived, their beds were made and pyjamas laid out. Rain was still battering the window panes, and Remus could smell a storm on its way - electricity and pressure making the air feel thick and too close.
樓上的臥室裡，他們所有的行李都已經到達，床鋪已經整理好了，睡衣也擺好了。雨仍在猛烈拍打窗戶，雷木斯能嗅到風暴即將來臨——電氣和壓力使空氣感覺黏稠而逼仄。

Sirius was pacing, and though a window was open the room stank of cigarettes from his chain smoking. He had showered at some point, and his hair was still damp at the ends, dripping onto the maroon t-shirt he wore to bed. Peter was just coming out of the bathroom, already in his pyjamas and smelling faintly of toothpaste.
小天狼星來回踱步，儘管窗戶開著，房間裡還是充滿了他連續吸煙後的煙味。他在某個時候洗了澡，頭髮末端仍然濕漉漉的，滴在他睡覺時穿的酒紅色T恤上。彼得剛從浴室出來，已經穿上睡衣，身上還有淡淡的牙膏味。

“You didn’t wake me up.” Remus said neutrally to Sirius. Sirius shrugged, carelessly, sitting down on his bed,
「你沒叫醒我。」雷木斯平靜地對小天狼星說。小天狼星隨意地耸了耸肩，坐在他的床上，

“You looked comfortable. Thought you could probably do with the rest.” He turned to James. “Well?”
「你看起來很舒服。覺得你可能需要休息一下。」他轉向詹姆斯。「那麼？」

“It’s about Regulus,” James said, not beating about the bush.
「是關於雷古勒斯的，」詹姆斯直言不諱地說。

“He give you that?” Sirius nodded at James’s now very prominent black eye.
「他給你的？」小天狼星指著詹姆斯現在明顯的黑眼圈。

“Yeah.” James nodded. He looked angry - a strange emotion on James. “Yeah, we had a few words in the prefect’s carriage…”
「是的。」詹姆斯點了點頭。他看起來很生氣——這是詹姆斯不常有的情緒。「是的，我們在督學車廂裡有幾句話...」

“Words.”
「話。」

“Yeah,” James’s jaw was tight, and the back of his neck was flushed red. He flexed his fists, “Seems like Regulus and some of his mates have a problem with Evans being Head Girl.”
「是的，」詹姆斯的下巴緊繃，脖子後面泛紅。他握緊了拳頭，「看來雷古勒斯和他的一些朋友對艾文斯擔任學姐有問題。」

“Oh no,” Peter said, realising what had happened, “James, he didn’t... “
「哦不，」彼得說，意識到發生了什麼事，「詹姆斯，他沒...」

“He was all talk.” James said.
「他只會嘴巴說說。」詹姆斯說。

“But you weren’t.” Sirius said. He was still sitting on the bed, his shoulders slumped.
「但你不是。」小天狼星說。他仍然坐在床上，肩膀垂下來。

“Prongs!” Remus sighed, impatiently, “You didn’t attack him first?! You know that’s exactly what that lot want from our side. You should just have ignored him.”
「詹姆斯！」雷木斯不耐煩地嘆息，「你沒有先攻擊他嗎？！你知道那群人正是想要我們這邊這樣做的。你應該直接忽略他。」

“He didn’t make it very easy.” James snapped, still wound up. “Anyway, don’t bother, I’ve had all this from Lily.”
「他不容易讓人忽視。」詹姆斯咬牙切齒地說，仍然很激動。「無論如何，別再費心了，莉莉已經告訴我一切。」

Remus wondered what she had to say - he couldn’t imagine that she would have taken very kindly to James playing the white knight. But then, Mary had said she’d been very shaken. “I didn’t hurt him, anyway,” James carried on. He had begun to pace the room, now that Sirius had stopped. “Just wanted to shut him up - I was going to use silencio, or maybe scourgify his mouth, you know - but the little weasel dodged it and tried to get me back, so I used jelly-legs. That’s when Mulciber swung for me, and Evans petrified all three of us. Just for a few minutes. Still, I got Regulus, so he had to go to the hospital wing and it all got written up.”
雷木斯想知道她說了什麼——他無法想像她會對詹姆斯充當白衣騎士的行為有多友善。但瑪麗說她感到非常震驚。「反正我沒有傷到他，」詹姆斯繼續說。他開始在房間裡來回踱步，因為小天狼星已經停止了。「只是想讓他閉嘴——我本來打算用靜音咒，或者也許是清潔咒，你知道的——但那隻小鼬鼠躲開了，試圖報復我，所以我用了腿麻痺咒。然後穆爾基伯揮向我，艾文斯將我們三個都石化了。只是幾分鐘。不過，我抓到了雷古勒斯，他不得不去醫務室，然後一切都被寫下來了。」

“Are you in trouble?” Peter asked, chewing his fingernails.
「你有麻煩嗎？」彼得問，咬著指甲。

“Nah,” James waved a hand, “Loads of witnesses said Reg was asking for it, and in the end it was Gryffindor vs. Slytherin so McGonagall and Slughorn agreed to give us another chance to ‘be civil’.” He pulled a face at this.
「沒事，」詹姆斯揮了揮手，「很多目擊者說雷古勒斯自找的，最後是格蘭芬多對斯萊特林，所以麥格教授和斯拉赫霍恩同意給我們一次‘文明對待’的機會。」他對此做了個鬼臉。

“But Reg is ok?” Sirius asked, quietly.
「但雷古勒斯沒事吧？」小天狼星輕聲問。

“Yeah, fine.” James nodded. He stopped moving and scratched his head, awkwardly, “There’s something else, though…”
「嗯，沒事。」詹姆斯點頭。他停下來，尷尬地抓了抓頭，「不過，還有其他事...」

Sirius looked up. His arms were folded across his body, but not in a defiant way - more as if to protect himself.
小天狼星抬頭看著。他的雙臂抱在胸前，但不是挑釁的姿態——更像是保護自己。

“What?”
「什麼？」

“Regulus, when Lily petrified him he fell, and we had to lift him up onto a seat. He’d rolled his sleeves up to duel, and when I was moving him, I saw… I saw… on his arm…”
「雷古勒斯，當莉莉石化他時，他摔倒了，我們不得不把他抬到座位上。他捲起了袖子準備打鬥，當我在搬動他時，我看到...我看到...在他的手臂上...」

“Prongs?” Sirius was staring at his friend with such a burning in his eyes that his pupils were twin flames - he looked desperate, as if willing James not to tell him.
「詹姆斯？」小天狼星用燒灼的目光盯著他的朋友，他的瞳孔如雙火焰般熾熱——他看起來很絕望，好像在希望詹姆斯不要告訴他。

“He’s got the mark.”
「他有那個印記。」

Peter made a noise, and sat down hard on his bed. Remus bit his lip, and stayed still, because he couldn’t think of anything else to do that wouldn’t look suspicious.
彼得發出一聲噪音，重重地坐在他的床上。雷木斯咬著嘴唇，靜靜地待著，因為他想不到其他不會顯得可疑的事情。

Sirius swallowed - Remus could see his adam’s apple bob - then looked down, then back up at James. Now he looked defiant. He gave another shrug, which was probably meant to be casual, except he was still hugging himself, so it just looked petulant. He tossed his hair,
小天狼星吞了吞口水——雷木斯可以看到他的喉結上下擺動——然後低下頭，再抬頭看詹姆斯。現在他看起來很挑釁。他又耸了耸肩，這大概是想表現得隨意，只是他還是擁抱著自己，所以看起來更像是悶悶不樂。他甩了甩頭髮，

“Well then.” He said, “S’pose we know how my family spent their summer, then. Fine. That’s fine. He’s picked his side. I’ve picked mine.” He nodded, as if agreeing with himself. “Fine.” He repeated.
「那麼。」他說，「想必我們知道我家人怎麼度過他們的暑假了。好吧。這沒問題。他選擇了自己的立場。我也選擇了我的。」他點了點頭，好像在自我認同。「好吧。」他重複道。

“Padfoot,” James reached out to his friend, “I’m angry with Reg, ok? I’m not… it’s nothing to do with you, everybody knows you’re not one of them.”
「天狼星，」詹姆斯伸出手去摸他的朋友，「我對雷古勒斯很生氣，好嗎？我不是...這跟你無關，每個人都知道你不是他們中的一員。」

“I know.” Sirius said, almost violently. “It’s fine.” He squeezed his hands tighter over his arms and Remus felt dizzy with the urge to run over and wrap his own arms around him. “Is Evans ok?”
「我知道。」小天狼星幾乎是暴力地說。「沒事。」他更緊地擠壓著雙臂，雷木斯感到一陣頭暈，急切地想跑過去把他抱住。「艾文斯沒事吧？」

“Yeah, she’s fine.” James said, “I mean, I think she was hurt, but… well, she’s tougher than me. Cooler under pressure.”
「嗯，她沒事。」詹姆斯說，「我是說，我覺得她受了傷，但...她比我更堅強。面對壓力時更冷靜。」

“Want me to have a word? With Reg, I mean?”
「你要我去和雷古勒斯談談嗎？」

“I’d leave it, mate,” James shook his head. “McGonagall and Slughorn know everything now, you’ll only make it worse.”
「我會留給你的，夥伴，」詹姆斯搖了搖頭。「麥格教授和斯拉赫霍恩現在知道一切，你只會讓事情變得更糟。」

“Everything?” Sirius looked up again. The rims of his eyes were red - but that might just be tiredness.
「一切？」小天狼星再度抬頭。眼睛的邊緣紅紅的——但這可能只是疲倦。

“Not everything,” James admitted, “Not about the mark, I wanted to leave that up to you…”
「不是一切，」詹姆斯承認，「不是關於那個印記的，我想把這留給你...」

“...Ok.” Sirius looked down again. They were all quiet for a long time, before James tried again, heroically.
「...好吧。」小天狼星再次低下頭。他們靜靜地待了很久，直到詹姆斯再次英勇地開口。

“Do you want to talk about it?”
「你想談談嗎？」

“No.” Sirius replied. “I just want to go to bed.”
「不。」小天狼星回答。「我只想去睡覺。」

“Yeah, good idea.” James said, running his fingers through his hair.
「嗯，好主意。」詹姆斯說，撫摸著頭髮。

He was doing the usual James-thing - taking charge, assessing and managing the Sirius-thing - but the wind was obviously out of his sails. He wasn’t sure what to do. Remus wished he could tell him, telepathically; he knew exactly the right thing. But it was a bad idea. No need to add his own nonsense to the pile. He would simply have to wait.
他在做詹姆斯一貫的事情——掌控局面，評估和處理小天狼星的問題——但顯然他已經無法再從中獲得力量。他不知道該怎麼做。雷木斯希望能用心電感應告訴他，他知道正確的做法。但這是個糟糕的主意。沒有必要在這堆亂象中再增加自己的胡言亂語。他只能靜靜等待。

They all got ready for bed quietly, unpacking a few things, reclaiming their space on the bathroom counter, settling back into the comfortable and familiar room in which they had shared an entire childhood. Remus took a quick shower, to wash London off him, then brushed his teeth and dressed for bed.
他們靜靜地準備上床，打開了一些東西，重新佔據了浴室櫃檯上的空間，回到那個他們共度整個童年的舒適而熟悉的房間。雷木斯快速地洗了個澡，洗去倫敦的氣息，然後刷牙，換上睡衣。

When he opened the door again, he found the curtains drawn around all of the beds except his own. Light snoring was coming from Peter’s, but James and Sirius were still awake. If Remus concentrated very hard, he could even sense how they were lying (James on his back, tossing his lucky golden snitch up and down, Sirius curled up on his side), and how relaxed they were (not at all). That felt like an invasion of privacy, though, so he just tried to creep as quietly as possible to his own four-poster, looking forward to a proper rest at last.
當他再次打開門時，發現除了自己的床外，所有的床都拉上了簾子。彼得的床傳來輕微的打鼾聲，但詹姆斯和小天狼星仍然醒著。如果雷木斯集中精力，他甚至能感覺到他們的姿勢（詹姆斯仰臥，將他的幸運金色飛賊上下擲動，小天狼星側身蜷縮著），以及他們的放鬆程度（完全沒有）。不過，這感覺像是對隱私的侵擾，所以他只是盡量輕手輕腳地走向自己的四柱床，期待著最後能有一個真正的好好休息。

No such luck.
但沒這麼幸運。

“Remus.” Sirius’s head popped out from behind his curtains. Remus turned his head,
「雷木斯。」小天狼星的頭從窗簾後面冒了出來。雷木斯轉過頭來，

“Sirius.” He whispered back.
「小天狼星。」他低聲回答。

Sirius pulled back the curtain and - after a quick glance at the other beds - Remus climbed in as neatly as he could. Inside it was pitch dark, but he could still see Sirius’s warm outline, kneeling before him. He twitched his wand.
小天狼星拉開了簾子——在快速掃了一眼其他床鋪後，雷木斯儘量整齊地爬了進來。裡面一片漆黑，但他仍然能看到小天狼星溫暖的輪廓，跪在他面前。他輕輕揮動了魔杖。

“ Sonoro Quiescis .”
「靜音咒。」

“James isn’t asleep yet,” Remus cautioned, “Are you sure you want me--”
「詹姆斯還沒睡，」雷木斯提醒道，「你確定你要我——」

“Yes,” Sirius replied, “Please stay, just for a little bit.” He reached out and grasped Remus’s hand, squeezing it. Remus relented and finally put his arms around Sirius, pulling him closer. It was an immense relief.
「是的，」小天狼星回答，「請留下來，只一會兒。」他伸出手抓住雷木斯的手，緊緊握住。雷木斯讓步了，終於把手臂圍繞在小天狼星身上，把他拉得更近。這是一種巨大的安慰。

“I’m so sorry about Reg.”
「我對雷古勒斯感到非常抱歉。」

“He’s not even of age!”
「他還不到成年！」

“I know.”
「我知道。」

They pulled apart, and sat cross legged, facing each other. Sirius’s head was bowed, his hair covering his face. He probably remembered how well Remus could see in the dark.
他們分開了，盤腿坐下，面對面。小天狼星低下頭，頭髮遮住了他的臉。他可能記得雷木斯在黑暗中看得多麼清楚。

“I can’t believe… I know it’s stupid, I should have known all along that he would, but… I dunno, I suppose I just hoped he’d…”
「我不敢相信……我知道這很傻，我應該早就知道他會這樣，但……我不知道，我想我只是希望他會……」

“It’s not stupid.” Remus said. “And we don’t know he joined willingly. Remember what they did to you, when they wanted you to join him.”
「這不傻。」雷木斯說。「而且我們不知道他是否是自願加入的。記得他們對你做了什麼，當他們想讓你加入他們時。」

Sirius flinched, but didn’t move away.
小天狼星畏縮了一下，但沒有退開。

“Yeah.” He murmured. “I doubt it got that far with Reg. He was always… he always wanted it more than me. The whole circus; our parent’s approval, the respect you get from purebloods just for being a Black. We like to be popular, and powerful. It only makes sense. That’s why we’re all Slytherins.”
「是的。」他喃喃道。「我懷疑雷古勒斯會那麼遠。他總是……他總是比我更渴望這些。整個鬧劇；我們父母的認可，純血家族對黑家族的尊敬。我們喜歡受歡迎和強大。這也很合情合理。這就是為什麼我們都是斯萊特林。」

“You’re not a Slytherin.”
「你不是斯萊特林。」

“No, I’m not.” Sirius exhaled, shakily, “I used to think…”
「不，我不是。」小天狼星顫抖著吐出一口氣，「我曾經認為……」

“What?”
「什麼？」

“I used to think… maybe I didn’t get sorted into Gryffindor because I’m brave, or chivalrous, like James is. Maybe I just wasn’t welcome in Slytherin because I haven’t got the ambition.”
「我曾經認為……也許我沒有被分到格蘭芬多是因為我勇敢，或者像詹姆斯那樣有騎士精神。也許我在斯萊特林不受歡迎是因為我沒有雄心。」

“Ambition?!” Remus stared at him, “Sirius, what Reg is doing, it isn’t… it’s not anything to be proud of. It’s cowardly; he’s doing exactly what he’s been raised to do, without thinking, without questioning .”
「雄心？！」雷木斯盯著他，「小天狼星，雷古勒斯在做的事，它不是……這不是值得驕傲的事。這是懦弱的；他在做的正是他被教導去做的，沒有思考，沒有質疑。」

“Yeah, but…”
「是的，但……」

“And you’re the bravest person I know.”
「而且你是我認識的最勇敢的人。」

“Moony…”
「月亮狼……」

“Really.” Remus said this with such seriousness that it stopped Sirius in his tracks.
「真的。」雷木斯以如此認真的語氣說道，讓小天狼星停下了腳步。

“Thanks.” Sirius smiled. He reached forward again, plucking the fabric of Remus’s pyjama bottoms and sniffing slightly. “I thought that keeping quiet about you and me would be the hardest thing about this year,” he said, “Forgot about the stupid war.”
「謝謝。」小天狼星微笑著。他再次伸手，撫摸雷木斯睡衣褲的布料，輕輕嗅了一下。「我以為保密我們之間的事是今年最難的事情，」他說，「忘記了那場愚蠢的戰爭。」

“Yeah.” Remus wasn’t sure how to respond. He wished he could forget about the war too. Sirius looked up at him, sensing his unease,
「嗯。」雷木斯不確定如何回答。他也希望能忘記戰爭。小天狼星看著他，感受到他的不安，

“It’s still hard.” He said, “Keeping this quiet,” his fingers kept playing with the cuffs of Remus’s trouser leg. “I feel like we’re so far apart, when the others are around.”
「這仍然很難。」他說，「保守這個秘密，」他的手指不斷玩弄著雷木斯褲腿的褲口。「當其他人圍繞時，我覺得我們如此遙遠。」

“We’re pretty close right now,” Remus offered, hoping to cheer him up a bit. It worked. Sirius took this as an invitation and finally met his eye, grinning. He leaned over and as their lips met Remus forced himself to forget about everything else, just for a little bit.
「我們現在很親近，」雷木斯說，希望能讓他高興些。這有效。小天狼星把這當作邀請，終於對上了他的眼睛，露出了笑容。他靠過來，他們的嘴唇接觸時，雷木斯強迫自己暫時忘掉其他一切。

Afterwards, they found themselves crawling under the covers for warmth, sleepy and affectionate.
之後，他們在被窩下蜷縮著取暖，困倦而充滿愛意。

“I shouldn’t get too comfortable,” Remus yawned, “I’d better go back to my bed.”
「我不應該太舒服，」雷木斯打了個哈欠，「我最好回到我的床上。」

“Not yet,” Sirius whispered, shyly.
「還不行，」小天狼星害羞地低聲說。

“Ok.” His eyes were very heavy, though. He was in real danger of falling asleep.
「好吧。」他的眼睛非常沉重。他真的有可能會睡著。

“Remus?”
「雷木斯？」

“Mm.”
「嗯。」

“Tell me a secret.” Sirius’s fingers curled around his.
「告訴我一個秘密。」小天狼星的手指纏繞在他的手上。

“Um. I dunno.”
「嗯。我不知道。」

“Go on. Something good. Happy.”
「說吧。什麼好的事。開心的事。」

“Er…” Perhaps now was the right time. He didn’t like to bring up the Black family, but after all, it wasn’t about Regulus or Walpurga. “I could tell you about something I did in my second year, if you won’t get angry…”
「呃……也許現在是時候了。他不喜歡提到黑家族，但畢竟，這不是關於雷古勒斯或沃爾普爾加的。「我可以告訴你我第二年做的事情，如果你不會生氣……」

“What did you do?”
「你做了什麼？」

“Promise you won’t get angry. It’s a bit… well, remember I was thirteen, and I only wanted to help.”
「答應我你不會生氣。這有點……好吧，記得我當時才十三歲，我只是想幫忙。」

“Merlin, Moony, just tell me!”
「梅林，月亮狼，快告訴我！」

“Narcissa,” he said, “I um… I gave her the idea to use the unbreakable vow. You know, to get out of the engagement.”
「娜迦希莎，」他說，「我呃……我給了她使用不破誓言的主意。你知道，就是為了擺脫訂婚。」

The engagement, not your engagement, because that was still too painful.
訂婚，不是你的訂婚，因為那仍然太痛苦了。

Sirius was quiet. Remus bit his lip, and turned his head on the pillow to get a look at Sirius’s face. “I’m really sorry for interfering… But you gave me that reading spell, and you were so… I just thought you were so amazing and clever and brave, I wanted to do something to help you for once.”
小天狼星安靜了。雷木斯咬了咬嘴唇，轉過頭來看小天狼星的臉。「我真的很抱歉插手……但你給了我那個閱讀咒語，你那麼……我只是覺得你真的很棒、聰明和勇敢，我想做些什麼來幫助你一次。」

“But you didn’t want to tell me about it?”
「但你不想告訴我這件事？」

“I, er… no, I didn’t. At first I didn’t want to boast about it. Then so much time had passed, it just didn’t seem worth it.”
「我，呃……不，我不想。一開始我不想吹噓這件事。後來時間過得太久，似乎不值得。」

“Moony!” Sirius exhaled again - exasperated this time. “Honestly, you and your secrets!”
「月亮狼！」小天狼星再次吐出一口氣——這次是厭煩的。「說實話，你和你的秘密！」

“I’m sorry!”
「對不起！」

“Don’t be sorry,” Sirius chuckled, yawning again and shifting slightly to get comfortable, “I s’pose I did ask. And… that’s bloody impressive. I couldn’t have come up with that, at thirteen.”
「別道歉，」小天狼星笑著說，再次打了個哈欠，稍微調整了一下以便舒適，「我想我確實問過。那……真是太厲害了。我在十三歲時可想不出這個。」

“Well, you didn’t.” Remus smirked.
「嗯，你沒想出來。」雷木斯露出一抹微笑。

“So you actually went and talked to my cousin?”
「所以你真的去和我的表妹談過？」

“Yeah. She was terrifying.”
「是的。她非常可怕。」

“Still is.” Sirius snorted. “They all bloody are.”
「還是這樣。」小天狼星哼了一聲。「她們全都是。」

“Don’t think about it now,” Remus chastised him, “Or I’ll have to cheer you up again, and I can’t think of any more secrets tonight.”
「現在別想這些，」雷木斯責備他，「否則我得再次讓你高興起來，我今晚想不出更多的秘密了。」

“There are other ways…” Sirius replied, slyly. Remus laughed, hoping the silencing spell was still secure.
「還有其他方式……」小天狼星狡黠地回答。雷木斯笑了，希望靜音咒語還有效。

“Harlot.”
「蕩婦。」

Chapter 121: Seventh Year: Quill Shopping 

Friday 9th September 1977

“Seven years. Seven years at this school. And I haven’t learnt anything.” Remus said, as he frantically looked for the right passage in his History books.
「七年了。七年在這所學校。我什麼都沒學到。」雷木斯說著，慌忙尋找歷史書中的正確段落。

There were twelve of them open, currently, and he couldn’t remember which had the best counter argument for the 1382 Pixie Relocation Act. Seven of the books lay open on the desk in front of him, taking up almost all of the space. Five more hovered in mid air, at eye level so that he could check for references as he went.
現在有十二本書攤開著，他無法記住哪一本書對1382年精靈遷徙法案有最佳的反駁。七本書在他面前的桌子上攤開，佔據了幾乎所有的空間。另五本書則懸在空中，與眼睛平行，以便他在翻閱時能檢查參考資料。

“If you haven’t learnt anything, then what chance have the rest of us got?” Christopher smiled peacefully from his spot on the floor. He was sitting cross-legged, books on the carpet in front of him.
「如果你什麼都沒學到，那我們其他人還有什麼機會呢？」克里斯多福在地板上的位置上和平地笑著。他盤腿坐著，面前的地毯上擺著書本。

“I haven’t learnt anything useful.” Remus replied, impatiently, still searching.
「我沒有學到任何有用的東西。」雷木斯不耐煩地回答，仍在搜尋。

“How are we defining useful?”
「我們怎麼定義有用？」

“Anything that will help me pass my NEWTs.”
「任何能幫我通過新生考試的東西。」

“Oh, because you really buggered up your OWLs…” Christopher tutted sarcastically.
「哦，因為你真的搞砸了你的魔法史高級考試……」克里斯多福諷刺地嘆息道。

“NEWTs are completely different.” Remus countered, finally locating the passage he needed, now losing his quill. “Nastily exhausting…” He found his quill (behind his ear, embarrassingly enough), but now… “Shit.”
「新生考試完全不同。」雷木斯反駁道，最終找到了他需要的段落，卻發現丟失了他的羽毛筆。「非常累人……」他找到了他的羽毛筆（尷尬地在耳後），但現在……「該死。」

“What?” Christopher looked up.
「怎麼了？」克里斯多福抬起頭來。

“Lost my inkwell…”
「丟了我的墨水瓶……」

“You ought to get one of those self-inking quills. We can look in Hogsmeade, next weekend if you fancy.”
「你應該買一支自動上墨的羽毛筆。我們可以在霍格斯密去看看，下個週末如果你願意的話。」

“Yeah, why not…” Remus continued lifting books.
「嗯，為什麼不呢……」雷木斯繼續搬起書本。

“Here, I’ve got a pencil if it’s just note taking…” Christopher crawled underneath the desk now to find his book bag. Remus felt a bit guilty then, for taking up all the space.
「這裡，我有一支鉛筆如果只是做筆記……」克里斯多福現在爬到桌子下面去找他的書包。雷木斯感到有點內疚，因為占用了所有空間。

“Sorry.” He said, stepping back from the madness for a moment, “It’s fine. It’ll all be fine once we get the study group up and running again…”
「對不起。」他說，暫時從混亂中退後一步，「沒關係。一切都會好起來的，一旦我們重新開始學習小組……」

“Talking to yourself, Moony?” James and Sirius appeared in quidditch robes (Sirius was still officially off the team, but nothing was stopping him from using the pitch on off days, and at least it kept him distracted.)
「自言自語，月亮狼？」詹姆斯和小天狼星穿著魁地奇袍子出現（小天狼星仍然官方上不在隊伍中，但沒有什麼能阻止他在休息日使用場地，至少這讓他保持了分心。）

“Merlin’s wrinkly ballsack.” Sirius said, staring at Remus’s desk. “You can’t have this much homework after the first week?!”
「梅林的皺巴巴的蛋蛋。」小天狼星說著，盯著雷木斯的書桌。「第一週後你怎麼會有這麼多作業？！」

“I’m reading around my subject.” Remus replied, irritable again.
「我正在閱讀相關主題。」雷木斯再次不耐煩地回答。

“Here you are, Remus,” Christopher reappeared from under the table, brandishing a pencil.
「這裡，雷木斯，」克里斯多福從桌子下重新出現，揮舞著一支鉛筆。

“Cheers!” Remus took it and began to scribble away onto his parchment.
「謝謝！」雷木斯拿過鉛筆，開始在羊皮紙上寫字。

“Oh, hello Black,” Christopher nodded politely, ducking his head.
「哦，你好，布萊克，」克里斯多福禮貌地點了點頭，低下了頭。

Remus glanced up, mid-scribble. Sirius was looking at Christopher with a bored kind of disdain.
雷木斯抬起頭來，正寫字的時候。小天狼星以一種無聊的蔑視看著克里斯多福。

“Hello.” He nodded. He looked at Remus, “Study group, is it?”
「你好。」他點了點頭。他看著雷木斯，「學習小組嗎？」

“No, just ordinary studying today,” Remus explained. “But I was just saying we ought to set up a meeting soon - if people still want to do it.”
「不，今天只是普通學習，」雷木斯解釋道。「但我剛才在說我們應該儘快安排一次會議——如果大家仍然想做的話。」

“Of course they will!” Christopher said, eagerly, “You got half of us through our OWLs last year.”
「當然了！」克里斯多福熱切地說，「你讓我們一半的人通過了去年的魔法史高級考試。」

“Yeah,” Sirius said, out of the blue. He looked thoughtful, which was dangerous. “Yeah, I might join this year. What’dyou think, Prongs?”
「是的，」小天狼星突然說。他看起來很深思，這很危險。「是的，我可能會加入。今年怎麼樣，角？」

Jamus looked up from the sofa, where he was polishing his broom.
詹姆斯從沙發上抬起頭來，當時他正在擦拭他的掃帚。

“Mate, I’m busy enough as it is! --Sorry, Remus.”
「夥計，我已經很忙了！——對不起，雷木斯。」

Remus shrugged. He looked at Sirius,
雷木斯聳聳肩。他看著小天狼星，

“You’d hate being in a study group.”
「你會討厭參加學習小組。」

“Well I’ll never know unless I try, will I? And you’re always saying it’s such an important year.”
「我不試怎麼知道呢？而且你總是說這是一個非常重要的年級。」

“Mm, I’ve been saying that for the past three years, actually…”
「嗯，實際上我已經說了三年了……」

“And it’s finally sunk in!” Sirius grinned. That Sirius Black grin. Even with everything between them now, it was completely disarming. “Besides,” Sirius continued, looking at Christopher now, “I might be able to impart some of my wisdom.”
「而且終於明白了！」小天狼星笑了。那個小天狼星的笑容。即使現在他們之間有了一切，它仍然完全能讓人放鬆。「而且，」小天狼星繼續說，看向克里斯多福，「我可能能傳授一些我的智慧。」

Remus didn’t argue it any further. He’d learnt his lesson - you couldn’t tell Sirius anything; just had to let him work it out for himself. And yes, he probably wanted to join the study group because Christopher was in it. But after all; Sirius had made the choice to keep the relationship quiet; Sirius was choosing to pretend that he really did want to do homework. Remus would just go along with it.
雷木斯沒有進一步爭辯。他已經學到教訓——你不能告訴小天狼星任何事情；只能讓他自己弄明白。而且，是的，他可能想加入學習小組是因為克里斯多福也在其中。但畢竟，小天狼星選擇了保持這段關係的秘密；小天狼星選擇假裝他真的想做作業。雷木斯就隨他去吧。

In the meantime, Remus felt as though he was limping through the first half of the term. He had not been so overwhelmed by his curriculum since his first year. Everything seemed ten times more involved than it had been the year before, and the essay requirements were at least ten inches longer. He felt suddenly very guilty about spending the entire summer relaxing and pleasing himself, when all the while time had been ticking away.
與此同時，雷木斯覺得自己像是拖著傷腿度過學期的前半段。他自從第一年以來，就沒有如此被課程壓倒過。一切似乎比去年更加複雜，並且論文要求至少長了十英寸。他突然感到非常內疚，因為整個夏天都在放鬆和取悅自己，而時間卻在一刻不停地流逝。

Even having dropped Potions, Astronomy and Herbology, there was still Arithmancy, History, Charms, Transfiguration, Defence Against the Dark Arts and Care of Magical Creatures; all of which seemed to have reached new heights of complexity as the final year got into full swing. Not to mention the extra lessons he was taking with Madam Pomfrey.
即使已經放棄了魔藥學、天文學和草藥學，仍然有算術學、歷史、魔咒學、變形學、黑魔法防禦術和魔法生物護理；所有這些似乎在最後一年全面開展時達到了新的複雜程度。更不用說他還和彭西夫人一起上了額外的課。

Not for the first time, Remus was extremely glad he was no longer a prefect, as he found himself spending almost all of his time squirrelled away in the bowels of the library, squinting over ancient texts with dust in his hair. He stayed through his free lessons, half of his lunch break, and more often than not was still there until Madam Pince chased him out.
雷木斯第一次感到非常高興他不再是學監，因為他發現自己幾乎將所有的時間都藏在圖書館的深處，瞇著眼睛看著髮間沾滿灰塵的古老文本。他在空閒課程期間待在那裡，午餐時間的一半，往往還會待到彭斯夫人把他趕出來。

In the end, he was thrilled to meet up with his study group again, just to have a bit of human company.
最後，他很高興能再次和他的學習小組見面，僅僅是為了有一點人類的陪伴。

“There you are!” Christopher met him outside the Charms classroom after lessons on a Thursday. Professor Flitwick had been kind enough to hand over his classroom for another year.
「你在這裡！」克里斯多福在星期四的課後在魅力課教室外遇見了他。弗利維克教授非常好心地把他的教室交給了他們一年。

(“I’ve no doubt you’ll have a classroom of your own, one day, young Lupin!” the tiny teacher had squeaked cheerily. Remus blushed and did not comment. One day his secret would be out; everyone would know why he was not fit to teach, or even be in a school at all, and then what?)
（「我毫不懷疑你會有一個屬於自己的教室，年輕的雷木斯！」這位矮小的老師愉快地尖叫道。雷木斯臉紅了，沒有評論。總有一天他的秘密會曝光；每個人都會知道他為什麼不適合教學，甚至不適合在學校裡，那麼怎麼辦呢？）

“Here I am,” Remus replied to Chris with a smile, “Were you looking for me?”
「我在這裡，」雷木斯對克里斯多福笑著回答，「你在找我嗎？」

“Not particularly, just haven’t seen much of you for the past week. Not even in the common room.”
「不特別，只是過去一周沒怎麼見到你。甚至在公共休息室也沒見到。」

“I’ve been there reading for an hour a night,” Remus said, “...but only once the library is closed.” And before Sirius came down yawning at one o’clock telling him to go to bed.
「我每晚都在那裡讀書一小時，」雷木斯說，「……但僅僅是在圖書館關閉之後。」以及在小天狼星在凌晨一點打哈欠來告訴他該上床睡覺之前。

“Admirable dedication,” Christopher nodded as they entered the room and began rearranging it to their liking. “But don’t go too hard, ok? Try to enjoy your last year a bit!”
「值得讚賞的奉獻，」克里斯多福點頭說，當他們進入房間並開始重新安排它以適合他們的喜好時。「但不要太過努力，好嗎？試著稍微享受一下你最後的一年！」

“I enjoy studying.” Remus said, firmly, unpacking his books. This wasn’t exactly a lie, but he knew he sounded defensive.
「我喜歡學習。」雷木斯堅定地說，開始整理他的書本。這不完全是謊言，但他知道自己聽起來很防備。

The truth was; he knew he was working harder than he needed to, and for longer hours. But it was better than lying awake all night worrying about the various other problems that plagued him. He still hadn’t heard from Grant - though that could just be the vagaries of muggle post. He hadn’t given any proper thought to his mother yet, though he knew he really ought to. There had been three reports of werewolf attacks over the summer, and one arrest made. When it came down to it, NEWTs were the only thing Remus thought he could really cope with at the moment.
事實是；他知道自己比需要的更努力工作，並且工作時間更長。但這比整晚躺在床上擔心困擾他的各種其他問題要好。他仍然沒有聽到格蘭特的消息——雖然這可能只是麻瓜郵政的不確定性。他還沒有正確地考慮到他的母親，雖然他知道他真的應該這樣做。夏天有三起狼人攻擊的報告，並且有一人被逮捕。說到底，新生考試是雷木斯目前唯一認為自己能夠應對的事。

And he didn’t actually think anyone had really missed him, exactly - after all, they were very busy too. Lily and James had a whole host of new responsibilities, on top of their NEWTs. Lily was taking Advanced Potions, James had quidditch. Peter and Dorcas were on-again-off-again, but it seemed to keep him pretty occupied, and Marlene was working harder than ever this year in the lead up to her healer academy entrance exams. Mary, of course, had a new boyfriend, which kept her busy.
而且他實際上並不認為有人真的想念他——畢竟，他們也很忙。莉莉和詹姆斯除了新生考試外，還有一整套新的責任。莉莉正在學習高級魔藥學，詹姆斯有魁地奇。彼得和多卡斯一會兒在一起，一會兒又分開，但這似乎讓他們非常忙碌，而瑪琳今年在她的醫療學院入學考試前比以往更加努力地工作。當然，瑪麗有了一個新男友，這讓她很忙。

「你需要休息。」克里斯多福說，坐在雷木斯旁邊，像是他的副手。「我只想說這些。」

「好的，」雷木斯點頭，彷彿他真的聽進去了。

If Remus worked every hour of the day, and got an O in every NEWT, he still didn’t see much of a future beyond part time work and depending on his friends for help. That’s if Greyback didn’t get him first, or if the ministry didn’t lock him up.
對克里斯多福來說這沒問題；他是純血巫師。即使他沒有像現在這樣努力工作，一旦他完成學校，可能還會有一份舒適的部門工作等著他。如果雷木斯一天工作每一個小時，並且在每個新生考試中都獲得O，他仍然看不到除了兼職工作和依賴朋友幫助之外的未來。那還是如果格雷巴克沒有先抓住他，或者部門沒有把他鎖起來。

其他學生開始陸續到來，他們可以停止談論這個話題。這是一個比去年更小的團體，但仍然有十二個人。你不能指望每個人都會在第一週出現。小天狼星來了，令雷木斯驚訝，女孩們也很高興。

「坐這裡，小天狼星！」五年級的赫夫帕夫學生瑪莎·艾瑞克森向他揮手。

五年級的學生在天文學上遇到了困難，克里斯多福自願幫他們講解厄多克索斯的行星運行理論。三名六年級學生在歷史論文上陷入困境，二年級學生則需要變形學方面的幫助。

「我可以做那個，」小天狼星突然說。

「真的嗎？」雷木斯眨了眨眼，挑起懷疑的眉毛。

「真的。」小天狼星冷靜地回答，「反正我變形學比你強。」

那兩名二年級學生看起來非常高興有小天狼星·布萊克——他的名聲作為學校叛逆者和一般迷人男孩早已傳開——給他們關注，儘管瑪莎·艾瑞克森看起來有點不悅。

By the end everyone seemed to have achieved whatever they had wanted to achieve, and Sirius even stayed behind to help tidy the room.
這次安排了兩小時的學習小組，在雷木斯看來進行得非常順利。他試著不過於干涉小天狼星，儘管房間角落那邊傳來了很多笑聲和喧鬧。到最後，大家似乎都完成了他們想要達到的目標，小天狼星甚至留下來幫忙整理房間。

「我們會沒事的。」小天狼星說，帶著他認為很甜美的微笑，但已經接近於瘋狂。

「好的。」克里斯多福給了他一個高傲的瞥視，然後回過頭對雷木斯說，「星期六見，去買文具？」

「太好了，是的，早餐後在公共休息室見。」雷木斯點頭說，幫助小天狼星把桌子推回原位。

「再見！」

門一關上，小天狼星就停下手中的動作，把雙手放在腰上，皺起眉頭。

「你要和他一起去霍格斯密德？！」

“I said I would.” Remus frowned, taken aback, “I need a new quill. What’s the problem? I can meet you lot after we shop for quills, can’t I?”
「我說過我會去的。」雷木斯皺眉，不解地說，「我需要一支新的羽毛筆。有什麼問題嗎？我可以在我們買完羽毛筆後和你們見面，不是嗎？」

「但我以為你和我會……我這周幾乎沒見到你。」

「我們不會單獨在一起，詹姆斯和彼得也會在那裡。我可不是要搶走你的什麼。」

“Lily and James will be off by themselves. And Peter and Dorcas, probably.” Sirius was in real danger of pouting, now. Remus knew he ought to try and avoid a sulk, if he could.
「莉莉和詹姆斯會單獨在一起。彼得和多卡斯也可能。」小天狼星現在真的有撅嘴的危險。雷木斯知道如果可以，他應該嘗試避免讓他鬧脾氣。

“You can join me and Christopher, if you want.” He said. Sirius grimaced.
「如果你願意，可以和我以及克里斯多福一起。」他說。小天狼星面露苦澀之色。

「買文具。」

“You need quills too. The only reason I keep running out is because you pinch all of mine.”
「你也需要羽毛筆。我一直缺的唯一原因就是因為你偷了我的。」

“But Moony…”
「但是，月亮。」

“You’re not jealous, are you?”
「你不會嫉妒吧？」

“Of course not.” Sirius shook his head, and returned to the desks, using his wand to return everything to order. He sighed, heavily, “I’ll come stationery shopping, then.”
「當然不會。」小天狼星搖頭，回到桌子旁，用魔杖把一切整理回原位。他重重地嘆了口氣，「那我就去買文具吧。」

Remus felt a pang of guilt.
雷木斯感到一陣內疚。

 

“I’ll see if I can get rid of Chris after. Or we could find the others and go for a drink?”

「我會看看能否把克里斯多福擺脫掉。或者我們可以找其他人去喝一杯？」

“I’m not going to Madam Puddifoot’s.” Sirius said darkly, a hint of humour returning to his face. Remus smiled and slapped him on the shoulder,

「我不會去馬丹·波迪富特的。」小天狼星黑著臉說，臉上帶著一絲幽默的痕跡。雷木斯微笑著拍了拍他的肩膀，

“Good. Or I’d have to stop fancying you.”

「那就好。不然我就得停止喜歡你了。」

“As if you could.” Sirius took his wrist and pulled him closer, kissing him hard on the lips.

「才不像你能做到那樣。」小天狼星抓住他的手腕，把他拉近，猛地吻了他一下。

Oh , Remus thought, we haven’t done this in a while. He felt really guilty, then. Perhaps Sirius was right - he’d been so wrapped up in everything else he’d neglected the one thing that might have made it all a bit more bearable.

哦，雷木斯想，我們有一段時間沒有這樣做了。他感到非常內疚。也許小天狼星是對的——他已經如此專注於其他事物，以至於忽略了可能會讓一切變得更可忍受的那一件事。

They pulled apart and Sirius glanced at the door, licking his lips.

他們分開，小天狼星看了一眼門，舔了舔嘴唇。

“Do you have to run off to the library or somewhere?”

「你是不是得跑去圖書館或其他地方？」

Remus shook his head. Sirius grinned. “Good. Colloportus .”

雷木斯搖了搖頭。小天狼星笑了。「好。封閉咒。」

The lock in the door clicked shut.

門上的鎖發出咔哒一聲關上了。

Saturday 17th September 1977

1977年9月17日，星期六

“Have you charmed your bloody curtains shut, you lunatic?!” James voice woke Remus and Sirius the Saturday of the Hogsmeade trip.

「你這個瘋子，把該死的窗簾用咒語鎖住了嗎？！」詹姆斯的聲音在霍格斯密德之行的那個星期六早上吵醒了雷木斯和小天狼星。

Remus sat up bolt upright, eyes wide. He stared at the curtains, which shook as James attempted to get in. Sirius took a more casual approach, rolling over slowly and groaning,

雷木斯驚慌地坐了起來，眼睛瞪得大大的。他盯著窗簾，窗簾在詹姆斯嘗試進入的過程中顫抖。小天狼星則採取了更隨意的態度，慢慢翻身，呻吟道，

“Bugger off, Potter.”

「滾開，波特。」

“You’ll miss breakfast!”

「你會錯過早餐的！」

“Be down in a bit.”

「過一會兒下來。」

“Hogsmeade today, remember! Common room at ten o’clock sharp.”

「記住今天是霍格斯密德！十點鐘準時在公共休息室。」

“Piss off , Prongs!”

「滾開，鹿角！」

“Charming.” James muttered, but the curtains stopped shaking, and in a few moments his footsteps could be heard receding, disappearing down the stairs.

「真迷人。」詹姆斯嘟囔道，但窗簾停止了顫抖，幾分鐘後他的腳步聲漸行漸遠，消失在樓梯下。

Remus exhaled. He pressed a hand to his chest, feeling his heart thudding hard, and willed it to calm down.

雷木斯嘆了口氣。他把手放在胸前，感覺到心臟跳動得很厲害，並希望它能平靜下來。

“Christ.” He breathed.

「天啊。」他輕聲說。

“Bit jumpy there, Moony?” Sirius grinned, rolling onto his back and stretching his arms over his head.

「有點神經質啊，月亮？」小天狼星笑著，翻身躺下，伸展雙臂。

“I really need to stop falling asleep here.”

「我真的需要停止在這裡睡著了。」

“You’re fine. The charm held, didn’t it?”

「沒事的。咒語有效，不是嗎？」

“You and James have boundary issues.” Remus pulled back the heavy bedclothes.

「你和詹姆斯有界限問題。」雷木斯掀開沉重的被子。

“Probably. Hey, don’t go!” Sirius reached out for his arm.

「可能是。嘿，別走！」小天狼星伸手抓住他的手臂。

“Breakfast!” Remus insisted, fishing about for his underwear.

「早餐！」雷木斯堅持道，四處找他的內褲。

他們洗漱、穿衣，急匆匆地下樓到大廳，正好趕上了最後幾片吐司和幾勺粥。

「我對布萊克這樣的事有所預期，但你不會錯過一頓飯，雷木斯。」莉莉一邊翻閱《預言家日報》一邊說道。

「我昨晚讀書讀得很晚。」雷木斯說。「如果我願意，星期六我可以多睡一會兒……」

「我不是說你不能。」她嘟囔道，好像他過於敏感似的。她放下報紙，「我昨晚和克里斯多福·巴利巡邏。他提到你們今天要一起去霍格斯密德……」

「嗯？」雷木斯愣愣地看著她，嘴裡滿是吐司和蜂蜜。

What fresh hell? Everyone was looking at him, suddenly, with varying degrees of amused curiosity. He swallowed. “Yeah. Just to Scrivenshaft’s, I need a new quill.”

什麼新煩惱？突然之間，所有人都帶著不同程度的好奇目光看著他。他吞下食物。「對，就去斯克里文肖夫那裡，我需要一支新的羽毛筆。」

「你們相處得很好，不是嗎？」莉莉天真地問。

「他有問你嗎，雷木斯？」瑪麗插話道。

“What’s that got to do with anything?”

「那和這有什麼關係？」

「哦，拜託，」她笑著說，「克里斯肯定是……你知道的；‘那樣’。他太娘了。」

「是嗎？」雷木斯不安地問。「我沒注意到。我們只是買羽毛筆，別的沒有。」

“Exactly.” Sirius nodded, “See? He’s not interested.”

「正是。」小天狼星點了點頭，「看吧？他不感興趣。」

「哦，但克里斯真的很好，」莉莉說，「我覺得你們會是一對很好的情侶。興趣相似什麼的。」

「也許月亮不想和相似的人約會。」小天狼星插話說，稍微用力地放下咖啡杯。

雷木斯偷偷地把手放在桌子下面的膝蓋上，希望能讓他安靜下來。小天狼星瞥了他一眼，然後低頭看著他的盤子。幸運的是，他明白了信息。

「什麼？！」雷木斯盯著他。小天狼星把雙手插進口袋，低聲嘀咕道，

「沒事。」他加快了腳步，追上了詹姆斯，留下雷木斯自己走。

「很好。」雷木斯回答道。

他現在心情不佳。小天狼星以為他自己是誰，抱怨保守秘密有多麼困難，當初保持這段關係秘密的主意完全是他的！他應該就和克里斯多福一起去，忽略小天狼星剩下的時間——那樣正好讓他得到應有的報應。

“What did he say?” Lily was asking.

「他說了什麼？」莉莉問道。

“Hm?”

「嗯？」

「小天狼星，」莉莉點了點前面的兩個黑髮男孩，「他在耍什麼花樣嗎？因為如果他對你……表現得很奇怪，我會給詹姆斯允許，讓他給小天狼星一頓耳光。」

“Oh, no, nothing like that,” Remus waved a hand and forced on a smile, “It was something else. Stupid stuff, don’t worry.”

「哦，不，沒有那樣的事，」雷木斯揮了揮手，強顏歡笑道，「是其他的事。愚蠢的事，不用擔心。」

“Yeah,” Chris nodded, excited, “I’ve got a list of books I wanted to look for, too - if that’s ok with you? I mean, if you have time, before you have to meet your friends…”

「嗯，」克里斯點了點頭，興奮地說，「我還有一張書單，想要找些書——如果你沒問題的話？我的意思是，如果你有時間，在你見你的朋友之前……」

“You’re my friend too, Chris.” Remus said, hoping Sirius overheard.

「你也是我的朋友，克里斯。」雷木斯說，希望小天狼星能聽到。

It was a nice day out, sunny for late September, with only a very faint chill in the air, meaning that by the time the students had trekked down to the village most of them were warm enough to have removed their heavy cloaks. Remus kept his on, because he rarely took off any layers, but Chris shrugged his off once they reached the first row of shops,

外面天氣很好，九月底的陽光灿烂，空氣中只有一絲輕微的寒意，這意味著當學生們艱難地走到村莊時，他們中的大多數已經暖和到可以脫下沉重的披風了。雷木斯保持著披風，因為他很少脫掉任何層，但克里斯一到達第一排商店就把它脫下了，

“Ooooh, look at him!” A sharp wolf-whistle sounded behind them. They both spun around to see Barty Crouch and Regulus Black not far away, both snickering meanly.

「哦，看那個！」一聲尖銳的狼嗥在他們身後響起。他們都轉過身來，看到巴提·克勞奇和雷古勒斯·布萊克不遠處，兩人都帶著惡意的笑聲。

“Ignore them.” Chris muttered to Remus, “They’re in my Potions class, they’re dickheads.”

「別理他們。」克里斯對雷木斯低聲說，「他們在我的魔藥課上，他們是些混蛋。」

“Come on,” Remus said, “Let’s see your list…”

「來吧，」雷木斯說，「讓我們看看你的書單……」

They passed a pleasant couple of hours together untroubled by anyone. Remus bought one of the fancy self-inking quills, as well as an ordinary one as a backup. They went to the book shop next and Christopher bought so much that he had to perform a weightlessness charm on the bag just to carry it all back.

他們一起度過了幾個愉快的時光，沒有受到任何人的打擾。雷木斯買了一支精美的自動上墨羽毛筆，還有一支普通的作為備用。他們接著去了書店，克里斯多福買了很多東西，甚至不得不對袋子施加抗重咒來攜帶所有的書。

“My trunk’s nearly full already,” he laughed, “What with all of the muggle books I brought with me. Have you read Other Voices, Other Rooms ?”

「我的行李箱差不多已經滿了，」他笑著說，「加上我帶來的所有麻瓜書。你讀過《其他聲音，其他房間》嗎？」

“No, I didn’t do much reading this summer…”

「沒有，我這個夏天沒有讀太多書……」

Everything was going pretty well, until they decided to head for the Three Broomsticks as a final stop. Remus was feeling almost like forgiving Sirius, by now, having calmed down, though he was a bit apprehensive about seeing the others with Christopher.

一切進展得相當順利，直到他們決定把三把掃帚作為最後一站。雷木斯現在幾乎覺得要原諒小天狼星了，心情也平靜下來了，儘管他對與克里斯多福一起見其他人有點擔心。

“Lily said you’d told her about us coming to Hogsmeade…” he said, casually. Christopher furrowed his brow,

「莉莉說你告訴她我們要來霍格斯密德……」他隨意地說。克里斯多福皺起了眉頭，

“Yeah, I think it just came up in conversation.”

「是的，我想這只是聊天時提到的。」

「嗯，她知道我也是。」克里斯多福說。「或者我認為她知道。我覺得大多數人比我早就弄明白了。不過莉莉是一個很棒的女孩。」

“Yeah, right,” Remus nodded. “Thing is, I think she thought this was… um… y’know, like we were coming to Hogsmeade together . So… just, if we see my friends, they might act a bit funny.”

「他們來了！」那個惡毒的聲音再次打斷了他們。他們剛轉過一個角落，發現他們的路被兩個六年級的斯萊特林擋住了。

「小心點，瘋狂的盧平，」雷古勒斯咯咯笑著說，「那個克里斯小子是個爛人！」

Chris turned bright red and looked at his feet. In a fit of rage, Remus withdrew his wand and adopted a duelling stance.

克里斯的臉變得通紅，低頭看著自己的腳。雷木斯憤怒地抽出魔杖，擺出了決鬥姿勢。

“ Protego !” Sirius yelled, deflecting the curse just in time.

「保護！」小天狼星大喊，及時擋住了咒語。

“Just you wait!” Regulus growled, backing away.

「等著吧！」雷古勒斯低聲咆哮，向後退去。

“What’re you gonna do, give me detention?” Sirius laughed, “I’m quaking in my boots. Run along, little brother.”

「你要怎麼做，給我留校察看？」小天狼星笑著說，「我在顫抖呢。快走吧，小兄弟。」

Regulus clenched his fists.

雷古勒斯握緊了拳頭。

“You’re no brother of mine!” He spat, as he turned and stalked away, Barty following him, looking annoyed that he hadn’t had his own fun.

「你不是我的兄弟！」他吐口水說，轉身走開了，巴提跟在他身後，看起來對自己沒有發揮樂趣感到惱火。

“Suits me.” Sirius said, quietly, under his breath. He turned to Remus and Chris, “Three Broomsticks?”

「正合我意。」小天狼星低聲說。他轉向雷木斯和克里斯多福，「三把掃帚？」

Sorry I did not write sooner I have been very busy. Sorry too for my bad writing. I am at my aunt Val’s pub in Hove and its very nice. Shes letting me work here and stay in her spare room but I will move out on my own when I have some mony saved. I hope you will come to see me when you can. You can ring me on the number at the bottom if you like.

“This time last year he’d have been all for it. It’s her.”
