“Oh dear,” Mary laughed, “I know what’s wrong with you, Mr Black.”

「“哦，親愛的，”瑪麗笑道，“我知道你怎麼了，布萊克先生。”」

“There’s nothing wrong with me, I’m the same as I ever was, it’s--”

「“我沒事，我跟以前一樣，這是——”」

“Exactly!” She arched her eyebrow at him, “You never change. You’re jealous.”

「“正是！”她挑了挑眉，“你從來沒變。你在嫉妒。”」

“Pfft.” Sirius folded his arms and slouched down in his seat. His legs stretched out under the table and bumped against Remus’s. “As if I would be jealous of him .”

「“哼。”小天狼星摺疊著雙臂，懶散地坐在座位上。他的腿伸展到桌子下面，碰到了雷木斯的腿。“我怎麼會嫉妒他呢。”」

“Not of James ,” Mary rolled her eyes, “You’re jealous of Lily. She’s taken your best friend away and now you’re feeling neglected, right?”

「“不是對詹姆斯嫉妒，”瑪麗翻了翻白眼，“你嫉妒莉莉。她把你最好的朋友搶走了，現在你感到被忽視，對吧？”」

Sirius went very quiet. He looked down, then back up at Mary.

「小天狼星變得非常安靜。他低下頭，然後再看著瑪麗。」

“No.” He said, very fiercely, getting up. “I’m going to Potions.” He muttered, stalking off, away from the breakfast table. Mary sighed deeply, in that that girls did when they thought boys were being particularly dense.

「“不。”他非常激烈地說，站起來。“我要去上魔藥課。”他喃喃自語，從早餐桌上走開了。瑪麗深深地嘆了口氣，像女孩們在認為男孩特別遲鈍時所做的那樣。」

“Honestly.” She tutted. “You agree with me, don’t you, Remus?”

「“說真的。”她輕輕咂嘴。“你同意我的看法，不是嗎，雷木斯？”」

Remus shrugged. He just wanted to eat his breakfast in peace. Mary tutted at him, too. “ Boys .” She said, exasperated, “Emotional cripples, the lot of you. Right, I’ve got a free this morning, going to the library. You?”

「雷木斯耸耸肩。他只是想安靜地吃完早餐。瑪麗對他也咂了咂嘴。“男孩們。”她厭倦地說，“你們都是情感上的殘疾人。對了，我今天早上有空，要去圖書館。你呢？”」

“Yeah, but I had something else I wanted to do.”

「“有，我有其他事情想做。”」

“Suit yourself,” she smiled, getting up and leaving too.

「“隨你便，”她微笑著，站起來離開了。」

Finally alone, Remus’s mind began to work, the beginnings of an idea forming. He didn’t disagree with Lily exactly - the parties were a massive distraction, and not really fair on everyone else. But at the same time, he hated seeing Sirius’s excitement quashed; particularly by James, who had always been a wholly positive force in his life.

「終於獨自一人，雷木斯的思緒開始運轉，逐漸形成了一個想法。他並不完全不同意莉莉的看法——派對確實是一個巨大的分心，對其他人也不公平。但同時，他厭惡看到小天狼星的興奮被壓制，尤其是詹姆斯，他在雷木斯的生活中一直是一個完全正面的力量。」

He couldn’t help but feel that he, Remus, ought to be able to do something to cheer Sirius up. After all, he’d done madder things before. But what to do...

「他忍不住感覺自己，雷木斯，應該能做點什麼來讓小天狼星高興起來。畢竟，他以前做過更瘋狂的事情。但該怎麼做呢……」

To distract himself, he re-read Grant’s letter as he finished eating, then wrote a quick response.

「為了分散注意力，他在吃完早餐後重新讀了一遍格蘭特的信，然後寫了一封簡短的回信。」

 

Dear Grant,

Thanks for your letter. I’m so glad everything is going well with your aunt.

I would love to come and see you at Christmas, if not then, over the summer maybe. I will try to call as soon as I am able to - hopefully the first weekend in November.

Crap news about Bolan! Thanks for telling me, we get no news here.

Speak soon,

Remus

 

 

 

He’d send it to the Potters first thing. It hadn’t solved the Sirius problem, though. Remus had such a strong sense that he needed to do something - a gesture. Not romantic exactly, but… dramatic. He wanted to do something by himself, something that would make Sirius proud of him. This wasn’t a secret, Remus told himself; not in the usual sense. It was a surprise. A present. But what ?!

他打算一早就把它送到波特家。然而，這並沒有解決天狼星的問題。雷木斯感覺自己需要做點什麼——一個姿態。不完全是浪漫，但……戲劇性。他想自己做點什麼，能讓天狼星為他感到驕傲。雷木斯告訴自己，這不是秘密；不是通常意義上的秘密。這是一個驚喜，一份禮物。但做什麼呢？！

Just as Remus was getting up to leave the hall, Emmeline Vance wafted past in a haze of sweet perfume and blonde hair. Something clicked in Remus’s brain and he jogged to catch her up,

就在雷木斯準備離開餐廳時，艾梅琳·范斯在一片甜美的香水和金髮的迷霧中飄過。雷木斯的大腦中突然閃過一個念頭，他急忙追上她，

“Hey! Hey, Emmeline! Can I ask you a favour…?”

“嘿！嘿，艾梅琳！我可以請你幫個忙嗎……？”

Friday 7th October 1977

It had taken all week between lessons and homework, but Remus had finally cracked it in time for Friday morning. It was a bit mad - which was why he hadn’t told anyone about it. They might think it was a bit strange, going so far over the top just to cheer Sirius up. But it just seemed so worthwhile at the time; making Sirius happy.

1977年10月7日，星期五

整個星期在課程和家庭作業之間花費了很多時間，但雷木斯終於在星期五早上解決了這個問題。這有點瘋狂——這就是為什麼他沒有告訴任何人。他們可能會覺得有點奇怪，為了讓天狼星高興而如此過火。但當時似乎非常值得；讓天狼星快樂。

Emmeline’s instructions had been relatively clear, but Remus had made some of his own tweaks for good measure. He had paid her off with the last of his tobacco and sworn her to secrecy, though she’d said she wouldn’t tell anyway because she liked the idea so much - she loved Marc Bolan too. The next few days he spent doing preliminary work in the library, hidden at his favourite desk near one of the back windows, where the light was good.

艾梅琳的指示相對清楚，但雷木斯為了保險起見做了一些自己的調整。他用最後的煙草贈送了她一些報酬，並向她保證保密，雖然她說她不會告訴任何人，因為她非常喜歡這個主意——她也喜歡馬克·博蘭。接下來的幾天，他在圖書館做了預備工作，隱藏在他最喜歡的一個靠近後窗的桌子上，那裡光線很好。

Friday morning, he woke early - earlier than James, even - borrowed the invisibility cloak and made sure everything was in place. He made a mental note to get better at setting timing spells as he yawned his way through the halls, tapping each portrait, statue and suit of armour with his wand.

星期五早晨，他早早醒來——甚至比詹姆斯還要早——借用了隱形斗篷，確保一切就位。他在穿過走廊時打了個哈欠，心裡記下要提高設置定時咒語的技術，並用魔杖敲了敲每幅畫像、雕像和盔甲。

By the time everyone else was beginning to wake up, Remus had finished, and was snoozing in an armchair in the common room.

當其他人開始醒來時，雷木斯已經完成了，正坐在公共休息室的一張扶手椅上打盹。

“Morning, Moony!” James woke him cheerily, in full quidditch kit, broom in hand.

“早安，月亮！”詹姆斯高高興興地叫醒他，穿著完整的魁地奇裝備，手裡拿著掃帚。

“Mm morning…”

“嗯，早安……”

“See you in Charms!” He called as he exited through the portrait hole. Remus sat up straight and listened intently.

“在魅力課上見！”詹姆斯邊走出畫像洞邊喊道。雷木斯坐直身子，專心地聽著。

Quiet… footsteps… James whistling… then… yes! The fat lady began to sing in a high falsetto;

安靜……腳步聲……詹姆斯吹著口哨……然後……是的！胖夫人開始以高音假聲唱起來；

“ Ride it on out like a bird in the sky ways

Ride it on out like you were a bird

Fly it all out like an eagle in a sunbeam

Ride it on out like you were a bird…”

“像天上的小鳥一樣騎行

像你是只小鳥一樣騎行

像陽光中的鷹一樣飛翔

像你是隻小鳥一樣騎行……”

“What the fuck?!” James exclaimed.

“這他媽的是什麼？！”詹姆斯驚叫道。

Remus grinned and punched the air. It worked.

雷木斯咧嘴一笑，揮舞了一下拳頭。成功了。

The rest of the morning was delightful chaos. Every portrait in the castle had begun to sing ‘Ride a White Swan’, on repeat - and not just the portraits. Every radio, gramophone, record player, statue - anything that could make a noise was now tunefully blaring Marc Bolan’s greatest hit.

早上的其餘時間充滿了愉快的混亂。城堡中的每幅畫像都開始重複唱《Ride a White Swan》——而不僅僅是畫像。每台收音機、留聲機、唱片播放器、雕像——任何能發出聲音的東西現在都在和諧地播放馬克·博蘭的最偉大作品。

The best part was that most of the muggle born students were singing along too, as it was such a catchy song.

最棒的是，大多數麻瓜出生的學生也在跟著唱，因為這首歌實在太上口了。

The racket was so bad in the end, that McGonagall announced lessons would be cancelled for the day while the teachers worked out how to stop the singing - Remus had added a security measure which meant that ‘Silencio’ only resulted in a volume increase.

最後喧鬧得如此厲害，以至於麥格教授宣布當天的課程取消，讓老師們想辦法停止歌唱——雷木斯加了一個安全措施，這意味著‘Silencio’只能使音量增大。

Sirius was thrilled, of course.

小天狼星當然非常高興。

“Who’d you think did it?” Peter asked, excitedly at the breakfast table.

“你覺得是誰做的？”彼得在早餐桌上興奮地問道。

In the background some sixth year girls were chanting along with the tinny baritone of the armour;

在背景中，一些六年級的女孩們在跟著盔甲的尖銳男低音一起吟唱；

“ Wear a tall hat like a druid in the old days

Wear a tall hat and a tattooed gown

Ride a white swan like the people of the Beltane

Wear your hair long, babe you can't go wrong...”

“像古時的德魯伊一樣戴著高帽

穿上高帽和紋身的長袍

像貝爾坦的人民一樣騎著白天鵝

留著長髮，寶貝，你不會錯的……”

“I don’t need to think, I know.” Sirius said, smugly.

“我不需要思考，我知道。”小天狼星得意地說。

Remus smiled. Mary leaned over eagerly,

雷木斯微笑了。瑪麗興奮地靠過來，

“Who?!”

“誰？！”

“Prongs, obviously!” Sirius said, “Probably trying to make it up to me, about the party.”

“當然是詹姆斯！”小天狼星說，“可能是想彌補我關於派對的事。”

Remus’s stomach sank. The idiot.

雷木斯的胃部沉了下來。這傢伙。

“Blimey,” Mary said, “James? By himself?” She looked skeptical. Good old Mary.

“天啊，”瑪麗說，“詹姆斯？自己一個人？”她看起來有些懷疑。好老瑪麗。

“Amazing, right?” Sirius kept saying, “I didn’t even think Prongs knew any T-Rex songs!”

“真了不起，不是嗎？”小天狼星不停地說，“我甚至沒想到詹姆斯會知道任何T-Rex的歌曲！”

“Mm.” Remus said, irritably, “Funny thing, that.”

“嗯。”雷木斯不耐煩地說，“這真有趣。”

“What’s up with you?” Mary nudged him, “I thought you liked T-rex!”

“你怎麼了？”瑪麗推了推他，“我以為你喜歡T-rex！”

“I do.” Remus replied, tight lipped. He stood up. “If lessons are cancelled, I s’pose I’ll go and catch up on some homework.”

“我喜歡。”雷木斯回答，緊閉嘴唇。他站了起來。“如果課程取消了，我想我會去補補作業。”

Sirius looked up, confused.

小天狼星抬頭看著他，困惑不解。

“I thought we were going to - er - play chess?” Remus shrugged,

“我以為我們要——呃——下棋？”雷木斯耸了耸肩，

“Not in the mood.” He left quickly, before his annoyance became too obvious.

“沒心情。”他迅速離開，免得他的煩惱變得太明顯。

He did go to the library, of course (it was the only quiet place in the castle) but he couldn’t concentrate on anything - plus, someone had dared to sit in his favourite seat. They were only two second years, and Gryffindors too - if he wanted to play the marauder card he could easily get them to move. But he was in the mood to suffer in silence, so he picked a lesser desk.

他當然去了圖書館（那是城堡裡唯一安靜的地方），但他無法集中精力做任何事——而且，有人敢坐在他最喜歡的位置上。他們只是兩個二年級的學生，還是格蘭芬多的——如果他想用流氓牌，他可以輕易地讓他們讓開。但他想要默默忍受，所以他選了一張較差的桌子。

Someone had carved something into the wood - who knew how long ago, everything in this damn castle was so old. It was a poem - a few lines of adolescent doggerel.

有人在木頭上刻了些東西——誰知道那是多麼久以前的事，這該死的城堡裡的一切都那麼古老。那是一首詩——幾行青春期的粗俗詩句。

Never kiss your lover at the garden gate

Love is blind - but your neighbours ain’t!

雷木斯哼了一聲，儘管他自己。真愚蠢。甚至押韻都不完整。

“Alright, Moody?”

“好吧，穆迪？”

Remus looked up to see Sirius sauntering towards him, weaving smoothly between the big study desks. A group of girls sitting behind Remus tittered noisily. Remus slouched down further in his seat, folding his arms.

雷木斯抬頭看到小天狼星正悠閒地朝他走來，在大學習桌之間自如地穿梭。坐在雷木斯後面的幾個女孩嘻嘻哈哈。雷木斯在座位上更深地縮了下來，雙臂交叉。

“I’m busy.” He grunted, flipping open the nearest book to a random page.

“我很忙。”他咕噥道，翻開最近的一本書到隨機一頁。

“Mm, you look it.” Sirius grabbed a chair, spun it around and straddled it, folding his arms along the back and rested his chin on them, staring at Remus in that annoying way, with that annoying grin.

“嗯，你看起來是的。”小天狼星抓起一張椅子，旋轉過來，跨坐在椅子上，雙臂放在椅背上，將下巴靠在上面，以那種煩人的方式、帶著煩人的笑容盯著雷木斯。

“Go away.” Remus said, looking at his book.

“走開。”雷木斯說，看著他的書。

“Moony.” Sirius smiled, “It was you, wasn’t it?”

“月亮。”小天狼星笑著說，“是你，是不是？”

Remus shrugged. Sirius snorted, “You twat, why didn’t you just say so?!”

雷木斯耸了耸肩。小天狼星哼了一聲，“你這個傻瓜，為什麼不直接說呢？！”

“Didn’t feel like it.”

“沒那麼想。”

“Ok…”

“好吧……”

“I dunno.”

“我不知道。”

“Could it be that you are completely mental, in addition to being a moody git?”

“難道你除了是個情緒化的傢伙，還完全瘋了嗎？”

“Bugger off.” Remus was starting to smile. He hated that Sirius could always do that. Sirius gave a little sigh.

“滾開。”雷木斯開始微笑。他討厭小天狼星總是能做到這一點。小天狼星嘆了口氣。

“Y’know, Moony, if you insist on being so secretive all the time, misunderstandings will happen…”

“你知道，月亮，如果你總是堅持保密，誤會就會發生……”

“I know.” Remus felt uncomfortable. He wasn’t used to Sirius being the logical one. “Sorry.” His shoulders sank and he looked down nervously. “Do you like it, though?”

“我知道。”雷木斯感到不安。他不習慣小天狼星變得如此理智。“對不起。”他的肩膀垂了下來，他緊張地低下頭。“你喜歡嗎？”

“Of course I like it you idiot!” Sirius exclaimed, slapping his hand in the desk. “It’s incredible, Remus. Thank you. I...” Sirius pinked slightly, “I really love it.”

“當然喜歡，你這個傻瓜！”小天狼星驚呼道，拍了拍桌子。“這真了不起，雷木斯。謝謝你。我……”小天狼星臉頰微紅，“我真的很喜歡。”

“You do?” Remus looked up at him.

“你喜歡嗎？”雷木斯抬頭看著他。

“I do. I’ve always loved your magic. It's so… you.”

“我喜歡。我一直喜歡你的魔法。它太……像你了。”

“Shut up.” Remus felt himself blushing. It was even harder not to smile, every muscle in his face was conspiring against him.

“閉嘴。”雷木斯感覺自己臉紅了。更難不笑了，每一塊臉上的肌肉都在和他作對。

He kicked Sirius’s foot under the table. Sirius kicked him back.

他在桌子下踢了踢小天狼星的腳。小天狼星踢了他一腳。

 

Chapter 123: Seventh Year: Darkness Falls 

 

Friday 4th November 1977 - 2:00 AM in Gryffindor Tower

“I think there’s something to the colour changing idea.” James slurred, using his goblet to gesture wildly. Thankfully, it was empty, and didn’t spill.
“我覺得顏色變化的主意還不錯。”詹姆斯含糊地說，揮舞著他的酒杯。幸好它是空的，沒有灑出來。

“Nah, it’s too obvious,” Sirius shook his head, just as drunk as James, but handling himself remarkably well, for once.
“嗯，這太明顯了，”小天狼星搖了搖頭，和詹姆斯一樣醉，但這次處理得相當好。

“Besides,” Lily yawned, from where she sat on the floor, head nodding against James’s knee. “What do we change? Their robes?”
“再說，”莉莉打了個哈欠，坐在地板上，頭靠在詹姆斯的膝蓋上。“我們改變什麼？他們的袍子？”

“Their whole dormitory!” Mary suggested, the only one still dancing, winding her arms slowly over her head and rolling her hips to a sultry Nina Simone track. “Complete makeover! Bright pink!”
“他們整個宿舍！”瑪麗提議，唯一一個仍在跳舞的人，慢慢地將雙臂繞過頭部，臀部隨著性感的妮娜·西蒙曲目擺動。“完全改造！亮粉色！”

“Why pink, though?” Sirius said, “Some people might like pink.”
“為什麼是粉色？”小天狼星說，“有些人可能喜歡粉色。”

“Ha, on your own, Black!” Marlene pulled a face at him. She was sitting upside down in an armchair, her legs dangling over the back, long blonde hair touching the floor. Her eyes were fixed on Mary moving in front of the fireplace.
“哈，就你自己，布萊克！”瑪琳對他做了個鬼臉。她坐在一張倒置的扶手椅上，腿垂在椅背上，長長的金髮觸及地面。她的目光固定在瑪麗在壁爐前移動的身影上。

They were the last few standing after Sirius’s eighteenth birthday party, which had been as uproarious and over the top as usual. The only non-seventh year remaining was Christopher, who looked like he was struggling to keep his eyes open, but held on valiantly, taking notes for the Slytherin prank which they were currently brainstorming.
在小天狼星的十八歲生日派對後，他們是最後幾個站著的人，派對一如既往地喧鬧而過火。唯一剩下的非七年級生是克里斯托弗，他看起來像是努力保持清醒，但勇敢地堅持著，為他們正在頭腦風暴的斯萊特林惡作劇做筆記。

“How would we even get hold of their robes, though?” Peter asked, fiddling with the label on his beer bottle, “We had the same problem in first year, remember? With the itching powder.”
“我們怎麼弄到他們的袍子？”彼得問道，擺弄著啤酒瓶上的標籤，“我們在第一年也遇到過這個問題，記得嗎？用止癢粉。”

“Oh yeah,” James nodded, “That’s right - it was easier to sneak into their common room than it was to work out how the house elves organise the laundry…”
“哦，對了，”詹姆斯點了點頭，“沒錯——偷偷進入他們的公共休息室比搞清楚家養小精靈如何整理洗衣更容易……”

“How did you sneak in?” Marlene asked, frowning, “You can’t have perfected an invisibility spell by the age of eleven…”
“你是怎麼偷偷進去的？”瑪琳問道，皺著眉頭，“你不可能在十一歲時就把隱形咒語弄得那麼完美……”

“Ask us no questions and we shall tell you no lies, McKinnon.” Sirius winked at her. He was watching Mary dance too, his eyes shining with intoxication. “Anyway, we’ve decided not to do it.”
“不要問我們問題，我們不會告訴你謊言的，麥金農。”小天狼星對她眨了眨眼。他也在看瑪麗跳舞，眼中閃爍著醉意。“總之，我們決定不做了。”

“You decided.” James corrected.
“是你決定的。”詹姆斯糾正道。

“It’s my birthday!”
“今天是我的生日！”

“Not anymore, it isn’t,” Peter threw a cushion at him. Sirius threw one back, then James launched another, and soon enough they were all drunkenly flinging cushions back and forth, giggling dopily.
“現在不是了，”彼得朝他扔了一個墊子。小天狼星扔回一個，然後詹姆斯又扔了一個，很快他們都醉醺醺地來回扔墊子，傻笑著。

“Right,” Marlene laughed, after deflecting a big round velvet one, “I’m off to bed.” She placed her hands on the carpet and flipped forward neatly. She brushed her jeans as she got up, a bit wobbly on her feet, then headed for the girls’ dorm.
“對了，”瑪琳笑道，在擋住了一個大圓形天鵝絨墊子後，“我要上床了。”她把手放在地毯上，利索地翻了個身。她起身時刷了刷牛仔褲，腳步有些搖晃，然後向女生宿舍走去。

“Noo,” Mary grabbed her around the waist, “Don’t go, Marls, dance with meee!”
“不要，”瑪麗抓住她的腰，“不要走，瑪爾斯，和我跳舞吧！”

Marlene laughed lightly, but Remus caught an odd flash of annoyance in Marlene’s usually placid face as she gently unwound herself from Mary and backed away.
瑪琳輕笑了一下，但雷木斯注意到瑪琳平時平靜的臉上閃過一絲奇怪的不悅，她輕輕地從瑪麗身上解開，退後了一步。

“I’m sure one of the boys will oblige.” She said, shortly, “Night, all!”
“我相信會有男孩願意的。”她簡短地說，“晚安，大家！”

“Night!” They chorused back. Remus vaguely wondered what was going on between the two best friends, but he was too drunk and sleepy to dwell on it very long.
“晚安！”他們齊聲回答。雷木斯模糊地想知道這兩個好朋友之間發生了什麼事，但他太醉了，太困了，無法長時間琢磨這個問題。

“I think I’ll go up, too.” Christopher was already on his feet, as though he had been waiting for someone else to admit defeat so that he wasn’t the first. “Don’t decide anything without me, though!”
“我想我也該上去了。”克里斯托弗已經站了起來，好像他在等其他人先認輸，以免自己成為第一個。“不過，不要在我不在的時候做決定！”

“I really don’t think anyone’s going to formulate a plan tonight.” Lily yawned again. “See you tomorrow, Chris.”
“我真的不認為今晚會有人制定計劃。”莉莉又打了個哈欠。“明天見，克里斯。”

“Night.” The younger boy waved at all of them in his awkward, cheery way.
“晚安。”那個年輕的男孩以他那笨拙而愉快的方式向他們揮手。

“If no one wants to dance with me,” Mary sighed, moving to turn off the record player, “I s’pose I’d better get in some beauty sleep too.”
“如果沒有人想和我跳舞，”瑪麗嘆了口氣，轉身去關掉唱片機，“我想我也該好好睡一覺了。”

“And me,” Peter got up, tossing back the dregs of his drink.
“我也是，”彼得站起來，將杯中的酒渣一飲而盡。

“And me--” Lily was getting up, when James pulled her into his lap, hugging her close.
“我也是——”莉莉正要起身，詹姆斯卻把她拉到自己腿上，緊緊擁抱著她。

“Don’t go yet…”
“別走……”

“Mmm…” She curled into him, sleepily, and they became one unit, cocooned in the big leather armchair. Remus blinked at them blearily and marvelled once again that they had all teased James for years about his certainty that he and Lily were made for each other. Funny how things work out.
“嗯……”她迷迷糊糊地依偎在他懷裡，他們成為一體，蜷縮在大皮扶手椅裡。雷木斯迷迷糊糊地看著他們，再次驚訝於他們這些年來如何戲弄詹姆斯，對他和莉莉是天作之合的確定。事情真有趣。

“Absolutely obscene.” Sirius tutted, pulling a face at the couple. “Well, if that’s the way this party’s going, I’ll follow Wormtail’s example… coming, Moony?”
“真是太猥褻了。”小天狼星咂了咂嘴，對那對情侶做了個鬼臉。“好吧，如果派對就這樣進行下去，我就跟著蟲尾的例子……你來嗎，月亮？”

“Yep.” Remus got up off the sofa they had been sharing (maintaining a polite and inconspicuous distance, as they had done all evening).
“嗯。”雷木斯從他們一直共享的沙發上站起來（保持著禮貌而不引人注意的距離，就像他們整晚所做的那樣）。

They followed Peter up, and found he was locked in the bathroom, noisily brushing his teeth and gargling. Remus was exhausted, and sat on the end of his bed to wait, yawning and rubbing his eyes.
他們跟著彼得上樓，發現他被鎖在浴室裡，吵吵嚷嚷地刷牙漱口。雷木斯感到非常疲倦，坐在床邊等著，打著哈欠，揉著眼睛。

“Good birthday?” He asked Sirius.
“生日過得怎麼樣？”他問小天狼星。

“Brilliant.” Sirius grinned back.
“太棒了。”小天狼星笑著回答。

“Good.”
“那就好。”

“...If we wait until Pete’s asleep--”
“……如果我們等到彼得睡著了——”

“Bad idea, Padfoot, especially if James isn’t back yet. Anyway, I’m knackered.” He yawned again, as if to prove his point, “Another time.” This was a bit of a white lie. After too many near misses, Remus had been trying to limit the amount of time he spent in Sirius’s bed. It seemed so sneaky and dishonest.
“主意不好，腳墊，尤其是詹姆斯還沒回來的時候。總之，我累壞了。”他又打了個哈欠，似乎是為了證明他的觀點，“改天再說。”這有點小謊言。在經歷了太多差點發生的情況後，雷木斯一直在嘗試限制他在小天狼星床上的時間。這看起來太狡猾和不誠實了。

“Another time.” Sirius sighed. “Just… it’s my birthday, and I’ve barely seen you.”
“改天再說。”小天狼星嘆了口氣。“只是……今天是我的生日，我幾乎沒見過你。”

“I’ve been here all day!” This was true, of course - but it was true of all of the marauders, and Lily.
“我整天都在這裡！”這當然是真的——但這對所有流氓們和莉莉來說都是事實。

“You know what I mean.” Sirius shook his head, impatiently.
“你知道我意思的。”小天狼星不耐煩地搖了搖頭。

Remus did know, but he didn’t have a response that would please Sirius. This same issue kept coming up, and, quite frankly, Remus was getting sick of it. Especially as there was no possible way to solve it until Sirius finally made his mind up. Tired, and getting more irritable by the second, Remus got up and began to change quickly into his pyjamas.
雷木斯知道他的意思，但他沒有什麼回應能讓小天狼星滿意。這個問題一再出現，坦白說，雷木斯開始厭倦它。尤其是，直到小天狼星最終決定之前，沒有任何解決辦法。雷木斯感到疲倦，越來越煩躁，站起來開始迅速換上睡衣。

Sirius stood up and came over to him, crossing the beam of moonlight streaking the ancient floorboards. “You’re not avoiding me, are you?” He asked.
小天狼星站起來走向他，穿越了劃過古老地板的月光束。“你不是在躲著我吧？”他問道。

“No!” Remus muttered, “I’m just busy. I’ve got a lot on.” If he’d said it once, he’d said it a thousand times.
“沒有！”雷木斯喃喃道，“我只是忙。我有很多事。”如果他說過一次，他就說過一千次。

“Ok.” Sirius said, slowly. “Just, y’know. Lily and James are busy too, but they still seem to find time to--”
“好的。”小天狼星慢慢地說，“只是，你知道的。莉莉和詹姆斯也很忙，但他們似乎還是能找到時間……”

“We’re not Lily and James, though, are we?!” Remus raised his eyebrow. Honestly.
“但我們不是莉莉和詹姆斯，不是嗎？！”雷木斯挑了挑眉毛。說真的。

Sirius looked hurt.
小天狼星看起來受傷了。

“No… but,”
“不……但是，”

“That was your decision.” Remus said, buttoning his nightshirt. “What was it you said? Not to ‘scream it from the rooftops’. I thought you wanted it this way.”
“那是你的決定。”雷木斯說，扣上睡衣的扣子。“你說了什麼？不要‘從屋頂上大喊出來’。 我以為你想要這樣。”

“I…” Sirius looked lost.
“我……”小天狼星看起來迷茫。

Remus rolled his eyes, exasperated.
雷木斯翻了個白眼，顯得很厭煩。

“You said you needed time. I’m giving it to you. But you can’t keep whinging about it.”
“你說你需要時間。我在給你時間。但是你不能一直抱怨。”

Sirius withdrew. Remus knew he had won, but there was no joy in the victory.
小天狼星退後了。雷木斯知道他贏了，但勝利中沒有快樂。

Fortunately, Peter chose that moment to exit the bathroom. He made a beeline for his bed, head down, waving a lazy hand at them,
幸運的是，彼得選擇了這個時候出浴室。他直奔自己的床，低著頭，懶洋洋地向他們揮手，

“Night, lads…”
“晚安，伙計們……”

“Night Pete!” They both replied, cheerily.
“晚安，彼得！”他們都愉快地回答。

 

Saturday 26th November 1977
1977年11月26日，星期六

They could get over little tiffs like that in those days - they could wake up the next morning and both be ready to wipe the slate clean. At least until the next time. In the end, their desire for each other, their affection - and most of all their friendship - seemed strong enough to win out over any other problems. It was a state of being that Remus would later learn they were taking very much for granted.
那時候，他們能夠克服這樣的小爭執——第二天醒來時，雙方都準備好重頭開始。至少直到下一次。最終，他們對彼此的渴望、感情——最重要的是他們的友誼——似乎足夠強大，可以戰勝任何其他問題。雷木斯後來才知道，他們對此是多麼的視而不見。

On top of this, there was a war on, which may have explained quite a bit. Everyone was slightly melodramatic, and nerves were raw all round. The headlines weren’t helping:
此外，還有一場戰爭，這或許解釋了很多問題。每個人都有點戲劇化，神經緊繃。頭條新聞也沒有幫助：

MINISTRY RAIDS THREE HOUSES IN SEARCH FOR FORBIDDEN ARTEFACTS
部搜尋三戶人家尋找被禁文物

THIRD VAMPIRE ATTACK IN TWO WEEKS
兩週內第三起吸血鬼襲擊

MINISTER JENKINS STEPS DOWN IN WAKE OF DISAPPEARANCES
傑金斯部長因失蹤事件辭職

WEREWOLF REGISTRY ‘DANGEROUSLY UNDER-MANAGED’ MINISTRY INSIDERS REVEAL
部內部人士透露，狼人登記處管理不善

And that was only this week’s papers. Something was going on with the Slytherins too - more than the usual classist nonsense. Over the summer - or perhaps before that - a new hierarchy seemed to have formed, creating obvious divisions in the most controversial Hogwarts house.
這只是本週的報紙。斯萊特林似乎也有些事情——比平常的階級主義廢話還要多。整個夏天——或者更早之前——似乎形成了一個新的階層，明顯劃分了霍格沃茲爭議最大的學院。

Regulus Black had always carried a certain amount of clout, of course. The heir to the most noble, exclusive and wealthy pureblood family had been popular amongst his ambitious peer group since his very first day of school. In turn, he had surrounded himself with a faction of pureblood students who seemed to grow nastier by the year. Except for Barty Crouch Jr, perhaps, who had been incredibly nasty even as a little boy.
當然，Regulus Black一直有一定的影響力。這位最貴族、最排外和最富有的純血家族的繼承人自入學第一天起就在他那有野心的同齡人中頗受歡迎。反過來，他周圍聚集了一群純血學生，這些人似乎每年都變得更壞。也許除了Barty Crouch Jr，他從小就非常壞。

Now in his sixth year, Regulus did nothing to dispel the rumours that he was not only a death eater, but in regular communication with Lord Voldemort himself. In fact, Regulus seemed to rather enjoy his increased powers, which (according to Christopher, who shared several classes with him) even some of the teachers were observing. He held himself differently. He walked with his back straight, his chin raised, a permanent smirk affixed to his pale face. Remus could hardly recognised the nervous, troubled boy that Sirius had once called ‘Reggie’.
現在已經六年級的Regulus並沒有做任何事來消除他不僅是食死徒，而且與伏地魔本人經常聯繫的謠言。事實上，Regulus似乎相當享受他增加的權力，（根據與他共用幾門課的Christopher所說），甚至有些老師也在觀察。他的姿態不同了。他走路時背挺得直直的，下巴抬起，臉上永遠帶著冷笑。雷木斯幾乎認不出小天狼星曾經稱為“Reggie”的那個緊張、煩惱的男孩。

Regulus was not stupid. He had never once had a detention, in all his time at school, and was as bright as his older brother when it came to his lessons. Still, unpleasant things seemed to happen to everyone around him. A fourth year Hufflepuff who (rumour had it) knocked over an inkwell on Regulus’s desk while he was studying in the library was found two days later locked in a broom cupboard in the dungeons, white as a sheet and completely mute. He had been sent home to recover and had not been seen since.
Regulus並不愚蠢。在整個學校期間，他從未被拘留過，在課堂上，他和他哥哥一樣聰明。儘管如此，似乎所有人周圍都會發生不愉快的事情。據說，有一名四年級的赫奇帕奇學生在圖書館學習時碰翻了Regulus的墨水瓶，兩天後被發現在地牢的一個掃帚櫃裡，臉色蒼白，完全失聲。他被送回家療養，從那以後就沒有再見過他。

The Ravenclaw quidditch team practice overran by half an hour one afternoon due to a mix up with the rota - meaning that the Slytherin team’s practice had to be pushed back to the following day. The next time the Ravenclaws met they had to cancel their practice altogether, as well as postpone an upcoming match with Gryffindor, because nobody was able to touch their brooms without receiving hundreds of tiny splinters, which could only be removed by Madam Pomfrey.
有天下午，由於輪值表混亂，拉文克勞魁地奇隊的練習時間超過了半小時——這意味著斯萊特林隊的練習不得不推遲到第二天。下次拉文克勞隊見面時，他們不得不完全取消練習，並推遲即將與格蘭芬多的比賽，因為沒有人能夠在不受到數百個微小刺痛的情況下觸摸他們的掃帚，而這些刺只能由Pomfrey夫人來去除。

And the words ‘mudbloods get out!’ had been magically carved into the chalkboard in the Muggle Studies classroom, so that the lessons had to be moved while the teachers investigated.
而“麻瓜種滾出去！”的字樣被魔法刻在麻瓜研究教室的黑板上，導致課堂不得不轉移，老師們進行調查。

Of course, no one ever questioned Regulus, and, as there were no witnesses to any of these crimes, nothing could be done. Everybody knew, though, everybody with any stake in the war. The increasing cruelty and prevalence of such attacks had thrown a shadow over the castle which every student felt now, if they hadn’t in previous years.
當然，沒有人質疑Regulus，由於這些罪行沒有目擊者，無法採取任何行動。然而，每個與戰爭有關的人都知道。這些攻擊的殘酷性和普遍性日益增加，給城堡投下了一層陰影，現在每個學生都感受到了這種陰影，如果他們以前沒有感受到的話。

It might have been the reason that so many people wanted to help the marauders plan their next prank. Though that also had a lot to do with Christopher.
這可能是為什麼這麼多人想幫助流氓們策劃他們的下一個惡作劇的原因。雖然這也與Christopher有很大關係。

“Did you tell everyone?!” Remus sighed, exasperated, as a third year scuttled out of the study room, flushed and grinning after offering his services to the cause (‘I blow stuff up all the time in potions!’ he had explained, without a trace of irony. Remus had assured him that James and Sirius would be thrilled to hear it.)
“你告訴了所有人嗎？！”雷木斯嘆氣，顯得很厭煩，一個三年級生從自習室裡逃出來，臉紅紅的，笑著說要為這個事情效勞（“我在魔藥課上經常把東西炸飛！”他解釋說，毫無諷刺之意。雷木斯向他保證，詹姆斯和小天狼星聽了肯定會很高興。）

“I just mentioned it to a friend…” Christopher replied sheepishly. “You know, a lot of people have got it in for Slytherin, and it’s always a good idea to get a wide range of experience…”
“我只是提到了一個朋友…”Christopher尷尬地回答。“你知道，很多人都對斯萊特林有意見，而且獲得廣泛的經驗總是個好主意…”

“The marauders do not outsource their pranks.” Remus sniffed, haughtily as they made their way back towards the tower.
“流氓們不外包他們的惡作劇。”雷木斯傲慢地哼了一聲，然後他們朝塔樓走去。

“It’s not outsourcing, ” Christopher countered, “It’s…. er… collaboration.”
“這不是外包，”Christopher反駁道，“這是…呃…合作。”

“We don’t collaborate, either!”
“我們也不合作！”

“Why not? Isn’t that what we’re supposed to be fighting for? Inclusion?”
“為什麼不呢？這不是我們應該為之奮鬥的嗎？包容？”

“Inclusion, yes. Equality, yes. Prank Planning Co-operatives? No.”
“包容，是的。平等，是的。惡作劇策劃合作社？不。”

Christopher snorted with laughter. Remus smiled. Christopher had an awkward, braying laugh, like a donkey. It was pretty glorious to witness.
Christopher忍不住笑了。雷木斯微笑著。Christopher的笑聲尷尬而刺耳，像驢叫。這真是壯觀的景象。

“So,” Christopher wheezed, catching his breath and wiping his eyes, “What are your Christmas plans? staying here again?”
“那麼，”Christopher喘著氣，擦著眼睛說，“你的聖誕節計劃是什麼？還是留在這裡？”

“Mm, maybe… or going to the Potter’s. All hangs on whether or not James is going to spend it with Lily’s family.”
“嗯，也許…或者去Potter家。一切取決於詹姆斯是否會和Lily的家人一起過。”

“Oh, Merlin, don’t,” Christopher pulled a face, “I think I preferred it when they hated each other. Prefect meetings are so boring now, they spend the whole time talking each other up. Enough to give you toothache.”
“哦，梅林，不要這樣，”Christopher扮了個鬼臉，“我覺得他們互相討厭的時候更好。現在的級長會議太無聊了，他們整個會議都在互相吹捧。夠讓你牙疼的。”

“I think it’s nice,” Remus said. “James has been bonkers about Lily since second year, if he can finally tell her how amazing she is instead of telling us, then all the better.”
“我覺得這挺好，”雷木斯說。“詹姆斯從二年級開始就對Lily瘋狂著迷，如果他能最終告訴她她有多棒，而不是告訴我們，那就更好了。”

“Yeah, I s’pose you’re right. We should all be so lucky.” Christopher sighed.
“是啊，我想你是對的。我們都應該這麼幸運。”Christopher嘆了口氣。

They were quiet for a bit after that, just walking together. As they turned the next corner, Remus realised that they hadn’t passed anyone in a while. Fair enough, it was a Saturday, but it wasn’t a Hogsmeade weekend, and the weather was too poor for anyone to be outside.
之後他們安靜了一會兒，只是一起走著。當他們轉過下一個拐角時，雷木斯意識到他們已經有一段時間沒有遇到任何人了。這很正常，畢竟是星期六，但這不是霍格莫德的周末，天氣太差，沒有人會在外面。

Finally, a first year came hurrying towards them through an archway which led to the east wing. Her eyes were big and frightened, she looked up at the two older boys,
終於，一名一年級的學生匆忙穿過通往東翼的拱門朝他們走來。她的眼睛大而驚恐，她抬頭看著兩個大男孩，

“Ooh,” she squeaked, “Don’t go down there, it’s horrid!” and ran past them, presumably back to her house.
“哦，”她尖叫道，“不要往那邊走，那裡很可怕！”然後跑過他們，可能是回她的宿舍。

Chris and Remus looked at each other. Chris licked his lips, then squared his shoulders slightly, setting his mouth.
Chris和雷木斯互相看了一眼。Chris舔了舔嘴唇，然後稍微挺起肩膀，擺出決心的樣子。

“I am a prefect… so I’d better…”
“我是級長…所以我最好…”

“I’ll come with you.” Remus patted his shoulder. Christopher nodded, looking very relieved. Remus wished James was there - or Sirius.
“我和你一起去。”雷木斯拍了拍他的肩膀。Christopher點了點頭，顯得很放心。雷木斯希望詹姆斯在那裡——或者小天狼星在那裡。

They walked side by side through the archway, and found themselves enveloped in total darkness. It was the middle of the afternoon, and Remus knew there were usually windows on this corridor, and even at night it was never this dark. Something was very wrong.
他們並肩走過拱門，發現自己被完全的黑暗包圍。當時是下午，雷木斯知道這條走廊上通常有窗戶，即使在晚上也從未這麼黑。出了大問題。

“Lumos,” they both whispered, lighting their wand tips and holding them up, casting beams of white light across the grey flagstones, the blood red tapestries, the glinting suits of armour. It seemed empty. Christopher took a brave step ahead of Remus, clearing his throat,
“光亮如晝，”他們倆輕聲說著，點亮了魔杖尖，舉起來，把白色的光束投射在灰色的石板、血紅的掛毯和閃閃發光的盔甲上。似乎是空的。Christopher勇敢地邁步走在雷木斯前面，清了清嗓子，

“Hello? Is anyone here?” He called.
“你好？這裡有人嗎？”他喊道。

No response, utter silence. Christopher turned around to look at Remus, squinting and raising an arm to his eyes against the brightness of Remus’s wand light, “Perhaps you ought to go for a teacher?”
沒有回應，完全的寂靜。Christopher轉身看向雷木斯，眯著眼，舉起手臂遮住雷木斯魔杖的光亮，“也許你應該去找老師？”

“Come back with me, then,” Remus said.
“那麼跟我一起回去，”雷木斯說。

“I…”
“我…”

There was a noise. A nasty, crawling, slimy squelch, just ahead of Christopher. They both whipped around and aimed their lights at it, but found only an empty corner. Christopher’s heart was pounding hard, he reeked of adrenaline and terror. “There’s something in here…” he whispered, fearfully.
有一個聲音。一種令人厭惡的、爬行的、黏糊糊的嘎吱聲，就在Christopher的前方。他們倆迅速轉身，將光亮對準那裡，但只發現一個空角落。Christopher的心臟劇烈跳動，他充滿了腎上腺素和恐懼的味道。“這裡有東西…”他恐懼地低語。

“Come on,” Remus said, “Let’s go and get help…”
“快點，”雷木斯說，“我們去找人幫忙…”

“I think it’s over there…” Christopher walked forward again, and Remus lost sight of him and had to go by smell. This was particularly disconcerting - Remus had never met a darkness so black that he could not see through it.
“我想它在那邊…”Christopher再次向前走，雷木斯失去了他的視線，不得不靠氣味來辨認方向。這特別讓人不安——雷木斯從未見過如此黑暗，甚至無法看穿。

“Chris…?” He reached forward, casting his light about.
“Chris…？”他向前伸手，把光亮投向四周。

“I’ve found it… it’s… no! Oh Merlin, no! No!” Christopher began to scream, somewhere further up the hall.
“我找到了…它是…不！哦，梅林，不！不！”Christopher開始尖叫，在走廊更遠的地方。

Without thinking, Remus bolted forward, following the terrible wails,
雷木斯不假思索地向前衝去，跟隨著可怕的哀嚎，

“Chris!”
“Chris！”

He almost tripped over him. Christopher was curled up on the floor, hands covering his head, rocking and sobbing. “What…?” Remus asked, trembling now, as Christopher pointed at it. Remus used his wand to follow his friend's shaking arm, finally throwing light on their tormentor. Remus almost screamed too.
他差點被他絆倒。Christopher蜷縮在地板上，雙手捂著頭，搖晃著哭泣。“什麼…？”雷木斯問道，此時全身顫抖，隨著Christopher指向那東西。雷木斯用魔杖順著他朋友顫抖的手臂，終於照亮了他們的折磨者。雷木斯也差點尖叫出聲。

A corpse - a horrible, rotting, shambling corpse was stumbling towards them through the velvet blackness. It slumped forward with a heavy stoop, reaching for Christopher. The eyes were intact, yellow and red – both vacant and ravenous. It still had most of its skin; a grotesque pallet of mottled grey and deep bruise purple. It moaned, a ghastly, rattling sound through crooked yellow teeth.
一具屍體——一具可怕的、腐爛的、蹣跚的屍體在天鵝絨般的黑暗中朝他們跌跌撞撞地走來。它彎著腰，向前傾斜，伸手去抓Christopher。眼睛完好無損，黃紅相間——既空洞又貪婪。它還有大部分的皮膚；一個怪誕的調色板，斑駁的灰色和深紫色。它呻吟著，通過彎曲的黃牙發出可怕的、嘎吱作響的聲音。

Remus raised his wand, and stood in front of Chris. He was about to fire a knockback jinx at it - the only thing he could think of at short notice - when it fixed its hungry eyes on him. In a second, it vanished.
雷木斯舉起魔杖，站在Chris前面。他正準備對它施放擊退咒——他能想到的唯一方法——就在這時，屍體用貪婪的眼神盯著他。瞬間，它消失了。

Remus blinked, gasping, and suddenly the hallway was filled with a pale, milky light, as a full moon rose before him. The scream died in his throat, and he was gripped with horror - how was it possible?! The moon was not due for a week! He had to run, he had to get away from Christopher, but… wait a minute.
雷木斯眨了眨眼，喘著氣，突然走廊充滿了淡淡的乳白色光芒，一輪滿月在他面前升起。尖叫聲在他的喉嚨裡消失，他被恐懼抓住——這怎麼可能？！滿月還有一個星期才來！他得跑，他得遠離Christopher，但…等等。

“I know what you are!” Remus’s terror turned to elation, as he raised his wand once more, and shouted out confidently; “Riddikulus!”
“我知道你是什麼！”雷木斯的恐懼變成了興奮，他再次舉起魔杖，自信地喊道：“滑稽滑稽！”

The moon began to expand and transform once more - this time into a huge white beach ball, which began to bounce and spring off the walls, before bursting into a cloud of soapy bubbles. Remus laughed, as loudly as he could under the circumstances, and the boggart retreated. He took his chance, and grabbed Christopher - still curled up, eyes closed tight - under the arm, dragging him back towards the archway as fast as he could.
月亮開始再次膨脹和變形——這次變成了一個巨大的白色沙灘球，它開始在牆上彈跳，然後變成了一片肥皂泡。雷木斯大笑著，在這種情況下盡可能大聲地笑，博格特退縮了。他抓住機會，抓住仍然蜷縮著、緊閉雙眼的Christopher的手臂，盡可能快地把他拖回拱門。

They came out the other side gasping and blinking hard in the light. Christopher was gripping Remus’s robes tightly, his breathing heavy, face ashen.
他們來到另一邊，在光線下氣喘吁吁地眨著眼。Christopher緊緊抓住雷木斯的袍子，呼吸沉重，臉色蒼白。

“Fuck.” Remus murmured, feeling pretty shaky himself.
“該死。”雷木斯低聲說，自己也覺得很不安。

“Th-th-that was a boggart!?” Christopher stutted.
“那-那-那是博格特！？”Christopher結巴地說。

“Yeah, yeah, it was… I’ve never seen one before, have you?”
“是的，是的，那是…我從來沒見過，你見過嗎？”

Chris shook his head. Remus patted his hands, willing him to let go.
Chris搖了搖頭。雷木斯拍了拍他的手，希望他放開。

“Hey, it’s ok. It wasn’t real, remember? C’mon, we have to tell someone, before anyone else runs into it…”
“嘿，沒事的。那不是真的，記得嗎？來吧，我們得告訴別人，在其他人碰到它之前…”

“I’ll go.” Chris said, getting some of his courage back, “I’ll go now… are you ok to wait here? In case someone comes?”
“我去。”Chris說，恢復了一些勇氣，“我現在就去…你可以在這裡等嗎？以防有人來？”

“Of course.” Remus nodded, “No one’s getting past me.” He grinned, trying to make light of it, but Christopher was still too shaken. He nodded grimly, and set off, still gripping his wand.
“當然。”雷木斯點點頭，“沒有人能從我這裡過去。”他笑了笑，試圖讓事情顯得輕鬆一些，但Christopher仍然太過震驚。他嚴肅地點點頭，然後出發了，仍然緊握著魔杖。

Alone, Remus reached into his deep robe pockets and pulled out the marauder’s map. He’d had it on him for a while now, out of concern that James might take a look one day and wonder which he and Sirius were sharing the bathroom so often. “I solemnly swear that I am up to no good,” he whispered, tapping the parchment.
獨自一人時，雷木斯伸手進入深袍口袋，拿出流氓地圖。他已經隨身帶了一段時間，擔心有一天詹姆斯會看一眼，然後想知道他和小天狼星為什麼這麼頻繁地共用浴室。“我鄭重宣誓我不懷好意，”他輕聲說，敲擊羊皮紙。

The map immediately sprang to life, ink spreading like vines across the page. Remus held it up to his eyes and frantically searched for the corridor with the boggart. There it was, and there he was, ‘Remus Lupin’, clearly marked out at one end.
地圖立刻活了起來，墨水像藤蔓一樣蔓延在頁面上。雷木斯把它舉到眼前，瘋狂地尋找著有博格特的走廊。它在那裡，他也在那裡，“雷木斯·盧平”，清楚地標記在一端。

He followed the length of it with his finger, it was completely empty; apparently boggarts did not show up, not enough substance, maybe. He reached the end, there was a second archway on the other side, he remembered, covered by a tapestry. Three people were waiting there, quite still. Barty Crouch Jr, Garrick Mulciber and... Remus’s stomach sank, though he was not all that surprised. Here it was; proof in black and white. Regulus Black.
他用手指沿著它的長度，完全是空的；顯然博格特沒有出現，可能沒有足夠的實質。他到達了盡頭，記得另一邊還有一個拱門，被掛毯覆蓋著。三個人靜靜地等在那裡。小巴蒂·克勞奇，加里克·穆爾西伯和…雷木斯的胃沉了下去，雖然他並不那麼驚訝。這就是了；黑白分明的證據。Regulus Black.

 

Chapter 124: Seventh Year: Christmas Part 1 

In a miserable twist of fate, the December 1977 full moon fell on Christmas Day. The marauders all agreed to stay at Hogwarts for the duration, with a plan to travel back to the Potter’s on Boxing Day. Lily made them all promise that they would meet up as soon as possible in Diagon Alley,
命運的悲慘扭曲，1977年12月的滿月正好落在聖誕節那天。流氓們都同意在霍格沃茲待一段時間，計劃在節禮日回到Potter家。Lily讓他們都保證會盡快在對角巷見面，

“It’s the only place my parents will let me go by myself,” she explained to Remus, “I wanted to come to the Potters too, but they’re protective and they haven’t met James yet.”
“這是我父母唯一允許我獨自去的地方，”她向Remus解釋，“我也想去Potter家，但他們很保護我，而且他們還沒見過James。”

“Why not invite James to yours?” Remus suggested. Lily bit her lip and shrugged.
“為什麼不邀請James去你家？”Remus建議。Lily咬了咬嘴唇，聳了聳肩。

“It’s just a bit tricky. Maybe for Easter break.”
“這有點麻煩。也許復活節假期可以。”

It was a cheerless Christmas, really. James was missing Lily, Peter obviously wished he was at home, not stuck at school, Sirius was anxious and jittery whenever he and Remus were in the same room with someone else, and Remus himself was grumpy and irritable, waiting for the moon to take hold.
這真是一個沉悶的聖誕節。James在想念Lily，Peter顯然希望他在家，而不是被困在學校，Sirius每次和Remus與其他人在同一個房間裡時都很焦慮和緊張，而Remus自己則是煩躁易怒，等待著滿月的到來。

They didn’t do anything very Christmassy, either, other than go down for lunch with the other students who had stayed. They had promised Mrs Potter not to exchange gifts until they could all be together.
他們也沒做什麼聖誕節的事情，除了和其他留下來的學生一起去吃午飯。他們答應Potter夫人不會交換禮物，直到他們都能在一起。

“I feel awful.” Remus sighed, as he wound his scarf around his neck, ready to start heading towards the shack ahead of his friends. “You lot should be at home. I could have stayed by myself – or used your attic again, Prongs.”
“我感覺糟透了。”Remus嘆了口氣，把圍巾繞在脖子上，準備在朋友們之前朝小屋走去。“你們應該在家。我可以自己留下來——或者再次用你的閣樓，Prongs。”

“Don’t be silly,” James shook his head manfully, “I know how bad it is for you, in the attic, tied down like that. The shack is the best place – at least we can all run about a bit.”
“別傻了，”James堅定地搖搖頭，“我知道你在閣樓裡被這樣綁著有多糟。小屋是最好的地方——至少我們都可以跑動一下。”

And he was right, of course. They all needed a good run, and in the morning, Remus woke up and looked at his friend’s rosy, grinning faces, and knew they all felt much better for it.
當然，他是對的。他們都需要好好跑一跑，到了早晨，Remus醒來，看著朋友們紅潤的笑臉，知道他們都感覺好多了。

They couldn’t leave immediately, of course, Madam Pomfrey would not allow it. Remus was prescribed his usual morning of sleep, and he hoped that the other marauders had taken the opportunity to do the same.
當然，他們不能立即離開，Pomfrey女士不允許。Remus按照慣例早上睡覺，他希望其他流氓們也抓住機會這樣做。

When he woke up in the infirmary, Sirius was sitting in the chair next to him, grinning, two suitcases at his feet.
當他在醫療翼醒來時，Sirius正坐在他旁邊的椅子上，笑著，腳邊有兩個行李箱。

“Ready when you are!” He said, cheerfully, and Remus felt a pang of guilt again. Sirius needed to get home to the Potters’ just as much as James did.
“隨時準備好！”他愉快地說，Remus又感到一陣內疚。Sirius和James一樣需要回Potter家。

“Have you packed for me?” Remus sat up, blinking, “Blimey.”
“你幫我收拾了嗎？”Remus坐起來，眨著眼睛，“天哪。”

“Of course I haven’t,” Sirius snorted, “Prongs did. I made sure he got the book on your bedside table, though.”
“當然沒有，”Sirius哼了一聲，“Prongs幫你收拾的。不過我確保他拿了你床頭桌上的書。”

Remus opened his mouth to speak, but Sirius raised a hand, “And the one under your pillow. Don’t worry, Moony, nothing gets past me.”
Remus張口想說話，但Sirius舉起手，“還有你枕頭下的那本。別擔心，月亮臉，沒什麼能瞞過我。”

“Cheers,” Remus smiled. “Just let me get dressed, then…”
“謝了，”Remus微笑著說。“那麼讓我穿好衣服…”

“Sure you’ll be ok to floo?” Sirius asked, as Remus swivelled out of the bed, his bare feet landing on the cold flagstones. He felt a bit weak and woozy, but no worse than usual. He nodded,
“你確定可以用飛路網嗎？”Sirius問道，當Remus從床上轉身下來，赤腳踩在冰冷的石板上。他感到有點虛弱和頭暈，但並不比平常更糟。他點點頭，

“Yeah. Apparated after a full moon once, remember?”
“嗯。記得嗎，有一次滿月後我還幻影移形過？”

“Ok. But you should say, if you don’t feel up to it.”
“好吧。但如果你覺得不行，你應該說。”

“I will. Pass my jeans, will you?”
“我會的。把我的牛仔褲遞給我，好嗎？”

Sirius complied. Remus dressed, slowly, checking his body with every stretch and turn, making sure everything was working as it should be. He was starving hungry, but willing to wait for Mrs Potter’s cooking. “Where are the others?” Remus asked, bending now to tie his shoelaces.
Sirius照辦了。Remus慢慢地穿好衣服，檢查每一個伸展和轉身，確保一切都正常運作。他餓得要命，但願意等著Potter夫人的烹飪。“其他人在哪？”Remus彎腰系鞋帶時問道。

“Common room,” Sirius replied. He held up his silver compact mirror, “I’m to let Prongs know when we’re on our way to McGonagall’s office, they’ll meet us.”
“公共休息室，”Sirius回答。他舉起他的銀色小鏡子，“我要在我們前往McGonagall辦公室的路上通知Prongs，他們會和我們會合。”

“Great.” Remus nodded. He stopped for a moment, dizzy again, and pretended to just be stretching.
“太好了。”Remus點點頭。他停了一會兒，再次頭暈，假裝只是在伸展。

“Moony?”
“月亮臉？”

“Mmm...?” Remus began his second shoe, concentrating very hard.
“嗯...？”Remus開始穿第二只鞋，非常專心。

“I’m going to tell Prongs, over Christmas.”
“我打算在聖誕節期間告訴Prongs。”

“What?!” He straightened up so suddenly that he had to grab Sirius’s arm to stop from wobbling over. His head swam, and he blinked a few times while equilibrium restored itself. “Tell… Prongs?”
“什麼？！”他突然挺直身子，不得不抓住Sirius的手臂以免自己搖晃倒下。他頭暈目眩，眨了幾次眼睛才恢復平衡。“告訴…Prongs？”

“Yeah.” Sirius looked very pale, his eyes big, “If it’s ok with you? I think I’d better.”
“是的。”Sirius看起來非常蒼白，眼睛很大，“如果你不介意的話？我覺得我最好這樣做。”

“Of course. Yeah. I mean. Wow. Why now?”
“當然可以。嗯。我是說。哇。為什麼現在？”

Sirius shrugged,
Sirius聳了聳肩，

“Something’s got to give. And I’m mental about you.”
“總得做些改變。而且我對你瘋狂。”

Remus’s face grew hot and he looked away. He nudged Sirius’s toe with his own,
Remus的臉變得火熱，他轉過頭。他用自己的腳輕輕碰了Sirius的腳趾，

“Shut up.”
“閉嘴。”

“Never.” Sirius poked his tongue out. “So it’s ok?”
“絕不。”Sirius吐了吐舌頭。“所以可以嗎？”

“Yeah. Of course it is. Will you let me know… when?”
“嗯。當然可以。你會讓我知道…什麼時候嗎？”

“Definitely. I want to pick the right time.”
“當然。我想選擇合適的時機。”

“Ok.”
“好吧。”

“I’ll go and get Pomfrey now, shall I?”
“那我現在去叫Pomfrey，好嗎？”

“Cheers.” And with that, Sirius jumped up and disappeared behind the screen. Remus sat still for a few minutes, stunned. Well. People could always surprise you.
“謝了。”說完，Sirius跳起來消失在屏風後面。Remus坐了幾分鐘，驚訝不已。嗯。人們總是會給你驚喜。

Boxing Day afternoon at the Potters was a welcome change of pace. Euphemia wanted to know all about Lily, and Fleamont wanted to know how the new Gryffindor quidditch line-up was working out. This led to a very long and involved argument between Peter, Sirius, James and his father, as they complained about the poor new chaser – something Eriksson – and fretted over whether or not this would be the end to Gryffindor’s six year winning streak.
在Potter家的節禮日下午是一個受歡迎的變換節奏。Euphemia想知道所有關於Lily的事情，而Fleamont想知道新的Gryffindor魁地奇陣容如何。這導致了Peter、Sirius、James和他父親之間非常長且涉及甚廣的爭論，他們抱怨新的追球手——什麼Eriksson——很糟糕，並擔心這是否會結束Gryffindor六年的連勝紀錄。

In the end, Remus and Euphemia abandoned them to this and went into the kitchen to help Gully with the washing up. Mrs Potter pulled up a seat for Remus by the sink, and said,
最後，Remus和Euphemia拋下他們進了廚房幫Gully洗碗。Potter夫人給Remus在水槽旁拉了一個椅子，說，

“You just sit there, my love, and you can dry. Don’t want you on your feet all evening, or you’ll never get up tomorrow. And it sounds like the boys have a lot planned.”
“你就坐在那裡，親愛的，你可以擦乾。不想讓你整晚都站著，否則你明天起不來。而且聽起來男孩們有很多計劃。”

They worked away in companionable silence for a while, Remus practiced several drying spells before giving up and just using a dishcloth. Maybe he would never be any good at domestic incantations.
他們在友好的沉默中工作了一會兒，Remus練習了幾次乾燥咒語，然後放棄了，只用了抹布。也許他永遠不會擅長家務咒語。

“Comes with practice,” Euphemia smiled. Her face was soft in the twinkle of the fairy lights, and though she looked tired, and older than Remus had remembered her, she looked content and homely. Just as a mother should look, in his mind.
“熟能生巧，”Euphemia微笑著說。她的臉在妖精燈光的閃爍下顯得柔和，雖然她看起來很累，比Remus記得的老了，但她看起來滿足且溫馨。就像他心目中的母親應該有的樣子。

“Mrs Potter?”
“Potter夫人？”

“Yes dear?”
“怎麼了，親愛的？”

“You knew my dad, didn’t you?”
“你認識我爸爸，不是嗎？”

“Lyall? A little bit, but not well. Monty knew him better, they crossed paths at the Ministry once or twice… and I believe they were both partial to a few Friday night pints in the Leaky Cauldron,” she clucked her tongue indulgently.
“Lyall？有一點，但不熟。Monty比較熟悉他，他們在部里碰過一兩次面……而且我相信他們都喜歡在漏鍋酒吧喝幾杯周五晚上的啤酒，”她溺愛地咂咂舌。

“What about Hope?”
“那Hope呢？”

Euphemia set down the plate she had been about to hand over, and looked down at him. He swallowed, “Hope Lupin? My mother. She was a muggle.”
Euphemia放下她準備遞過來的盤子，低頭看著他。他吞了口唾沫，“Hope Lupin？我的母親。她是一個麻瓜。”

“Yes, I know, dear. I only met her once.”
“是的，我知道，親愛的。我只見過她一次。”

“But you met her.” He stared at James’s mother, amazed. Why had it never occurred to him before? She pulled off her bright yellow marigolds and sat down in the chair beside him.
“但你見過她。”他驚訝地盯著James的母親。為什麼他以前從未想到過？她脫下鮮黃色的橙皮手套，坐在他旁邊的椅子上。

“We were only introduced. We were both pregnant, at the time, that’s the only reason I remember. She was a lot younger than me, and – as you say – a muggle. We moved in different circles, I suppose. Lyall was a very private man.”
“我們只是被介紹過。我們當時都懷孕了，這是我記得的唯一原因。她比我年輕很多，而且——正如你所說——是一個麻瓜。我猜我們活動在不同的圈子。Lyall是一個非常私密的人。”

“What was she like?!” Remus asked, desperately, “Was she… nice?”
“她是什麼樣子？！”Remus絕望地問，“她……好嗎？”

“Oh, Remus,” Euphemia reached over and took his hand, which was cold from the dishes, and felt a bit too familiar. He didn’t want to upset her, though, so he let her do it. “She was very nice, from what I remember. Mousey little thing, blonde hair, and a lovely smile. Very small, I remember thinking – though next to Lyall, anyone looked small. I don’t remember what the occasion was, but we were both enormous – I remember her telling me she was expecting in March. I told her to get in touch if she needed anything, but I’m afraid she never did. Perhaps she didn’t know how to do it.”
“哦，Remus，”Euphemia伸手握住他的手，那隻手因洗碗而變得冰冷，感覺有點過於親密。不過他不想讓她難過，所以讓她這樣做。“她非常好，據我記得。瘦小的身材，金色的頭髮，還有可愛的笑容。非常小，我記得想過——雖然在Lyall旁邊，任何人看起來都很小。我不記得是什麼場合，但我們都很胖——我記得她告訴我她預產期在三月。我告訴她如果需要什麼就聯繫我，但恐怕她從未聯繫過。也許她不知道怎麼做。”

Remus looked down. If he had made it through his childhood unscathed, perhaps in time his mother might have made more friends. Perhaps she would have befriended Mrs Potter, and perhaps they would all have spent Christmases together.
Remus低下頭。如果他在童年時期安然無恙，也許隨著時間的推移，他的母親可能會交到更多的朋友。也許她會和Potter夫人成為朋友，或許他們會一起度過聖誕節。

“I was given a letter,” Remus said, slowly. “When I turned seventeen. She wrote it – Hope – before giving me away. She said in it… she said I might try to find her.”
“我收到了一封信，”Remus慢慢地說。“當我十七歲的時候。她寫的——Hope——在送走我之前。她在信裡說……她說我可以試著去找她。”

“Is that what you’d like?”
“那是你想要的嗎？”

“I don’t know. Maybe she’s changed her mind by now.”
“我不知道。也許她現在改變主意了。”

“Remus.” Euphemia said, very fiercely, “I can promise you she hasn’t. If you want to look for your mother, then just give me the word. Monty can do it in a trice.”
“Remus。”Euphemia非常激烈地說，“我可以向你保證她沒有。如果你想找你母親，只要告訴我一聲。Monty可以馬上去做。”

Remus looked up, finally, and smiled.
Remus終於抬起頭，笑了。

“Thank you.”
“謝謝。”

He went to bed early, and was woken by Sirius, creeping in under the covers. The house had grown quiet, and it was very dark out.
他早早上床睡覺，結果被Sirius叫醒了，Sirius悄悄爬進了被窩。房子已經變得安靜，外面非常黑。

“Sorry,” Sirius whispered, smelling faintly of brandy, and warm all over as he wound his arms around Remus, “Di’n’t mean to wake you up.”
“對不起，”Sirius低聲說，身上有淡淡的白蘭地味，當他把手臂繞過Remus時，全身都溫暖起來，“不想把你吵醒。”

“Yeah, you did.” Remus murmured, sleepily. “Haven’t told Prongs yet, then?”
“是的，你吵醒了我。”Remus昏昏欲睡地喃喃道。“還沒告訴Prongs嗎？”

“Nah,” Sirius shook his head against Remus’s arm, burying his face under the duvet, “I thought tomorrow. After Diagon Alley, before dinner.”
“沒有，”Sirius把頭靠在Remus的手臂上，將臉埋在被子下，“我想明天。在對角巷之後，晚餐之前。”

“Ok.” Remus sighed, closing his eyes and settling back to sleep. Just before he drifted off, he whispered, “You better set an alarm of something, then, so you can get back to your own bed, before…” But no. Sirius had fallen sound asleep.
“好吧。”Remus嘆了口氣，閉上眼睛，重新入睡。就在他快要睡著時，他低聲說：“你最好設個鬧鐘什麼的，這樣你可以回到自己的床上，免得……”但沒有，Sirius已經熟睡了。

 

Tuesday 27th December 1977 1977年12月27日星期二

“COME ON, COME ON! HURRY UP!” James was bellowing up the stairs as Remus searched for his woolly hat.
“快點，快點！快點！”James在樓梯上大喊，Remus正在找他的毛線帽。

“Calm down you lunatic, we’re almost ready!” Sirius yelled back, from the landing, where he was re-arranging his parting in the full length mirror.
“冷靜點你這瘋子，我們快準備好了！”Sirius在樓梯間回喊，他正在全身鏡前重新整理他的髮型。

“No shouting in the house, boys!” Euphemia called from the kitchen.
“不要在家裡大喊大叫，孩子們！”Euphemia在廚房裡喊道。

“I can’t find it. Did you pack it?” Remus huffed, hanging off his door frame.
“我找不到。你打包了嗎？”Remus氣喘吁吁地說，靠在門框上。

“I told you, I left packing to Prongs. OI, PRONGS! YOU FORGOT MOONY’S HAT YOU BASTARD!”
“我告訴過你，我讓Prongs打包了。喂，PRONGS！你忘了Moony的帽子，你這混蛋！”

“I ASKED YOU TO HELP ME!” James shouted back, “YOU SAID I HAD EVERYTHING UNDER CONTROL!”
“我請你幫忙了！”James回喊，“你說我已經控制了一切！”

“I ASSUMED YOU DID!”
“我以為你真的做了！”

“SORRY, MOONY!”
“對不起，Moony！”

“IT’S OK, PRONGS!” Remus joined in, a bit embarrassed. “I’ll go without.” He said, “It’s not that cold.”
“沒事，Prongs！”Remus有點尷尬地加入了進來。“我就不用了。”他說，“不是很冷。”

“Have mine,” Sirius shrugged, tossing his head again, still eyeing himself in the mirror, “I don’t want to muck up my hair, anyway, “Accio hat.”
“用我的吧，”Sirius聳聳肩，再次甩了甩頭，仍在鏡子裡看著自己，“我不想弄亂我的頭髮，‘Accio帽子’。”

Sirius’s red woollen hat, emblazoned with a Gryffindor lion came shooting out of the rubbish tip he called a bedroom, and Remus grabbed it from the air and rammed it down on his head.
Sirius的紅色毛線帽，上面繡著Gryffindor的獅子圖案，從他稱之為臥室的垃圾堆裡飛了出來，Remus從空中抓住它，戴在頭上。

“Ok. Let’s go!”
“好吧。我們走吧！”

“Finally!” James met them at the bottom of the stairs, where he had been waiting for a good half an hour now.
“終於！”James在樓梯底下見到了他們，他已經等了好半個小時了。

“Where’s Wormtail?”
“Wormtail在哪？”

“Sent an owl, doesn’t feel like it, apparently. Grumpy git.”
“他發了一隻貓頭鷹，顯然不想來。脾氣暴躁的傢伙。”

“Yeah, well for once I don’t blame him for not wanting to floo to London on a winter’s day just to see you and Evans snog.” Sirius teased.
“是啊，這次我不怪他不想在冬天的某一天飛到倫敦來看你和Evans親熱。”Sirius揶揄道。

“That’s not all we do!” James’s ears turned red. “Anyway, if that’s true, why are you and Moony coming?”
“我們不只是做那種事！”James的耳朵變紅了。“不管怎樣，如果那是真的，為什麼你和Moony也來？”

“I want some new books and he’s a voyeur.” Remus shrugged. “C’mon, let’s go, shall we?”
“我想要一些新書，而他是個窺視者。”Remus聳聳肩。“走吧，我們走吧，好嗎？”

Remus remembered to keep his eyes and mouth closed this time, and liked to think that he arrived in the fireplace of The Leaky Cauldron with some dignity, even if he had tripped over the cast iron grate. Luckily, he stumbled straight into Lily’s arms, as she had been anxiously awaiting their arrival.
這次Remus記得閉上眼睛和嘴巴，他喜歡認為自己是帶著某種尊嚴到達漏鍋酒吧的壁爐的，即使他絆倒在鑄鐵柵欄上。幸運的是，他直接跌進了Lily的懷裡，因為她一直焦急地等待著他們的到來。

“Oof!” She yelped, staggering but just about keeping upright. “Hiya, Remus!”
“哎呀！”她尖叫道，踉蹌了一下但勉強保持站立。“你好，Remus！”

“Hi,” he laughed, getting his own balance, “My hero!”
“嗨，”他笑著，重新站穩，“我的英雄！”

“Too late, Prongs,” Sirius said, brushing himself off, as he stepped neatly over the grate, “You’ve lost her to a better man already.”
“太晚了，Prongs，”Sirius一邊拍打自己身上的灰塵，一邊整齊地跨過柵欄說，“你已經把她輸給了一個更好的人。”

“It was inevitable, I suppose.” James grinned, following him out. Lily let go of Remus immediately and flung herself at James, who looked thrilled to bits.
“我想這是不可避免的。”James咧嘴笑著，跟在他身後走出去。Lily立刻放開Remus，撲向James，James看起來激動極了。

They managed to find a table to sit at in the crowded pub, and ordered four butterbeers.
他們設法在擁擠的酒吧裡找到了一張桌子坐下，點了四杯奶油啤酒。

“Busy, isn’t it!” Remus said, raising his voice over the din as he pushed through the throngs of shoppers with the drinks.
“很忙，不是嗎！”Remus抬高聲音說，推著飲料穿過購物人群。

“Sales,” Lily said, casually, “Oxford Street’s just as bad, I was there with Mum this morning.”
“打折季，”Lily隨意地說，“牛津街也一樣糟糕，我今天早上和媽媽去了那裡。”

“Anyone here we know?” Sirius asked, raising his head to look about at the faces,
“這裡有我們認識的人嗎？”Sirius抬起頭環顧四周，看看周圍的面孔，

“Um… not really… Ooh, er, I did see Frank, earlier – do you remember Frank Longbottom? He was Head Boy in our first year.” Lily said, before ducking her head and focusing on her drink – and James’s hand, which was on her hip and snaking slowly underneath her green wool jumper.
“嗯……不太……哦，呃，我確實早些時候見過Frank——你還記得Frank Longbottom嗎？他是我們一年級的級長。”Lily說，然後低下頭，專注於她的飲料——以及James的手，那隻手在她的臀部上，慢慢地滑到她的綠色毛線衫下。

Once they had finished their drinks, they were all keen to get out of the noisy, overwarm pub and into the fresh air. The street, however, was just as packed. It seemed to Remus that the entire wizard population of Britain must be crammed into these few crooked streets, all wrapped up in heavy winter robes, carrying bags and baskets and boxes, cheerily wishing each other merry Christmas or else rudely barging through the hustle and bustle to get to the shop they wanted.
喝完飲料後，他們都急於離開這家吵鬧、過熱的酒吧，走進新鮮空氣中。然而，街道也同樣擁擠。在Remus看來，整個英國的巫師人口似乎都擠進了這幾條蜿蜒的街道，每個人都裹著厚重的冬袍，提著包包、籃子和盒子，愉快地互祝聖誕快樂，或者粗魯地穿過熙熙攘攘的人群，趕去他們想去的商店。

“Try to stay together!” James threw over his shoulder at Sirius and Remus, before promptly disappearing into the throng with Lily.
“盡量待在一起！”James朝Sirius和Remus肩後喊道，然後迅速和Lily一起消失在人群中。

“Let’s just do our shopping and find them later,” Sirius huffed, put out. “Did you say you wanted books?”
“我們先買東西，然後再找他們，”Sirius有點生氣地說。“你說你想要書嗎？”

“Yeah,” Remus nodded, distracted. “Can you smell that?”
“是的，”Remus點點頭，有點心不在焉。“你能聞到那個嗎？”

“Smell what?” Sirius asked, pulling Remus’s robe in the direction of Flourish & Blott’s. Remus followed, but sniffed the air again. The trouble was, it was so hard to describe a scent – even to Sirius, whose own canine attributes sometimes surfaced even when he was in human form.
“聞到什麼？”Sirius問，拉著Remus的袍子朝Flourish & Blott's方向走去。Remus跟著，但再次嗅了嗅空氣。問題是，描述一種氣味是如此困難——即使是對Sirius也是如此，他的犬類特徵有時即使在人形時也會顯現出來。

“I dunno.” He said, lamely, “Just smells different than last time. The magic. It’s probably just all these people.”
“我不知道。”他無力地說，“只是聞起來和上次不一樣。魔法。可能只是因為這些人。”

“You can smell magic?!”
“你能聞到魔法？！”

“Oh. Yeah, I can.”
“哦，是的，我能。”

“Bloody hell.”
“見鬼了。”

The bookshop was manic, but Remus didn’t mind. He would have been content to wander the shelves all day, row by row, picking through and reading blurbs and stroking covers. He was having the best afternoon he’d had in ages, until he was interrupted.
書店裡一片忙亂，但Remus並不介意。他會很滿意地在書架間徘徊一整天，一排一排地翻閱、閱讀書皮介紹和撫摸封面。他度過了很長時間以來最美好的下午，直到他被打斷。

“Well, well. Look who it is.” Remus looked up, and saw Snape standing only a few meters away. He reeked of silver, so Remus stayed back.
“哦，哦。看看這是誰。”Remus抬起頭，看到Snape站在幾米外。他身上有一股銀的氣味，所以Remus後退了。

“What do you want, Snivellus?” He tutted, pretending to be unconcerned, returning to the book he was looking at.
“你想要什麼，Snivellus？”他咂舌，假裝不在意，繼續看他正在看的書。

“You and your little band of delinquents might think you own the school, Loony Lupin,” Severus tutted, “But you do not have any claim on Diagon Alley. I’m allowed to shop wherever I like.”
“你和你的小搗蛋鬼團伙可能以為你們擁有這所學校，Loony Lupin，”Severus咂舌，“但你們對對角巷沒有任何要求。我可以隨便在哪裡購物。”

“Well. Piss off and shop, then.” Remus shrugged, turning away. He was starting to feel sick, and he wanted Snape and whatever he was hiding under his robes gone.
“好吧。那就滾開去購物吧。”Remus聳聳肩，轉身離開。他開始感到不適，他希望Snape和他藏在袍子下的東西消失。

“You’re in my way.” Snape narrowed his cold black eyes. He began to advance on Remus, reaching over his shoulder for a book on potions. Remus’s hands began to shake, so he put his book down and moved away, shoving his hands inside his pockets. Where was Sirius?
“你擋住我的路了。”Snape眯起冰冷的黑眼睛。他開始向Remus逼近，伸手從肩上取下一本關於魔藥的書。Remus的手開始顫抖，所以他放下書，走開，把手插進口袋。Sirius在哪？

“Feeling all right, Loony?” Snape smiled maliciously.
“感覺還好嗎，Loony？”Snape惡意地笑道。

“What are you doing with that much silver on you, you freak?” Remus choked, leaning back on the bookcase behind him, his eyes watering.
“你身上帶這麼多銀幹什麼，你這怪物？”Remus哽咽著，靠在身後的書架上，眼睛流淚。

“One can’t be too careful.” Snape purred. “You get all sorts, ‘round here.”
“再小心也不為過。”Snape低聲說。“這裡什麼人都有。”

“All right, Snivellus?” Sirius’s voice came from just behind them. Remus sighed with relief as Snape reeled back, looking as though he’d been caught stealing. Sirius stepped out from behind the bookcase, arms folded, “Get lost on the way to Knockturn Alley, did you? Or maybe just in town for your annual hair wash?”
“怎麼了，Snivellus？”Sirius的聲音從他們身後傳來。Remus鬆了一口氣，Snape退了回去，看起來像是被抓住偷東西一樣。Sirius從書架後走出，雙臂交叉，“迷路到Knockturn Alley了嗎？還是只是來城裡洗個年度頭髮？”

“Fuck off, Black.”
“滾開，Black。”

“Oh, please, after you,” Sirius made a sweeping bow, allowing Severus to stalk off, mumbling darkly to himself. Remus chuckled, weakly.
“哦，拜託，隨你便，”Sirius做了個大幅鞠躬動作，讓Severus悻悻離開，自言自語地低聲咕噥。Remus虛弱地笑了。

“Thanks,” he said.
“謝謝，”他說。

“You ok?”
“你還好嗎？”

Hm. Better not to worry him, about the silver. Probably just Snape being his usual revolting self.
嗯。最好不要讓他擔心銀的事。可能只是Snape一如既往地令人厭惡。

“Fine.” Remus smiled. “Come on, let’s go and find the others, shall we?”
“沒事。”Remus笑了。“走吧，我們去找其他人，好嗎？”

“Don’t you want to buy your books?”
“你不想買書了嗎？”

“Nah,” Remus shook his head, “I just wanted to make a note of the names, see if Pince will order them into the school library for me. Free, that way.”
“不要了，”Remus搖搖頭，“我只是想記下書名，看看Pince會不會幫我訂進校圖書館。這樣免費。”

“Fair enough. C’mon then, mad in here.”
“好吧。那我們走吧，這裡太瘋狂了。”

They had to push most of their way outside, and once they were out, Remus needed a breather, and had to lean against the wall in the alleyway beside the shop.
他們不得不擠出大部分路，一旦走出去，Remus需要喘口氣，不得不靠在店旁的小巷牆上。

“Are you sure you’re ok?!” Sirius asked, tugging at a lock of his long hair, anxiously.
“你真的沒事嗎？！”Sirius焦急地問，拉著他的一縷長髮。

“Fine!” Remus breathed, nodding again. The sickly feeling was receding, now, he just needed a minute. “Just the moon, probably. Still tired.”
“沒事！”Remus呼吸著，再次點頭。那種不適感正在消退，他只需要一分鐘。“可能只是月亮。還是累。”

“What did Snivellus want?”
“Snivellus想要什麼？”

“Oh, the usual nonsense,” Remus screwed up his face, “I don’t think he meant to bump into me. What’s Knockturn Alley?”
“哦，還是那套胡扯，”Remus皺起臉，“我不認為他是故意碰到我的。Knockturn Alley是什麼？”

“Over there,” Sirius nodded across the street to another alleyway, slightly wider than the one they were standing in, which clearly led to more shops. “It’s where the dodgier types hang out. Dark wizards, banshees in disguise, vampires. That sort of thing.”
“在那邊，”Sirius點頭示意對面的另一條小巷，比他們站的這條稍寬，顯然通向更多的商店。“那是那些更陰險的人聚集的地方。黑巫師，偽裝的女妖，吸血鬼。那類東西。”

“Oh.” And werewolves. Remus knew this instantly. There was a very faint scent, now he knew what to look for. Someone who had been there recently. Not Livia.
“哦。”還有狼人。Remus立刻知道這一點。現在他知道要找什麼了，有一種非常微弱的氣味。最近有人去過。不是Livia。

“James’s dad was telling me they’re planning a raid on some of the shops down there in the New Year – reckon they’re stocking illegal supplies. Bet you anything it’s where Snivellus snuck off to.”
“James的爸爸告訴我，他們計劃在新年對那裡的一些商店進行突襲——估計他們在儲存非法物品。賭你什麼都行，那就是Snivellus溜去的地方。”

Remus stared at Knockturn Alley for a while, as he caught his breath. Whatever the strange new scent was, it was coming from there. He’d smelled something like it before; from Moody. Dark Magic – burnt around the edges, charred flesh. He shivered.
Remus盯著Knockturn Alley看了一會兒，喘著氣。不管那奇怪的新氣味是什麼，它都來自那裡。他以前聞到過類似的氣味；來自Moody。黑魔法——邊緣燒焦，燒焦的肉。他打了個寒顫。

“Quality Quidditch Supplies?” He suggested, “If James is anywhere he’ll be there.”
“Quality Quidditch Supplies？”他建議道，“如果James在任何地方，他會在那裡。”

“Good shout!” Sirius nodded, “Let’s go then.”
“好主意！”Sirius點頭，“那我們走吧。”

They left the shadowy alleyway, and stepped out into the bright winter sunshine. It hadn’t snowed this year, but it was still bitterly cold, and the sky was clear, making the air fresh and crisp with energy. As they crossed the road, slowly past the gaggles of witches shopping with their children, the wizards stopping to pass the time of day, and house elves running errands for their masters, the energy seemed to change, slightly. It made the hairs on Remus’s stand up neck, like the arrival of a predator. He tensed, and looked around. He caught sight of Lily and James looking at the latest broom in the window of Quality Quidditch Supplies. He was about to turn and get Sirius’s attention, when it happened.
他們離開陰暗的小巷，走進明亮的冬日陽光中。今年沒有下雪，但天氣依然刺骨寒冷，天空晴朗，使空氣清新而充滿活力。他們過馬路時，慢慢地穿過一群帶著孩子購物的女巫，停下來打發時間的巫師，為主人跑腿的家養小精靈，能量似乎有些變化。這讓Remus的脖子上的毛髮豎起來，就像捕食者的到來。他緊張起來，四處張望。他看到Lily和James正在Quality Quidditch Supplies的櫥窗前看最新的掃帚。他正準備轉身叫Sirius的注意，這時發生了。

BANG
砰

The front of The Leaky Cauldron exploded in a plume of thick, blood red smoke, bricks and wood and glass flying out into the street. There was barely a microsecond of stunned silence before the screams started, wails of pain and terror and shock. The chaos around them seemed to expand and contract, like a crashing wave.
The Leaky Cauldron的前部在一股濃濃的血紅色煙霧中爆炸，磚頭、木頭和玻璃飛到街上。幾乎沒有一微秒的驚愕沉默，尖叫聲就開始了，痛苦、恐懼和震驚的哀號聲。周圍的混亂似乎在擴展和收縮，就像一個撞擊的波浪。

CRACK CRACK CRACK, people were apparating around them – many were leaving, but a few were arriving, too. These were the ones that made something deep inside Remus want to start growling.
噼啪噼啪噼啪，人們在他們周圍幻影移形——很多人正在離開，但也有一些人正在到來。這些人讓Remus內心深處的某些東西開始想要咆哮。

BANG
砰

Another shop, further up the street exploded too, then another, and…
另一家商店，在街上更遠處的也爆炸了，然後是另一家，還有……

“Get down!” Sirius full-body tackled Remus to the ground, and they both covered their faces as Quality Quidditch Supplies went up in smoke.
“趴下！”Sirius全身撲向Remus，把他按倒在地，他們都捂住臉，Quality Quidditch Supplies在煙霧中消失。

Chapter 125: Seventh Year: Christmas Part 2The ground shook, and Remus squeezed his eyes shut, belly down on the cobblestones. Everything after that moment – seeing Lily and James’s heads turn, before the building in front of them exploded – everything after that made so little sense. It was all too slow, or too fast, and Remus found he did not react in his usual way – he was weak, frightened, his comprehension muddled. He felt stunned.
地面震動，Remus閉上眼睛，趴在鵝卵石上。從那一刻起，一切都變得毫無意義——看到Lily和James轉過頭，然後面前的建築爆炸——之後的一切都變得毫無意義。一切都太慢或太快，Remus發現自己沒有像往常那樣反應——他很虛弱，害怕，理解力模糊。他感到震驚。

They raised their heads – he and Sirius – much too long after it had gone quiet, when people around them were already standing up, and were shouting, or crying. Someone was definitely crying, a woman. That seemed loudest of all. And someone laughing, too, a thin, razor sharp cackle in the distance, pure joy.
當他和Sirius抬起頭時，四周已經安靜了很久，人們已經站起來，有人喊叫或哭泣。確實有人在哭，一個女人。這聲音最響亮。還有一個人在笑，遠處傳來一聲薄而尖銳的笑聲，純粹的喜悅。

Diagon Alley looked like a bomb site. The shops which had been destroyed were like broken teeth in a gaping maw; strange blue patches of sky where something else should be. It was hard to see much on ground level, but they squinted through the settling dust further down the street towards Gringotts, where most of the noise seemed to be coming from,
Diagon Alley看起來像一個爆炸現場。被摧毀的商店像是張開的嘴巴中的破碎牙齒；天空中奇怪的藍色斑塊，本應有其他東西的地方。在地面上很難看到什麼，但他們眯著眼睛穿過街道上逐漸沉降的灰塵，朝著Gringotts的方向看去，那裡似乎是大多數噪音的來源。

“You two!” A woman hissed, coming towards them from behind, picking through the rubble, her wand raised, “Get back! Behind me!” She stalked ahead. Her robes were deep maroon, an auror’s uniform.
“你們兩個！”一個女人嘶嘶地說，從後面向他們走來，穿過瓦礫堆，舉起魔杖，“退後！到我後面去！”她走在前面。她的長袍是深栗色，是傲羅的制服。

“James!” Sirius choked, his voice strange and strangled with terror. He scrambled to his feet, his robes all dusty and his hair full of soot. He half ran, half stumbled, towards the hole in the sky where the quidditch supply shop had stood, minutes before.
“James！”Sirius嗆了一下，他的聲音因恐懼而變得奇怪而窒息。他爬起來，長袍滿是灰塵，頭髮裡滿是煤灰。他半跑半跌地朝著幾分鐘前魁地奇用品店所在的天空中的洞口跑去。

“Sirius no…” Remus coughed, weakly, following him, feeling stupid and heavy.
“別去，Sirius…”Remus虛弱地咳嗽著，跟在他後面，感覺愚蠢而沉重。

“James!?” Sirius was shouting, but so many people were shouting.
“James！？”Sirius在喊，但很多人都在喊。

“Sirius!” Remus coughed again, trying hard to keep up, but he’d bruised his hip when he’d hit the ground, and his ears were still ringing, and his eyes were starting to go blurry as he wiped away tears with dusty wrists. “Sirius—”
“Sirius！”Remus再次咳嗽，努力跟上，但他跌倒時撞傷了臀部，耳朵還在嗡嗡作響，當他用沾滿灰塵的手腕擦去淚水時，眼睛開始變得模糊。“Sirius—”

“MUDBLOODS OUT!”
“泥巴種滾出去！”

Remus dropped to his knees, covering his ears, and he was not the only one. The voice seemed to be right behind him – inside his head, it was everywhere. The crowd was silent, finally, as everyone stared around, blinking, looking for the owner of the horrible, insidious voice.
Remus跪下來，捂住耳朵，他不是唯一一個這樣做的人。這聲音似乎就在他身後——在他腦海裡，無處不在。人群終於安靜下來，大家四處張望，眨著眼睛，尋找那可怕而狡猾聲音的主人。

Whatever was going on, it was happening further away – Remus could smell magic now, and see beams of light firing through the dust cloud surrounding Gringotts. He could smell Moody, and… Ferox? Maybe him. And the death eaters. Some of them he recognised, others he didn’t – but they were there, and there were a lot of them. Where was Sirius? The ruins of the shop which had stood before them was still bleeding smoke, and Sirius had wandered straight into it, the idiot.
不管發生什麼事情，它發生在更遠的地方——Remus現在可以聞到魔法的氣味，看到光束穿過Gringotts周圍的灰塵雲。他能聞到Moody的氣味，還有…Ferox？也許是他。還有食死徒。他認識其中一些，其他的則不認識——但他們都在那裡，而且有很多。Sirius在哪裡？他們面前的商店廢墟仍然冒著煙，而Sirius已經徑直走進去，這個笨蛋。

Gritting his teeth, and with not a little pain, Remus pushed himself to his feet again. He had to find them.
咬緊牙關，忍著疼痛，Remus再次站起來。他必須找到他們。

The shouts of battle were getting louder, more desperate; the woman who had ordered him and Sirius back had joined in, and Remus’s conscience told him he ought to go and help. But James, and Lily, and Sirius…
戰鬥的喊聲越來越大，越來越絕望；那個命令他和Sirius退後的女人也加入了進來，Remus的良心告訴他應該去幫忙。但James，Lily，還有Sirius…

“Morsmorde!” The same voice spoke, close and far away.
“Morsmorde！”同樣的聲音，既近又遠。

The smoke filling the street seemed to writhe and darken, expanding and swirling upwards to form an enormous snake entwined with a screaming, hollow eyed black skull.
充滿街道的煙霧似乎在扭動和變暗，膨脹並旋轉向上，形成一條巨大的蛇纏繞著一個尖叫的、空洞眼睛的黑色骷髏。

“It’s him!” A man near Remus shouted, “It’s you know who!”
“是他！”Remus附近的一個男人喊道，“是你知道的那個人！”

“Silencio!” Someone else hexed him into quiet. An odd stillness, more flashes – blue, green, yellow, red, and then…
“Silencio！”另一個人對他施了靜音咒。一種奇怪的寂靜，更多的閃光——藍色，綠色，黃色，紅色，然後…

CRACK CRACK CRACK, they were getting away!
噼啪噼啪噼啪，他們逃走了！

For the first time, Remus thought to withdraw his wand, fumbling about in his borrowed robes for it. As he did, his fingers brushed against something else – smooth and heavy. His fingers closed around his pocket watch and he wrenched it out, prising it open quickly and saying aloud,
Remus第一次想到要拔出魔杖，在他借來的長袍裡摸索。當他這樣做時，他的手指碰到了其他東西——光滑而沉重。他的手指握住懷錶，迅速把它掏出來，快速打開並大聲說，

“Sirius Black.”
“Sirius Black。”

The needle did not even wobble, but pointed forward immediately, and Remus followed it towards the ruin of the shop. “Sirius?! Sirius?!”
針頭甚至沒有晃動，但立即指向前方，Remus跟著它走向商店的廢墟。“Sirius？！Sirius？！”

“Moony!” A hand grabbed his shoulder and he whipped around desperately.
“Moony！”一隻手抓住他的肩膀，他絕望地轉過身。

“James!”
“James！”

James hugged him, fiercely, and Remus didn’t even think about how unusual it was, he was just so, so grateful, and relieved, he hugged him back. Lily appeared at his shoulder, pale faced, her hair falling out of its ponytail, clothes smudged with ash. There was a cut just under her hairline, dark blood oozing down into her left eyebrow. And Sirius, too, thank god thank god thank god.
James緊緊地抱住他，Remus甚至沒有考慮這有多不尋常，他只是感到如此、如此的感激和如釋重負，回抱住了他。Lily出現在他的肩膀上，臉色蒼白，頭髮從馬尾中散落，衣服上沾滿了灰燼。在她髮際線下方有一道傷口，黑暗的血液滲入她的左眉毛。還有Sirius，謝天謝地。

He used a knock-back jinx on us, right before the shop was hit, then protego, I think. I didn’t… I didn’t know what to do.” Her eyes filled with tears, and James wrapped his other arm around her, enveloping her completely.

Sirius was gripping his, though. He looked dreadful; fierce as a demon, eyes full of hatred,
但Sirius握著他的魔杖。他看起來很可怕；像惡魔一樣兇狠，眼中充滿仇恨，

“無論如何我要去。他們可能還需要幫助。”他說。

Remus抓住他的肩膀，甚至連自己都對自己的力量感到驚訝。

CRACK
噼啪

Fleamont Potter來到了James旁邊。他抓住了他的兒子，然後是Sirius，然後是Remus——他現在已經恢復得足夠好，覺得這麼多擁抱有點過了——然後恐懼地看著Diagon Alley的殘骸。他濃密的眉毛皺了起來，對他的兒子說，
