“They’re not!” He snapped. “Not all of them.”

“他們不是！”他厲聲說。“不是所有人。”

Lily looked uncertain, and Sirius was practically burning a hole in the back of Remus’s head with his indignance. Remus ran his hands through his hair. They weren’t going to understand. How could they? He barely did. “Look.” He said. “This is important, and I need you all to trust me.”

Lily看起來不確定，而Sirius幾乎用他的憤怒在Remus的後腦勺上燒出了一個洞。Remus用手撥弄著頭髮。他們不會理解的。他們怎麼可能理解？他自己也幾乎不理解。“聽著。”他說。“這很重要，我需要你們都信任我。”

It wasn’t a request, and nor was it received as one. James and Lily looked at each other, then at Sirius. James nodded.

這不是請求，也不是作為請求被接受。James和Lily互相看了一眼，然後看向Sirius。James點了點頭。

“Ok, Moony.”

“好吧，Moony。”

Sirius made a noise of protest, but Remus was too far gone now to care. He would make it up to him later, when he could think clearly; when every instinct in him wasn’t telling him to run into the forest at full pelt.

Sirius發出抗議的聲音，但Remus現在已經太過專注於其他事而不再在意。他會在以後補償他，當他能清晰思考的時候；當他內心的每一個本能都不再告訴他要全速奔向森林的時候。

“Ok.” He nodded back. “Stay here.” A tug in his midriff as the magic took over - he would never be sure whether or not he had done it on purpose, and at the time he simply did not care.

“好吧。”他點點頭。“待在這裡。”魔法接管時，他的腹部有一種牽引感——他永遠無法確定自己是否故意這樣做了，而當時他根本不在乎。

He turned and began to walk into the forest, quickly, his long legs making long strides, his friends behind him, unmoving, unable to follow.

他轉身迅速走進森林，他的長腿邁出大步，他的朋友們在他身後，動彈不得，無法跟隨。

 

Chapter 130: Seventh Year: Castor 

It was easiest not to think, for the next few minutes at least. Remus did not slow down, or tire as quickly as usual - even his hip had stopped hurting. Despite the wheedling guilt he had to keep at bay, he had not felt so good in months. The scent grew stronger as the woods grew thicker, and a shade of darkness fell, casting strange shadows which seemed to move in the corners of Remus’s eyes. 至少在接下來的幾分鐘內，不去思考是最容易的。Remus 沒有放慢腳步，或像往常那樣迅速感到疲倦——甚至他的臀部也不再疼痛。儘管他必須克制住內心的懊悔，但他幾個月來都沒有感覺如此良好。隨著森林變得越來越密，氣味越來越強烈，一片黑暗降臨，投下奇怪的陰影，似乎在 Remus 的眼角移動。

He didn’t think. It was too late to think; he was too far gone. 他沒有思考。現在思考已經太晚了；他已經走得太遠了。

Bloody hell a voice in his head popped out of nowhere, when you go for it you really go for it, don’t ya sweetheart? 該死的，一個聲音突然在他腦海中冒出來，當你決定做某件事的時候，你真的全力以赴，不是嗎，親愛的？

Grant. Remus didn’t want to do this, now. Shut up, he willed his brain. Grant。Remus 現在不想這樣做。閉嘴，他對自己的大腦說。

Oh, charming! Grant’s voice cackled, here I am, only tryna help. Don’t I always try to help? 哦，真迷人！Grant 的聲音咯咯笑道，我在這裡，只是想幫忙。我不是總是試圖幫忙嗎？

I don’t need help. 我不需要幫助。

If you didn’t, I wouldn’t be here. Grant’s voice countered. I could be someone else, if you prefer? Lots of sensible people to choose from. I’ve got Ferox here, wanna chat wif him? Or Lily, though she’s a bit whingy, if you ask me… Dumbledore? Nah, bit of a prick. Ooh, how about your poshboy? Eh, ‘Moony’? 如果你不需要，我就不會在這裡。Grant 的聲音反駁道。如果你願意，我可以變成別人嗎？有很多明智的人可以選。我這裡有 Ferox，想跟他聊聊嗎？或者 Lily，雖然如果你問我，她有點愛抱怨……Dumbledore？不，有點討厭。哦，那你的貴族男孩怎麼樣？嗯，‘Moony’？

Shut up. Remus repeated, walking faster, breathing harder. 閉嘴。Remus 重複道，走得更快，呼吸更加急促。

Yeah, Grant’s voice agreed, slyly, I can see why you wouldn’t wanna talk to ‘im, after what you just done. 是的，Grant 的聲音狡猾地同意道，我能理解為什麼你不想跟他說話，在你剛剛做的事之後。

I had to. Remus insisted. None of you would understand. 我必須這樣做。Remus 堅持道。你們誰都不會理解。

Well they won’t now, you lunatic. 那他們現在也不會理解，你這個瘋子。

Remus ignored the voice. There was no time for this; he would just have to deal with the consequences later. He knew there was no coming back from it now, not really. Remus 無視了這個聲音。現在沒有時間想這些；他只得以後再處理後果。他知道現在已經無法回頭，真的無法回頭。

Hope you like the woods, Remus, Grant was whispering, now, ‘Cos no one’s going to want you back in civilisation after that mess. 希望你喜歡森林，Remus，Grant 現在低聲說，因為在這場混亂之後，沒有人會想要你回到文明社會。

Shut up, shut up, shut UP. Remus raged inside his head, like a mad person; like someone deranged. Perhaps it had been a mistake, to go alone. Perhaps he really had lost it, and his friends were only trying to keep him safe… 閉嘴，閉嘴，閉嘴。Remus 在腦海中怒吼，像個瘋子；像個精神錯亂的人。也許獨自去是個錯誤。也許他真的失去了理智，而他的朋友們只是試圖保護他……

No. He caught the scent again, and it stirred up his insides so much that he felt as though he was being propelled by it; dragged forward, unable to resist. Remus had to find him, or else… well, he wasn’t sure, but it wasn’t even worth considering. 不。他再次捕捉到了那種氣味，這讓他的內心翻騰，感覺自己被它推動著；被拖向前，無法抗拒。這種感覺他以前只在變形時才有，而在他的人形狀態下，他對它的控制力不比狼多。就是他——另一隻狼，某個地方的另一隻狼。Remus 必須找到他，否則……嗯，他不確定，但這甚至不值得考慮。

Something moved, just ahead, and Remus froze. The different scents of the forest began to pile up, he had to concentrate to identify and categorise each one. There was magic. And there was a different kind… it wasn’t the wolf; it was female - or feminine, at least, and not lupine at all. 前方有東西移動，Remus 凝固了。森林裡的不同氣味開始堆積，他必須集中注意力來識別和分類每一種氣味。有魔法。而且還有一種不同的……不是狼；是女性的——或者至少是女性的，而且根本不是狼的氣味。

“Just as Livia said. Toothless. Told father you weren't ready. Told him it was too soon.”
“正如 Livia 所說。牙無，告訴父親你還未準備好。告訴他這還為時已早。”

“Too soon for what?”
“為什麼還早？”

“For the big night, of course,” Castor was smiling again, a sinister grin which made Remus feel queasy. The werewolf continued, recognising Remus’s uncertainty, “On the night of the next moon, the pack will be on the hunt. It will be a hunt such as the world has not seen since the dark ages.”
“當然是為了那個大夜晚。”Castor 再次露出邪惡的笑容，使 Remus 感到不安。狼人繼續說，察覺到 Remus 的不確定，“在下次月亮的那晚，狼群將會出獵。這將是一場自黑暗時代以來未曾見過的獵殺。”

“Why are you telling me this?” There was a quaver on Remus’s voice now, as much as he tried to disguise it, “You know I’m going straight to Dumbledore.”
“你為什麼告訴我這些？”Remus 的聲音顫抖著，儘管他努力掩飾，“你知道我會直接去找鄧不利多。”

Castor laughed, a breathless, hollow sound coming from deep in his chest.
Castor 笑了，從胸腔深處發出一種無力而空洞的聲音。

“Perfect.”
“太好了。”

CRACK
咔嚓

Remus winced as the air around them shimmered slightly, and he staggered back from the figure who had appeared between them in the clearing. She hissed, low under her breath, steely eyes flicking from Remus to Castor. Livia.
Remus 皺起了眉頭，當他們周圍的空氣輕微顫動時，他從出現在空地上的身影旁踉蹌後退。她低聲嘶嘶作響，鋼鐵般的眼睛在 Remus 和 Castor 之間來回掃視。Livia。

“Sister!” Castor rasped, straining for freedom once more, “Release me!”
“姐姐！”Castor 嘶啞地喊道，再次掙扎著尋求自由，“放開我！”

“You have failed our father.” She replied. “Punishment awaits.”
“你讓我們的父親失望了。”她回答道。“懲罰在等待著你。”

“No!” Castor protested, “It was the dryad, I could not--”
“不！”Castor 抗議道，“是那乾枯的樹精，我無法——”

Livia raised a hand, and Castor was silenced, unable to move or make a sound. Remus’s insides froze as she turned on him.
Livia 舉起一隻手，Castor 立刻噤聲，無法移動或發出聲音。當她轉向 Remus 時，Remus 的內心凍結了。

“Hello, my love. Are you ready?”
“你好，我的愛人。你準備好了嗎？”

Remus pulled his wand out and pointed it at her, assuming a duelling stance and rooting himself to the ground. She would not hold him, this time. This time he knew what to expect.
Remus 拔出魔杖，指向她，擺出決鬥姿勢，將自己固定在地上。這次，她不會控制他了。這次，他知道會發生什麼。

“I’m not going anywhere, Livia.”
“我不會去哪裡的，Livia。”

“There isn’t time for this, the moon approaches.” She tutted, walking towards him, as ragged and filthy and wild as he remembered her. “Drop that silly stick.” She raised a hand and twisted it mid air, as if she was turning a door knob. Remus felt the strength of it, prying his fingers apart, his wand burning in his hand, but this time, he did not drop it. He clenched his teeth and gathered every ounce of magic from the woods around him.
“沒有時間再拖延了，月亮快要來了。”她嘆了口氣，向他走去，依舊是那樣破爛、骯髒、狂野，就像他記得的那樣。“把那根愚蠢的棍子放下。”她舉起一隻手，在空中旋轉，就像她在轉門把手。Remus 感覺到那股力量，撬開了他的手指，魔杖在他手中燃燒，但這次，他沒有放下。 他咬緊牙關，從周圍的樹林中汲取所有的魔力。

“No.”
“不。”

“Remus Lupin.” She growled, “You will come with us.”
“Remus Lupin。”她低聲咆哮，“你會跟我們走。”

She raised both arms now, and flicked her fingers, so that they fanned out from her palms. The trees surrounding Remus caught light in an instant, from trunk to branches, blazing columns of fire roaring around him. He was terrified, but he was not letting go.
她現在雙手高舉，手指輕輕一揮，使它們從她的掌心擴散開來。環繞 Remus 的樹木瞬間被點燃，從樹幹到樹枝，火焰的柱子在他周圍咆哮。他感到恐懼，但他沒有放手。

“No.” He repeated, stepping backwards, slowly. He would run, if he had to, let the dryads deal with them - let the centaurs do it, come to that. You didn’t just show up in a forest like this and start burning it down.
“不。”他重複道，慢慢向後退。如果有必要，他會逃跑，讓樹精處理他們——如果需要的話，讓半人馬去做。你不會隨便出現在這樣的森林中，然後開始燒毀它。

Livia snapped her fingers then, and at once Castor was freed from his bondage, gasping and snarling. He joined his pack mate, and now there were two of them, their eyes glowing like hot coals, reflecting back the flames surrounding them.
Livia 突然打了個響指，Castor 立即被解放出來，喘息著和咆哮著。他與他的同伴會合，現在有了兩個，他們的眼睛像炙熱的煤炭一樣發光，反射著圍繞他們的火焰。

“The time has come, Remus Lupin,” they said, in unison, as black smoke began to fill the air, the scent of sap and pine fizzling around them.
“時候到了，Remus Lupin，”他們齊聲說道，當黑煙開始充滿空氣，樹脂和松樹的氣味在他們周圍散發。

“No.” He said again, though he could see no way out, now. “Mordeo!” He shouted, aiming his wand at them, as he backed away. Castor recoiled, growling, but Livia laughed throatily, and waved her hand again, dismissing the curse as if it was no more than a cobweb.
“不。”他再次說道，雖然現在他看不到任何出路。“Mordeo！”他喊道，將魔杖對準他們，向後退去。Castor 往後退，低聲咆哮，但 Livia 咯咯笑了，再次揮動手，將詛咒當作一根蛛網般拋開。

This was it. They were going to take him - god knows where - and make him one of them. He would never see his friends again, never see Sirius again. He had been such an idiot, forcing them to stay behind. Now there was nobody left to protect him.
這就是結局了。他們將帶走他——天知道去哪裡——並讓他成為他們的一員。他再也見不到他的朋友，再也見不到天狼星了。他真是個傻瓜，強迫他們留在後面。現在再也沒有人可以保護他了。

There’s you. Remus didn’t recognise this voice. It wasn’t Grant’s, or anyone he’d ‘spoken to’ before. But maybe it was right. There was a spell he hadn’t considered, simply because he had never mastered it properly. But he was in dire straits now, and he had more power than ever before at his disposal.
有你。Remus 不認識這個聲音。它不是 Grant 的，也不是他以前‘交談過’的任何人的。但也許這是對的。有一個他從未考慮過的咒語，只因為他從未真正掌握過它。但現在他處於困境中，他擁有比以往更多的力量。

As bright embers and burning leaves rained down on the three of them, Remus gathered all of his resources; his strength, and his rage, and every joy in his heart. He would have to be ready to run, as soon as the incantation was spoken. If it failed, he would have no time at all to make his escape.
當明亮的炭火和燃燒的樹葉降落在他們三人身上時，Remus 集中起來所有的資源；他的力量、憤怒，以及心中的每一份喜悅。他必須準備好在咒語發動的瞬間立刻逃跑。如果失敗，他將沒有時間逃脫。

He breathed in, carefully, and - just before he cast the spell - recalled Sirius’s eyes, and Sirius’s mouth, and Sirius grinning. “I’m mental about you.”
他小心地吸了口氣，在施咒之前，他回想起天狼星的眼睛、天狼星的嘴巴，還有天狼星的微笑。“我對你癡迷。”

“Expecto Patronum!” He practically screamed it, extending his arm, directing his wand as an enormous silver animal burst forth, leaping towards Livia and Castor, huge jaws wide, claws bared. In the split second before he began to run, Remus saw them both cover their eyes, and turn to run in the opposite direction as the great beast lunged at them.
“Expecto Patronum！”他幾乎是在尖叫著施法，伸出手臂，指揮著魔杖，一隻巨大的銀色生物爆發出來，向 Livia 和 Castor 跳去，巨大的嘴巴張開，爪子豎起。在他開始奔跑的瞬間，Remus 看見他們兩人都遮住了眼睛，轉身逃向相反的方向，當那隻巨大的生物向他們撲去。

But there wasn’t time to stay and enjoy his success, so he didn’t. He ran again, for the edge of the woods; back to Hogsmeade, and the wizarding world, and his friends. Remus ran so hard that his legs were burning, and the pain in his hip was like a spear in his side, but he did not stop, lungs full of woodsmoke and eyes watering, he just kept going until the trees began to thin, and the light grew stronger.
但沒有時間停下來享受他的成功，所以他沒有。 他再次奔跑，朝向森林的邊緣；回到 Hogsmeade，回到魔法世界，回到他的朋友們身邊。Remus 跑得如此劇烈，以至於他的雙腿在燃燒，臀部的疼痛就像是刺在側邊的矛，但他沒有停下來，肺部充滿了樹木的煙霧，眼睛含淚，他只是繼續前進，直到樹木變得稀疏，光線變得更加明亮。

Peter and Sirius were still there. Sirius was pacing erratically back and forth on the footpath. Peter was sitting on the ground with his knees drawn up, staring at the woods. He looked as though he had been crying.
Peter 和 Sirius 仍然在那裡。Sirius 在人行道上來回踱步，神情焦躁。Peter 坐在地上，雙膝縮在胸前，盯著森林。他看起來像是哭過。

Remus staggered out into the daylight, and felt ready to collapse right there. Peter stood up, wiping his eyes in disbelief, and Sirius ran towards him, and then stopped, suddenly, and was knocked back, as though he’d hit a wall. Furious, he gave out an angry grunt. Remus allowed one of the knots inside him to unravel, and the barrier was lifted. He limped towards his two friends, wheezing.
Remus 搖搖晃晃地走入陽光下，感到隨時會倒下。Peter 站起來，難以置信地擦拭眼睛，Sirius 跑向他，然後突然停下，彷彿撞上了牆壁。憤怒地，他發出了一聲憤怒的哼聲。Remus 讓內心的結鬆解開，障礙被解除。他跛行向兩位朋友走去，喘息著。

“Sorry.” He murmured.
“對不起。”他低聲說道。

Much to his surprise, Sirius threw his arms around his neck, and held him tightly. His heartbeat thrummed against Remus’s, and he hugged him back, exhausted and grateful.
令他驚訝的是，Sirius 把手臂圍住他的脖子，緊緊抱住他。他的心跳與 Remus 的心跳互相碰撞，他也回擁著他，感到疲憊而感激。

“We couldn’t come and help.” Sirius said, his voice hoarse and hollow, “Whatever you did… we couldn’t follow you.”
“我們不能來幫忙。”Sirius 說道，聲音嘶啞而空洞，“無論你做了什麼……我們無法跟隨你。”

“I’m sorry.” Remus said, again.
“對不起。”Remus 再次說道。

“I’m so sorry, Remus!” Peter suddenly burst out, his eyes filling with tears again, “I’m so sorry!”
“對不起，Remus！”Peter 突然激動地說，他的眼睛再次充滿淚水，“對不起！”

“It’s ok.” Remus reached out an arm to pat his shoulder, but Sirius wouldn’t let him go yet. Finally, Remus came back to his senses, and gently untangled himself, “I have to see Dumbledore, right now. Where are the others?”
“沒關係。”Remus 伸出手臂拍了拍他的肩膀，但 Sirius 還不願意放開他。最終，Remus 恢復了理智，輕輕地脫身，“我現在必須去見鄧不利多。其他人在哪裡？”

“They had to go back,” Sirius explained, “Curfew. They said they’d tell McGonagall.”
“他們必須回去了，”Sirius 解釋道，“宿舍規定。他們說會告訴 McGonagall。”

“Good.” Remus nodded. “Come on, we have to go, now.” He began to hobble towards the village.
“好。”Remus 點了點頭。“我們得走了，現在。”他開始跛行著向村莊走去。

“Moony, are you ok?” Sirius hurried alongside him, an arm under his shoulder for support.
“Moony，你還好嗎？”Sirius 急忙跟在他身旁，伸手搭在他的肩膀上以示支持。

“Just tired,” Remus said.
“只是累了，”Remus 說道。

“You’re covered in… is that soot?”
“你滿身都是……那是煤灰嗎？”

“There was a fire…”
“有場火……”

“Wormtail said something was summoning you.”
“Wormtail 說有東西在召喚你。”

“I can’t… I can’t explain it, yet, please don’t ask me.”
“我不能……我還無法解釋，請不要問我。”

“Fine.” There was a cold edge to Sirius’s voice which Remus didn’t like, but he kept supporting him, and he kept going, so it would have to be ignored for now. One thing at a time.
“好。”Sirius 的聲音帶著冷漠，Remus 不喜歡，但他繼續支持他，繼續前行，所以現在只能忽略這一點。一件事情一次處理。

McGonagall was waiting for them at the school gates, her arms folded, deep lines creasing her forehead.
McGonagall 在學校的大門口等著他們，雙臂交叉，額頭上深深的皺紋刻畫出她的焦慮。

“Professor!” Remus spluttered, still coughing up smoke, “I’m sorry we missed the curfew, but I need to see the headmaster right--”
“教授！”Remus 喘息著說，還在咳嗽，“對不起我們錯過了宵禁，但我需要立刻去見校長——”

“Yes of course, Lupin, come with me.” McGonagall nodded, quickly, and took his arm from Sirius. She peered down at Sirius and Peter. “You two go to the tower and say nothing. I don’t want any arguments, do you hear me?”
“是的，當然，Lupin，跟我來。”McGonagall 點了點頭，迅速地將他的手臂從 Sirius 那裡取下。她看了一眼 Sirius 和 Peter。“你們兩個去塔樓，什麼也不要說。我不想聽到任何爭論，你們聽見了嗎？”

The two young men were so surprised by these sharp instructions that they both nodded and left, immediately, Sirius throwing one glance back at Remus.
這兩位年輕人對這些嚴厲的指示感到非常驚訝，於是他們立刻點頭離開了，Sirius 向 Remus 投去了一瞥。

He told Dumbledore almost everything. He told him about the scent, and the dryad, and Castor. About the fire, and the plans Greyback had for his pack, and Livia. He did not mention the barrier he had somehow conjured, to keep his friends back. Nor did he explain that he had known how dangerous it would be, or that he had ignored every ounce of good sense he had in order to pursue Castor.
他告訴了鄧不利多幾乎所有的事情。他告訴了他氣味、樹精和 Castor 的事情。還有火焰、Greyback 對他的狼群的計劃，以及 Livia。他沒有提到他不知怎麼地施放了屏障來阻止朋友們靠近，也沒有解釋他知道這將會有多麼危險，或者他無視了所有的理智來追捕 Castor。

Dumbledore seemed very pleased, nonetheless.
儘管如此，鄧不利多似乎非常滿意。

“Everything you have told me is immensely useful, Remus.” The old man said, smiling across his desk at Remus with eyes twinkling with pride, for the first time Remus could remember. “You were very brave, and fulfilled your task admirably.”
“你告訴我的一切都非常有用，Remus。”老人說道，對著 Remus 微笑，眼中閃爍著驕傲的光芒，是 Remus 記憶中的第一次。“你非常勇敢，完美地完成了你的任務。”

“I… I did? Even though I went in the forbidden forest?”
“我……我做到了？即使我進入了禁忌森林？”

“You followed your quarry. And I don’t see that any harm has come to you? You are clearly a formidable wizard, like your father.”
“你追蹤了你的獵物。我看不出你受到任何傷害？你顯然是一位強大的巫師，就像你的父親一樣。”

Remus felt a very small twinge of pleasure at that, which put him more at ease.
Remus 感到了一絲微小的滿足，這讓他感到更加放鬆。

“This attack, though… the hunt they’re planning--”
“但這次襲擊……他們計劃的狩獵——”

“Let the Order deal with that.” Dumbledore shook his head, placing his hands on his desk and rising to his feet. “You have done quite enough - more than anyone could expect of a seventeen year old wizard.”
“讓秘社來處理吧。”鄧不利多搖了搖頭，雙手放在桌子上，站了起來。“你已經做得夠多了——超出了任何人對一位十七歲巫師的期望。”

“Yes, but if I can--”
“是的，但如果我能——”

“I am sorry I asked this of you, Remus.” Dumbledore came around his desk and placed a friendly hand on his shoulder. “I hope I will not have to ask again.”
“對不起，我要求你這樣做，Remus。”鄧不利多繞過桌子，把友好的手放在他的肩膀上。“我希望我不必再要求你這樣做。”

“I’m on your side.” Remus replied, feeling he ought to reiterate this. “I’ll do what has to be done.”
“我在你這邊。”Remus 回答道，感覺應該重申這一點。“我會做必須做的事。”

Dumbledore’s eyes glittered with triumph, and his grip tightened on Remus’s shoulder.
鄧不利多的眼睛閃爍著勝利的光芒，他的手握緊了 Remus 的肩膀。

The fire had been put out by the naiads, according to McGonagall, who walked him from Dumbledore’s office to the infirmary. There had been no trace of Livia or Castor, and it was assumed they had apparated.
據 McGonagall 說，火已經被水精靈撲滅了，她將 Remus 從鄧不利多的辦公室帶到醫務室。沒有 Livia 或 Castor 的痕跡，大家猜測他們已經使用了瞬間移動。

Madam Pomfrey tutted over him, cleaned off the soot and administered a pain killing draught. By then he was breathing normally again, and perversely quite fancied a cigarette, though he didn’t tell her that. Food was brought to him there, because by this time he had missed dinner, and he ate a pleasant, quiet supper in Madam Pomfrey’s homely little office.
Pomfrey 女士對他嘆了口氣，清理了煤灰並給他服用了止痛藥水。那時，他已經正常呼吸了，儘管他沒有告訴她，但他異常地想抽根煙。食物被送到他那裡，因為到這時候他已經錯過了晚餐，他在 Pomfrey 女士溫馨的小辦公室裡吃了一頓愉快而安靜的晚餐。

Thankfully, he was permitted to walk back to Gryffindor tower alone. His friends were all waiting - not in their usual place by the fire, but in a quieter corner, near one of the far windows. They were all speaking in serious, hushed tones, and their heads turned at once to face him as he appeared through the portrait hole.
幸運的是，他被允許獨自回到格蘭芬多塔樓。他的朋友們都在等著他——不是在他們平常坐在火爐旁的地方，而是在一個較安靜的角落，靠近其中一扇遙遠的窗戶。他們都用嚴肅的低語聲說話，當他從畫像孔中出現時，他們的頭立刻轉向他。

He walked over, a bit woozy from the draught he’d taken, and they made room for him to sit in the window seat, squashed between Lily and Sirius, who quickly squeezed his hand, before letting go. They all stared at him, and waited for him to speak, so he did.
他走過去，有些暈眩，因為他服用了藥水，他們讓出空間讓他坐在窗邊的座位上，擠在 Lily 和 Sirius 之間，Sirius 迅速握了握他的手，然後放開了。他們都盯著他，等待他開口，他於是開始說話。

He told them as much as he could - and a few things he hadn’t said to Dumbledore. Peter had luckily already covered the dryad, and apparently the marauders had spent much of their evening explaining the animagus secret to Lily. Still, she covered her mouth in horror when Remus talked about encountering Castor, and Livia’s incredible powers, and the fire… Sirius was practically quaking with rage beside him, but held his tongue the whole time, and let Remus finish.
他告訴了他們他能說的盡可能多的事情——還有一些他沒有告訴鄧不利多的事情。幸運的是，Peter 已經涵蓋了樹精的部分，顯然，小強們大部分時間都在向 Lily 解釋 animagus 的秘密。即便如此，當 Remus 講述遇到 Castor、Livia 的驚人力量以及火焰時，她仍然驚恐地捂住了嘴……Sirius 在他身旁幾乎因憤怒而顫抖，但他整個過程中都保持沉默，讓 Remus 講完。

“Bloody hell.” James said, once the story was told. “Well done on the patronus, though, mate.”
“該死。”James 說道，故事講完後。“不過，你的守護神做得很好，伙計。”

“Thanks,” Remus blushed, slightly. Trust James to find something praiseworthy, in all of that.
“謝謝，”Remus 稍微臉紅了。相信 James 能在所有事情中找到值得稱讚的地方。

“Did you see what it was?”
“你看到那是什麼了嗎？”

“No.” he said, quickly, “It happened too fast.”
“沒有。”他迅速回答，“一切發生得太快了。”

Still, Remus shook his head, straightening up. 然而，Remus 還是搖了搖頭，挺直了身子。

“No.” He said, “I have to find them. She hurt him.” “不。”他說，“我必須找到他們。她傷害了他。”

“So what?!” Peter replied, indignant, “We’re not supposed to be here!” “那又怎樣？！”Peter 憤怒地回答，“我們不應該在這裡！”

“Look, I’m sorry you got caught up in this,” Remus frowned, impatiently. Now that they weren’t in immediate danger, his desire to hunt the other wolf down had returned. He could smell blood; he was sure of it. “But I have to. You can go back, if you want - go and find the others.” “看，我很抱歉讓你捲入這件事，”Remus 不耐煩地皺眉。現在他們沒有立即的危險，他對追捕另一隻狼的渴望又回來了。他能聞到血腥味；他確信這一點。“但我必須這麼做。你可以回去，如果你想的話——去找其他人。”

Peter looked behind him, then back at Remus, his eyes big and shimmering. Peter 回頭看了看，然後又看著 Remus，他的眼睛大而閃爍。

“On my own?” The tremor in his voice was palpable, and Remus suddenly wanted him gone more than anything in the world, in case the terror was catching. “我自己一個人？”他的聲音顫抖得很明顯，Remus 突然比什麼都想讓他離開，萬一這種恐懼是會傳染的。

“I’ll give you my watch, so you don’t get lost.” Remus offered. “我會把我的手錶給你，這樣你就不會迷路了。”Remus 提議。

“No.” Peter stiffened his lips, “I’ll come with you.” “不。”Peter 咬緊嘴唇，“我會跟你一起去。”

Pete’s heartbeat was almost deafening, and Remus was starting to feel sorry for him. Peter 的心跳聲幾乎震耳欲聾，Remus 開始對他感到同情。

“It’s ok,” he whispered. “If something happens, you can just transform back, and go and tell the others, can’t you? You’ll know the way better, as a rat.” “沒事的，”他低聲說。“如果發生什麼事，你可以變回原形，去告訴其他人，不是嗎？變成老鼠後你會更清楚路。”

“I won’t leave you, Remus,” Peter whispered, shakily, “I can be brave, I know I can.” “我不會離開你，Remus，”Peter 顫抖地低語，“我可以勇敢，我知道我可以。”

Remus squeezed his shoulder. Remus 捏了捏他的肩膀。

“Fine. This way. Keep as quiet as you can.” “好吧。這邊走。儘量保持安靜。”

The dryad had not come after them, thank goodness. Remus couldn’t remember everything about tree guardians, but he was fairly sure they couldn’t leave their groves. Or maybe that was naiads? He couldn’t remember the difference. 幸好，樹妖沒有追來。Remus 不記得有關樹木守護者的一切，但他相當確定它們不能離開它們的樹叢。或者那是水澤仙女？他記不起來區別了。

But it didn’t matter now, he’d picked up the scent properly. A mouth-watering, rich, iron tang that made his stomach growl shamefully. They were still days out from the full moon, but that didn’t seem to matter to the wolf inside Remus, who was scaling the walls of its prison, howling for freedom. 但現在這些都不重要，他已經正確地聞到了氣味。一股令人垂涎的濃郁鐵味，讓他的肚子羞愧地咕咕叫。離滿月還有幾天，但這對 Remus 體內的狼似乎並不重要，它正在攀爬囚牢的牆壁，渴望自由地嚎叫。

“It’s close.” Remus whispered to Peter, as they pressed through a heavy thicket, probably announcing their arrival to every creature nearby. “很近了。”Remus 對 Peter 低語，當他們穿過一片濃密的灌木叢時，可能向附近的每個生物宣告了他們的到來。

There was another heartbeat, not very far away, and that sounded frightened, too. A few steps more and Remus could hear labored breathing; like someone who had been struggling for a while now, and was beginning to tire. Closer still and he could smell the sweat - and the rage - from this struggle. It was such a strong mix of emotions and energy, that Remus was momentarily lost in the fog of it, too overwhelmed to see a clear direction. Then it changed - stilled, suddenly. A harsh voice rang out, shattering the quiet of the woods, shaking birds from their nests; 不遠處還有另一個心跳聲，聽起來也很害怕。再走幾步，Remus 能聽到勞累的呼吸聲；像是某個人已經掙扎了一段時間，開始疲憊了。再近一點，他能聞到這場掙扎的汗水和憤怒。這是一種如此強烈的情感和能量的混合，以至於 Remus 一時間迷失在其中，太過震撼以至於看不清方向。然後它變了——突然靜止。一個刺耳的聲音響起，打破了森林的寧靜，驚醒了鳥巢中的鳥兒；

“Remus Lupin!” “Remus Lupin！”

Peter gave out a sharp squeak of terror, before leaping a foot in the air, transforming, and turning tail, scampering away from Remus. No matter. Remus stood taller. Peter 發出一聲尖銳的驚叫，然後跳起一英尺高，變形，轉身逃離 Remus。無所謂。Remus 挺直了身子。

“I’m here.” He whispered, back. “我在這裡。”他回應道。

“Come to me.” “來我這裡。”

That tugging sensation returned to Remus’s chest, and he followed it, letting himself be drawn forward, through to a small clearing of trees. At its center was an ancient yew, gnarled and creaking, and bound to the trunk was a young man. The dryad had him tied in place with miles of cruel, twisted bramble. The thorns were cutting into his worn leather cloak, and puncturing the skin of his neck. His arms were at his sides, and despite obvious attempts to free himself, the brown, sinewy stems held firm. 那種牽引感回到了 Remus 的胸口，他跟隨著它，讓自己被拉向前，穿過一小片空曠的樹林。在其中心是一棵古老的紫杉，盤曲著嘎吱作響，樹幹上綁著一個年輕人。樹妖用數英里的殘酷、扭曲的荊棘把他捆在原地。荊棘刺穿了他破舊的皮斗篷，刺入他的脖子皮膚。他的手臂垂在身側，儘管明顯有試圖掙脫的痕跡，那棕色、肌腱般的莖仍然牢牢地固定著。

He wasn’t struggling now, though. He was just staring at Remus, head bent forward, eyes dark and inscrutable. His head was shaved, as Livia’s had been, and his clothes were weather worn and threadbare, but there the resemblance ended. He was tall; as tall as Remus, and perhaps only a few years older. His skin was as dark as tanned leather, his features handsome and striking. He smiled, slowly, showing rows of straight white teeth. 不過，他現在沒有掙扎。他只是盯著 Remus，頭向前傾，眼神深沉難測。他的頭剃得光光的，像 Livia 一樣，衣服被風雨侵蝕得破爛不堪，但相似之處也僅限於此。他很高；和 Remus 一樣高，可能只大了幾歲。他的皮膚像鞣過的皮革一樣黝黑，五官俊美而醒目。他慢慢地笑了，露出一排整齊的白牙。

“Remus Lupin. Set me free.” “Remus Lupin。放我自由。”

“Who are you?” Remus held back, gripping his wand inside his pocket. “你是誰？”Remus 後退一步，握緊口袋裡的魔杖。

“I am Castor. Set me free. I am your brother.” “我是 Castor。放我自由。我是你的兄弟。”

Remus cocked his head. This man was trapped. Utterly at Remus’s mercy. He felt his courage returning. Remus 歪了歪頭。這個人被困住了。完全在 Remus 的掌控之中。他感到勇氣回來了。

“My brother, are you? Greyback send you?” “我的兄弟，是嗎？Greyback 派你來的？”

“Yes.” “是的。”

“Well.” Remus leaned against the nearest tree and folded his arms, “You’re going to have to give me a decent reason to set you free then, aren’t you?” “好吧。”Remus 靠在最近的樹上，抱起手臂，“那你得給我一個合理的理由來放你自由，不是嗎？”

Castor roared, furiously, fighting against his bonds once more, tearing his clothes and driving the thorns deeper into his neck. He was clearly very strong, with a broad build, thick biceps flexing against the vines. Castor 憤怒地咆哮著，再次掙脫束縛，撕裂了他的衣服，把荊棘更深地刺入他的脖子。他顯然非常強壯，體格魁梧，粗壯的二頭肌在藤蔓中彎曲。

“Oh dear,” Remus tutted, conversationally, “Looks like you’re not going anywhere without me.” “哦天哪，”Remus 若無其事地咂嘴道，“看來沒有我你哪裡也去不了。”

He would later wonder where this ridiculous sense of cockiness had come from. After all, the situation Remus now found himself in was every bit as dangerous as the attack on Diagon Alley, which had turned his mind inside out. Perhaps it was the woods, and the power he could feel coursing through him. Perhaps it was Grant’s voice, still ringing in his ears. Perhaps it was simply the familiarity of the situation. Remus had been facing off against bullies who thought they had him figured out since he was six years old. “So?” He said, smiling, “Wanna talk?” 他後來會想知道這種荒謬的自信感從何而來。畢竟，Remus 現在所處的情況與對 Diagon Alley 的襲擊一樣危險，那次襲擊讓他的思維翻轉。也許是因為這片森林，以及他能感受到的力量在他體內流動。也許是 Grant 的聲音，仍然在他耳邊迴響。也許只是因為情況的熟悉。自從他六歲起，Remus 一直在面對那些以為他已經被看透的惡霸。“那麼？”他笑著說，“想聊聊嗎？”

“I was sent to talk.” “我是來談的。”

“Really? Just talk?” “真的嗎？只是談談？”

“Just talk. Set me free.” “只是談談。放我自由。”

“Mm.” Remus played with the tip of his wand, thoughtfully, as if he hadn’t a care in the world. “See, I’ve got a bit of a problem believing you, Castor, mate. Seeing as the last time Greyback sent someone to ‘just talk’ to me, an innocent woman ended up dead.” “嗯。”Remus 若有所思地玩弄著魔杖尖端，彷彿他什麼也不在乎。“看，你讓我有點難以置信，Castor，兄弟。上次 Greyback 派人來‘只是談談’的時候，一個無辜的女人最後死了。”

“My father recognizes his mistake in sending Livia.” The werewolf said, earnestly. He had calmed down a bit, now, and was clearly watching Remus to see where this was going. “So this time he has sent me.” “我父親承認派 Livia 是個錯誤。”那狼人認真地說。他現在冷靜下來了，顯然在觀察 Remus，看看事情的進展。“所以這次他派我來。”

“I can see right through that, too, you know,” Remus mused, “Thought a good-looking bloke might… er… peak my interest, did he?” “我也看穿了這點，你知道，”Remus 若有所思地說，“覺得一個長得好看的傢伙可能會……呃……引起我的興趣，是嗎？”

Castor kept staring at him, eyes narrowing. Remus shrugged and continued, “I mean, I’m flattered, Castor, don’t get me wrong, I’m sure you’re lovely, but I’m still not interested. And I have to say, so far I’m not very impressed. Not as good at magic as your pal Livia, then? She’d have apparated right out of that, no trouble.” Castor 繼續盯著他，眼睛微微眯起。Remus 聳了聳肩，繼續說：“我是說，我感到受寵若驚，Castor，不要誤會我的意思，我相信你很可愛，但我還是沒興趣。我得說，到目前為止我並不太印象深刻。魔法不如你的朋友 Livia，對吧？她早就會幻影移形離開了，毫不費力。”

“That tree-bitch!” Castor snarled, struggling again, “Whatever she’s done, these vines… I can’t use magic…” “那個樹妖！”Castor 咆哮道，再次掙扎，“不管她做了什麼，這些藤蔓……我不能用魔法……”

“Oh I see!” Remus nodded, “Well, must remember to thank her, next time I see her.” “哦，我明白了！”Remus 點了點頭，“嗯，下次見到她一定要記得感謝她。”

“Livia told me about you,” Castor said, “She said you’re Dumbledore’s pet hound, toothless. Wouldn’t hurt a fly, wouldn’t chase a rabbit on a full moon.” “Livia 告訴過我關於你的事，”Castor 說，“她說你是 Dumbledore 的寵物獵犬，沒牙。連蒼蠅都不會傷害，滿月時也不會追兔子。”

“I’m nobody’s pet.” Remus replied, his jaw clenching. “And nor should you be. What’s so great about Greyback, eh? What do you lot think’s going to happen to you when we defeat Voldemort?” “我不是任何人的寵物。”Remus 回答，咬緊牙關。“你也不應該是。Greyback 有什麼了不起的，嗯？當我們打敗 Voldemort 後，你們這幫人覺得會發生什麼？”

“The same thing that always happens to our kind.” Castor replied, giving Remus a pitying look, “We will be hunted and oppressed.” “和我們這種人總是發生的事一樣。”Castor 回答，憐憫地看著 Remus，“我們會被追捕和壓迫。”

“Don’t you want to change that?” Remus implored, taking a step forward. “Don’t you have a family, in the real world? Don’t you want a family, one day?” “你不想改變這一點嗎？”Remus 懇求地說，向前邁了一步。“在現實世界裡，你沒有家庭嗎？你不想有一天有一個家庭嗎？”

“We are a pack. We are everything.” “我們是一個群體。我們是全部。”

Remus sighed. Remus 嘆了口氣。

“You don’t understand. He’s lying to you. I know there’s a way to make things better, to really change the way we’re treated, but it can’t be like this, don’t you see?” “你不明白。他在騙你。我知道有辦法讓事情變得更好，真正改變我們被對待的方式，但不能像這樣，你看不出來嗎？”

Castor sneered. Castor 冷笑。

 

“Just as Livia said. Toothless. Told father you weren't ready. Told him it was too soon.”
“正如 Livia 所說。牙無，告訴父親你還未準備好。告訴他這還為時已早。”

“Too soon for what?”
“為什麼還早？”

“For the big night, of course,” Castor was smiling again, a sinister grin which made Remus feel queasy. The werewolf continued, recognising Remus’s uncertainty, “On the night of the next moon, the pack will be on the hunt. It will be a hunt such as the world has not seen since the dark ages.”
“當然是為了那個大夜晚。”Castor 再次露出邪惡的笑容，使 Remus 感到不安。狼人繼續說，察覺到 Remus 的不確定，“在下次月亮的那晚，狼群將會出獵。這將是一場自黑暗時代以來未曾見過的獵殺。”

“Why are you telling me this?” There was a quaver on Remus’s voice now, as much as he tried to disguise it, “You know I’m going straight to Dumbledore.”
“你為什麼告訴我這些？”Remus 的聲音顫抖著，儘管他努力掩飾，“你知道我會直接去找鄧不利多。”

Castor laughed, a breathless, hollow sound coming from deep in his chest.
Castor 笑了，從胸腔深處發出一種無力而空洞的聲音。

“Perfect.”
“太好了。”

CRACK
咔嚓

Remus winced as the air around them shimmered slightly, and he staggered back from the figure who had appeared between them in the clearing. She hissed, low under her breath, steely eyes flicking from Remus to Castor. Livia.
Remus 皺起了眉頭，當他們周圍的空氣輕微顫動時，他從出現在空地上的身影旁踉蹌後退。她低聲嘶嘶作響，鋼鐵般的眼睛在 Remus 和 Castor 之間來回掃視。Livia。

“Sister!” Castor rasped, straining for freedom once more, “Release me!”
“姐姐！”Castor 嘶啞地喊道，再次掙扎著尋求自由，“放開我！”

“You have failed our father.” She replied. “Punishment awaits.”
“你讓我們的父親失望了。”她回答道。“懲罰在等待著你。”

“No!” Castor protested, “It was the dryad, I could not--”
“不！”Castor 抗議道，“是那乾枯的樹精，我無法——”

Livia raised a hand, and Castor was silenced, unable to move or make a sound. Remus’s insides froze as she turned on him.
Livia 舉起一隻手，Castor 立刻噤聲，無法移動或發出聲音。當她轉向 Remus 時，Remus 的內心凍結了。

“Hello, my love. Are you ready?”
“你好，我的愛人。你準備好了嗎？”

Remus pulled his wand out and pointed it at her, assuming a duelling stance and rooting himself to the ground. She would not hold him, this time. This time he knew what to expect.
Remus 拔出魔杖，指向她，擺出決鬥姿勢，將自己固定在地上。這次，她不會控制他了。這次，他知道會發生什麼。

“I’m not going anywhere, Livia.”
“我不會去哪裡的，Livia。”

“There isn’t time for this, the moon approaches.” She tutted, walking towards him, as ragged and filthy and wild as he remembered her. “Drop that silly stick.” She raised a hand and twisted it mid air, as if she was turning a door knob. Remus felt the strength of it, prying his fingers apart, his wand burning in his hand, but this time, he did not drop it. He clenched his teeth and gathered every ounce of magic from the woods around him.
“沒有時間再拖延了，月亮快要來了。”她嘆了口氣，向他走去，依舊是那樣破爛、骯髒、狂野，就像他記得的那樣。“把那根愚蠢的棍子放下。”她舉起一隻手，在空中旋轉，就像她在轉門把手。Remus 感覺到那股力量，撬開了他的手指，魔杖在他手中燃燒，但這次，他沒有放下。 他咬緊牙關，從周圍的樹林中汲取所有的魔力。

“No.”
“不。”

“Remus Lupin.” She growled, “You will come with us.”
“Remus Lupin。”她低聲咆哮，“你會跟我們走。”

She raised both arms now, and flicked her fingers, so that they fanned out from her palms. The trees surrounding Remus caught light in an instant, from trunk to branches, blazing columns of fire roaring around him. He was terrified, but he was not letting go.
她現在雙手高舉，手指輕輕一揮，使它們從她的掌心擴散開來。環繞 Remus 的樹木瞬間被點燃，從樹幹到樹枝，火焰的柱子在他周圍咆哮。他感到恐懼，但他沒有放手。

“No.” He repeated, stepping backwards, slowly. He would run, if he had to, let the dryads deal with them - let the centaurs do it, come to that. You didn’t just show up in a forest like this and start burning it down.
“不。”他重複道，慢慢向後退。如果有必要，他會逃跑，讓樹精處理他們——如果需要的話，讓半人馬去做。你不會隨便出現在這樣的森林中，然後開始燒毀它。

Livia snapped her fingers then, and at once Castor was freed from his bondage, gasping and snarling. He joined his pack mate, and now there were two of them, their eyes glowing like hot coals, reflecting back the flames surrounding them.
Livia 突然打了個響指，Castor 立即被解放出來，喘息著和咆哮著。他與他的同伴會合，現在有了兩個，他們的眼睛像炙熱的煤炭一樣發光，反射著圍繞他們的火焰。

“The time has come, Remus Lupin,” they said, in unison, as black smoke began to fill the air, the scent of sap and pine fizzling around them.
“時候到了，Remus Lupin，”他們齊聲說道，當黑煙開始充滿空氣，樹脂和松樹的氣味在他們周圍散發。

“No.” He said again, though he could see no way out, now. “Mordeo!” He shouted, aiming his wand at them, as he backed away. Castor recoiled, growling, but Livia laughed throatily, and waved her hand again, dismissing the curse as if it was no more than a cobweb.
“不。”他再次說道，雖然現在他看不到任何出路。“Mordeo！”他喊道，將魔杖對準他們，向後退去。Castor 往後退，低聲咆哮，但 Livia 咯咯笑了，再次揮動手，將詛咒當作一根蛛網般拋開。

This was it. They were going to take him - god knows where - and make him one of them. He would never see his friends again, never see Sirius again. He had been such an idiot, forcing them to stay behind. Now there was nobody left to protect him.
這就是結局了。他們將帶走他——天知道去哪裡——並讓他成為他們的一員。他再也見不到他的朋友，再也見不到天狼星了。他真是個傻瓜，強迫他們留在後面。現在再也沒有人可以保護他了。

There’s you. Remus didn’t recognise this voice. It wasn’t Grant’s, or anyone he’d ‘spoken to’ before. But maybe it was right. There was a spell he hadn’t considered, simply because he had never mastered it properly. But he was in dire straits now, and he had more power than ever before at his disposal.
有你。Remus 不認識這個聲音。它不是 Grant 的，也不是他以前‘交談過’的任何人的。但也許這是對的。有一個他從未考慮過的咒語，只因為他從未真正掌握過它。但現在他處於困境中，他擁有比以往更多的力量。

As bright embers and burning leaves rained down on the three of them, Remus gathered all of his resources; his strength, and his rage, and every joy in his heart. He would have to be ready to run, as soon as the incantation was spoken. If it failed, he would have no time at all to make his escape.
當明亮的炭火和燃燒的樹葉降落在他們三人身上時，Remus 集中起來所有的資源；他的力量、憤怒，以及心中的每一份喜悅。他必須準備好在咒語發動的瞬間立刻逃跑。如果失敗，他將沒有時間逃脫。

He breathed in, carefully, and - just before he cast the spell - recalled Sirius’s eyes, and Sirius’s mouth, and Sirius grinning. “I’m mental about you.”
他小心地吸了口氣，在施咒之前，他回想起天狼星的眼睛、天狼星的嘴巴，還有天狼星的微笑。“我對你癡迷。”

“Expecto Patronum!” He practically screamed it, extending his arm, directing his wand as an enormous silver animal burst forth, leaping towards Livia and Castor, huge jaws wide, claws bared. In the split second before he began to run, Remus saw them both cover their eyes, and turn to run in the opposite direction as the great beast lunged at them.
“Expecto Patronum！”他幾乎是在尖叫著施法，伸出手臂，指揮著魔杖，一隻巨大的銀色生物爆發出來，向 Livia 和 Castor 跳去，巨大的嘴巴張開，爪子豎起。在他開始奔跑的瞬間，Remus 看見他們兩人都遮住了眼睛，轉身逃向相反的方向，當那隻巨大的生物向他們撲去。

But there wasn’t time to stay and enjoy his success, so he didn’t. He ran again, for the edge of the woods; back to Hogsmeade, and the wizarding world, and his friends. Remus ran so hard that his legs were burning, and the pain in his hip was like a spear in his side, but he did not stop, lungs full of woodsmoke and eyes watering, he just kept going until the trees began to thin, and the light grew stronger.
但沒有時間停下來享受他的成功，所以他沒有。 他再次奔跑，朝向森林的邊緣；回到 Hogsmeade，回到魔法世界，回到他的朋友們身邊。Remus 跑得如此劇烈，以至於他的雙腿在燃燒，臀部的疼痛就像是刺在側邊的矛，但他沒有停下來，肺部充滿了樹木的煙霧，眼睛含淚，他只是繼續前進，直到樹木變得稀疏，光線變得更加明亮。

Peter and Sirius were still there. Sirius was pacing erratically back and forth on the footpath. Peter was sitting on the ground with his knees drawn up, staring at the woods. He looked as though he had been crying.
Peter 和 Sirius 仍然在那裡。Sirius 在人行道上來回踱步，神情焦躁。Peter 坐在地上，雙膝縮在胸前，盯著森林。他看起來像是哭過。

Remus staggered out into the daylight, and felt ready to collapse right there. Peter stood up, wiping his eyes in disbelief, and Sirius ran towards him, and then stopped, suddenly, and was knocked back, as though he’d hit a wall. Furious, he gave out an angry grunt. Remus allowed one of the knots inside him to unravel, and the barrier was lifted. He limped towards his two friends, wheezing.
Remus 搖搖晃晃地走入陽光下，感到隨時會倒下。Peter 站起來，難以置信地擦拭眼睛，Sirius 跑向他，然後突然停下，彷彿撞上了牆壁。憤怒地，他發出了一聲憤怒的哼聲。Remus 讓內心的結鬆解開，障礙被解除。他跛行向兩位朋友走去，喘息著。

“Sorry.” He murmured.
“對不起。”他低聲說道。

Much to his surprise, Sirius threw his arms around his neck, and held him tightly. His heartbeat thrummed against Remus’s, and he hugged him back, exhausted and grateful.
令他驚訝的是，Sirius 把手臂圍住他的脖子，緊緊抱住他。他的心跳與 Remus 的心跳互相碰撞，他也回擁著他，感到疲憊而感激。

“We couldn’t come and help.” Sirius said, his voice hoarse and hollow, “Whatever you did… we couldn’t follow you.”
“我們不能來幫忙。”Sirius 說道，聲音嘶啞而空洞，“無論你做了什麼……我們無法跟隨你。”

“I’m sorry.” Remus said, again.
“對不起。”Remus 再次說道。

“I’m so sorry, Remus!” Peter suddenly burst out, his eyes filling with tears again, “I’m so sorry!”
“對不起，Remus！”Peter 突然激動地說，他的眼睛再次充滿淚水，“對不起！”

“It’s ok.” Remus reached out an arm to pat his shoulder, but Sirius wouldn’t let him go yet. Finally, Remus came back to his senses, and gently untangled himself, “I have to see Dumbledore, right now. Where are the others?”
“沒關係。”Remus 伸出手臂拍了拍他的肩膀，但 Sirius 還不願意放開他。最終，Remus 恢復了理智，輕輕地脫身，“我現在必須去見鄧不利多。其他人在哪裡？”

“They had to go back,” Sirius explained, “Curfew. They said they’d tell McGonagall.”
“他們必須回去了，”Sirius 解釋道，“宿舍規定。他們說會告訴 McGonagall。”

“Good.” Remus nodded. “Come on, we have to go, now.” He began to hobble towards the village.
“好。”Remus 點了點頭。“我們得走了，現在。”他開始跛行著向村莊走去。

“Moony, are you ok?” Sirius hurried alongside him, an arm under his shoulder for support.
“Moony，你還好嗎？”Sirius 急忙跟在他身旁，伸手搭在他的肩膀上以示支持。

“Just tired,” Remus said.
“只是累了，”Remus 說道。

“You’re covered in… is that soot?”
“你滿身都是……那是煤灰嗎？”

“There was a fire…”
“有場火……”

“Wormtail said something was summoning you.”
“Wormtail 說有東西在召喚你。”

“I can’t… I can’t explain it, yet, please don’t ask me.”
“我不能……我還無法解釋，請不要問我。”

“Fine.” There was a cold edge to Sirius’s voice which Remus didn’t like, but he kept supporting him, and he kept going, so it would have to be ignored for now. One thing at a time.
“好。”Sirius 的聲音帶著冷漠，Remus 不喜歡，但他繼續支持他，繼續前行，所以現在只能忽略這一點。一件事情一次處理。

McGonagall was waiting for them at the school gates, her arms folded, deep lines creasing her forehead.
McGonagall 在學校的大門口等著他們，雙臂交叉，額頭上深深的皺紋刻畫出她的焦慮。

“Professor!” Remus spluttered, still coughing up smoke, “I’m sorry we missed the curfew, but I need to see the headmaster right--”
“教授！”Remus 喘息著說，還在咳嗽，“對不起我們錯過了宵禁，但我需要立刻去見校長——”

“Yes of course, Lupin, come with me.” McGonagall nodded, quickly, and took his arm from Sirius. She peered down at Sirius and Peter. “You two go to the tower and say nothing. I don’t want any arguments, do you hear me?”
“是的，當然，Lupin，跟我來。”McGonagall 點了點頭，迅速地將他的手臂從 Sirius 那裡取下。她看了一眼 Sirius 和 Peter。“你們兩個去塔樓，什麼也不要說。我不想聽到任何爭論，你們聽見了嗎？”

The two young men were so surprised by these sharp instructions that they both nodded and left, immediately, Sirius throwing one glance back at Remus.
這兩位年輕人對這些嚴厲的指示感到非常驚訝，於是他們立刻點頭離開了，Sirius 向 Remus 投去了一瞥。

He told Dumbledore almost everything. He told him about the scent, and the dryad, and Castor. About the fire, and the plans Greyback had for his pack, and Livia. He did not mention the barrier he had somehow conjured, to keep his friends back. Nor did he explain that he had known how dangerous it would be, or that he had ignored every ounce of good sense he had in order to pursue Castor.
他告訴了鄧不利多幾乎所有的事情。他告訴了他氣味、樹精和 Castor 的事情。還有火焰、Greyback 對他的狼群的計劃，以及 Livia。他沒有提到他不知怎麼地施放了屏障來阻止朋友們靠近，也沒有解釋他知道這將會有多麼危險，或者他無視了所有的理智來追捕 Castor。

Dumbledore seemed very pleased, nonetheless.
儘管如此，鄧不利多似乎非常滿意。

“Everything you have told me is immensely useful, Remus.” The old man said, smiling across his desk at Remus with eyes twinkling with pride, for the first time Remus could remember. “You were very brave, and fulfilled your task admirably.”
“你告訴我的一切都非常有用，Remus。”老人說道，對著 Remus 微笑，眼中閃爍著驕傲的光芒，是 Remus 記憶中的第一次。“你非常勇敢，完美地完成了你的任務。”

“I… I did? Even though I went in the forbidden forest?”
“我……我做到了？即使我進入了禁忌森林？”

“You followed your quarry. And I don’t see that any harm has come to you? You are clearly a formidable wizard, like your father.”
“你追蹤了你的獵物。我看不出你受到任何傷害？你顯然是一位強大的巫師，就像你的父親一樣。”

Remus felt a very small twinge of pleasure at that, which put him more at ease.
Remus 感到了一絲微小的滿足，這讓他感到更加放鬆。

“This attack, though… the hunt they’re planning--”
“但這次襲擊……他們計劃的狩獵——”

“Let the Order deal with that.” Dumbledore shook his head, placing his hands on his desk and rising to his feet. “You have done quite enough - more than anyone could expect of a seventeen year old wizard.”
“讓秘社來處理吧。”鄧不利多搖了搖頭，雙手放在桌子上，站了起來。“你已經做得夠多了——超出了任何人對一位十七歲巫師的期望。”

“Yes, but if I can--”
“是的，但如果我能——”

“I am sorry I asked this of you, Remus.” Dumbledore came around his desk and placed a friendly hand on his shoulder. “I hope I will not have to ask again.”
“對不起，我要求你這樣做，Remus。”鄧不利多繞過桌子，把友好的手放在他的肩膀上。“我希望我不必再要求你這樣做。”

“I’m on your side.” Remus replied, feeling he ought to reiterate this. “I’ll do what has to be done.”
“我在你這邊。”Remus 回答道，感覺應該重申這一點。“我會做必須做的事。”

Dumbledore’s eyes glittered with triumph, and his grip tightened on Remus’s shoulder.
鄧不利多的眼睛閃爍著勝利的光芒，他的手握緊了 Remus 的肩膀。

The fire had been put out by the naiads, according to McGonagall, who walked him from Dumbledore’s office to the infirmary. There had been no trace of Livia or Castor, and it was assumed they had apparated.
據 McGonagall 說，火已經被水精靈撲滅了，她將 Remus 從鄧不利多的辦公室帶到醫務室。沒有 Livia 或 Castor 的痕跡，大家猜測他們已經使用了瞬間移動。

Madam Pomfrey tutted over him, cleaned off the soot and administered a pain killing draught. By then he was breathing normally again, and perversely quite fancied a cigarette, though he didn’t tell her that. Food was brought to him there, because by this time he had missed dinner, and he ate a pleasant, quiet supper in Madam Pomfrey’s homely little office.
Pomfrey 女士對他嘆了口氣，清理了煤灰並給他服用了止痛藥水。那時，他已經正常呼吸了，儘管他沒有告訴她，但他異常地想抽根煙。食物被送到他那裡，因為到這時候他已經錯過了晚餐，他在 Pomfrey 女士溫馨的小辦公室裡吃了一頓愉快而安靜的晚餐。

Thankfully, he was permitted to walk back to Gryffindor tower alone. His friends were all waiting - not in their usual place by the fire, but in a quieter corner, near one of the far windows. They were all speaking in serious, hushed tones, and their heads turned at once to face him as he appeared through the portrait hole.
幸運的是，他被允許獨自回到格蘭芬多塔樓。他的朋友們都在等著他——不是在他們平常坐在火爐旁的地方，而是在一個較安靜的角落，靠近其中一扇遙遠的窗戶。他們都用嚴肅的低語聲說話，當他從畫像孔中出現時，他們的頭立刻轉向他。

He walked over, a bit woozy from the draught he’d taken, and they made room for him to sit in the window seat, squashed between Lily and Sirius, who quickly squeezed his hand, before letting go. They all stared at him, and waited for him to speak, so he did.
他走過去，有些暈眩，因為他服用了藥水，他們讓出空間讓他坐在窗邊的座位上，擠在 Lily 和 Sirius 之間，Sirius 迅速握了握他的手，然後放開了。他們都盯著他，等待他開口，他於是開始說話。

He told them as much as he could - and a few things he hadn’t said to Dumbledore. Peter had luckily already covered the dryad, and apparently the marauders had spent much of their evening explaining the animagus secret to Lily. Still, she covered her mouth in horror when Remus talked about encountering Castor, and Livia’s incredible powers, and the fire… Sirius was practically quaking with rage beside him, but held his tongue the whole time, and let Remus finish.
他告訴了他們他能說的盡可能多的事情——還有一些他沒有告訴鄧不利多的事情。幸運的是，Peter 已經涵蓋了樹精的部分，顯然，小強們大部分時間都在向 Lily 解釋 animagus 的秘密。即便如此，當 Remus 講述遇到 Castor、Livia 的驚人力量以及火焰時，她仍然驚恐地捂住了嘴……Sirius 在他身旁幾乎因憤怒而顫抖，但他整個過程中都保持沉默，讓 Remus 講完。

“Bloody hell.” James said, once the story was told. “Well done on the patronus, though, mate.”
“該死。”James 說道，故事講完後。“不過，你的守護神做得很好，伙計。”

“Thanks,” Remus blushed, slightly. Trust James to find something praiseworthy, in all of that.
“謝謝，”Remus 稍微臉紅了。相信 James 能在所有事情中找到值得稱讚的地方。

“Did you see what it was?”
“你看到那是什麼了嗎？”

“No.” he said, quickly, “It happened too fast.”
“沒有。”他迅速回答，“一切發生得太快了。”

 

Not long afterwards, they all trailed up to bed, one at a time, each of them with their faces set in a determined mask. Remus realised that he was not the only one who had had a very trying day. He took a quick shower, to get the last of the forest off him, and brushed his teeth without looking in the mirror, too afraid of what he might see there. Sirius still hadn’t tried to talk to him, or confront him about the terrible betrayal back at the forest edge, but Remus was certain this was yet to come, and though he knew it would be hard, he looked forward to clearing the air.
不久之後，他們一個接一個地上了床，每個人都帶著決心的面具。Remus 意識到自己不是唯一度過了艱難一天的人。他快速洗了個澡，將身上的森林氣味洗掉，然後刷牙時沒有看鏡子，太害怕看到那裡的景象。Sirius 仍然沒有嘗試與他交談，或對他在森林邊緣的可怕背叛進行對峙，但 Remus 確信這件事還未結束，雖然他知道這會很艱難，但他期待著澄清一切。

For hours, he lay in bed, waiting and hoping. Sirius always came to him, on a night like this; if something had happened. Sirius always knew when Remus needed to talk; even when Remus didn’t want to, Sirius could get it out of him, and make everything right again. Remus waited for a long time. Come on, he thought to himself, I need you, where are you?
幾個小時過去了，他躺在床上，等待和希望。像這樣的夜晚，Sirius 總會來找他；如果發生了什麼事。Sirius 總是知道 Remus 何時需要交談；即使 Remus 不想說，Sirius 也能把事情說出來，讓一切恢復正常。Remus 等了很久。快點，他在心裡想，我需要你，你在哪裡？

He ain’t a mind reader, sweetheart. Grant’s chirpy voice broke through once more.
他可不是讀心術的，親愛的。Grant 那輕快的聲音再次打破了沉默。

He knows me, though.
但他了解我。

Oh yeah? You ever told him?
哦，是嗎？你告訴過他嗎？

Remus declined to answer, because it was no longer necessary. Working through problems in your head using imaginary roleplay was all well and good. But that’s what he’d done when he’d felt most alone. When he thought he’d had no one else to turn to. He realised with a sickening sense of shame just how stupid he’d been. Without wasting another moment, he slid out of bed and crossed the floor. He parted Sirius’s bed curtains, and whispered into the darkness,
Remus 沒有回答，因為這已經不再必要。用幻想角色扮演的方式在腦海中解決問題雖然不錯，但這是他在感到最孤獨時做的事。當他認為自己沒有其他可以依靠的人時。他帶著噁心的羞愧感意識到自己有多愚蠢。沒有再浪費一刻鐘，他滑出床，穿過房間。他撥開 Sirius 的床簾，低聲在黑暗中說道，

“Sirius?”
“Sirius？”

“What?” Sirius was lying on his back, too, hands folded over his middle like a tombstone effigy. His coldness made Remus flinch, but he swallowed his pride.
“什麼？”Sirius 也躺在背上，雙手交叉在中間，像石碑上的雕像。他的冷漠讓 Remus 略感震驚，但他吞下了自尊。

“I need you.”
“我需要你。”

Sirius turned his head at once. He sighed and pulled back the covers.
Sirius 立刻轉過頭來。他嘆了口氣，拉開了被子。

“Get in.”
“進來吧。”

Remus scrambled inside, eagerly. They lay next to each other, on their sides, staring at each other.
Remus 迫不及待地爬進床裡。他們側躺在一起，對視著。

“Do you hate me?” Remus asked.
“你恨我嗎？”Remus 問道。

“No.” Sirius replied, voice still empty.
“沒有。”Sirius 回答，聲音仍然空洞。

“I’m really sorry. I wanted to protect you all.”
“我真的很抱歉。我想保護你們所有人。”

“I know. That’s what James said.” Sirius’s voice had melted slightly, and was now more petulant than angry.
“我知道。James 也是這麼說的。”Sirius 的聲音稍微變軟了，現在更像是發脾氣，而不是憤怒。

“But it’s no excuse,” Remus continued. “I just… I wasn’t myself. Do you understand?”
“但這不是借口，”Remus 繼續道。“我只……我不是我自己。你明白嗎？”

Sirius shrugged, moving the bed sheets so that they slid off his shoulder, exposing his collar bone. Remus tried not to get too distracted by that, and licked his lips, meeting Sirius’s eye again.
Sirius 聳了聳肩，讓床單滑落，露出了他的鎖骨。Remus 試著不被這個分心，舔了舔嘴唇，再次與 Sirius 眼神對上。

“I’ll tell you everything.” He said.
“我會告訴你一切。”他說。

“You told us.” Sirius replied, tetchily.
“你告訴過我們。”Sirius 不耐煩地回答道。

“Not everything.” Remus replied, “There are things I don’t want everyone to know about. But. I want you to know. If that’s ok?”
“不是所有的事。”Remus 回答道，“有些事我不希望大家知道。但。我希望你知道。如果可以的話？”

Sirius stared at him as if he couldn’t believe his ears. A small smile was creeping onto his face, and he was obviously trying to suppress it.
Sirius 盯著他，好像不敢相信自己的耳朵。臉上出現了一絲微笑，顯然他在努力抑制它。

“Go on, then.”
“那麼，繼續說吧。”

So he did. He told him every feeling he had had - the irresistible pull into the forest, the rugged power of natural magic, the terrible guilt. By the time he had stopped speaking, he realised that Sirius had reached out to him, and was stroking his arm, gently, back and forth to comfort him.
所以他這麼做了。他告訴他自己所有的感受——被森林的不可抗拒的吸引、自然魔法的強大力量、那種可怕的內疚。當他停止說話時，他意識到 Sirius 已經伸出手來，輕輕地撫摸他的手臂，來安慰他。

“What made you think of casting a patronus?”
“什麼讓你想到施放守護神？”

Remus snorted, lightly,
Remus 輕輕哼了一聲，

“It’s stupid. Voice in my head.”
“這很蠢。腦海中的聲音。”

“Ah.”
“啊。”

“Not like the normal voices, though. Usually it’s someone I know.”
“不是像普通的聲音那樣。通常是我認識的人。”

“Maybe this time it was just you.”
“也許這次只是你自己。”

Remus thought about this. It made him feel funny. Sirius was still watching him, still stroking his arm. Remus remembered something else.
Remus 思考了一下。這讓他感覺很奇怪。Sirius 仍在看著他，仍在撫摸他的手臂。Remus 想起了其他的事情。

“It’s a wolf. My patronus. I didn’t want the others to know, I don’t want them to think…”
“那是一隻狼。我 的守護神。我不希望其他人知道，我不希望他們認為……”

“They’d never think badly of you, Moony, they know you too well.”
“他們永遠不會對你有壞印象，Moony，他們太了解你了。”

“Do they, though? After today… I just feel so stupid. I got so caught up, I didn’t know what to do. I just kept getting in deeper and deeper.”
“他們真的了解嗎？今天之後……我感到自己太愚蠢了。我被困在裡面，不知道該怎麼辦。我只是越陷越深。”

“But you did the right thing, in the end.” Sirius said, firmly, gripping him now, “That’s all that matters.” He leaned forward and kissed Remus gently on the lips, a calming gesture. “You came back to us.”
“但最終你做了對的事。”Sirius 堅定地說，現在緊緊握住他，“這才是最重要的。”他向前傾身，輕輕地吻了 Remus 的嘴唇，一個安撫的舉動。“你回到我們身邊了。”

“I…” Remus looked down, lowering his voice to barely a whisper. He looked up at Sirius again, meeting those perfect blue eyes. “I came back to you.”
“我……”Remus 低下頭，將聲音降到幾乎聽不見的低語。他再次抬頭看著 Sirius，對上那完美的藍眼睛。“我回到了你身邊。”

Sirius kissed him again, harder, and did not stop for a long time.

“我什麼時候忘記過吃飯？”Remus 吐了吐舌頭。“不管怎樣，我得去上課了——歷史。午餐時見！”

1:50 PM

In spite of his promises, Remus was extremely late for lunch, and had missed everyone except Sirius, who had waited back.
儘管他做出了保證，Remus 還是非常晚到午餐，錯過了除了 Sirius 以外的所有人，Sirius 等他留下來了。

“Sorry!” Remus gasped as he reached the table, a little breathless from running. He sat down, “Stayed back to talk to Kettleburn, then remembered I’d forgotten my notes in Professor Binns’ room. History was a bloody waste, too, all stuff I’ve covered in the reading--oh, thank you!”
“對不起！”Remus 一邊喘著氣，一邊跑到桌邊坐下，“留在後面和 Kettleburn 談話，然後才想起來我把筆記忘在 Binns 教授的房間了。歷史課也浪費了，都是我在閱讀中已經學過的內容——哦，謝謝你！”

Sirius had pushed a plate of sausage and mash across the table to him. Remus dug in, eating and talking as quickly as he could - they only had ten minutes before lunch was over and the school choir would want the Hall for their weekly practice sessions. “Anyway, it worked out nicely in the end, I used the time to write my letter to Ferox and a note for Grant, so at least that’s done -- what’s that?”
Sirius 把一盤香腸和土豆泥推到桌子那邊。Remus 開始吃，盡快吃完並說話——他們只有十分鐘，然後午餐就結束了，學校合唱團要使用餐廳進行每週的練習。“不過，最後還算順利，我用時間寫了給 Ferox 的信和 Grant 的便條，至少這些都完成了——那是什麼？”

Sirius had slid a stack of parchment across the table now. Remus drained his glass of pumpkin juice and looked down at it. “Arithmancy?”
Sirius 現在把一疊羊皮紙滑到桌子上。Remus 喝光了南瓜汁，低頭看著它。“數術學？”

“Your essay,” Sirius said, casually, “Finished mine, like a good boy, so I thought I’d do yours too.”
“你的作文，”Sirius 隨意地說，“我把自己的寫完了，像個好孩子一樣，所以我想我也幫你做了。”

“You what?” Remus did a double take. Sirius was ridiculously good with a quill, and had mimicked his own spidery handwriting perfectly. “I don’t believe you!”
“你什麼？”Remus 驚訝地看了兩眼。Sirius 實在太擅長使用羽毛筆了，還完美地模仿了他的蜘蛛般的筆跡。“我不相信！”

“How many times have you done it for Wormy? Or James, for that matter - he’s still got a stick up his arse about this morning, by the way, won’t talk to me about it - anyway, now that’s done, and the letters, you’re free for the afternoon!”
“你幫 Wormy 做過多少次？或者 James，說實話，他對今早的事還有點介意，順便說一下，他不願意和我談論這個——總之，這些都完成了，信件也處理好了，你下午就空閒了！”

“Thanks so much, Padfoot, honestly, this is brilliant… but I did promise to see Christopher, and--”
“真的非常感謝你，Padfoot，說實話，這太棒了……但我確實承諾了要見 Christopher，還有——”

“Nope.” Sirius was grinning like the cat who’d got the cream. “Just saw him. Told him you weren’t well, so you couldn’t see him.”
“不行。”Sirius 像偷到奶油的貓一樣露出了笑容。“剛才見過他了。我告訴他你身體不舒服，所以你不能見他。”

“Sirius!”
“Sirius！”

“Well you’re not well.” Sirius responded, innocently. “What with tonight, you ought to be resting.”
“你不舒服。”Sirius 無辜地回答。“考慮到今晚的事，你應該休息。”

“I’ll be fine once I’ve eaten.” Remus replied shortly, eyes on his food, mopping up the last of the gravy with his mashed potato. He’d lick the plate if he was shameless enough; full moons made him ravenous. When he’d finished, he looked up and found Sirius staring at him, big eyes full of puppy-ish remorse.
“吃完我會好的。”Remus 簡短地回答，眼睛盯著他的食物，用土豆泥擦拭盤子上的最後一點肉汁。如果他夠無恥，他會舔盤子的；滿月使他感到飢餓。當他吃完後，他抬起頭發現 Sirius 盯著他，眼中充滿了小狗般的悔意。

“Angry with me?”
“生我的氣嗎？”

“No.” Remus wiped his mouth with his sleeve and pushed his plate away in time for it to vanish back down to the kitchens. “But you can’t re-organise my life like that just to get your own way...”
“沒有。”Remus 用袖子擦了擦嘴，把盤子推開，正好讓它消失回到廚房。“但你不能只是為了達到自己的目的而重新安排我的生活……”

“I didn’t mean it like that!” Sirius sat up, looking shocked, “I just… you always have so much on, and it’s insane. I mean, it’s amazing, because you’re amazing, and you can handle it, but you don’t have to.”
“我不是這個意思！”Sirius 坐起來，看起來很震驚，“我只是……你總是有這麼多事要做，這簡直瘋狂。我的意思是，這很了不起，因為你很了不起，你能處理得了，但你不必如此。”

“Ok…” Remus frowned, getting up. He wasn’t sure exactly what Sirius was saying. He had always tried to keep busy. He liked being busy, and useful to people.
“好……”Remus 皺了皺眉，站了起來。他不確定 Sirius 到底在說什麼。他一直嘗試保持忙碌。他喜歡忙碌，並對他人有用。

“And you’d written so many notes for that essay it practically wrote itself.” Sirius continued, as they left the Great Hall and began to head for Gryffindor tower. “And we can go and find Christopher if you want, he’s probably in the library…”
“而且你為那篇作文寫了那麼多筆記，幾乎自己就寫完了。”Sirius 繼續說道，他們離開了大禮堂，開始向 Gryffindor 塔前進。“如果你願意，我們可以去找 Christopher，他可能在圖書館……”

“Sirius…” Remus sighed, fondly.
“Sirius……”Remus 親切地嘆了口氣。

“Go on, I’ll post the letters for you, and I’ll see you for early dinner -”
“繼續吧，我會幫你寄信，然後見面吃早晚餐——”

“Sirius...” He checked the coast was clear - everyone was in lessons, and Peeves wasn’t about. An empty corridor was a rare thing at Hogwarts.
“Sirius……”他查看了一下情況是否安全——每個人都在上課，Peeves 不在附近。霍格華茲裡空蕩蕩的走廊是稀有的景象。

“Oh bugger!” Sirius slapped his forehead, “I can’t do early dinner, I’ve got that detention with Filch. Only for an hour though, I’ll be out in time for--”
“哦，該死！”Sirius 拍了拍額頭，“我不能吃早晚餐，我有那個與 Filch 的留堂。只是一個小時而已，我會及時出來——”

“Sirius!”
“Sirius！”

“What?!” He finally stopped talking in time for Remus to catch him unawares with a quick kiss on the lips.
“什麼？！”他終於停下了話語，正好讓 Remus 用一個快速的吻讓他感到驚訝。

“Shut up, you idiot.” He smiled, “I’d much rather spend the afternoon with you than studying with Christopher.”
“閉嘴，你這個傻瓜。”他微笑道，“我更願意和你一起度過下午，而不是和 Christopher 一起學習。”

“Oh.” Sirius blushed, looking very pleased.
“哦。”Sirius 臉紅了，看起來非常高興。

2:15 PM

Less than twenty minutes later, and Remus was completely blissed out, lying on his back with the record player at his feet and Sirius’s head resting against his good hip. Bowie was singing and strumming his eight string, and the two boys listening were sharing a spliff Sirius had charmed off a Ravenclaw earlier that week.
不到二十分鐘後，Remus 完全陶醉地躺在床上，腳邊是唱片機，Sirius 的頭靠在他的好髋上。Bowie 正在彈奏他的八弦吉他，兩個男孩正在分享一根 Sirius 這周早些時候從 Ravenclaw 那裡偷來的煙卷。

“Does the wolf get stoned too?” Sirius asked, reaching up for his turn. Remus shook his head, inhaling deeply and passing the joint.
“狼也會被嗨到嗎？”Sirius 問道，伸手拿到他的煙卷。Remus 搖了搖頭，深深地吸了一口，然後把煙卷遞給他。

“Hungrier, probably.” He replied, voice high.
“可能會更餓。”他回答，聲音有些尖。

“Hmm.” Sirius murmured.
“嗯。”Sirius 低聲說道。

Remus exhaled and closed his eyes, settling back on the pile of cushions. It was like sinking into warm treacle. He let his thoughts drift.
Remus 吐了口氣，閉上眼睛，靠在一堆墊子上。這就像沉入溫暖的糖漿中。他讓自己的思緒漂浮。

“Can I ask you something?” He mumbled,
“我能問你點事嗎？”他喃喃自語。

“Fire away, Moony.”
“隨便問，Moony。”

“What was Mary on about, this morning?”
“Mary 今早在說什麼？”

“About the Hufflepuff keeper’s stamina? I think she was blagging, to be honest with you.”
“關於 Hufflepuff 守門員的耐力？說實話，我覺得她在吹牛。”

“Not that,” Remus chuckled, “The bleeding thing… bleeding from her… um… What did she mean?”
“不是那個，”Remus 笑了笑，“那個流血的事……她的流血……嗯……她的意思是什麼？”

Sirius swivelled his head in Remus’s lap to look up at him, wearing a bemused frown.
Sirius 把頭轉到 Remus 的膝蓋上看著他，臉上帶著困惑的皺眉。

“She was talking about… you know, her ‘time of the month’…” He raised his eyebrows, as if Remus was supposed to catch on somehow.
“她在說……你知道的，她的‘月經期’……”他抬起眉毛，好像 Remus 應該知道一樣。

“What’s that?” Remus frowned back, none the wiser.
“那是什麼？”Remus 皺了皺眉，不明白。

“Re mus… seriously?!”
“Remus……真的嗎？！”

“What??”
“什麼？”

“You know! Girls are different from boys…”
“你知道的！女孩和男孩不一樣……”

“Well I know that.” Remus bristled, feeling defensive now.
“我知道這一點。”Remus 生氣地回答，感到有些防禦。

“Ok, so girls get this thing every month…” Sirius began to explain. Remus was utterly horrified, by the time he’d finished.
“好吧，女孩每個月都有這個……”，Sirius 開始解釋。Remus 在他解釋完後完全感到震驚。

“That’s the most disgusting thing I’ve ever heard.” He said, flatly.
“那是我聽過的最噁心的事情。”他平淡地說。

“It’s natural.” Sirius shrugged, “I’ll get Lily to explain it to you, I probably told it wrong. Bloody hell, you’re nearly eighteen, how did you not know?!”
“這是自然的。”Sirius 聳了聳肩，“我會讓 Lily 解釋給你聽，我可能講錯了。天啊，你快十八歲了，怎麼會不知道？！”

“Oh yeah, make fun of the Care Home kid.” Remus tutted, “I grew up in a boys’ reformatory! How am I supposed to know anything about girls?!”
“哦，是的，嘲笑那個孤兒院的孩子。”Remus 嘖了一聲，“我在男子教養院長大！我怎麼會知道任何關於女孩的事？！”

“Explains a lot.” Sirius said, dryly. Remus flicked his ear, sharply. “Ow!”
“說明了很多。”Sirius 乾燥地說。Remus 俏皮地彈了彈他的耳朵。“哎呀！”

“What’s your detention for, anyway?” Remus asked, settling back again.
“你留堂是因為什麼？”Remus 問道，重新躺好。

“Hexed Crouch.”
“下了詛咒的 Crouch。”

“Oh right.”
“哦，對了。”

“Him and my darling brother were tormenting some second years - but obviously he got out of it because he’s a prefect.” Sirius muttered, darkly.
“他和我那可愛的哥哥折磨一些二年級學生——但顯然他逃過了，因為他是級長。”Sirius 黯淡地嘀咕道。

He never said Regulus’s name any more, just ‘my darling brother’, in that cruel, overly plummy accent, which Remus thought was probably to make fun of Regulus’s posh-ness. Except (and Remus would never say this out loud) for the first few years Remus had known Sirius, he’d had exactly the same clipped received enunciation.
他再也不說 Regulus 的名字，只用‘我那可愛的哥哥’，用那種殘酷而過於上流的口音，Remus 認為這可能是在嘲笑 Regulus 的上流氣質。除了（而 Remus 永遠不會大聲說出來）Remus 認識 Sirius 的頭幾年，他也有完全一樣的生硬語調。

“Ought to try and ignore them, if you can.” Remus advised. “I know he bothers you, but it’s better to just stay out of his way. School’s over, soon.”
“如果可以的話，應該試著忽略他們。”Remus 建議道。“我知道他打擾你，但最好還是避開他。學校很快就結束了。”

“I know.” Sirius said, hogging the spliff.
“我知道。”Sirius 說，霸佔著煙卷。

Remus reached for it, snatching his wrist. God, he loved Sirius’s wrists. The bones were so fine, the veins like blue ribbon under translucent skin. His own fingers wrapped all the way around easily. He held it now, and pulled Sirius’s hand to his mouth, sucking the end of the joint, then letting him go.
Remus 伸手去拿它，抓住了他的手腕。天啊，他愛 Sirius 的手腕。骨頭如此纖細，靜脈在半透明的皮膚下像藍絲帶。他的手指輕鬆地包圍了它。他現在握著它，把 Sirius 的手拉到嘴邊，吸了一口煙，然後放開他。

Sirius just smirked up at him. The record stopped, and he had to get up to flip it to the b-side.
Sirius 只是對他咧嘴一笑。唱片停止了，他得起身把唱片翻到另一面。

“I s’pose I just don’t want him to hurt anyone.” He sighed, settling back down.
“我想我只是希望他不要傷害任何人。”他嘆了口氣，重新躺下。

“That’s not your job.” Remus frowned.
“那不是你的工作。”Remus 皺了皺眉。

“Feels like it.” Sirius muttered, stretching. “You don’t know what he was like when we were kids. He wasn’t… he’s not… I dunno. I just don’t want him to do something he’ll regret, later on.”
“感覺就是這樣。”Sirius 嘀咕道，伸展身體。“你不知道他小時候是什麼樣的。他當時不是……他現在不是……我不知道。我只是不想他做出他以後會後悔的事。”

Remus thought very hard - which was no mean feat, after a few lung fulls of Ravenclaw-grown hash.
Remus 仔細思考——這可不容易，在吸過幾口 Ravenclaw 出產的哈希後。

“Tell you something?” He asked.
“告訴你一件事？”他問道。

“A secret?” Sirius replied, eagerly, getting up to sit beside him.
“秘密？”Sirius 熱切地回答，起身坐到他旁邊。

“Er… sort of? But it’s about Regulus. You might not want to hear it.”
“呃……算是吧？但這是關於 Regulus 的。你可能不想聽。”

Sirius went a bit quiet; a bit more rigid, but he nodded,
Sirius 有點靜默了；有點僵硬，但他點了點頭，

“Go on.”
“說吧。”

“Remember the boggart that got me and Chris, before Christmas?”
“記得聖誕節前那隻嚇到我和 Chris 的 Boggart 嗎？”

“How could I forget?” Sirius replied, a note of jealousy in his voice, “Wish I’d been there, never seen a boggart.”
“我怎麼會忘？”，Sirius 回答，語氣中帶有一絲嫉妒，“希望我當時也在，從未見過 Boggart。”

“Werewolves not exciting enough for you now?” Remus raised his eyebrows. “Anyway, er… I checked the map, right after Chris went to get someone, and… well I’m pretty sure it was Regulus who put the boggart there. He and Barty were nearby.”
“狼人現在對你不夠刺激了嗎？”Remus 揚起眉毛。“無論如何，呃……Chris 去找人後，我檢查了地圖，嗯，我很確定是 Regulus 放了那隻 Boggart。他和 Barty 在附近。”

Remus craned his neck slightly, so he could see Sirius’s face, and how he was taking the news. His mouth was a straight line. He looked more tired than angry. He shook his head.
Remus 稍微伸長脖子，好讓他能看到 Sirius 的臉，以及他對這個消息的反應。他的嘴巴是一條直線。他看起來更疲倦而非憤怒。他搖了搖頭。

“Stupid prick.” He muttered. “It’s all her, you know. He’s an idiot for wanting to please her, obviously, but it’s all her fault, anyway.”
“愚蠢的傻瓜。”他嘀咕道。“都是她的錯，你知道的。他想取悅她顯然是個傻瓜，但不管怎樣，都是她的錯。”

“Your mother?”
“你說的是你母親？”

Sirius nodded. Remus didn’t know what to say. They had agreed, long ago - they could talk about anything but mothers. And that’s the way it had been, on Sirius’s side, anyway. Remus didn’t want to go into it now, either. Everything was so nice, and warm, and if they could just hang onto it a bit longer, then this would be such a good memory, something he would have inside him forever.
Sirius 點了點頭。Remus 不知道該說什麼。他們很久以前就達成過協議——他們可以談論任何事，但不要談論母親。這在 Sirius 那邊一直是這樣。Remus 現在也不想深入討論。所有的一切都如此美好和溫暖，如果他們能再保持一會兒，那麼這將是一個美好的回憶，是他永遠會珍藏在心中的東西。

He reached over and stroked Sirius’s cheek, that perfect, perfect jawline. He sat up, and shifted around to face him.
他伸手撫摸 Sirius 的臉頰，那完美的下巴輪廓。他坐起來，轉身面對他。

“Let’s forget about all that shit.” He said, “It’s boring.”
“我們就忘掉那些爛事吧。”他說，“那很無聊。”

Sirius kissed him.
Sirius 吻了他。

 

4:00PM

Remus walked down alone for dinner at four, as Sirius left for his detention. It was so early that Remus was the only one there, except for Marlene, who was also attending Madam Pomfrey’s healing class.
Remus 獨自下樓去四點的晚餐，因為 Sirius 去了留堂。那麼早，除了 Marlene，也在參加 Madam Pomfrey 的療癒課程，Remus 是唯一的人。

“I’m glad you’re coming,” she beamed at him. Marlene smiled a lot these days. “I haven’t seen you properly since Christmas!”
“我很高興你來了，”她對他笑著。Marlene 最近經常微笑。“自從聖誕節以來我還沒好好見過你呢！”

“Yeah, sorry!” Remus replied, beginning his second helping of lasagne, twice as big as the first, “Been so busy with NEWTs stuff…”
“是啊，對不起！”Remus 回答道，開始吃第二份比第一份大的千層麵，“最近忙得要命，都是關於 NEWTs 的事……”

“I really wanted to talk to you about what happened on the train…”
“我真的想跟你聊聊火車上的事……”

“Oh! … er…” Remus stared at her, fork halfway to his mouth. With all of the fuss about Castor and the full moon, Remus had been able to avoid talking about their strange meeting with Yasmin and Marlene on the train. He felt guilty again. Obviously Marlene had been thinking about it a lot.
“哦！……呃……”Remus 盯著她，叉子還在嘴邊。由於 Castor 和滿月的混亂，Remus 已經避免談論他們在火車上和 Yasmin 及 Marlene 的奇怪遇見。他再次感到內疚。顯然 Marlene 一直在想這件事。

“Hang on,” Marlene was saying, reaching for her wand, “ Muffliato !” She murmured.
“等一下，”Marlene 說，伸手拿出她的魔杖，“Muffliato！”她低聲念道。

The noise in the hall around them seemed to deaden, slightly.
他們周圍的走廊聲音似乎稍微變得沉寂。

“What was that?” He asked, keeping his voice low.
“那是什麼？”他問道，保持低聲。

“Stops people listening in.” Marlene explained, “Lily taught it to us. Mary uses it to gossip all the time in Charms.”
“阻止別人偷聽。”Marlene 解釋道，“Lily 教我們的。Mary 在魅力課上總是用它來八卦。”

“Wow,” Remus nodded, appreciatively.
“哇，”Remus 感激地點了點頭。

“So, anyway,” Marlene leaned forward on her elbows, eyes bright, “You and Sirius! Does anyone know?!”
“所以，”Marlene 支著胳膊，眼睛明亮地向前傾，“你和 Sirius！有人知道嗎？！”

“Oh!” Remus finally set down his knife and fork, though he could have happily kept going. “Yeah, actually. James and Peter, Lily too.”
“哦！”Remus 最終放下了刀叉，雖然他本來可以繼續吃。“嗯，實際上知道的有。James 和 Peter，還有 Lily。”

“Really?!”
“真的嗎？！”

“Yeah.” He nodded, checking that there was definitely nobody listening. “Only recently, though. What about you and Yaz?”
“是的。”他點了點頭，確認確實沒有人偷聽。“不過只有最近的事。那你和 Yaz 呢？”

“No one.” She said, firmly.
“沒有人。”她堅定地說。

“Not even Mary?”
“連 Mary 都不知道？”

“Least of all her!” Marlene said, ruefully. Remus decided not to enquire further. He’d had enough revelations concerning Mary for one day.
“最不應該是她！”Marlene 遺憾地說。Remus 決定不再詢問。他一天中已經聽到足夠關於 Mary 的揭露了。

“Has it been going on long? You two?” He asked. “I had no idea…”
“你們在一起有多久了？”他問道。“我完全不知道……”

“Sorry,” Marlene blushed, looking down, “I’ve known I was… different, I suppose, for a long time now, and I really wanted to say something to you, especially after the summer, but… I dunno, how do you bring it up?”
“對不起，”Marlene 臉紅著低頭，“我覺得自己……不同，已經有很長時間了，我真的想跟你說點什麼，尤其是夏天之後，但……我不知道，怎麼說呢？”

“Tell me about it.” Remus agreed, eagerly.
“告訴我吧。”Remus 熱切地說。

“Yaz has been my girlfriend since just before Christmas. She’s incredible.” Marlene was smiling again, and Remus could practically feel the joy radiating from her. He touched her hand, gently,
“Yaz 自聖誕節前不久就成為了我的女朋友。她真是太棒了。”Marlene 又笑了起來，Remus 幾乎能感受到她散發出的快樂。他輕輕地觸摸她的手，

“I’m really happy for you.”
“我真的為你感到高興。”

“Thanks.” She squeezed his hand back. “But what about you?! More to the point, what about Sirius ?!”
“謝謝。”她回握他的手。“但你呢？！更重要的是，Sirius 呢？！”

“What about him?”
“他怎麼了？”

“I’m just flabbergasted, really. Is he fully queer, or more AC-DC?”
“我真的很震驚。他是完全的同性戀，還是更偏向於雙性戀？”

“Um… you know, I haven’t asked. We don’t really talk about that sort of thing.”
“嗯……你知道，我沒問過。我們不太談論這種事。”

“You don’t?” She gave him an odd, sideways glance. “Doesn’t it bother you? His history with girls?”
“你不問？”她給了他一個奇怪的側目。“這不會打擾你嗎？他和女孩的歷史？”

“No.” Remus felt himself growing hot under the collar. This was exactly the sort of thing he wanted to avoid discussing. With anyone. “It’s not relevant.”
“不了。”Remus 感到脖子下方有點發熱。這正是他想要避免討論的事。對任何人。“這不重要。”

“Ok,” Marlene shrugged, though she looked unconvinced. “If it works, I suppose.”
“好吧，”Marlene 聳了聳肩，雖然她看起來不太相信。“如果有效的話，我想。”

He didn’t respond to that, and eventually the Muffliato spell wore off and they finished eating, before making their way to their healing class at 4.30.
他沒有回應這一點，最終 Muffliato 的魔咒消失了，他們吃完了，然後一起前往他們的療癒課程，四點半。

Marlene was planning to tell Mary, she said, when the time was right. Remus knew that argument well enough, and didn’t think it was really his place to offer advice. It was nice to know that someone else knew how he felt, at least - even just a little bit.
Marlene 說，她打算在合適的時候告訴 Mary。Remus 對這個說法很熟悉，並不覺得自己有資格提供建議。知道還有其他人知道他的感受，至少有點安慰。

The healing class passed very slowly. Remus found that he was still pretty stoned, plus quite full, which made him sleepy. He tried to listen to Madam Pomfrey’s lecture on circulatory diagnostic spells, but his mind kept wandering, drifting back to his bed, and Sirius. The kindly nurse assumed he was just out of it because the moon was close, and didn’t chastise him as she usually might - he ought to have felt bad about that, but he was too happy daydreaming to worry too much.
療癒課程過得非常緩慢。Remus 發現自己仍然有點嗨，加上吃得很飽，讓他感到困倦。他試著聽 Madam Pomfrey 關於循環診斷咒語的講座，但他的思緒不斷漂浮，回到他的床上和 Sirius 身邊。那位和藹的護士以為他只是因為月亮快來了才這樣，沒有像平時那樣責備他——他應該為此感到內疚，但他太開心做白日夢了，無法太過擔心。

6:30 PM

Remus hung back in the hospital wing and sat quietly in Madam Pomfrey’s office while she tidied a few things away, before the pair of them made their journey down to the Shack together. There would only be four more full moons at Hogwarts, after this one, Remus realised. He knew he would miss Poppy Pomfrey more than he could ever tell her. She would always be the first person who had ever tried to make him comfortable; the first person who ever thought they could help.
Remus 在醫療翼等了會兒，靜靜地坐在 Madam Pomfrey 的辦公室裡，她整理了一些東西，然後他們一起下到小屋。Remus 意識到，除了這次，霍格華茲只剩下四個滿月。他知道自己會非常想念 Poppy Pomfrey，超過他能告訴她的程度。她將永遠是第一個試圖讓他感到舒適的人；第一個認為自己能夠幫助他的人。

She bid him goodbye, and promised to return first thing in the morning, as always. He put on the same brave face he’d used when he was eleven, and waved to her cheerily from the bed as she closed the door. Alone, Remus stared at the floor for a bit, trying to recall his afternoon, and suppress the growing dread in the pit of his stomach. He got up and paced a bit, for something to do.
她向他道別，並承諾像往常一樣一大早就回來。他露出他十一歲時用過的勇敢面孔，當她關上門時，從床上愉快地揮手告別。獨自一人，Remus 盯著地板一會兒，試著回憶他的下午，並壓抑胃裡逐漸增長的恐懼。他起身走動了一會兒，找點事做。

In time, the door creaked open once more, and James poked his head around the corner. He glanced around the room, before entering, looking just as awkward as he had that morning.
過了一會兒，門再次發出吱吱聲，James 探出頭來。他瞥了一眼房間，然後進了來，看起來和早上一樣尷尬。

“Hiya, Moony,” he said, pushing his glasses up his nose nervously as he entered, “No Wormtail yet?”
“嗨，Moony，”他進來時緊張地推了推眼鏡，“Wormtail 還沒來嗎？”

“I think he had lines to do for McGonagall.” Remus said, sitting on the bed again.
“我想他有要給 McGonagall 寫的台詞。”Remus 說，重新坐到床上。

“Right-o.” James nodded. He stood leaning against the wall.
“好的。”James 點了點頭。他站在牆邊。

They were completely silent for a good three minutes. Remus tried not to fidget, but the quiet was pretty unbearable - he and James had never been awkward before. Even after Remus came out, he was the first to swear that nothing had changed. But of course, now something really had changed; something which had shifted and skewed the dynamic. James was generally good at rolling with the punches, but it seemed he had a real blind spot when it came to Sirius Black.
他們完全沉默了三分鐘。Remus 試著不去擺弄，但靜默非常難忍——他和 James 從未有過尷尬。即使在 Remus 出櫃之後，他也第一個發誓說一切沒有改變。但當然，現在真的改變了；一些東西改變了，扭曲了動態。James 一般很擅長應對變化，但看來他對 Sirius Black 確實有一個盲點。

“Lily wants to be an animagus, now.” James said, suddenly, clearly trying to crack the tension.
“Lily 現在想成為 Animagus。”James 突然說道，顯然試圖打破僵局。

“Of course she does,” Remus smiled fondly, “Bet she masters it in half the time you lot took.”
“當然，”Remus 懷著親切的微笑說，“我打賭她能在你們花費的一半時間內掌握。”

“You’re not wrong.” James laughed, appreciatively.
“你說得對。”James 笑著，感激地說。

But that only hit a dead end, and silence invaded the space between them once more. Remus swallowed, and watched James, who was looking at his feet. He had just made up his mind to speak - to make some joke, or ask about quidditch, when James looked up, suddenly, catching his eye.
但這僅僅是死胡同，沉默再次侵入他們之間的空間。Remus 吞了吞口水，觀察著看著自己腳的 James。他剛決定要開口——說個笑話，或問問魁地奇，當 James 突然抬頭，與他的目光相遇。

“ Look-Moony-I’m-really-sorry-about-this-morning .” He said, all in a rush, as if he’d been holding his breath. Remus blinked.
“Moony，我真的很抱歉今天早上。”他匆忙地說，就像一直憋著氣一樣。Remus 眨了眨眼。

“ You’re sorry?!
“你道歉？！”

“Yeah, I should have realised… you know, you two are. Um. Together. Going out. Whatever - I shouldn’t have been so surprised…”
“是的，我應該意識到……你們倆。嗯。一起。交往。無論如何——我不應該這麼驚訝……”

“It’s ok, Prongs.” Remus said, kindly, “ I’m sorry - we’ve been trying not to rub in in your face too much, and I swear nothing was happening this morning, I just sleep there sometimes.”
“沒關係，Prongs。”Remus 和藹地說，“對不起——我們一直在試著不讓你太尷尬，我發誓今天早上什麼也沒發生，我只是有時候會睡在那裡。”

“See, that’s what I mean; you shouldn’t have to sneak around!” James burst out, “Really, it’s not a problem! You should sleep where you want to sleep.”
“你看，我的意思是；你不應該偷偷摸摸的！”James 突然說，“真的，這沒問題！你應該在你想睡的地方睡。”

“Oh… ok, thank you.” Remus nodded.
“哦……好的，謝謝。”Remus 點了點頭。

“I don’t want things to be weird.” James said, helplessly.
“我不想事情變得尷尬。”James 無奈地說。

“Me neither!” Remus insisted. “That’s the last thing I want - Sirius too. I just wanted to keep a low profile because… well he’s your best friend, and him and me seeing each other doesn’t mean…”
“我也不想！”Remus 堅持道。“那是我最不想要的——Sirius 也是。我只是想保持低調，因為……他是你最好的朋友，他和我見面並不意味著……”

“I never thought it did!” James said, hurriedly. He had crossed the room now, his inherent good nature taking over as he sat down next to Remus on the bed, “And you’re my best friend too, Remus.”
“我從未認為會有！”James 匆忙說道。他現在已經走過了房間，他天生的好性格占了上風，坐在 Remus 床邊，“而且你也是我的最好朋友，Remus。”

Remus looked down at his hands, shyly.
Remus 羞怯地低頭看著自己的手。

“Christ, Potter,” he grinned, “Why’d you always have to be so perfect?”
“天哪，Potter，”他笑著說，“為什麼你總是那麼完美？”

“Born that way.” James shrugged, mirroring Remus’s grin. “Come here, tosser.” He pulled him in for a hug. Remus relaxed, finally. All was well.
“天生如此。”James 聳了聳肩，模仿著 Remus 的微笑。“過來，笨蛋。”他擁抱了 Remus。Remus 終於放鬆了。一切都很好。

At that moment, the door swung open once more, and Sirius sauntered into the room, closely followed by Peter.
就在這時，門再次打開，Sirius 悠閒地走進房間，身後跟著 Peter。

“Oi!” Sirius barked, pointing at James, “Hands off my man.”
“喂！”Sirius 吼道，指著 James，“別碰我的男人。”
