还有一些更新——大家想知道Dumbledore在忙什么，取得了什么进展。具体进展是什么，Remus不知道。还分配了任务——Frank和Alice下周每晚6点必须在Anglesey。一个叫Shacklebolt的男人周五要去见“我们的共同朋友”，“你知道在哪里”。Prewett双胞胎负责守卫这个地点或那个地点。大家在Moody点名时都点头表示同意。

Finally, Moody called an end to the discussion.
最后，Moody宣布讨论结束。

“Those who have to go, go,” he said, gruffly, “I’ll send word via the usual channels for our next meeting. Anyone needs to speak to me now, you’ll have to wait a bit.” He clambered to his feet, hands on the table.
“有事要走的就走，”他说，声音粗哑，“我会通过常规渠道通知下次会议的时间。现在有人需要和我说话的话，你们得等一会儿。”他爬到桌子上站起身来。

Suddenly, the little conservatory was no longer silent and solemn, as everyone began chattering with the person next to them, furtively agreeing things, or else just catching up. Remus blinked. That was it?! He frowned, and looked for Mr Potter, who was pushing his way around the room to them,
突然，温室不再是寂静而严肃的场景，大家开始和旁边的人喋喋不休，偷偷达成协议，或者只是聊天。Remus眨了眨眼。这就结束了？！他皱起眉头，寻找Mr Potter，Mr Potter正在穿过房间走向他们，

“跟我和Hagrid来，”他说对他们的团队，“你们也是，女士们，我们会让你们了解最新情况的。”

Remus relaxed, finally. Thank goodness for that. It was deeply unpleasant, feeling so out of the loop. He felt incredibly young and naive.
Remus终于放松了。真是太感谢了。感觉被排除在外非常不愉快。他感到自己非常年轻和幼稚。

“Not you, lad,” Alastor Moody had reached them too, and clapped a chapped calloused hand on Remus’s shoulder. “Ferox and I need a word. And you, McKinnon - Daniel, that is.” He added, to answer Marlene’s startled expression.
“不是你，小子，”Alastor Moody也走到他们面前，拍了拍Remus的肩膀。“Ferox和我需要谈谈。还有你，McKinnon——Daniel，就是你。”他补充道，回答Marlene惊讶的表情。

Remus的眼睛睁大了，他默默地向Sirius寻求帮助，结果Ferox加入了他们，笑着说，

“Don’t look so jumpy, Lupin, I promise we’re not going to torture you.”
“别这么紧张，Lupin，我保证我们不会折磨你。”

Remus laughed weakly, accepting his fate. He and Danny followed Moody and Ferox out of the conservatory back into the house; through the poky kitchen and along the corridor, up the brown carpeted staircase, which creaked heavily underfoot.
Remus虚弱地笑了，接受了自己的命运。他和Danny跟随Moody和Ferox离开温室回到房子里；穿过狭小的厨房，沿着走廊，走上棕色地毯的楼梯，楼梯在脚下发出沉重的吱吱声。

They entered a small box room, evidently a child's bedroom. There was a small bed in the corner with a stars and spaceships pattern on the duvet. The furniture was small and painted pale blue, and there were glow in the dark stars on the ceiling.
他们进入了一个小小的房间，显然是一个儿童卧室。角落里有一张小床，床单上印有星星和宇宙飞船的图案。家具很小，涂成淡蓝色，天花板上有夜光星星。

“Sit down, chaps,” Ferox nodded at the little bed. Danny and Remus obeyed. Moody stood. Towering over them both, his electric blue eyeball whirring in its socket.
“坐下，伙计们，”Ferox点了点小床。Danny和Remus照做了。Moody站着，高耸在他们两人之上，他的电蓝色眼球在眼窝里嗡嗡作响。

“No prizes for guessing what we want to talk about.” He said.
“你们不用猜也知道我们要谈什么。”他说。

Remus said nothing, because he didn’t think an answer was required, but Danny did.
Remus没有说话，因为他认为不需要回答，但Danny说了。

“The werewolves.”
“狼人。”

“Right.” Ferox said, sitting in a small desk chair, leaning forward on his knees.
“对。”Ferox说，坐在一把小书桌椅上，向前倾在膝盖上。

He was as handsome as he had ever been, in Remus’s opinion. Still a broad, amiable ‘man of action’. His golden blond mane of hair was as lustrous as when Remus was fourteen, only maybe with some grey streaks now. An old, comfortable warmth bubbled in the pit of Remus’s stomach - a crush he had never even recognised at the time, which felt so innocent now. He smiled, finally, feeling a bit more at ease.
在Remus看来，他依然如往常一样英俊。仍然是一个宽广、和蔼的“行动派”。他的金色长发依旧光泽如Remus十四岁时那样，只是现在可能带有一些灰白色的条纹。Remus的胃里涌起一种旧而舒适的温暖——一种他当时甚至没有意识到的暗恋，现在感觉如此纯真。他终于微笑了，感觉稍微放松了一些。

“I’m not sure how I can help,” Danny was saying, “I never met one until that night.” He shuddered slightly.
“我不确定我能帮上什么忙，”Danny说，“直到那晚我才见过一个。”他微微颤抖了一下。

“But Lupin here has,” Moody said, fixing both eyes on Remus.
“但Lupin见过，”Moody说，目光紧紧盯着Remus。

“You have?” Danny’s eyes flicked over Remus, taking him all in with surprise.
“你见过？”Danny的目光扫过Remus，带着惊讶的神情打量着他。

Remus knew what Danny saw, obviously; it was what everyone saw, a skinny, gawky eighteen year old with a too long neck and scrubby blond curls and knobbly knees and so many scars. He swallowed, feeling like a stupid kid in a room full of men.
Remus知道Danny看到的是什么，显而易见；那是大家都看到的，一个瘦弱、笨拙的十八岁少年，脖子太长，头发蓬乱，膝盖关节突出，还有许多伤疤。他咽了咽口水，感觉自己像是在一群男人中间的愚蠢孩子。

“Yeah, I have.” He said, looking at his hands. “Two members of Greyback’s pack, Livia and Castor.”
“是的，我见过。”他说，低头看着自己的手。“Greyback的两个手下，Livia和Castor。”

“Greyback?!” Danny said in hushed awe. “Bloody hell.”
“Greyback？！”Danny低声惊叹道。“真是该死。”

“Remus isn’t new to this sort of operation.” Ferox said. He sounded proud, but Remus looked up at him, beseeching, because yes he was, he was absolutely new to all of this - spying and secret meetings and warfare. He didn’t like this feeling. Everyone was expecting a lot.
“Remus对这种操作并不陌生。”Ferox说。他听起来很自豪，但Remus抬头看着他，恳求地，因为他确实是，他对这一切都是全新的——间谍活动、秘密会议和战争。他不喜欢这种感觉。大家对他有很高的期望。

“I just talked to them.” He said. “They don’t hurt me because Greyback told them not to, I think. They do everything he says, they’re loyal.”
“我只是跟他们谈过。”他说。“他们不伤害我，因为我觉得Greyback告诉他们不要这样做。他们听从他的一切指示，他们很忠诚。”

“Like an army.” Ferox said, nodding, as if he understood. Remus gave him a long stare.
“像一个军队。”Ferox说，点头表示理解。Remus长时间盯着他。

“No.” He said, “Like a family.”
“不是。”他说，“像一个家庭。”

“They’re a dangerous cult.” Moody said, sharply. “I don’t care what we call it. We need to keep an eye on them. Insight.”
“他们是一个危险的邪教。”Moody尖锐地说。“我不在乎我们怎么称呼它。我们需要密切关注他们。洞察力。”

“So what do you want us to do?” Remus asked, straightening his back. He felt more himself. Ferox was still looking at him, but with real respect now.
“那么你们想让我们做什么？”Remus问，挺直了背部。他感觉自己恢复了状态。Ferox仍然看着他，但现在带着真正的尊敬。

“Yeah, what can we do?” Danny asked.
“是啊，我们能做什么？”Danny问。

 

Notes:Lyrics are from Don't Fear the Reaper by Blue Oyster Cult.

So in the UK we don't really 'graduate' from school, we're just 'school leavers'. You don't get called a graduate until you get a degree. No ceremony, and until pretty recently, no prom!

 

Chapter 152: The War: Infiltration 

Whatever happened to

All of the heroes?

All the Shakespeare-os?

They watched their Rome burn.

Whatever happened to the heroes?

Whatever happened to the heroes?

No more heroes any more

No more heroes any more

 

Monday 17th July 1978

 Remus travelled to Diagon Alley alone for the first time via muggle transport. Well; he actually apparated a lot of the way, but caught the tube two stops just to make it look convincing. Moody had forbidden him from using the Potters’ floo connection in case he was followed, and Remus agreed.  

Remus 第一次通过麻瓜交通工具独自前往对角巷。实际上，他在大部分路程中使用了瞬间移动，但为了让人相信他是通过麻瓜交通工具到达的，他坐了两站地铁。穆迪禁止他使用波特家的壁炉通道，以防被跟踪，雷穆斯同意了。

 

He entered the alley via the brick wall by the Leaky Cauldron, and headed straight for the pub. Danny was inside, waiting for him, nursing a tumbler of firewhisky. He smiled sheepishly at Remus,  

他从破釜酒吧旁边的砖墙进入了对角巷，直接向酒吧走去。丹尼在里面等着他，手里拿着一杯火焰威士忌。他不好意思地对雷穆斯笑了笑，

 

“Needed some dutch courage.”  

“需要点荷兰勇气。”

 

“Know the feeling.” Remus nodded, grimly. He ordered the same from the hunchbacked innkeeper.  

“我懂那种感觉。”雷穆斯点了点头，严肃地说道。他向驼背的酒保点了一样的酒。

 

They moved away from the bar and found a quiet corner. Remus cast muffliato for good measure. They exchanged pleasantries, briefly - Marlene had begun training at St Mungo’s and was enjoying it, Danny wasn’t doing much of anything.  

他们离开了酒吧，找到一个安静的角落。雷穆斯施了一个沉默咒以防万一。他们简短地寒暄了一下——玛琳开始在圣芒戈医院接受训练，并且很喜欢这份工作，而丹尼则没做什么特别的事。

 

“I’ve got savings, obviously; I’m not exactly hard up,” he sighed, “The Cannons paid pretty well, I could retire if I wanted. Just didn’t expect to this early.”  

“我有积蓄，显然；我并不缺钱，”他叹了口气，“坎农队的薪水不错，如果我想的话，可以退休。只是没想到这么早就遇到这种事。”

 

Remus didn’t know what to say, because the idea of having a job at all still seemed too distant for him. The older man kept stealing glances at Remus’s scars, too. “Sorry,” he said, when he was caught staring, “I just… you know. Never seen…”  

雷穆斯不知道该说什么，因为对他来说，有工作这个想法还是太遥远了。那位年长的男子也不停地偷看雷穆斯的伤疤。“对不起，”他被抓到盯着看时说，“我只是……你知道的。没见过……”

 

“I know.” Remus replied, trying to relax a bit. He swallowed the last of his whisky and pulled out his cigarette case. “It’s fine. Do you have…?”  

“我知道。”雷穆斯回答道，试着放松一下。他喝下了最后一口威士忌，掏出香烟盒。“没事的。你有……？”

 

“Only one or two.” Danny replied. “S’pose I’ll get more. Oh, and the bite, obviously.” His eyes darted around as he said this, in case anyone was listening in.  

“只有一两个。”丹尼回答道。“我想我会再拿一些。哦，还有那次咬伤，显然。”他说这话时四处张望，以防有人在偷听。

 

“Of course.” Remus nodded, lighting his cigarette and inhaling desperately. “Do you know who did it?”  

“当然。”雷穆斯点点头，点燃了香烟，急切地吸了一口。“你知道是谁干的吗？”

 

“What’s it matter?”  

“那又有什么关系？”

 

“It might,” Remus shrugged, “I think it’s important to them, anyway. I think the one who turns you… they have a connection to you, afterwards. You might recognise their scent. They might recognise yours.”  

“可能有关系，”雷穆斯耸耸肩，“我觉得对他们来说这很重要。我认为咬你的人……他们和你有某种联系。你可能会认出他们的气味。他们可能也会认出你的。”

 

Danny wrinkled up his nose in disgust.  

丹尼厌恶地皱起了鼻子。

 

“How’d you learn all this stuff?”  

“你是怎么学到这些的？”

 

“Some of it’s just experience. Some of it from books. Have you read anything?”  

“有些是经验，有些是书上的。你读过什么吗？”

 

“No.” Danny looked away, “Never been one for reading. At St Mungo’s they said not to bother, anyway. Not like there’s a cure.”  

“没有。”丹尼转过头去，“从来不喜欢读书。在圣芒戈医院，他们说别浪费时间，反正没有治愈的方法。”

 

“No,” Remus frowned, somehow bothered by this line of reasoning, “No, there’s not a cure, but… well there are still things to learn. It’s not just a disease, you know, it’s who we are.”  

“没有，”雷穆斯皱眉，显然对这种理由感到不满，“没有治愈的方法，但是……还有东西可以学。它不仅仅是一种疾病，你知道的，它是我们的一部分。”

 

“S’not who I am.” Danny said, fiercely, his fist clenched on the table.  

“这不是我。”丹尼激烈地说，握紧了拳头放在桌子上。

 

Remus looked away too, embarrassed. Danny wasn’t ready for this, he realised. He was still in denial. Danny raised an arm, signalling to Tom at the bar for another drink. Remus wondered how many he’d had already. It seemed rude to ask; Danny was older than him, had been in the Order longer.  

雷穆斯也转过头去，感到尴尬。他意识到丹尼还没准备好，他仍在否认中。丹尼抬起手臂，向酒吧的汤姆示意再来一杯酒。雷穆斯想知道他已经喝了多少。问这个似乎不太礼貌；丹尼比他年长，在凤凰社的时间也更长。

 

“So.” Danny said, business like, “What’s the plan? Go in, ask questions?”  

“那么。”丹尼商务般地说道，“计划是什么？进去，问问题？”

 

“I don’t think so…” Remus said, carefully. God, Danny definitely wasn’t ready. “I think we need to be more… um… subtle.”  

“我不这么认为……”雷穆斯小心地说。天啊，丹尼肯定还没准备好。“我觉得我们需要更加……嗯……微妙一点。”

 

“We want them to know who we are.”  

“我们希望他们知道我们是谁。”

 

“They’ll know who we are the second we walk in. The scent.”  

“他们一进门就会知道我们是谁。气味。”

 

“Ugh.” Danny wrinkled his nose again and downed his next drink.  

“呃。”丹尼再次皱了皱鼻子，喝下了下一杯酒。

 

“Look, why don’t you stay here?” Remus tried, “Honestly, I’ve done this sort of thing before, I’ll be fine. I can send you a signal, if I get into trouble.”  

“听着，你为什么不留在这里？”雷穆斯试图劝说，“老实说，我以前做过这种事，我会没事的。如果我遇到麻烦，我可以给你发信号。”

 

Danny shook his head.  

丹尼摇摇头。

 

“Promised Ferox and Moody I’d do it.”  

“我答应了费洛克斯和穆迪我会去做。”

 

“They won’t know, I won’t tell them.” Remus pressed, “Really, it’s fine, if you’re not comfortable, they shouldn’t make you---”  

“他们不会知道的，我不会告诉他们。”雷穆斯坚持，“真的，没关系，如果你不舒服，他们不应该强迫你——”

 

“I said I can do it!” Danny slammed his fist down on the tabletop.  

“我说我可以做！”丹尼把拳头重重地拍在桌子上。

 

Remus had a strange desire to start growling. It would be so much easier to settle this as wolves; he could just assert himself as the leader, and Danny would have to submit or get a cuff round the ear. He settled for just meeting Danny’s eye and holding it, sternly. It had the desired effect.  

雷穆斯有种奇怪的冲动，想要开始咆哮。作为狼来解决这个问题会简单得多；他可以直接自信地作为领导，丹尼不得不服从，否则就会挨耳光。他决定只是严厉地与丹尼对视，这样效果很好。

 

“Sorry.” The quidditch player said, sighing, tense shoulders

 

 now sloping down, wearily. “I’m just wound up, with the moon coming on Thursday.”  

“对不起。”那位魁地奇选手叹了口气，紧张的肩膀现在垂了下来，显得疲惫。“我只是有点紧张，星期四月亮就要来了。”

 

“I understand.” Remus said, evenly. “But you’ve got to keep it together in there, ok?”  

“我理解。”雷穆斯平静地说道。“但你必须在里面保持冷静，明白吗？”

 

“Yeah. Ok.” Danny nodded. He paused, giving Remus an appraising look, “Marls said you were the cleverest kid in the year.”  

“嗯。好的。”丹尼点了点头。他停顿了一下，打量了雷穆斯一眼，“玛尔斯说你是那一年里最聪明的孩子。”

 

Remus felt his ears turn red.  

雷穆斯感觉耳朵有些发红。

 

“Hardly,” he said.  

“哪有。”他说。

 

“She trusts you, though. I think I’d better too.” Danny had submitted. Remus straightened his back, a flush of animal pride running through him.  

“不过，她相信你。我想我也应该相信你。”丹尼妥协了。雷穆斯挺直了背脊，一股动物的自豪感涌上心头。

 

“Thank you,” he nodded. “Ok, so they’ll know us when we go in. The scent - I know you don’t like it, but I swear, it’s one of the most useful skills you have now, so don’t ignore it, all right?”  

“谢谢你，”他点头说道。“好吧，他们一进门就会认出我们来。气味——我知道你不喜欢，但我发誓，这是你现在最有用的技能之一，所以不要忽视它，好吗？”

 

“It’s confusing, though.” Danny said, sounding frustrated, “Half the time I don’t know what it is I can… smell.”  

“不过这很让人困惑。”丹尼说，声音里带着挫败感，“一半时间我不知道我能……闻到什么。”

 

“What about me?” Remus asked, “Could you identify me?”  

“那我呢？”雷穆斯问，“你能识别出我吗？”

 

Danny looked at him, quietly, concentrating. His nostrils twitched slightly. He nodded.  

丹尼安静地看着他，集中注意力。他的鼻孔微微抽动了一下。他点了点头。

 

“Good!” Remus said, a bit excited now - he’d never had anyone else to talk to about this before, “It’s like… like something familiar, isn’t it? Something you know really well. You’ll get better at distinguishing different scents, as long as you stop trying to ignore it. I find that if I relax it’s much easier - hardly any work at all, really, it just comes naturally after a while.” Then he remembered something else that Danny ought to know, though he wasn’t sure how to phrase it. “Uhm… You might notice that um… females smell different too. Er. More attractive.”  

“很好！”雷穆斯说，有些兴奋——他以前从未有人可以讨论这些，“这就像……像某种熟悉的东西，对吧？某种你非常熟悉的东西。只要你不再试图忽视它，你会更擅长区分不同的气味。我发现，如果我放松的话，这会容易得多——几乎不需要任何努力，真的，过一段时间它就会自然而然地来。”然后他想起丹尼还应该知道其他的事情，尽管他不确定怎么表达。“呃……你可能会注意到……女性的气味也会不同。呃，更吸引人。”

 

“Right.” Danny nodded again, paling a bit.  

“对。”丹尼再次点头，有些脸色苍白。

 

Remus looked down, cleared his throat, and resumed.  

雷穆斯低下头，清了清喉咙，继续说道。

 

“And the ones I’ve met? The ones in Greyback’s pack? They’re strong. They have really powerful magic, they don’t even need wands all the time. So it’s best not to make a move, because it won’t be like duelling - they’re hard to predict.”  

“还有我遇到的那些呢？灰背狼群中的那些？他们很强大。他们有非常强大的魔法，甚至不需要总是用魔杖。所以最好不要贸然行动，因为这不像决斗——他们很难预测。”

 

“Merlin.” Danny breathed.  

“梅林。”丹尼轻声说道。

 

“Don’t worry.” Remus said, briskly, “They won’t try to fight us. I don’t think they will, anyway. It wouldn’t make sense; they want to recruit us.”  

“别担心。”雷穆斯简洁地说道，“他们不会试图和我们打架。我认为他们不会这样做。没有意义；他们想招募我们。”

 

Danny snorted derisively.  

丹尼嗤之以鼻。

 

“Fat chance.”  

“没戏。”

 

“Try to be understanding, though.” Remus said, “Listen to them - we want them to think we’re interested, right?”  

“不过，尽量理解一下。”雷穆斯说道，“听他们说——我们希望他们认为我们感兴趣，对吧？”

 

“Right. Of course. Except we’re not.” Danny was looking at him oddly again.  

“对，当然。只是我们并不感兴趣。”丹尼再次以奇怪的目光看着他。

 

“Obviously not.” Remus snapped. “But we’re still there to make friends. We’re there to talk, which means first we have to listen.”  

“显然不是。”雷穆斯厉声说道。“但我们仍然要去交朋友。我们去那里是为了交谈，这意味着我们首先得倾听。”

 

“That’s not the impression I had from Moody.” Danny said, “This is reconnaissance, not a peace mission.”  

“我从穆迪那里得到的印象不是这样。”丹尼说道，“这是侦查任务，不是和平任务。”

 

“Well Moody doesn’t know anything about it.” Remus said, “Danny, listen to me. Stop thinking they’re your enemies, because they’re not. The one who bit you - he was wrong, ok? He ought to be arrested, he ought to be punished. But someone bit him, once. And because of that, his whole life changed, and no one looked at him like he was the same person any more. You understand that, don’t you?”  

“穆迪对这事一无所知。”雷穆斯说道，“丹尼，听我说。别再认为他们是你的敌人，因为他们不是。咬你的人——他是错的，明白吗？他应该被逮捕，应该受到惩罚。但曾经有人咬过他。而因为那次，他的整个生活发生了变化，没人再把他当作原来的那个人看待。你明白这一点了吗？”

 

Danny was staring at the bottom of his empty glass. He didn’t answer, but Remus knew he was paying attention.  

丹尼盯着他空酒杯的底部。他没有回答，但雷穆斯知道他在认真听。

 

“They’re like us.” Remus said, firmly. “Except they’ve not been as lucky. You and me, we have people who care about us, who want to keep us safe, who know we’re more than just… just monsters. The ones we’re about to meet, maybe they never had that. Maybe Greyback was the first person who cared.”  

“他们和我们一样。”雷穆斯坚定地说道。“只是他们没有那么幸运。你和我，我们有关心我们的人，想要保护我们的人，他们知道我们不仅仅是……只是怪物。我们即将见到的那些，也许他们从未拥有过这些。也许灰背狼是第一个关心他们的人。”

 

“Person.” Danny spat, “How can you talk like that. How can you give a toss about what happens to them? How can you be so calm?!”  

“人。”丹尼吐槽道，“你怎么能这么说。你怎么能在乎他们发生什么？你怎么能这么冷静？！”

 

“I’ve been angry for long enough.” Remus replied coolly. “Now I’m ready to do something about it.”  

“我已经生气够久了。”雷穆斯冷冷地回答。“现在我准备采取行动了。”

 

They ordered one more drink, and then they left.  

他们再点了一杯酒，然后离开了。

 

Danny said he had never been to Knockturn Alley before, and of course Remus only knew it by sight - and scent. The odour of dark magic was still there; acrid smoke, sour milk. It was a dim, cobbled street with crooked lanes winding off in different directions. The shop windows were dingy and displayed diabolical assortments of dark and dangerous artefacts.  

丹尼说他以前从未去过诺克特恩巷，当然，雷穆斯只知道它的外观——以及气味。黑暗魔法的气味依然存在；刺鼻的烟雾，酸臭的牛奶。这是一条昏暗的鹅卵石街道，

 

弯曲的小巷蜿蜒延伸。在黑暗的商店橱窗里展示着邪恶和危险的魔法物品。

 

The pub was easy to find. The Manticore’s Head had a horrible swinging sign hanging on a bracket outside which bore the image of a manticore’s bloody severed head on a platter. The creature had the head of a man, but a thick lion’s mane. Its eyes rolled upwards and its mouth gaped in a silent moan of misery. It made Remus shudder. It looked like Ferox.  

酒吧很容易找到。曼提科尔的头外面挂着一个可怕的摇摆招牌，上面画着一个曼提科尔的血腥断头放在托盘上。那生物有人的头，却有着浓密的狮子鬃毛。它的眼睛向上翻，嘴巴张开，发出无声的痛苦呻吟。这让雷穆斯打了个寒颤。它看起来像费罗克斯。

 

He went in first, Danny more happy to follow than lead. He pushed the door open and the moment he crossed the threshold he caught the scent. It hit him like a wall, igniting him, making every hair stand deliciously on end.  

他先进去，丹尼更愿意跟在后面而不是领头。他推开门，一踏入门槛，他就闻到了气味。它像墙一样撞击了他，点燃了他，让每根汗毛都愉快地竖了起来。

 

Five werewolves. He knew each one before he laid eyes on them. Three gathered around a table in the far corner. Two at the bar. There were others there too; creatures Remus had heard of, but never seen. A vampire. Two banshees. A whole gang of goblins.  

五只狼人。他在看到他们之前就知道了每一个。三只聚集在远处角落的桌子旁。两只在酒吧前面。还有其他生物；雷穆斯听说过的，但从未见过。一个吸血鬼。两个女妖。还有一整群地精。

 

Danny was tense behind him, Remus willed him to calm down; it was so obvious. But there was nothing they could do now but go in; Remus heard the door bang shut behind them.  

丹尼在他身后紧张得不得了，雷穆斯希望他能冷静下来；这很明显。但现在他们除了进去别无选择；雷穆斯听到门在他们身后咣当一声关上了。

 

It was fairly dark inside; the windows covered with threadbare velvet curtains. The mahogany wall panelling and countertops were grimy, covered in a strange sticky dust that glistened in places like glitter. Behind the bar were enormous mirrors covered with shelves and shelves of bottles, each one a different size, shape and colour, glowing in the firelight like a wall of jewels. The fire roared, but it was strangely cool.  

里面相当昏暗；窗户被褴褛的天鹅绒窗帘遮盖着。红木墙板和台面都很肮脏，覆盖着奇怪的粘性灰尘，在某些地方像闪光一样闪烁。在酒吧后面是巨大的镜子，镜子上摆满了各种大小、形状和颜色的瓶子，像一面宝石墙一样在火光中发光。火焰咆哮着，但却显得异常寒冷。

 

Remus approached the bar, as casually as he could manage. The figure standing behind it was heavily robed, hood pulled low, so that Remus couldn’t see its face.  

雷穆斯尽量装作随意地走向酒吧。站在酒吧后面的身影穿着沉重的长袍，兜帽拉得很低，以至于雷穆斯看不清他的脸。

 

Moody’s haggard, pitted face curved into a wicked grin.
Moody那张憔悴的面孔露出狡黠的笑容。

“Ever heard of Knockturn Alley?”
“听说过Knockturn Alley吗？”

“Two firewhiskies, please.” He said, instantly regretting the politeness. He’d spent too much time at the bloody Potters’.  

“来两杯火焰威士忌。”他说，立刻后悔了这种礼貌。他在该死的波特家里待得太久了。

 

The bartender turned around, and reached for a bottle. Remus fumbled in his robes for change. Danny joined him, standing close, looking around himself furtively.  

酒保转过身，拿起一瓶酒。雷穆斯在长袍里摸索着找零钱。丹尼也靠近他，站得很近，偷偷地环顾四周。

 

The two werewolves at the bar were watching them both. That was to be expected, of course; that was what they wanted. All part of Moody’s plan - Remus and Danny were invaluable to the Order, he said. A boy who’d been turned by Greyback himself; who Greyback was interested in, and a man who’d been recently turned, who the others would see as vulnerable.  

酒吧里的两只狼人正注视着他们。这是可以预料的；这正是他们想要的。都是穆迪计划的一部分——雷穆斯和丹尼对凤凰社来说不可或缺，他说。一个被格雷巴克亲自变成狼人的男孩；格雷巴克感兴趣的，还有一个最近被变成狼人、其他人会认为他很脆弱的男人。

 

Remus nodded at them, carefully. Danny didn’t move a muscle, but that was ok - it was clear that Remus was the leader. The other two nodded in return. Remus sensed curiosity, but not danger. He straightened up, more confident.  

雷穆斯小心翼翼地点了点头。丹尼没有动一根手指，但没关系——很明显雷穆斯是领导者。另两只也回以点头。雷穆斯感到的是好奇，而不是危险。他挺直了身体，显得更有自信。

 

They were male, both roughly the same height, only an inch or so shorter than Remus. One was stocky, with dirty blond hair, a square jaw, fairly handsome under any other circumstances. The other was one of Greyback’s. His hair was shaved close to his skull, he had a thick scar on one cheek, and of course the tattoos covering his arms and throat, spiralling moon phases.  

他们是男性，个子大致相同，比雷穆斯矮了大约一英寸。一个体格健壮，脏金色的头发，方形的下巴，在其他情况下还算英俊。另一个是格雷巴克的手下。他的头发剃得很短，一只脸颊上有一道粗大的伤疤，当然还有覆盖手臂和脖子的纹身，呈螺旋状的月相。

 

Glancing over these two men’s shoulders, Remus tried to get a read on the three in the corner. Two of them were female, one male, all Greyback’s. No Livia or Castor, which was a relief.  

雷穆斯透过这两个人的肩膀瞥了一眼角落里的三个人。他们中有两个女性，一个男性，都是格雷巴克的手下。没有莉维亚或卡斯托，这让他松了口气。

 

The whiskies arrived, and Remus knocked his back, maintaining eye contact with the two werewolves at the bar - or at least the one who belonged to Greyback. Danny followed suit. Greyback’s man inclined his head slightly, considering, and then extended a hand. He had long, thick fingernails, black with filth. Remus shook it.  

火焰威士忌上来了，雷穆斯一饮而尽，与酒吧里的两只狼人——或者说至少是格雷巴克的手下——保持眼神接触。丹尼也效仿。格雷巴克的手下微微点了点头，考虑了一下，然后伸出手。他的指甲又长又厚，黑乎乎的。雷穆斯握了握他的手。

 

“Welcome, brothers.” The man said, shaking Danny’s hand too. Danny was visibly horrified by this, but Remus thought it probably just came across as nerves. And who could blame him. “I am Gaius. Come and sit with us.”  

“欢迎，兄弟们。”那人说，同时握住了丹尼的手。丹尼明显对这一点感到恐惧，但雷穆斯觉得这可能只是紧张罢了。谁能怪他呢。“我是盖乌斯。来和我们坐在一起吧。”

 

Remus glanced back at Danny, who nodded, and they both followed Gaius over to the table in the corner. The seats looked like ancient church pews, and they were just as uncomfortable to sit on. Remus tried to subtly maneuver himself beside Danny, but Gaius slipped between them, splitting them up. There was nothing to be done; Remus just hoped that Danny knew when to apparate.  

雷穆斯回头看了看丹尼，丹尼点了点头，于是他们俩跟随盖乌斯来到角落的桌子旁。座位看起来像古老的教堂长椅，坐上去也一样不舒服。雷穆斯试图巧妙地挪到丹尼身旁，但盖乌斯却从他们之间溜过，将他们分开了。没有办法；雷穆斯只能希望丹尼知道什么时候使用隐形术。

 

The scent of all of them gathered together was overwhelming and exciting. Remus felt alert, full of energy - but also very safe, almost comfortable. It was no wonder werewolves were so easy to recruit, he thought. People spent their whole lives in search of a feeling like this; it was a feeling he knew well. He’d had it ever since the marauders became animagi. Pack. Family. Home.  

他们聚集在一起的气味是压倒性的和令人兴奋的。雷穆斯感到警觉，充满了能量——但也非常安全，甚至感到舒适。他想，难怪狼人如此容易招募。他们整个人生都在寻找这样的感觉；这是他很熟悉的感觉。他自从淘气包们成为了动物形态变形者后就一直拥有这种感觉。群体。家庭。家园。

 

“Brother, sisters,” Gaius was saying, “This is Jeremy,” he gestured at the fair haired, handsome man he’d been talking to at the bar. “And these two are…”  

“兄弟们，姐妹们，”盖乌斯说道，“这是杰里米，”他指了指那个在酒吧里和他交谈的金发英俊的男人。“这两个是……”

 

“Daniel.” Danny said, stiffly. He drank from his glass, eyes darting around. He kept looking at the women, and Remus knew why. Gaius nodded agreeably, then looked at Remus expectantly.  

“丹尼。”丹尼僵硬地说道。他喝了口酒，眼睛四处游移。他不断看向那些女人，雷穆斯知道原因。盖乌斯同意地点了点头，然后期待地看着雷穆斯。

 

“Remus Lupin.” He replied, steadily.  

“雷穆斯·卢平。”他稳稳地回答道。

 

The atmosphere shifted, the two women leaned in closer, eyes glittering, teeth bared in what might have passed for a smile.  

气氛发生了变化，那两个女人靠得更近了，眼睛闪烁，露出可能算作笑容的牙齿。

 

“Remus Lupin.” Gaius said. “The cub who attacked our brother Castor and our sister Livia.”  

“雷穆斯·卢平。”盖乌斯说道。“那个攻击了我们兄弟卡斯托和我们姐妹莉维亚的幼崽。”

 

“I defended myself.” Remus said, raising his chin. Any sign of weakness would be exploited.  

“我是在自卫。”雷穆斯说道，抬起下巴。任何表现出弱点的迹象都会被利用。

 

“We were under the impression that Remus Lupin has made his choice.” One of the women said, her voice low and rasping.  

“一直以为雷穆斯·卢平已经做出了他的选择。”其中一个女人说道，声音低沉而沙哑。

 

“I wanted to complete my studies. I’ve finished school, now,” Remus said, reasonably, “I’m exploring my options.”  

“我想完成学业。我现在已经毕业了，”雷穆斯理智地说道，“我在探索我的选择。”

 

The two women continued to glare at him, clearly not believing a word he said. But Gaius raised his hand.  

两个女人继续怒视着他，显然不相信他的话。但盖乌斯举起了手。

 

“Our father is forgiving and generous,” he said, smiling, “He welcomes all of his children.”  

“我们的父亲宽容大度，”他说，带着微笑，“他欢迎所有他的孩子。”

 

“Brother,” one of the women said, “He is not to be trusted! He is Dumbledore’s lapdog!”  

“兄弟，”其中一个女人说道，“他不值得信任！他是邓布利多的走狗！”

“He was elevated by Greyback himself .” Gaius snapped, sharply, turning his head and twitching his left hand, turning the wrist. The woman who had spoken up went rigid, suddenly, eyes wide, as if she was gripped by some enormous pain. “So hold. Your. Tongue.” Gaius said, turning his wrist again.  

“他是被格雷巴克亲自提拔的。”盖乌斯尖锐地说道，转过头来，抽动左手，转动手腕。刚才发言的女人突然变得僵硬，眼睛睁得大大的，好像被某种巨大的痛苦困住了。“所以闭上你的嘴。”盖乌斯说道，再次转动手腕。

 

The woman relaxed, breathing hard. They could all hear her heart thumping. Remus felt sick.  

那女人放松了，喘着粗气。他们都能听到她的心跳。雷穆斯感到恶心。

 

Gaius smiled around the table.  

盖乌斯在桌子周围微笑。

 

“Brothers,” he said to the three new recruits, “Our father, Fenrir Greyback, welcomes you into his pack. We have been shut out, like you, we have been denied shelter, friendship, protection. Our father would return these things to you - and much more.”  

“兄弟们，”他对三位新成员说道，“我们的父亲，芬里尔·格雷巴克，欢迎你们加入他的团队。我们曾像你们一样被排斥，失去了庇护、友谊和保护。我们的父亲将这些东西还给你们——还有更多。”

 

“How?” Remus asked, hoping his voice sounded pleasant and inquisitive.  

“怎么做？”雷穆斯问，希望自己的声音听起来既愉快又好奇。

 

Gaius gave him a look. Remus returned it. It was strange. He knew that the thing to do - the correct thing to do for the mission, for his safety and for the other werewolves, was to lower his head, to look subservient, stay quiet. He had to get them to trust him.  

盖乌斯给了他一个眼神。雷穆斯回望了他。这很奇怪。他知道该怎么做——为了任务，为了自己的安全和其他狼人，正确的做法是低下头，显得顺从，保持安静。他必须让他们信任他。

 

But he couldn’t do it. Maybe it was nerves, or the strength of their scent and their power so close to him, or maybe it was just that old Lyall Lupin belligerence, but Remus found himself doing exactly the opposite. He held high head higher, taking advantage of how much taller he was than the others, even seated. He made clear eye contact and said,  

但他做不到。也许是紧张，或是他们的气味和力量如此接近，或者只是那种老派的莱尔·卢平的好斗性格，但雷穆斯发现自己恰恰做了相反的事。他昂起头，利用自己比其他人高的优势，即使坐着也如此。他做出了明确的眼神接触，说道，

 

“I just wanted to know how Greyback plans to provide us with shelter, friendship and protection.”  

“我只是想知道格雷巴克打算怎么给我们提供庇护、友谊和保护。”

 

“You will see, in time.”  

“你会看到的，随着时间的推移。”

 

“Right, well that’s not very convincing.” Remus shrugged, “Sounds to me like a lot of promises, but not much of a plan, what do you two think?” He looked at Danny and Jeremy, the blond man.  

“好吧，那不太让人信服。”雷穆斯耸了耸肩，“听起来像是很多承诺，但没有什么具体计划，你们怎么看？”他看向丹尼和那个金发男人杰里米。

 

Danny just stared at Remus, looking appalled. Jeremy, unaware of what was going on, shrugged,  

丹尼只是盯着雷穆斯，看起来很震惊。杰里米则不知道发生了什么，耸了耸肩，

 

“I don’t care how he does it, as long as he does. Got nowhere else to go, my folks kicked me out.”  

“我不在乎他怎么做，只要他做到就行。我没有其他地方去，我的父母把我赶出了家。”

 

“What if you did have somewhere to go, though?” Remus said, quickly, “What if there was a safe place, and you didn’t have to pick any sides in the war--?”  

“那如果你真的有地方去呢？”雷穆斯快速说道，“如果有一个安全的地方，而你不必在战争中选择任何一方——？”

 

“Remus Lupin, you are confused.” Gaius said, raising his voice. “No such place exists for us. The humans have made it perfectly clear.”  

“雷穆斯·卢平，你很困惑。”盖乌斯提高了声音。“我们没有这样一个地方。人类已经明确表示了。”

 

“The… the humans,” Remus said, carefully, thinking fast, “They’re in the wrong, I agree with you - The Ministry of Magic needs reforming - but change can only happen if--”  

“那……那些人类，”雷穆斯小心翼翼地说道，快速思考，“他们是错的，我同意你的观点——魔法部需要改革——但变化只能发生在——”

 

“They are not interested. They are only concerned with murdering our brothers and sisters; locking us up, suppressing the wolf.”  

“他们不感兴趣。他们只关心谋杀我们的兄弟姐妹；把我们关起来，压制狼性。”

 

“And what exactly is Greyback going to do about that?” Remus persisted.  

“那格雷巴克到底会怎么做呢？”雷穆斯坚持问道。

 

He knew why Danny’s pulse was racing; why he kept raising his eyebrows at Remus desperately over Gaius’s shoulder, but Remus couldn’t think about that now. It sounded like madness, pushing Gaius like this when he was clearly giving off danger signs, but it was almost as if Remus couldn’t stop himself.  

他知道为什么丹尼的脉搏在加速；为什么他不断在盖乌斯的肩膀上绝望地抬起眉毛，但雷穆斯现在不能考虑这些。这样推动盖乌斯听起来像是疯狂，尤其是当他明显发出危险信号时，但几乎就像雷穆斯无法阻止自己一样。

 

“When you meet my father.” Gaius growled, “You will understand.”  

“当你见到我的父亲时。”盖乌斯低声咆哮道，“你会明白的。”

 

“I’d like to meet him.” Remus said, keenly.  

“我很想见见他。”雷穆斯热切地说道。

 

Gaius’s lips curled,  

盖乌斯的嘴唇勾起了，

 

“There will be time for that. When you have proved yourself.” He looked at the others, “When you have all proved yourselves, you will earn the right to call him father.”  

“那时候会有机会的。等你们证明自己。”他看了看其他人，“当你们都证明了自己时，你们就会获得称呼他为父亲的权利。”

 

“And how do we do that?” Remus asked, leaning forward, keen to keep Gaius’s attention on him. He knew Danny would never join the werewolves, but this Jeremy kid - he was in real danger.  

“那我们怎么做呢？”雷穆斯前倾身子问道，热切地保持盖乌斯的注意力在他身上。他知道丹尼永远不会加入狼人，但这个杰里米小子——他确实很危险。

 

Gaius’s whole posture had changed; he seemed larger, his shoulders broader, he frowned at Remus.  

盖乌斯的姿态完全改变了；他看起来更高大，肩膀更宽广，他对雷穆斯皱起了眉头。

 

“Three full moons spent with the pack,” he said, eyes blazing with intensity.  

“和团队一起度过三个满月，”他说，眼睛中闪烁着强烈的光芒。

 

“Great,” Remus nodded, “Yes, ok, I’d love to meet him, can we do that? Can you tell me where--”  

“太好了，”雷穆斯点了点头，“是的，好吧，我很想见见他，我们可以做到吗？你能告诉我在哪里——”

 

Pain shot through him, excruciating, burning; his bones were melting, his skin was bubbling, he wanted to cry out, but his jaw locked. Gaius’s eyes bore into Remus’s, furious, and suddenly Remus could hear him; hear Gaius’s voice inside his head.  

剧烈的痛苦袭来，灼烧般的疼痛；他的骨头在融化，皮肤在起泡，他想呼喊，但下巴却紧锁。盖乌斯的眼睛愤怒地盯着雷穆斯，突然雷穆斯能听到他；听到盖乌斯的声音在他脑海里。

 

Remus Lupin you are a fool.  

雷穆斯

 

·卢平，你是个傻瓜。

 

It purred  

它低声说道

 

My father wishes you to live, but only you. You will be obedient, or I will kill everyone in this room. I will kill…  

我父亲希望你活下来，但只有你。你必须听话，否则我会杀了房间里所有的人。我会杀……

 

Remus felt a strange, sifting feeling inside his mind, and knew what Gaius was doing. He tried to resist, but the pain was such a distraction, he hadn’t the strength. Gaius alighted on something he’d found, his eyes lit up maliciously,  

雷穆斯感到脑海中出现了奇怪的筛选感，知道盖乌斯在做什么。他试图抵抗，但痛苦的分心使他没有力气。盖乌斯发现了他找到的东西，眼睛恶意地闪亮，

 

I will kill... James Potter and Lily Evans… and Peter, and Marlene and Mary and... I will kill Sirius Black...   

我会杀……詹姆斯·波特和莉莉·埃文斯……还有彼得、玛琳和玛丽……我会杀死天狼星·布莱克……

 

A surge of fury rose up in Remus and it was enough - only just enough, only barely - to break away from Gaius’s fierce grip on his mind and body. He roared, lashing out with his arms and legs, because his thoughts were too muddled to do anything else. Shaking his head, as if to rid himself of Gaius’s wicked voice, he lunged at the other werewolf, forcing him back against the pew, half on top of him, wrapping his hands around his throat and squeezing.  

愤怒的激流涌上雷穆斯的心头，这足以——仅仅足以——从盖乌斯对他心灵和身体的猛烈控制中挣脱出来。他咆哮着，挥舞着手臂和腿，因为他的思绪过于混乱，无法做其他事情。他摇着头，仿佛要摆脱盖乌斯那邪恶的声音，他猛扑向另一个狼人，把他压回长椅上，半个身子压在他身上，双手绕到他的脖子上，紧紧地掐住。

 

The other three werewolves - Greyback’s werewolves - all tried to move, but Remus was so full of anger and violent emotion that he barely needed to think and they were locked in place.  

另外三个狼人——格雷巴克的狼人——都试图移动，但雷穆斯充满了愤怒和暴力情绪，几乎不需要思考，他们便被锁在了原地。

 

“Is this what you mean by proving myself, Gaius?” He hissed, squeezing harder, so that the other man’s face was turning red, veins bulging in his temples. “Have I earned your fucking respect now?!”  

“这就是你说的证明自己吗，盖乌斯？”他咝咝地说道，更用力地掐住，让对方的脸变红，太阳穴的血管突起。“我现在赢得了你的尊重了吗？！”

 

Gaius clawed at Remus desperately, but only when he was beginning to slacken and fade did Remus let go. He stepped back quickly,  

盖乌斯绝望地抓着雷穆斯，但只有在他开始松弛和褪色时，雷穆斯才放手。他迅速后退，

 

“Danny!” He said, urgently, “We have to go.”  

“丹尼！”他说，急切地，“我们得走了。”

 

They had to leave first; they couldn’t be chased out, that would look like they were running away. Oh fuck, he thought, oh fuck, why did I do that?! What was he going to tell Ferox? Moody would have his bollocks!  

他们必须先离开；他们不能被追出来，那会显得他们在逃跑。哦，该死，他想，哦，该死，为什么我这么做？我该怎么告诉费洛克斯？穆迪会揪着他的命！

 

The last thing Remus saw before he and Danny apparated was Jeremy’s horrified face.  

雷穆斯和丹尼在消失之前看到的最后一幕是杰里米惊恐的脸。

 

* * *

 

“Merlin!” Danny yelled, as soon as they were away from there. “What the fuck ?!”  

“梅林！”丹尼一离开那里就喊道，“他妈的发生了什么？！”

 

They were in a field, miles and miles outside of London. They were supposed to walk from there to a bus shelter, where Moody would be waiting for a debrief.  

他们在一个田野里，离伦敦有好几英里。他们应该从那里走到一个公交车站，穆迪会在那里等着进行简报。

 

“I’m sorry,” Remus panted, shaking his head, “I got -- I lost my temper.”  

“对不起，”雷穆斯喘着气，摇了摇头，“我……我失控了。”

 

“I’ll bloody say!” Danny ranted, “Wouldn’t have let you have all that firewhisky if I knew you were going to flip your shit and try and take on Greyback’s whole army single-handed!”  

“我会他妈地这么说！”丹尼咆哮道，“如果我知道你会发狂并试图单枪匹马对抗格雷巴克的整个军队，我才不会让你喝那些火焰威士忌！”

 

“That was not his whole army.” Remus replied sourly, wiping sweat from his brow. He was still buzzing from the agony Gaius had put him through.  

“那不是他的全部军队。”雷穆斯苦涩地回答，擦去额头上的汗水。他仍在经历盖乌斯带给他的痛苦的余波。

 

“And that wasn’t the bloody mission, was it?!” Danny retorted, “Subtle, you said! Just listen to them, you said!”  

“那不是他妈的任务，对吧？！”丹尼反驳道，“你说要低调！说只要听他们的就行！”

 

“I realised that wasn’t going to work,” Remus tried to explain, “They’re a pack; you have to dominate the leader, you need to show them--”  

“我意识到那样行不通，”雷穆斯试图解释，“他们是一个团队；你必须主宰领导者，你需要展示给他们看——”

 

“You sound like them!” Danny said, suddenly.  

“你听起来像他们！”丹尼突然说道。

 

“What?”  

“什么？”

 

“You! All of your ‘special skills’ crap. You want to be like that, do you? No better than a pack animal? A fucking beast?!”  

“你！你所有的‘特殊技能’废话。你想变成那样吗？不比一只包围的动物强？一个他妈的野兽？！”

 

Remus stared at him. He didn’t know what to say, he was too giddy, his thoughts were a mess.  

雷穆斯盯着他。他不知道该说什么，他太兴奋了，思绪一片混乱。

 

“Look.” He said, trembling, “Let’s just find Moody.”  

“听着。”他说，颤抖着，“我们还是去找穆迪吧。”

 

“Right.” Danny agreed, still red-faced, “Sooner we do, sooner I can get away from you .”  

“好。”丹尼同意道，脸色仍然发红，“我们越快做到，我就能越早远离你。”

 

Remus didn’t reply, just started walking. His head hurt so much, a migraine building behind his eyes, the bright summer sunshine was like daggers after the gloom of The Manticore’s Head. His mind was running a mile a minute. How would he explain this? How could anyone hear it and trust him ever again? What worried him most was that his first instinct was to lie.  

雷穆斯没有回答，只是开始走路。他的头疼得厉害，眼睛后面出现了偏头痛，明亮的夏日阳光在《曼提科头》的阴郁之后如同利刃。他的思绪飞速运转。他该如何解释这一切？怎样才能让人相信他？最让他担心的是，他的第一反应是撒谎。

 

Danny was walking faster than him, but then he hadn’t just had his mind ripped apart by a… oh fuck. Was Danny right? Was Remus just like them, deep down?  

丹尼走得比他快，但他刚刚没有经历心灵的撕裂……哦，该死。丹尼说得对吗？雷穆斯在内心深处真的和他们一样吗？

 

They reached the bus shelter - long abandoned, covered in yellow pollen and sprayed on graffiti. Moody was waiting, punctual as always. He looked at them both, blue eye whirring wildly between them.  

他们到达了公交车站——长期被遗弃，覆盖着黄色花粉和喷涂的涂鸦。穆迪在等着，像往常一样准时。他看了看他们俩，蓝色的眼睛在他们之间急速转动。

 

“What went wrong?” He asked, at once.  

“发生了什么问题？”他立刻问道。

 

Remus looked at Danny. Danny looked at Remus, then down at his feet. Remus swallowed, and bit the bullet.  

雷穆斯看了看丹尼。丹尼看了看雷穆斯，然后低头看着自己的脚。雷穆斯吞了吞口水，硬着头皮说道。

 

“I made a mistake.” He said. “I let my temper get the better of me.”  

“我犯了个错误。”他说。“我让自己的脾气失控了。”

 

Moody looked at him for a long time. He was completely inscrutable, and though Remus knew Moody wasn’t actually reading his mind - he knew how that felt, now - he felt as though he was being picked slowly apart all the same.  

穆迪盯着他看了很长时间。他完全无法揣测，虽然雷穆斯知道穆迪实际上没有读他的脑袋——他现在知道那种感觉——但他感觉自己像是被慢慢剥离。

 

“Tell me everything, lad.” Moody said, finally.  

“把一切告诉我，小伙子。”穆迪终于说道。

 

Remus did his best. He didn’t mention the whiskies. He didn’t mention the loss of control he’d felt, even before Gaius had hurt him. He definitely didn’t repeat anything Gaius had whispered into his brain. He told only the story Danny might have told. And it worked.  

雷穆斯尽力而为。他没有提到火焰威士忌。他没有提到他在盖乌斯伤害他之前感受到的失控。他绝对没有重复盖乌斯在他脑海里耳语的任何内容。他只讲述了丹尼可能会讲的故事。效果很好。

 

“Sounds like you acted in self defence.” Moody said, business-like, as if this sort of thing happened all the time.  

“听起来你是为了自卫。”穆迪说道，像是这种事情经常发生一样。

 

“I went too far.” Remus said. It was easy to be submissive now, to be polite and deferential to someone else. “I acted… I behaved badly. I put Danny in danger.”  

“我过头了。”雷穆斯说道。现在很容易表现得顺从，对别人礼貌和谦恭。“我行为…表现得很糟糕。我让丹尼处于危险之中。”

 

“Don’t be so hard on yourself, Lupin.” Moody said, sounding almost kind. “You were in a tight spot. You both got out of it. Do you need to see a healer? Do you know what curse it was?”  

“别对自己太苛刻，卢平。”穆迪说道，听起来几乎是善意的。“你当时处境艰难。你们都脱离了困境。你需要去看治疗师吗？你知道那是什么咒语吗？”

 

“It was wordless magic,” Remus shook his head, “And I’m ok. It wasn’t even as bad as a full moon.”  

“那是无言魔法，”雷穆斯摇了摇头，“我没事。甚至比不上一个满月的痛苦。”

 

This was a lie. He could still feel the remnants of it, his head throbbed and his nerves were vibrating. But it was going away. Pain often did, or else you just learnt to get on top of it.  

这是个谎言。他仍能感受到残余的痛苦，头疼得厉害，神经在颤动。但它正在消退。痛苦往往会消退，否则你就学会了如何应对它。

 

Moody laughed gruffly.  

穆迪粗声粗气地笑了。

 

“Good chap. Right, McKinnon, anything further?”  

“好小子。对了，麦金农，还有什么其他事吗？”

 

Danny shook his head. He hadn’t said much while Remus was explaining himself, only interjected once or twice to confirm that it was the truth. He still didn’t look at Remus, and Remus didn’t blame him. Moody, if he noticed, didn’t comment on this odd atmosphere. He clapped his hands together. “Well then, I should say we’re ok to apparate now. Lupin, I’m coming with you, got another meeting. McKinnon, you’ll be ok to get back somewhere safe?”  

丹尼摇了摇头。他在雷穆斯解释自己的情况时没说太多，只是插话确认了一两次是真的。他仍然没有看雷穆斯，雷穆斯也不怪他。如果穆迪注意到了，他并没有评论这种奇怪的气氛。他拍了拍手。“那么，我想我们现在可以瞬移了。卢平，我和你一起去，还有其他会议。麦金农，你能安全回去吗？”

 

“Yeah. No problem.” Danny replied, hollow voiced. “See you.” And began to walk away, back into the field.  

“是的，没问题。”丹尼回答，声音空洞。“再见。”然后开始离开，回到田野里。

 

Remus looked at Moody.  

雷穆斯看着穆迪。

 

“He’s angry with me. I don’t think we should pair up again like that.”  

“他对我很生气。我觉得我们不应该再这样配对了。”

 

“You won’t.” Moody said, briskly.  

“你不会的。”穆迪简洁地说道。

 

Remus’s heart sank. So that was it. Moody didn’t trust him any more. The auror began to walk in the opposite direction from Danny, across the quiet country road. Remus hurried to keep up. The ground felt weird below his feet, like sponge.  

雷穆斯的心沉了下去。就这样了。穆迪不再信任他了。那位傲罗开始朝着与丹尼相反的方向走，穿过安静的乡村道路。雷穆斯赶忙跟上。脚下的地面感觉奇怪，就像海绵一样。

 

Moody stopped abruptly, having apparently judged the shady copse of trees they were now standing in a suitable place to apparate from. He glanced at Remus,  

穆迪突然停下，显然判断他们现在站立的那片阴暗树丛是适合瞬移的地方。他瞥了一眼雷穆斯，

 

“McKinnon can’t hack it, that much is clear. We’ll have him on communications or guarding a safe house. You’ll be prepared to go it alone, next time?”  

“麦金农搞不定，这点很明确。我们会让他负责通讯或看守安全屋。你下次准备独自行动吗？”

 

“I… What?!”  

“我……什么？！”

 

“You showed them who you are, today.” Moody said, both of his eyes focused on Remus. “That's good. That’ll get back to the pack. Stir them up. We want Greyback distracted.”  

“今天你向他们展示了你是谁。”穆迪说道，他的两只眼睛都集中在雷穆斯身上。“这很好。那会传回给团队。激起他们的情绪。我们想让格雷巴克分心。”

 

“I’m not sure I understand.” Remus frowned.  

“我不太明白。”雷穆斯皱眉道。

 

“Don’t you?” Moody raised a bushy eyebrow. “I think you’re more canny than you let on, Lupin. Right, come on, I’ve an appointment with Fleamont.”  

“你不明白吗？”穆迪挑起了浓密的眉毛。“我认为你比你表现出来的更精明，卢平。好了，快点，我还有个跟弗利蒙特的约会。”

 

That was that. No more questions. In a matter of seconds they were on the Potters’ back doorstep, answering the identifying questions from Euphemia, and then everything was normal; they were back in reality, surrounded by the gentle warm familiarity of the kitchen. It was like being jolted awake from a nightmare, and you just had to keep reminding yourself everything was ok now.  

事情就这样结束了。没有更多的问题。几秒钟内，他们就到了波特家的后门，回答了尤菲米亚提出的识别问题，然后一切恢复了正常；他们回到了现实中，周围被厨房的温暖熟悉包围。就像从噩梦中惊醒，你只是不断提醒自己一切都好。

 

Moody disappeared off towards Mr Potter’s study, and James and Sirius came running through the hallway to meet Remus. Sirius looked half mad, and they stood in front of each other for a moment, wide eyes full of words. Finally Sirius came towards him, enveloping Remus in a hug and burying his head in his neck.  

穆迪消失在波特先生的书房方向，詹姆斯和天狼星跑过走廊来见雷穆斯。天狼星看起来半疯狂，他们站在彼此面前，一时间满眼言语。最后，天狼星向他走去，紧紧地拥抱雷穆斯，把头埋在他的脖子里。

 

“You’re ok.” He whispered.  

“你没事的。”他低声说道。

 

“I’m ok.” Remus said, fiercely, squeezing him back tightly. And he wanted to say

 

 it, oh god, he really really wanted to. But he had no energy left, so he just kissed him, and James was right there, and so was Mrs Potter, but it was the only thing Remus knew that could tell Sirius what he needed to tell him.  

“我没事。”雷穆斯坚定地说道，紧紧地抱住他。他想说出来，哦，天哪，他真的真的想说。但他没有力气了，于是他只是吻了他，而詹姆斯就在旁边，波特夫人也在，但这是雷穆斯知道的唯一能够告诉天狼星他需要告诉他的事。

 

He put the rage away, the terror, the guilt and the fierce need for revenge. There would be a time for it. But not yet.  

他将愤怒、恐惧、内疚和强烈的复仇欲望放在了一边。会有时候的。但不是现在。

 

Chapter 153: The War: Home Front 

Late summer, 1978

He rolled over for the hundredth time, the sheets sticking to his hot skin. He hadn’t felt right since the full moon. Maybe even since before then. He was sleeping only a few hours each night, and now it was almost four o’clock in the morning, and he hadn’t drifted off yet.

“Can’t sleep?” Sirius rolled over too.

“No.” Remus sighed, sitting up. “Sorry. I should go in the other room.”

“Please don’t.” Sirius said, rubbing his eyes, “It's fine, I’m up too now, I’ll keep you company.”

“I’m really not in the mood to talk.”

“That’s ok. I can talk, I’m always in the mood to talk.”

Remus smiled, though he didn’t want to. Bloody Black.

“Go on, then.” He murmured, lying back down slowly. His back hurt from the last full moon, and he’d rubbed some of Marlene’s ointment on there before bed, but it was wearing off already. Sirius rolled over onto his side, stretching an arm over Remus’s body and talking sleepily into his ear.

“I can’t wait for tomorrow,” he murmured, “I can’t wait for you to see the flat finally. I never had anywhere that was just mine before.”

“Me neither.” Remus replied, eyes closing.

Sirius had bought the flat the week before, while Remus was recovering from the full moon. It had been - of course - an impulse buy, but Remus thought that was ok, really - he had too much on his mind to be much help, and it was Sirius’s money, after all.

It was in London, and a muggle neighbourhood too. After the Potters’ initial surprise at the boys’ decision, Fleamont had insisted on ensuring that all of the standard security charms and alarms were in place before they were allowed to move in, so Remus hadn’t even seen it yet.

“Tell me what it’s like.” Remus said, turning into Sirius’s body, curling up. He didn’t make himself small very often - after all he was bigger than Sirius, and it seemed silly. But just now, sleep deprived and filled with anxiety, it felt nice to bury his face in Sirius’s night shirt.

“It’s small,” Sirius said, resting his chin on top of Remus’s head, “Just one bedroom, one bathroom, one kitchen.”

“Sounds massive.” Remus replied. He meant it. He’d never imagined living somewhere like that, not in a million years.

“We can have it however we want; furniture, wallpaper, anything.”

“I’ll leave the interior design up to you.”

“Fine. You can build the bookcases.”

“Bookcases?” Remus raised his head. He hadn’t thought of that.

“Yep, bookcases,” Sirius replied, a smile in his voice, “Space for the record collection too, obviously. And there are some garages nearby I might be able to rent…”

“We’re getting a car?!” Remus was a bit alarmed by this; he’d only just agreed to keep James’s old broom for travel on Order related business, he really didn’t fancy learning to drive too.

“Not a car…” Sirius said, evasively, “But I was just thinking… I mean, it would be really useful to have another means of transport.”

“There’s the tube.” Remus said, “Buses. London is actually sort of famous for them, y’know.”

“Yeah…”

“Have you already bought it?” Remus pulled away to see Sirius’s face.

“Er... “

“Sirius!”

“What?!” Sirius was grinning mischievously, “It’s an early birthday present to myself.”

“Your birthday isn’t for months!”

“Housewarming, then. I’ll get you something too!”

“Honestly,” Remus laughed, wrapping his arms around Sirius again, “You’re a liability. Spoilt brat.”

“Care home oik.” Sirius replied, laughing, his voice muffled by Remus’s shoulder.

They lay still and quiet for a little while, just like that.  

他们就那样静静地躺了一会儿。

 

Remus relaxed a bit, but he still wasn’t going to sleep. It would be light, soon, surely. Every now and then he thought he could hear a bird singing in the garden.  雷穆斯稍微放松了一点，但他仍然没有睡意。天很快就会亮了。时不时他以为自己能听到花园里有鸟儿在唱歌。Wouldn’t get that in London. Just rattling milk floats and bin lorries and buses hissing and maybe the odd pigeon.  在伦敦是听不到这些的。只有咣当作响的送奶车、垃圾车和嘶嘶作响的公交车，或许还有偶尔出现的鸽子。He couldn’t wait.  

He held Sirius a little tighter. They’d been hugging a lot, lately. Contact seemed vital; it reminded Remus he was human.

“Everything ok?” Sirius asked, quietly.

“Fine. Just can’t sleep.”

* * *

Remus had sort of expected to see his new flat for the first time alone with Sirius.  

雷穆斯本以为会和天狼星一起第一次看到他的新公寓。

 

How foolish of him; he had forgotten that even outside of Hogwarts Sirius and James came as a pair. And wherever James went, Peter and Lily typically went. So it ended up being the five of them catching the train into London the next morning.  

他真是傻了；他忘记了即使在霍格沃茨外，天狼星和詹姆斯也是一对。而无论詹姆斯去哪里，彼得和莉莉通常也会去。所以最后他们五个人第二天早上一起乘火车去了伦敦。

 

Sirius was buzzing with excitement, unable to sit still the whole way. He bounced about the carriage, ran down the escalators at Waterloo, and hopped from foot to foot on the underground platform.  

天狼星兴奋得不得了，整个路程都坐不住。他在车厢里来回蹦跳，在滑铁卢站的自动扶梯上跑来跑去，在地铁站台上脚步不停。

 

They were all in muggle clothes, and he was wearing his leather jacket, black jeans and combat boots. Remus liked to focus on these details, because if they were muggles then they weren’t at war today.  

他们都穿着麻瓜的衣服，天狼星穿着皮夹克、黑色牛仔裤和战斗靴。雷穆斯喜欢关注这些细节，因为如果他们是麻瓜，那么今天就不会在战争中。

 

The flat was off Leicester Square, in Chinatown. It was a seedy part of town, but that didn’t bother Remus, nor did it seem of any concern to Sirius.  

公寓在莱斯特广场附近的唐人街。这是一个破旧的地方，但这并没有困扰雷穆斯，似乎也不影响天狼星。

 

It was crowded and noisy, the smell of Chinese food and cigarettes and open drains permeating the air. The phone boxes were plastered with adverts for escorts, and they passed at least two peep show cinemas.  

这里人多嘈杂，空气中弥漫着中餐、香烟和下水道的气味。电话亭上贴满了陪游广告，他们经过了至少两家偷窥电影院。

 

“I love London.” Remus smiled to himself.  

“我爱伦敦。”雷穆斯对自己微笑道。

 

Sirius flashed him a grin.  

天狼星对他咧嘴一笑。

 

They entered their building through a door in the back alley of an off-licence, filing in one by one, Peter loudly remarking on how small everything seemed, and how strange muggles were.  

他们通过酒铺后巷的一扇门进入大楼，一个接一个地进入，彼得大声评论着一切看起来多么小，麻瓜多么奇怪。

 

Then up a short flight of stairs where they reached a concrete landing, with a bright yellow front door. Number 9.  

然后上了一段短短的楼梯，来到一个混凝土地板，上面有一扇亮黄色的前门。9号。

 

“Home!” Sirius said, as he jammed the key into the lock, beaming at them all.  

“家！”天狼星说着，把钥匙插进锁孔，笑着对他们说。

 

It was small. It was mundane, plainly furnished. It was basic. It was absolutely perfect.  

它很小。它很普通，布置简单。它很基本。它简直完美。

 

They stepped directly into the living room, which was very modern, with no entrance hall. There was a doorway to the left leading through to the kitchen, which was sunny and bright, a little window over the gleaming metal sink.  

他们直接走进客厅，非常现代，没有门厅。左边有一个通往厨房的门，厨房阳光明媚，闪亮的金属水槽上方有一扇小窗户。

 

Lily made a beeline for the fridge - she’d very sweetly brought a bottle of sparkling white wine to celebrate with.  

莉莉直奔冰箱——她非常贴心地带来了一瓶起泡白葡萄酒来庆祝。

 

Remus went back into the living room, and down a hallway where there were two doors - one was the bathroom - sixties green tile with pink porcelain fittings - the other was a bedroom.  

雷穆斯回到客厅，沿着走廊走，那里有两扇门——一扇是浴室——六十年代的绿色瓷砖和粉红色瓷器装饰——另一扇是卧室。

 

Two suitcases - the clothes they’d packed up and sent ahead - sat side by side by the wardrobe.  

两只行李箱——他们打包好并提前送来的衣物——并排放在衣柜旁。

 

The bed was there already, neatly made with a maroon blanket and throw. Not a four poster; no secretive dark hangings. Just a perfectly ordinary bed for two.  

床已经在那里了，整齐地铺着栗色的毯子和盖毯。不是四柱床；没有神秘的黑色帷幔。只是一个普通的双人床。

 

“Well?” Sirius asked, anxiously, entering the room behind him.  

“怎么样？”天狼星紧张地问，跟在他身后进了房间。

 

“I know it’s really muggle-ish, but I didn’t want to go overboard on the money… and it’s much easier to protect, Monty even had Moody advising on some of the shield enchantments…”  

“我知道这真的很麻瓜风格，但我不想在钱上花太多……而且更容易保护，蒙蒂甚至让穆迪建议了一些防护魔法……”

 

“It’s… great.” Remus nodded. He was so happy. He just smiled, staring around. “It’s…” there weren’t words.  

“这……很棒。”雷穆斯点点头。他很开心。他只是微笑着，四处张望。“这……”没有词语可以形容。

 

Luckily, Sirius was smiling too, watching him.  

幸运的是，天狼星也在笑着看着他。

 

“I always know it’s good when you don’t have something sarcastic to say,” he winked, “Come on, you barely looked at the living room!”  

“当你没有讽刺的话说时，我总是知道这很好，”他眨了眨眼，“来吧，你几乎没看客厅！”

 

Remus followed him back through. Lily was pouring out tumblers of sparkling white wine (“We should have got you proper wine glasses as a present!”), and they all toasted, cheering loudly.  

雷穆斯跟着他走了回来。莉莉正在倒起泡白葡萄酒（“我们应该送你们正规的酒杯作为礼物！”），他们都举杯欢呼。

 

“Mate, you’ve got to show me how that eclectic oven thing works,” James said, wide-eyed, “And the radar-eater.”  

“伙计，你得告诉我那个多功能烤箱是怎么用的，”詹姆斯瞪大了眼睛说，“还有那个雷达加热器。”

 

“Radiator.” Lily rolled her eyes, “Honestly, how did you get an Acceptable in Muggle Studies?!”  

“是散热器。”莉莉翻了个白眼，“说真的，你是怎么在麻瓜研究课上拿到及格的？！”

 

Peter was looking at the small brick fireplace, which was very out of place in the contemporary living room with its cream carpet and plastic venetian blinds.  

彼得正在看那个小砖壁炉，在这个有着奶油色地毯和塑料百叶窗的现代客厅里显得格格不入。

 

“Are you on the floo network, then?” he asked.  

“那你们在飞路网吗？”他问道。

 

“Yep,” Sirius nodded. “For Order stuff, obviously. And you lot. Moody’s made it untraceable. The whole flat is unplottable, too.”  

“是的，”天狼星点点头。“显然是为了凤凰社的事。还有你们。穆迪已经让它无法追踪了。整个公寓也是无法定位的。”

 

Remus couldn’t help feeling a bit put out by the fireplace. Even if it was essential, he didn’t like the idea that members of the order had access to their flat at any time of day or night. The thought of Alastor Moody’s head appearing in their living room made him shudder. Sirius, still watching Remus’s face carefully, gave him a nudge.  

雷穆斯不禁对壁炉感到有点不满。即使这是必要的，他也不喜欢凤凰社成员可以随时随地进入他们公寓的想法。想到阿拉斯托·穆迪的头出现在他们的客厅里让他不寒而栗。天狼星仍然在仔细观察雷穆斯的脸，轻轻推了他一下。

 

“I got something else, too,” he gestured to the couch.  

“我还有别的东西，”他示意沙发。

 

They all turned to look.  

他们都转头看去。

 

“You’ve got a telly-phone!” James suddenly yelled, almost spilling his drink in excitement as he pointed at the device sitting on an end table by the sofa.  

“你们有电话！”詹姆斯突然叫道，兴奋得差点洒了酒，指着沙发旁的桌子上的设备。

 

“Calm down!” Lily chastised.  

“冷静点！”莉莉责备道。

 

“A phone!” Remus stared at it, amazed. “Is it connected?”  

“电话！”雷穆斯惊讶地盯着它。“连上了吗？”

 

“Yep,” Sirius nodded, proudly, “Just pick it up and dial - so I don’t have to hang about outside phone boxes any more--”  

“是的，”天狼星骄傲地点点头，“只要拿起来拨号——这样我就不用再在电话亭外闲逛了——”

He was cut off, because Remus had practically knocked him over, throwing his arms around Sirius, and then - because after all, they were in their own home now, took his head in his hands and kissed him long and hard.  

他被打断了，因为雷穆斯几乎把他撞倒了，抱住了天狼星，然后——毕竟，他们现在在自己的家里，捧着他的头，长久而热烈地亲吻他。

Lily and James cheered again, Peter downed his drink and went to pour some more.  

莉莉和詹姆斯再次欢呼，彼得喝了他的酒，又去倒了一些。

* * *

“Still not in the mood to talk about it?”

“No.”

“Ok.” Sirius sighed a little. Then he moved his head against Remus’s shoulder, turning to kiss the softest part of his neck. Sirius’s hand slid down to Remus’s hip, slowly. “In the mood for anything else?”

 

“Do I look ok?” Sirius was peering at himself in the bathroom mirror. He kept buttoning and unbuttoning his shirt. “Should I wear a tie?”  

“我看起来怎么样？”天狼星在浴室的镜子里看着自己。他不停地扣上又解开衬衫的纽扣。“我应该戴领带吗？”

 

“No,” Remus laughed, standing behind him, pulling on a plain grey t-shirt over his damp hair. “Stop fussing, you look fine.”  

“不用，”雷穆斯笑着说，站在他身后，穿上一件灰色的T恤，头发还湿着。“别忙活了，你看起来很好。”

“Just fine?!”  

“只是很好？！”

“Sorry.” Remus replied, deadpan, “You look incredible.”  

“抱歉。”雷穆斯面无表情地回答，“你看起来太棒了。”

“Thank you.” Sirius smiled smugly at him through the mirror. “I just don’t want to let you down, I’ve never met anyone’s mum before.”  

“谢谢。”天狼星通过镜子得意地对他笑道。“我只是怕让你失望，我从没见过别人的妈妈。”

“What about Mrs Potter?”  

“那波特夫人呢？”

“The Potters don’t count, they’re like my own parents, I don’t need to impress them.”  

“波特家不算，他们就像我的父母，我不需要打动他们。”

“You’ll be standing next to me,” Remus shrugged on a cardigan to cover his arms, “She’ll be impressed.”  

“你会站在我旁边，”雷穆斯穿上开襟羊毛衫盖住手臂，“她会很满意的。”

“Don’t do that,” Sirius tutted, “I bet she thinks the sun shines out of your arse.”  

“别那样说，”天狼星啧了一声，“我敢打赌她认为你简直完美无缺。”

“Are you ready?”  

“你准备好了吗？”

“As I’ll ever be.”  

“尽量准备好了。”

 

They left the bathroom, making their way out of the flat. They had only been moved in for a week and a half, and there were still boxes everywhere, but it already felt like home to Remus. He loved the jangle of keys in his pocket; the sensation of closing the front door on the world; having a place to be himself completely. The cramped soho flat was nothing like as grand as Hogwarts, but already Remus liked it better than anywhere else he had ever lived.  

他们离开浴室，走出公寓。他们只搬进来一个半星期，箱子还到处都是，但雷穆斯已经觉得这里像家了。他喜欢口袋里钥匙的叮当声；喜欢关上前门时隔绝世界的感觉；喜欢有一个完全属于自己的地方。狭窄的苏荷公寓完全不像霍格沃茨那样宏伟，但雷穆斯已经比他住过的任何地方都更喜欢这里。

 

(Grant had put it best - Remus phoned him as soon as he had the chance - “A fixed address, eh? Blimey, we have moved up in the world.”)  

（格兰特说得最好——雷穆斯一有机会就打电话给他——“固定的地址，哎？天哪，我们在世界上已经上升了。”）

 

They apparated from the landing outside, which had become a habit; it was secluded enough that no one would see them. In mere moments they found themselves on a quiet residential road in Cardiff, where it was - of course - just starting to rain.  

他们从外面的楼梯间幻影移形出去，这已经成了习惯；那里足够隐蔽，没有人会看到他们。片刻之后，他们发现自己在卡迪夫的一条安静的居民街道上，当然，刚刚开始下雨。

 

“Sorry, should’ve warned you,” Remus laughed as Sirius yelped and scrambled to yank up his shirt to protect his hair, “Welsh summers aren’t much better than Scottish ones.”  

“抱歉，应该提醒你的，”雷穆斯笑着说，当天狼星尖叫着急忙拉起衬衫保护他的头发时，“威尔士的夏天并不比苏格兰的好多少。”

 

They made the short walk to the hospital quickly, and Remus led Sirius to Sparrow ward with much more confidence than that first time he’d met Hope. He smiled and gave a little wave to the nurse on duty, before walking to the end of the ward to see his mother.  

他们很快走到医院，雷穆斯比第一次见到霍普时更有信心地带领天狼星走向麻雀病房。他微笑着对值班护士挥了挥手，然后走到病房尽头去看他的母亲。

 

The curtain was drawn halfway across, so he peered around it first, to check if she was asleep. But no, she was sitting up in bed, flicking through a fashion magazine. He cleared his throat and she looked up. A huge smile spread across her thin face, showing every pearly tooth.  

窗帘拉了一半，所以他先绕过它，看看她是否睡着了。但没有，她正坐在床上，翻看着一本时尚杂志。他清了清嗓子，她抬起头来。她瘦削的脸上绽开了一个巨大的笑容，露出每一颗珍珠般的牙齿。

 

“Remus!”  

“雷穆斯！”

 

“Hi,” he said, ducking his head shyly and walking around to greet her.  

“嗨，”他害羞地低下头，走过去迎接她。

 

He kissed her lightly on the cheek. He’d done that three times now, having graduated up from her kissing his hand. Progress was slow, but every milestone felt enormous.  

他轻轻地亲了亲她的脸颊。他已经这样做了三次，从她亲他的手到现在。他们进展缓慢，但每一个里程碑都感觉巨大。

 

“I was hoping you’d come today!” She beamed, clutching his hand and looking him over as he folded himself into the orange plastic chair by her bed.  

“我希望你今天会来！”她笑着说，抓住他的手，打量着他，而他把自己折叠进床边的橙色塑料椅子里。

 

“Sorry it’s been so long,” he apologised, “I finished school, and then I moved… um. I’ve brought someone to meet you,” he glanced up at Sirius, still standing just behind the curtain, looking at Hope nervously. “Mum,” (second time he’d ever said that to her face), “This is Sirius Black.”  

“抱歉这么久才来看你，”他道歉道，“我毕业了，然后搬家了……嗯。我带了一个人来见你，”他抬眼看了一下天狼星，天狼星还站在窗帘后面紧张地看着霍普。“妈妈，”（这是他第二次当面这样叫她），“这是天狼星·布莱克。”

 

Sirius came around and stood at the end of the bed, hands in front of him. He looked like he was trying very hard not to fidget.  

天狼星走过来，站在床的尽头，双手放在前面。他看起来在努力不让自己坐立不安。

 

“Pleased to meet you, Ms Lupin,” he said, politely.  

“很高兴见到你，卢平女士，”他礼貌地说道。

 

She didn’t correct him on the name, only smiled benignly back at him,  

她没有纠正他的名字，只是和善地对他笑了笑，

 

“Hello, Sirius. Are you a friend of Remus’s from school?”  

“你好，天狼星。你是雷穆斯的同学吗？”

 

“That’s right,” he nodded.  

“是的，”他点点头。

 

“Sirius and I live together, in London.” Remus said, testing the water. He watched her face, but she was inscrutable. She could be an auror, no problem.  

“天狼星和我住在一起，在伦敦。”雷穆斯试探地说。他看着她的脸，但她无动于衷。她完全可以成为一个傲罗。

 

“Doesn’t that sound like fun,” she said, glassy eyed, “Your dad used to take me for trips to London, I loved a go on the double deckers.”  

“听起来很有趣，”她眼睛湿润地说，“你爸爸以前常带我去伦敦，我喜欢坐双层巴士。”

 

Ah. She was in the mood to talk about Lyall. These were far from Remus’s favourite visits, but he let her talk, because it seemed to make her happy. She started on a long and rambling story about all the times Lyall had taken her to London, where they’d seen all the sights, and then all of the various other places he had taken her - Edinburgh and Blackpool and Aberystwyth. Remus tried not to listen too hard. He didn’t want to start wondering whether Lyall would have taken them both to these places, if things had been different.  

啊。她有谈论莱

 

尔的心情了。这些远不是雷穆斯最喜欢的探望，但他让她说，因为这似乎让她开心。她开始讲述莱尔带她去伦敦的所有时候，他们看过的所有景点，以及他带她去的其他各种地方——爱丁堡、布莱克浦和阿伯里斯特威斯。雷穆斯尽量不听得太仔细。他不想开始思考如果事情不同，莱尔是否会带他们两人去这些地方。

 

Eventually, with Hope showing no sign of stopping, Remus gestured for Sirius to take a seat, and he dragged one over from the next bed, which was empty. As he settled in, Remus noticed the suitcase at the foot of the bed. It wasn’t usually there. Was she finally allowed to go home?  

最终，霍普没有停下来的迹象，雷穆斯示意天狼星坐下，他从隔壁的空床拖过来一把椅子。雷穆斯坐下后，注意到床脚的行李箱。它通常不在那。她终于可以回家了吗？

 

“...and I had my first ever curry in a little restaurant in Wembley…” she was saying now.  

“……我第一次在温布利的一家小餐馆吃咖喱……”她现在说着。

 

“We’re in Chinatown,” Remus said.  

“我们在唐人街，”雷穆斯说。

 

“Lovely.” She smiled, though she clearly had no idea where that was. She was growing increasingly childlike, he thought, must be the medication they had her on. It ought to have been annoying, but it actually helped him empathise with her. “And you’ll have your exam results soon, will you?”  

“真好。”她笑了笑，虽然显然不知道那是哪里。她越来越像个孩子了，他想，一定是他们给她吃的药。这本该让人烦恼，但实际上让他更能理解她。“你很快就会拿到考试成绩了，是吗？”

 

“We’ve had them,” Remus replied, “I passed everything.”  

“我们已经拿到了，”雷穆斯回答，“我全部通过了。”

 

“He came top in the school in three subjects,” Sirius said, out of the blue. “History, Care of Magical Creatures and Arithmancy - and top marks in everything else!”  

“他在三门学科中名列前茅，”天狼星突然说。“历史、神奇生物饲养学和算术——其他所有科目也都是最高分！”

 

Remus blushed. That wasn’t strictly true. Ok, he’d earned ‘Outstanding’ in most subjects, but he’d only got an ‘Exceeds Expectations’ in Transfiguration.  

雷穆斯脸红了。那并不完全属实。好吧，他在大多数科目上都得了“杰出”，但变形术只得了“超出预期”。

 

“That’s my clever boy,” she grinned dozily, “Just like his dad.”  

“那是我的聪明孩子，”她昏昏欲睡地笑着说，“就像他的爸爸。”

 

“Are you going somewhere, mum?” Remus asked, still bothered by the suitcase.  

“妈妈，你要去哪儿吗？”雷穆斯问道，仍被行李箱困扰。

 

“Oh yes,” she nodded, resting her head back against the pile of pillows propping her up, “Yes, I’m off to the hospice tomorrow.”  

“哦，是的，”她点点头，把头靠在支撑着她的一堆枕头上，“是的，我明天要去临终关怀医院。”

 

Remus’s insides turned ice cold. His throat went dry. No , he thought, no, I need more time .  

雷穆斯的内心变得冰冷。他的喉咙干涩。不，他想，不，我需要更多时间。

 

“Tomorrow?” He choked. She squeezed his hand again, her eyes sharpening,  

“明天？”他哽咽着说。她再次握紧他的手，眼神变得锐利，

“我准备好了，亲爱的。是时候了。”

 

“But…” he didn’t know what to say. He thought he might cry, but he didn’t want to upset her.  

“但是……”他不知道该说什么。他觉得自己可能会哭，但他不想让她难过。

 

Sirius looked confused. He didn’t know what it meant.  

天狼星看起来很困惑。他不知道这意味着什么。

 

“I’m making sure everything’s in order,” Hope said, matter-of-factly, suddenly sounding much more mature than usual, “If you leave me your address, I’ll make sure everything ends up where it ought to. And of course the funeral - I’ve told Gethin you’re to be notified as soon as possible, and that you’re sat at the front. Don’t let them put you at the back like some poor relation. You’re my son, and I’ve no shame at all, understand?”  

“我在确保一切都井井有条，”霍普平静地说，突然比平时成熟了许多，“如果你把地址给我，我会确保所有东西都到该去的地方。当然还有葬礼——我已经告诉了格辛，会尽快通知你，并让你坐在前排。不要让他们把你安排在后面像个可怜的亲戚。你是我的儿子，我毫无羞耻之心，明白吗？”
