Chapter 170: The War: Winter 1980 & Spring 1981 

Well I love you baby,

I'm telling you right here.

But please don't make me decide baby

Between you and a bottle of beer!

 

Baby come on over;

Come on over to my side.

Well I may not live past twenty-one

But WOO!

What a way to die!

 Sirius made Remus go straight to bed after the skirmish in Galloway. Ferox summoned Moody to the scene, and he excused them. Remus wanted to ask about Livia’s body - were they planning to bury her, at least? He didn’t know if Livia had had any wishes regarding her final resting place, but he assumed she’d prefer to be somewhere in nature; somewhere moonlight could reach her. Sirius在Galloway的冲突之后让Remus直接上床休息。Ferox召唤了Moody到现场，他为他们辩解。Remus想问Livia的尸体——他们打算埋葬她吗？他不知道Livia是否有关于她最后安息之地的任何愿望，但他猜她会希望被安置在自然之中；在月光能够照耀到的地方。

 

Marlene came over the flat on her way to work to sort out his broken arm. Marlene在上班途中过来修理他的断臂。

“Thanks, Marls,” he smiled weakly, “I can do dislocations no problem, but broken bones…” “谢谢，Marls，”他虚弱地笑了笑，“脱臼我没问题，但骨折就…”

“You really shouldn’t be doing spells on yourself, Remus,” she chided, “You know you can always contact me, if you need to.” “你真的不应该自己施放咒语，Remus，”她责备道，“你知道你可以随时联系我，如果你需要的话。”

“I know.” “我知道。”

She left a sleeping draught and some more of her own ointment for pain relief, and ordered him to stay in bed and do nothing useful or important for at least forty-eight hours. 她留下了安眠药和一些她自己制作的止痛药膏，并命令他至少在床上待四十八小时，不做任何有用或重要的事情。

It wasn’t until the next day, when Remus woke up after two in the afternoon, that he was suddenly gripped with terror at the memory of Greyback’s last words. 直到第二天，Remus在下午两点多醒来时，他突然被Greyback最后的话语吓坏了。

“He’s going to kill Ferox!” He shouted, sitting up in bed. “他要杀了Ferox！”他喊道，坐起身来。

Sirius came through from the living room, eyes wide with concern, “What?” Sirius从客厅走过来，眼中充满了担忧，“什么？”

“We need to find Greyback!” Remus said, climbing out of bed, limbs creaking, “He said he’d kill Ferox!” “我们需要找到Greyback！”Remus说，一边从床上爬起来，四肢吱嘎作响，“他说他会杀了Ferox！”

“Moony, it’s all taken care of,” Sirius said, placing cool hands on Remus’s shoulders, smoothing down his arms in a comforting gesture, “Ferox is going to move to a safe house, he’ll up his security and be extra vigilant, don’t worry.” “Moony，一切都处理好了，”Sirius说，把凉爽的手放在Remus的肩膀上，安抚性地抚摸他的胳膊，“Ferox会搬到一个安全屋，他会提高安全级别并更加警惕，不要担心。”

“It won’t be enough,” Remus shook his head, batting away Sirius’s attempts to calm him, “Moody and Ferox, they don’t treat Greyback like a proper threat - look at what happened! He’s more dangerous than they think, and now he’s angry…” “这还不够，”Remus摇摇头，打断了Sirius安抚他的尝试，“Moody和Ferox，他们没有把Greyback当成真正的威胁——看看发生了什么！他比他们想的更危险，现在他很生气…”

“I’m sure Moody knows that, even if Ferox is a bit cavalier about it.” Sirius said. He was being so diplomatic; so reasonable, it was infuriating. “我相信Moody知道这一点，即使Ferox对这事有点随意。”Sirius说。他非常圆滑、理智，这让人生气。“你感觉怎么样？我去泡水，你去洗个澡吧？你会感觉好一点的……”

Remus did take a bath, because his muscles still hurt. He slathered on a bit of poultice afterwards, which at least meant he could straighten up fully. He refused to rest. All he wanted to do was check on Ferox - make sure he had the right security in place. After all, wasn’t it Remus who’d been doing all the grunt work on protection charms? It was within his remit, surely. Remus确实洗了个澡，因为他的肌肉仍然疼痛。他之后涂抹了一些药膏，这至少让他可以完全伸直。他拒绝休息。他只想去检查Ferox——确保他有合适的安全措施。毕竟，是Remus一直在做保护咒语的繁重工作。这应该在他的职责范围内。

In the end, Sirius gave in and summoned Moody through the fireplace. The Auror’s grizzled head hovered in the flames like a hideous easter egg. 最后，Sirius妥协了，通过壁炉召唤了Moody。Auror那满是胡茬的头在火焰中悬浮，就像一个可怕的复活节彩蛋。

“All in hand, Lupin,” he barked, “You can stand down.” “一切都掌控之中，Lupin，”他厉声道，“你可以撤下了。”

“But Mad-Eye,” Remus pleaded, on his knees in front of the hearth, “Greyback will find him, I know he will, he’ll be able to follow the scent - if you just tell me where he is, then I can--” “但是Mad-Eye，”Remus在壁炉前跪下乞求，“Greyback会找到他的，我知道他会，他能够追踪气味——如果你告诉我他在哪里，那我可以——”

“Classified information.” Moody snapped. “Every precaution has been taken. You can trust that the Auror’s office can cope with a lone werewolf.” “机密信息。”Moody厉声道。“所有预防措施都已经到位。你可以相信Auror办公室能应付一个孤狼。”

Remus’s temper rose, and he was about to retort, but Moody signed off. “No time for this, Lupin, it’s been a busy week. Get some rest.” Remus的脾气上来了，他正要反驳，但Moody挂断了电话。“没时间讨论这个了，Lupin，这周很忙。去休息一下吧。”

Remus groaned furiously, slamming his fist on the rug. Remus愤怒地呻吟着，拳头重重地砸在地毯上。

“See?” Sirius said, standing behind him, “Moody’s got it all sorted.” “看？”Sirius站在他身后说，“Moody已经搞定了一切。”

“But I need to be sure,” Remus said, climbing to his feet, “They don’t understand, not really, not like…” “但我需要确认，”Remus说，站起来，“他们不明白，真的，不像…”

“Not like you do?” “不像你明白的那样？”

“Exactly!” “正是！”

“Remus,” Sirius’s voice hardened, out of nowhere, “You need to be careful with that kind of talk. I think… I think you ought to put a lid on the werewolf stuff, for a bit.” “Remus，”Sirius的声音突然变得严厉，“你需要小心这种言论。我认为……我认为你应该暂时放下那些‘狼人问题’。”

“What?” Remus turned to look at him, blindsided. “‘The werewolf stuff’!? What’s that supposed to mean? I am a werewolf.” “什么？”Remus转过身来盯着他，“‘狼人问题’！？那是什么意思？我就是狼人。”

“I know,” Sirius bit his lip, “But you’re a wizard too, and you’re on our side. It just might be a good idea to focus on something else, you don’t want anyone in the order to get the wrong end of the stick…” “我知道，”Sirius咬着嘴唇，“但你也是个巫师，你在我们这一边。专注于别的事情可能是个好主意，你不想让任何人在组织中误解你…”

Remus gaped at Sirius as if he was a complete stranger. Remus瞪着Sirius，好像他是个完全陌生的人。

“The wrong end of the stick…?” “误解…？”

“I’m not trying to upset you,” Sirius said, choosing his words carefully, “I’m only warning you - things are bad enough already, no one trusts anyone. Frank told me Dumbledore thinks there’s a spy in the Order, and if you keep bringing up how chummy you are with dark creatures then--” “我不是想让你不高兴，”Sirius说，选择着自己的词语，“我只是警告你——情况已经够糟糕了，没人信任任何人。Frank告诉我Dumbledore认为组织里有间谍，如果你继续提到你和黑暗生物关系密切的话……”

“I am not ‘chummy’ with dark creatures!” Remus shouted. “How can you… unless you’re saying I’m a dark creature too?!” “我和黑暗生物没有‘密切关系’！”Remus喊道。“你怎么能…除非你说我也是黑暗生物？！”

“Of course I’m not!” Sirius returned, clearly offended, “It’s just... you know how much prejudice there is, and it’s not going to do you any favours to broadcast this weird connection you have with them. I saw Livia, I saw Greyback, you’re nothing like them. Don’t let people think you are.” “当然不是！”Sirius反驳道，显然感到受了冒犯，“只是……你知道有多少偏见，把你和他们的这种奇怪联系公之于众对你没有好处。我见过Livia，也见过Greyback，你一点也不像他们。不要让人觉得你是那样的。”

“Has somebody said something?” Remus asked, wondering where this was coming from, “Was it Danny, or--” “有人说了什么吗？”Remus问，想知道这些话从何而来，“是Danny，还是——”

“No, it’s not… it’s… well, after you spent all that time with them, people have raised concerns, that’s all. You can understand that, can’t you?” “不，不是……就是……在你花了那么多时间和他们在一起之后，人们提出了一些担忧，仅此而已。你能理解的，对吧？”

“No I can’t! I was only with the pack because Dumbledore ordered it! Just like I’ve always done everything Dumbledore’s told me to!” “我不能理解！我只是因为Dumbledore的命令才和那个狼群在一起！就像我一直按照Dumbledore的要求做一切一样！”

“I know that…” Sirius looked away, as if embarrassed. “我知道……”Sirius看向别处，似乎感到尴尬。

He tucked a strand of hair behind his ear. Remus knew that gesture. Sirius was nervous. He clenched his jaw. 他把一缕头发塞到耳后。Remus知道这个动作。Sirius很紧张。他咬紧了牙关。

“Do you trust me?” He asked, knowing his body language was aggressive, but not willing to temper it. “你相信我吗？”他问，知道自己的肢体语言有些攻击性，但不愿意缓和。

Sirius looked up at him, blue eyes filled with alarm. Sirius抬头看着他，蓝色的眼睛充满了惊恐。

“Of course I do! It’s just…” His eyes fell again, another swish of hair, “You’ve always been good at keeping secrets, Moony…” “当然相信！只是……”他的目光再次落下，头发又一抹，“你一直擅长保守秘密，Moony……”

Remus’s mouth dropped open. He clenched his fists, then unclenched them. Remus张大了嘴巴。他握紧拳头，然后松开。

“Fine.” He said, coldly. “If that’s how you feel.” “好吧。”他说，冷冷地。“如果你这么觉得。”

He turned and walked out of the flat. Sirius didn’t try to stop him. 他转身走出了公寓。Sirius没有试图阻止他。

Remus went to the nearest corner shop first, and bought an extremely cheap and nasty bottle of gin. Then the problem was where to drink it. He didn’t want to look like an alkie, chugging hard spirits on the street in broad daylight. But then he didn’t really have anywhere else to go, either. Remus首先去了最近的便利店，买了一瓶极其便宜且恶劣的杜松子酒。然后问题是在哪里喝。他不想在大白天的街上看起来像个酒鬼，喝烈酒。但他也确实没有其他地方去。

He considered looking for Grant, but he didn’t know if he’d be working that day. Grant had moved back to London early in the spring, after too many times stuck on the late train back to Brighton. He was living in a bedsit somewhere north - but based on the telephone conversations they’d had, he rarely slept there. Grant had a string of paramours, and if he wasn’t attending a lecture he could usually be found bed hopping - or at work, in the Sawyer’s Arms pub. 他考虑找Grant，但他不知道Grant那天是否在工作。Grant早春时搬回了伦敦，因多次被困在回布赖顿的晚班火车上。他住在北边某个地方的一个小房间里——但根据他们的电话谈话，他很少在那里过夜。Grant有一系列情人，如果他不去听讲座，通常可以在换床之间找到——或者在Sawyer’s Arms酒吧工作。

“Variety is the spice of life,” he teased Remus, “And I’m crap on my own. Can’t hack the quiet.” “变化是生活的调味品，”他戏弄Remus，“我自己太差了。无法忍受寂静。”

Remus knew how that felt. A lot of the time it was the reason he drank. In the end, he decided he was too angry to be around anyone else, and went to hide in the park like a proper old waster. He ought to have gone to Grant’s, he thought, once he was properly drunk; that would serve Sirius right. Remus知道这种感觉。很多时候，这就是他喝酒的原因。最后，他决定自己太愤怒了，无法和其他人待在一起，于是像个真正的酒鬼一样去公园里藏身。他想，他应该去Grant那儿，等他彻底醉了；那样会让Sirius受罚。

He grieved for Livia, too; and made a silent toast. She’d been cruel, yes, and a murderer. But none of it had been her fault, really - not if you went back far enough. She’d been taken by Greyback before she was old enough to speak; when she was Harry’s age, maybe. Livia had no choice but to become a killer, any more than Remus had a choice about his drinking. 他也为Livia哀悼，并默默地举杯致敬。她曾经很残忍，是个杀人犯。但这些其实都不是她的错——如果你追溯得足够远的话。她在还没足够大到能说话之前就被Greyback带走了；也许是和Harry差不多大。Livia别无选择，只能成为一个杀手，就像Remus无法选择他的饮酒一样。

He went home eventually, when it got too cold. He hadn’t thought to bring a coat when he stormed out. Sirius was sitting on the couch, waiting for him, hands twisting anxiously in his lap. When Remus walked in, Sirius took one look at him, and - no doubt smelling the gin - shook his head, disappointed, and got up to make a pot of strong tea. 最终，他回了家，当天气变得太冷的时候。他在暴怒离开时没想到带上外套。Sirius坐在沙发上等他，双手焦虑地扭曲在膝上。当Remus走进来时，Sirius看了一眼他，毫无疑问闻到了杜松子酒的味道，摇了摇头，失望地站起来去泡一壶浓茶。

They didn’t say much, and they never spoke about ‘werewolf stuff’ again. 他们没有说太多话，也再没有提起过‘狼人问题’。

* * *

Remus did not celebrate Christmas 1980.

In fact, he did not see any of his friends, or Sirius, from the full moon, which fell on 21st December, until January. He spent it hiding in Moody’s cellar, with Danny McKinnon.

Ferox was dead.

Not just dead; destroyed; eviscerated. Ripped to pieces. According to the Daily Prophet, every wall of Ferox’s house was splattered with blood. Moody said that the carpet was so saturated it squelched under their feet - the Aurors who’d arrived on the scene. 不仅仅是死了；是被摧毁了；是被肠子撕裂的。撕成了碎片。根据《今日预言家》的报道，Ferox的房子的每面墙壁上都溅满了血。Moody说地毯已经被浸湿到脚下发出吱吱的声音——到场的傲罗们说的。

Greyback had made good on his promise, just as Remus had tried to warn them. But he couldn’t bring himself to say ‘I told you so’. He was too angry. Angrier still, when Moody told him he’d need to hide from the Ministry. Greyback兑现了他的承诺，就像Remus曾试图警告他们的那样。但他无法说出‘我早说过了’。他太生气了。更生气的是，当Moody告诉他需要躲藏在魔法部时。

Ferox’s murder spurred the wizarding public to demand a clampdown on werewolves. There were too many unregistered names; laws needed to be harsher; the register ought to be published. It was no longer safe - two days after Ferox’s death hit the headlines, a known werewolf, Theodora Lupa, was attacked in her home. She was fully registered, and had spent the full moon locked up in the cells at the Ministry, but her innocence meant nothing to the vengeful mob. Ferox的谋杀激发了巫师界公众要求对狼人进行打压的呼声。登记的名字太多了；法律需要更加严厉；注册名单应该公开。已经不再安全——在Ferox的死讯登上头条两天后，一位知名狼人Theodora Lupa在家中遭到了袭击。她已完全登记，并在魔法部的牢房里度过了满月，但她的清白对复仇的暴民来说毫无意义。

What was more, the Death Eaters appeared to be using the excuse to stir up more bias against magical creatures - it was understood that Voldemort himself was offering a reward for information on the locations of any ‘half-breeds’. 更糟糕的是，食死徒似乎利用这个借口煽动对魔法生物的更多偏见——据说伏地魔本人正在提供有关任何“半血种”的位置的信息奖励。

So Remus was forced to hide. 所以Remus被迫藏起来。

“I’ll miss Harry’s first Christmas.” He said stupidly, as he packed his suitcase. “我会错过Harry的第一个圣诞节。”他傻傻地说，同时打包他的行李箱。

“James and Lily will understand.” Sirius said. He was watching Remus from the bed, pale with terror. “We all just want you safe.” “James和Lily会理解的。”Sirius说。他从床上看着Remus，脸色苍白，充满恐惧。“我们都只是希望你安全。”

“I know.” Remus nodded. There was nothing more to say. “我知道。”Remus点了点头。没有什么更多要说的了。

They shared a chaste kiss goodbye. Things hadn’t been the same since Livia died, and news of Ferox’s hellish demise had turned Remus completely numb. 他们分享了一个纯洁的告别吻。自从Livia去世后，事情就再也不是一样的了，Ferox那地狱般的死讯让Remus彻底麻木。

Moody was not much of a host. He blindfolded Remus and made him side-along, so he had no idea where he was. He saw none of the house - if it was a house - but the whole place reeked of black magic, so heavy and thick Remus thought he’d choke on it. Moody并不是一个好东道主。他给Remus蒙上了眼罩，让他侧身跟着他走，所以他完全不知道自己在哪里。他没看到那房子——如果那是房子的话——但整个地方散发着黑魔法的气味，沉重而浓厚，Remus觉得自己快要窒息了。

In the cellar, his blindfold was removed, and it was a sorry sight. Danny sat on one rickety put-up bed, and there was another pushed back against the opposite wall. There were no windows, and the walls were bare brick. Moody had put aside some provisions - he explained that there were so many protection charms and cloaking spells on the cellar door that it took hours to enter or to leave, so it was best they just sat tight until he told them the coast was clear. 在地下室里，他的眼罩被摘掉了，场景十分悲惨。Danny坐在一张摇摇欲坠的临时床上，另一张床被推回到对面的墙边。没有窗户，墙壁是裸砖。Moody预留了一些生活必需品——他解释说地下室门上有太多的保护咒语和隐形咒语，进出都需要几个小时，所以最好还是耐心等待，直到他告诉他们一切安全。

Remus agreed, only because he knew that he could break the charms if he wanted. Remus同意了，仅仅因为他知道如果他愿意，可以打破那些咒语。

There was a little toilet at the back with a sink - no shower, so they’d have to do their best with a flannel and a bar of soap. The food was all dried stuff that didn’t need too much preparation, and besides that there was nothing at all. Remus was just glad he’d had the foresight to bring a few books. Not to mention the bottle of firewhisky he’d stashed just in case. 后面有一个小厕所，配有洗手池——没有淋浴，所以他们只能用毛巾和一块肥皂尽力清洁。食物都是干的，不需要太多准备，除此之外什么也没有。Remus很庆幸他有先见之明带了几本书。更不用说他藏起来的那瓶火威士忌，以备不时之需。

“Hi.” Danny said, dully. “嗨。”Danny无精打采地说。

“Hello.” Remus nodded, as Moody locked the door at the top of the stairs. “你好。”Remus点了点头，Moody在楼梯上锁上了门。

“This is shit, isn’t it?” “这真糟糕，不是吗？”

“Yeah.” Remus went over and set his suitcase beside his bed, then sat on it. It sagged heavily, and squeaked. A faint smell of mildew rose from it, which put him in mind of the Shrieking Shack. “是的。”Remus走过去，把他的行李箱放在床边，然后坐了上去。床垫沉重地下陷，发出吱吱的声音。床上散发出一股轻微的霉味，让他想起了尖叫的小屋。

“Never spent a Christmas away from my family.” Danny said. “Even when I was touring.” “从未在家人之外度过圣诞节。”Danny说。“即使在我巡演的时候也是如此。”

Remus nodded, glumly. He hadn’t had Christmas without Sirius in almost ten years. Remus沮丧地点了点头。他已经有近十年没有和Sirius一起过圣诞节了。

“Couldn’t believe it when I heard about Leo Ferox. He was so… I dunno, I just really thought he’d make it through the war. Did you er… know him well?” “听到Leo Ferox的事我简直不敢相信。他是那么……我也不知道，我只是非常相信他会活过这场战争。你呃……认识他吗？”

“He was my Care of Magical Creatures professor,” Remus offered. He wasn’t quite sure it had sunk in yet. He didn’t really feel very much, when he thought about Ferox; only a blurry sort of wistfulness. “他是我的神奇生物护理教授，”Remus提供道。他不太确定自己是否已经接受了这一点。想到Ferox时，他的感觉并不强烈；只是有种模糊的怀旧感。

“Oh wow,” Danny said, “Bet he was good at that.” “哇哦，”Danny说，“敢打赌他一定很擅长那个。”

“Yeah, he was,” Remus gave a small smile, “Had loads of good stories.” He suddenly remembered Achilles, Ferox’s kneazle - what had happened to it? He thought about Greyback, in full wolf form, coming across the sleek silver animal, and for the first time, his eyes filled with tears. “是的，他很擅长，”Remus露出一丝微笑，“有很多很棒的故事。”他突然想起了Achilles，Ferox的kneazle——它发生了什么事？他想到Greyback，全狼形态，遇到那只光滑的银色动物，眼睛第一次充满了泪水。

Bugger. Why did this have to happen now? He thought, as his shoulders began to shake and he tried to get himself under control. Why couldn’t I get emotional at the flat, when it was just Sirius? Sirius wouldn’t care if he cried. It was no good. He covered his face with his hands and just waited for it to stop. 真是糟糕。为什么现在非得发生这些事呢？他想，肩膀开始颤抖，努力控制自己。为什么我在公寓里时不能流露感情，那只是Sirius而已？Sirius不会在意他哭泣的。没有用。他用手捂住脸，只是等着这一切停止。

“Sorry, Remus,” Danny said, awkwardly. “I didn’t realise… he must have meant a lot to you.” “对不起，Remus，”Danny尴尬地说，“我没意识到……他一定对你很重要。”

That made Remus cry harder, because of course Ferox had meant a lot. He was Remus’s first crush (not counting David Bowie, maybe), even if Remus hadn’t fully understood it at the time. He was one of the first adults Remus trusted, who made him feel like a person with value. Maybe they’d clashed a bit, as Remus had grown up, but no one was perfect. 这让Remus哭得更厉害，因为Ferox当然很重要。他是Remus的初恋（也许不包括David Bowie），即使Remus当时并没有完全理解。他是Remus最早信任的成年人之一，让他觉得自己是一个有价值的人。也许他们在Remus长大过程中发生了一些冲突，但没有人是完美的。

“I’m sorry,” he coughed, wiping his eyes with his sleeve, “It’s been a bad year.” “对不起，”他咳嗽着，擦拭眼泪，“这是糟糕的一年。”

“You can say that again.” Danny said. “Oh, Marls says hello. You should’ve seen her when Moody came for me, she was all set to come along too.” “你说得对。”Danny说，“哦，Marls向你问好。你应该看看当Moody来找我的时候，她还准备一起来的。”

“Really?” Remus smiled, sniffing, “That sounds like her.” “真的吗？”Remus笑了，抽泣着，“那听起来像她。”

“Yeah, she said to give you a hug and a kiss, so tell her I did, ok?” “是的，她让我给你一个拥抱和吻，所以告诉她我已经做到了，好吗？”

“Ok,” Remus laughed, feeling a bit more normal. “好的，”Remus笑了，感觉稍微正常一点。

They pottered about a bit in their little living space. Remus tried not to think about the cell at St Edmund’s, or the Shrieking Shack, or the crypt in the forest - every cage he’d ever been forced into. He unpacked his clothes, then, finding nowhere to put them, re-packed them and slid his suitcase under the bed, leaving only his pyjamas out. 他们在小小的生活空间里闲逛了一会儿。Remus尽量不去想St Edmund’s的牢房，或尖叫的小屋，或森林中的地下室——他曾经被迫进入的每一个牢笼。他 unpack 了衣服，然后发现没有地方放它们，就重新打包，把行李箱滑到床下，只留下睡衣。

They had a little bit to eat - just some bread and cheese. Remus hadn’t eaten any meat since hearing about Ferox. 他们吃了一点东西——只是些面包和奶酪。自从听到Ferox的事后，Remus没有再吃肉。

“What were you going to do for Christmas, if you weren’t stuck here?” Danny asked, over supper. “如果你没有被困在这里，你打算怎么过圣诞节？”Danny在晚餐时问道。

“Spend it at the Potters.” Remus replied, “With the new baby.” “和Potters一起过。”Remus回答道，“还有那个新生儿。”

“Oh yeah, of course, you’re all mates, aren’t you,” Danny nodded. “Marlene talks about you all like you’re celebrities.” “哦，是的，当然，你们都是朋友，不是吗？”Danny点头说。“Marlene谈到你们时，就像你们是名人一样。”

“Ha.” Remus grunted. “Maybe James and Lily. And Sirius.” “哈。”Remus哼了一声。“也许James和Lily。还有Sirius。”

Danny cleared his throat awkwardly. Danny尴尬地清了清喉咙。

“Marls said you and he were…” “Marls说你和他……”

Remus just looked back at him, holding his gaze, allowing him to feel uncomfortable. Danny finally looked away, “Obviously that’s fine. I’m fine with Marlene and Yaz, aren’t I?” Remus只是看着他，盯着他，让他感到不舒服。Danny终于移开了视线，“显然这没问题。我对Marlene和Yaz没意见，不是吗？”

Remus just shrugged, Remus只是耸了耸肩，

“It’s a bit like being a werewolf,” he said, pulling the crust off his bread, “Everyone’s perfectly ‘fine’ with it, as long as you never bring it up.” “这有点像成为一个狼人，”他说，撕下面包的硬皮，“每个人都‘没问题’，只要你从不提起它。”

He had a few leftover cigarettes, and would have liked one after dinner, but for one thing, he didn’t want to share, and for another, there weren’t any windows and it seemed a bit rude to smoke the place out. God, he thought, this is going to be agony. 他还有几根剩下的香烟，本来想晚餐后抽一根，但一方面他不想分享，另一方面，这里没有窗户，抽烟会让地方变得有点不礼貌。天啊，他想，这将是折磨。

Things got even more awkward when it came time for bed. They were both yawning, and agreed it was quite late, and that they were tired. Remus began to take his socks off, and stood up to unbutton his trousers, when he realised Danny had not moved. He couldn’t see why he was so shy; didn’t quidditch players get undressed in front of each other all the time? James had been a borderline exhibitionist in the dorm room at Hogwarts. And surely Danny couldn’t be shy about scars; Remus had heaps more than him. 上床睡觉时情况变得更加尴尬。他们都打着哈欠，认为已经很晚了，都很疲倦。Remus开始脱掉袜子，站起来解开裤子的扣子时，他意识到Danny还没有动。他看不出为什么他会这么害羞；难道魁地奇选手不总是在彼此面前脱衣服吗？James在霍格沃茨的宿舍里曾经是个边缘的展示狂。Danny肯定不会对伤疤感到害羞；Remus的伤疤比他多得多。

“Close quarters.” Remus commented, hoping to put Danny more at ease. “狭小的空间。”Remus评论道，希望让Danny感到更加舒适。

Danny twisted his mouth, eyes flicking up and down Remus’s height. Danny扭了扭嘴，眼睛上下扫视着Remus的身高。

“Er… Just so you know, it’s not like I’ve got a problem with it… with you. But I don’t swing that way.” Danny eyed him warily. “呃……只是让你知道，我并不是说我对这件事……对你有问题。但我并不那样。”Danny警惕地看着他。

Remus rolled his eyes. Remus翻了个白眼。

“Oh, poor me, whatever will I do?” He drawled, then turned his back and got into his pyjamas. “哦，可怜的我，我该怎么办？”他拖长音调地说，然后转过身穿上了睡衣。

He climbed into bed and rolled onto his side, facing the wall, to prove that he couldn’t care less which way Danny ‘swung’. Have you seen my boyfriend?! He wanted to say. As if I’d be interested in you, you big lump. 他爬上床，侧身躺下，面朝墙壁，以证明他不在乎Danny‘倾向’哪一边。你见过我的男朋友吗？！他想说。好像我会对你感兴趣，你这大块头。

Eventually, Danny undressed and got into bed too, then flicked out the light. Remus could hear his heart beating, and realised that Danny could probably hear his, too. They had even less privacy than they thought. 最终，Danny也脱掉衣服上了床，然后熄灭了灯。Remus能听到他的心跳，意识到Danny也许能听到他的心跳。他们的隐私比他们想象的还要少。

“Sorry, Remus.” Danny whispered, eventually, “I didn’t mean anything by it.” “对不起，Remus。”Danny最终低声说，“我并没有恶意。”

That echoed something Ferox had said, and Remus felt the sadness return. He rolled onto his back, and spoke to the ceiling, “It’s ok. Forgotten.” 这让Remus想起了Ferox说过的话，他感到悲伤再次袭来。他翻身仰躺，对着天花板说，“没关系。已经忘记了。”

Quiet for a while. Remus waited, hearing Danny poised on the cusp of a question. 安静了一会儿。Remus等待着，听到Danny在准备问问题。

“Did he always know?” Danny whispered. “Sirius?” “他一直知道吗？”Danny低声问道，“Sirius？”

“Hmm?” Remus squinted over at him. “嗯？”Remus眯着眼看向他。

“You know. Did he always know you were a werewolf?” “你知道的。他一直知道你是个狼人吗？”

“Oh. Yeah - mostly. He worked it out, when we were twelve or something.” “哦。是的——大部分是。他在我们十二岁左右的时候就明白了。”

“And he still… I mean you still got together.” “他仍然……我的意思是你们仍然在一起。”

“Yeah.” “是的。”

“That’s good.” Danny said, sounding very earnest, “It’s nice to think… to think someone might be able to look past it, one day, you know?” “这很好。”Danny说，声音很真诚，“想到……想到有一天可能有人能够超越这个，真的很好，你知道吗？”

“It shouldn’t be something people have to look past in order to love you.” Remus said, fiercely, “It’s part of who you are.” “这不应该是人们必须忽视的东西才能爱你。”Remus激烈地说，“这是你的一部分。”

Danny didn’t reply. Danny没有回答。

Things got a bit easier between them, after the first night, but they kept each other at a distance anyway. Remus did a lot of reading. Danny sometimes exercised, doing press ups or jogging on the spot. It was annoying, but Remus couldn’t blame him. 他们之间的关系在第一晚之后变得稍微容易了一些，但他们仍然保持一定距离。Remus读了很多书。Danny有时锻炼，做俯卧撑或原地跑步。虽然很烦人，但Remus不能怪他。

On Christmas day, Remus couldn’t take it any more, and whipped out the bottle of fire whisky. They both got extremely drunk, and spent all of Boxing Day hungover. The room stank. 圣诞节那天，Remus再也忍不住了，拿出了火威士忌。他们俩都喝得醉醺醺的，整个节礼日都在宿醉。房间里满是恶臭。

By the 27th, they were climbing the walls. Remus had finished his books - Danny had even read one of them, and they’d tried to have a conversation about it, but Danny knew so little about muggles that he hadn’t really understood the plot. 到了27号，他们都快发疯了。Remus读完了他的书——Danny甚至读了一本，他们尝试过讨论一下，但Danny对麻瓜了解得太少，根本没真正理解情节。

“How much longer can it be?!” Danny said, exasperated. It was the 31st, the last day of the year. “What if we’re still here for the full moon?!” “还要多久？！”Danny气喘吁吁地说。今天是31号，年的最后一天。“如果我们还在这里等满月怎么办？！”

“That’s weeks away.” Remus replied. He was lying on his back on his bed, an arm slung over his face. Danny snored, and kept him up all night. “Anyway, we’d be fine, best place for us.” “那还要几周。”Remus回答道。他躺在床上，一只手搭在脸上。Danny打鼾，把他整夜都吵醒了。“反正我们会没事的，这对我们来说是最好的地方。”

“What if we attack each other?” “如果我们互相攻击怎么办？”

“Well, I won’t attack you if you don’t attack me.” “嗯，如果你不攻击我，我也不会攻击你。”

“You mean you can control it?!” “你的意思是你能控制它？！”

Remus sighed. Remus叹了口气。

“Yeah. You can too. Not around humans, but other animals. Other wolves, it’s fine. Why’d you think they live in packs?” “是的。你也可以。不在人类周围，但其他动物可以。其他狼没问题。你为什么觉得它们会群居？”

“I never really thought.” Danny said. “What was it like? The pack?” “我从未真正考虑过。”Danny说。“群体是什么样的？”

Remus bit his lip. Should he lie? Or did Danny deserve to know? Remus咬了咬嘴唇。他应该撒谎吗？还是Danny应该知道？

“It… wasn’t as bad as I thought it would be.” He said. That was the first time he’d admitted it. “Obviously Greyback was… but the rest of them. The ones who split off - they were ok. They were like family.” “这……并没有我想象的那么糟。”他说。这是他第一次承认这一点。“显然Greyback很糟，但其他人。那些分裂出去的人——他们还好。他们像家人一样。”

“Well.” Danny said. “I’ve got a family already.” “嗯。”Danny说。“我已经有了一个家庭。”

That was how it went, with Danny. He wanted to know things - he wanted to learn from Remus, but if he heard anything that made him uncomfortable it was right back to self-loathing. 事情就是这样发展下去的，和Danny。他想了解一些事情——他想向Remus学习，但如果他听到让他不舒服的东西，他会立刻回到自我厌恶中。

Remus missed Sirius so much he swore he could feel it in his gut like hunger. He wanted so desperately to have someone he could really talk to; what a relief it would be to spend time with his best friend, to relax. I’ll apologise, he promised himself, I’ll never get angry at him again. I’ll kiss his feet and crawl over hot coals and broken glass if it’ll get things back the way they were. Remus非常想念Sirius，他发誓自己能在内心深处感受到这种痛苦，像饥饿一样。他非常渴望有一个可以真正交谈的人；能和最好的朋友一起度过时光，放松一下将是多么大的解脱。我会道歉，他对自己承诺道，我再也不会对他生气了。如果这能让一切回到原样，我会亲吻他的脚，跪过炭火和破碎的玻璃。

He didn’t want to end up like Danny. 他不想变得像Danny一样。

 

They were a week into the new year by the time Mad Eye finally came for them. They both caught his scent at once, and sat up, keenly staring at the door. They’d almost run out of food by then, and Remus prayed this wasn’t just a grocery delivery. He felt the charms being slowly undone, each layer peeling back. Finally, the door swung open, and the clunk of Moody’s wooden leg on the first stair. 终于，Mad Eye来找他们时，他们已经过了一周的新年。他们立刻闻到了他的气味，坐了起来，专注地盯着门。到那时，他们几乎把食物吃光了，Remus祈祷这不是仅仅一次杂货送货。他感受到护符被慢慢解开，每一层都被剥离。最后，门打开了，Moody木腿在第一阶梯上的碰撞声。

“All right, boys?” He called. “Ready to get back to work?”

* * *

Coming out of that cellar was like coming up for air. Remus felt as though all of his senses had been muted for weeks, and now everything was a riot of colour and noise and scent.

Coming out of that cellar was like coming up for air. Remus felt as though all of his senses had been muted for weeks, and now everything was a riot of colour and noise and scent. 从那个地窖里出来就像是浮出水面一样。Remus感觉到自己的所有感官似乎已经被静音了几个星期，现在一切都是色彩和噪音的狂欢。

Moody wasn’t joking about getting back to work. He took them straight to a new safehouse, where the rest of the order were gathering for a meeting. Remus could smell Sirius as soon as he got in the door, and it made him so giddy with excitement that if he’d had a tail it would have been wagging. He ran his fingers quickly through his greasy hair, and thought about how awful he must look. Moody并不是在开玩笑要回到工作中。他直接带他们去了一个新的安全屋，其他成员正在那里开会。Remus一进门就闻到了Sirius的气味，这让他兴奋得几乎要摇尾巴。他迅速用手指梳理了一下油腻的头发，想着自己看起来该有多糟糕。

Moody led them down a corridor and - rather than going straight through to the kitchen, where they could hear everyone talking - veered into a small utility room, which had a muggle washing machine inside and a big pile of dirty towels in a basket. Moody带他们走过一条走廊，然后——而不是直接去厨房，在那里他们可以听到所有人的谈话——转向一个小储物室，里面有一台麻瓜洗衣机和一个篮子里的大堆脏毛巾。

“I’m bringing you through in a minute,” he explained, “Ms McKinnon’s been harassing me every day for the past two weeks to have you back, and Black’s threatened me with every curse I’ve ever heard of,” he smirked indulgently. “So you’re out now, but I need you both to listen, right?” “我马上带你们进去，”他解释道，“McKinnon小姐这两周每天都在骚扰我，让我把你们带回来，Black还用我听过的每一个咒语威胁我，”他带着宠溺的笑容说道。“所以你们现在可以出来了，但我需要你们都听着，好吗？”

“Right.” They both nodded, blinking. “好的。”他们俩点了点头，眨了眨眼。

“The danger hasn’t passed. You’re still under threat. I can’t have either of you leaving your homes without a disguise. I’d rather you didn’t leave at all.” “危险还没有过去。你们仍然受到威胁。我不能让你们没有伪装地离开你们的家。我宁愿你们根本不要离开。”

“But how can we help the Order if--” “但如果我们不离开，我们怎么帮助 Order 呢——”

“There’s plenty you can do,” Mad-Eye raised a hand of warning, fixing Remus with a hard look, “Research, communications, tracking spells, what have you. Unless you were enjoying your cosy little break in my cellar?” “你们可以做很多事情，”Mad-Eye举起一只警告的手，严厉地看着Remus，“研究、通讯、追踪咒语等等。除非你们喜欢在我的地窖里度过你们舒适的小假期？”

They both shook their heads fiercely. No. Never. 他们俩猛烈摇头。不。绝对不。

“Right then.” Moody nodded, business-like again. “Come on, then,” he pushed the door open and their filed out, following him to the kitchen. It was crowded with people, most of whom Remus knew, and they all turned as soon as the door opened, fifty pairs of eyes, all wide with mistrust and worry. “那么好了。”Moody点了点头，又恢复了商务模式。“来吧，”他推开门，他们跟着他走向厨房。那里挤满了人，大多数Remus都认识，一旦门打开，他们都转过身来，五十双眼睛都充满了不信任和担忧。

“DANNY!” A blonde blur rushed past Moody and Remus and body-slammed Danny, winding him. He chuckled and hugged Marlene back, “All right, sis?” “DANNY！”一个金发的模糊影像从Moody和Remus身边冲过来，撞倒了Danny，让他喘不过气来。他笑了，回抱住Marlene，“怎么样，姐姐？”

“Remus?” Sirius had stood up, and was crossing the room anxiously, climbing over chairs and squeezing past people who had to bend and twist out of the way, snatching back mugs of hot tea. He had to look down as he approached, so he didn’t trip, and his hair fell in front of his face, swaths of black silk. “Remus？”Sirius站起来了，焦急地穿越房间，越过椅子，挤过那些不得不弯腰和扭曲身体让路的人，拿回热茶的杯子。他走近时不得不低头，以免绊倒，头发垂在脸前，黑色丝绸般的头发。

As he reached Remus, who was still standing half in the hallway, Sirius had to raise his arm and sweep his hair back, and Remus swore the room went completely silent for a moment, and the only sound was the frantic thudding of his own heart. He forgot to breathe, and gasped, “Hi.” 当他走到仍然站在半个走廊里的Remus面前时，Sirius不得不抬起手臂把头发扫到一边，Remus发誓房间瞬间完全安静下来，唯一的声音是他自己心跳的急促。他忘记了呼吸，喘息道，“嗨。”

Sirius smiled a little, and stepped forward, a hand on Remus’s shoulder to push him out of the room, into the dark hallway. Away from everyone else, Sirius slid his hand up Remus’s neck, into his hair, and kissed him on the lips - so beautifully. Sirius微微笑了，向前迈了一步，一只手放在Remus的肩膀上，把他推向房间外，进入黑暗的走廊。离开其他人后，Sirius滑动着手抚上Remus的脖颈，进入他的头发中，亲吻了他的嘴唇——如此美丽。

Spring 1981

The honeymoon period after Remus’s hiding lasted well into February. Both of them were so apologetic, and so grateful to be together again, that for a while everything was wonderful - they were like teenagers again. Especially because Remus wasn’t supposed to leave the flat, which meant that there really wasn’t a lot else to do. Remus隐藏后的蜜月期一直持续到2月。两人都非常抱歉，并且非常感激能再次在一起，因此一段时间一切都很美好——他们就像青少年一样。尤其是因为Remus不应该离开公寓，这意味着真的没有很多其他事情可以做。

Sirius popped over to check on James and Lily and the baby every now and then, and he still had missions to go on - but he always rushed back to Remus as soon as he could. They spent days and evenings lounging in bed together, eating beans on toast and smoking and playing records. It was like living on a private island - they’d even had to cut off the floo connection for safety’s sake. Sirius时不时去看James、Lily和宝宝，他仍然有任务要去完成——但他总是尽快回到Remus身边。他们整天整晚一起躺在床上，吃烤豆吐司，抽烟，听唱片。这就像生活在一个私人岛屿上——他们甚至为了安全起见不得不切断了传送门。

Luckily, Remus was allowed to keep the telephone, his lifeline, and the others came over when they could. Mary visited on her way back from work at least twice a week, to avoid her noisy family. 幸运的是，Remus被允许保留电话，这是他的生命线，其他人也会尽可能地过来。Mary至少每周在下班回家的路上来访两次，以避开她吵闹的家人。

“It's bliss, over here,” she smiled, sinking into the couch and closing her eyes. “If you had a telly I’d never leave.” “这里真是太幸福了，”她笑着，沉入沙发，闭上了眼睛。“如果你有电视的话，我会永远留下来。”

“Ha, I’m working on it, trust me.” Remus replied. “Is it really bad at yours? Do you want to stay over a few nights?” “哈，我在想办法，相信我。”Remus回答道。“你那边真的很糟糕吗？你想在这里多待几晚吗？”

“Nah,” she opened her eyes, “I want to be with my family. They keep me normal. It's just… you know, they don’t know anything about the war - I don't want them to know, but… it’s so hard.” “不，”她睁开眼睛说，“我想和家人在一起。他们让我保持正常。只是……你知道，他们对战争一无所知——我不想让他们知道，但……这真的很难。”

“Sorry, love.” Remus said, wistfully. “Want a drink?” “对不起，亲爱的。”Remus惆怅地说，“想喝点酒吗？”

Mary gave him one of her long, gentle looks, tilting her head. “No, Remus,” she touched his knee, “It's never a good idea to drink when you feel like this. It doesn’t make things better, does it?” Mary给了他一个温柔的长时间的目光，倾斜着头。“不，Remus，”她摸了摸他的膝盖，“在这种情况下喝酒从来不是一个好主意。这并不会让事情变得更好，对吗？”

Remus just shrugged. He didn’t see what the big deal was. Mary just smiled again, and took a sip of her tea, and continued as if nothing had happened. Remus只是耸了耸肩。他看不出问题在哪里。Mary又笑了笑，喝了一口茶，然后继续说话，就像什么也没发生过一样。

“Anyway, I can always pop to Darren’s if I need a break from the kids.” “反正，如果我需要休息一下，我可以随时去Darren那里。”

“Darren? That kid you were going out with in fourth year?” “Darren？那个你在四年级时交往的孩子？”

“Well remembered,” she laughed, “Yeah, he still lives across the hall. I go over sometimes, we’re friends.” “记得很清楚，”她笑了，“是的，他现在仍然住在对面。我有时会过去，我们是朋友。”

“Just friends?” Remus raised an eyebrow. Mary looked down, suddenly sad. “只是朋友？”Remus挑了挑眉。Mary低下头，突然显得伤心。

“Yeah. That's all it can be, right now. He's a muggle, I’m in the Order… I’m already putting my family at so much risk, I couldn't bear if…” “是的。现在只能这样。他是个麻瓜，我在Order中……我已经把我的家人置于如此大的危险中，如果……”

She shook her head, her face resolute. “Sorry! I’m supposed to be here keeping you company, not bringing you down!” 她摇了摇头，脸上露出坚定的神情。“对不起！我应该在这里陪伴你，而不是让你沮丧！”

 

She still didn’t want to drink after that, but they had a nice long chat anyway. In hindsight, Remus would be glad that Mary was there that night, and that she stopped him getting drunk. Because that was the night James got hurt. 她之后仍然不想喝酒，但他们还是聊了很久。事后看来，Remus会很高兴Mary那晚在场，并且阻止了他醉酒。因为那晚James受了伤。

 While Mary and Remus sat on the cosy couch in the little Soho flat, curtains drawn over the dark windows, fireplace crackling, Sirius, Lily and James were in mortal peril. 当Mary和Remus坐在小小的Soho公寓里的舒适沙发上，窗帘拉得严严实实，火炉发出噼啪声时，Sirius、Lily和James正处于生死危险之中。

This passed for a normal Friday night, in those days. By now everyone had developed a fatalistic attitude to life, and a kind of gallows humour. “See you, later,” Sirius would say, leaving the house, “If I make it.” 在那段日子里，这算是一个正常的星期五晚上。到现在为止，每个人都对生活抱有一种宿命论的态度，还有一种绞刑架式的幽默感。“再见了，”Sirius会在离开家时说，“如果我活下来。”

“Meet you at home,” James would tell Lily, “If it’s still there!” “在家见，”James会告诉Lily，“如果家还在的话！”

It helped everyone get through it, at the time - after all, if you said the worst thing out loud, it couldn't hurt as much, could it? The thought tortured Remus for a long time after the war was over. 这样帮助了大家度过那段时光——毕竟，如果你把最坏的事说出来，它也不会那么伤人，对吧？这个想法在战争结束后折磨了Remus很久。

They were only supposed to be on a routine patrol - in Diagon Alley, which made Remus feel better because it was so close by. There were three of them, and they would be checking in with a senior Order member at the start and finish, so it should have been business as usual. In fact, Mary was about to leave Remus and go home for the night - when there was a hammering on the door. 他们本来只应该是在例行巡逻——在Diagon Alley，这让Remus感觉好些，因为那儿离得很近。他们三个人，会在开始和结束时向一位高级Order成员报告，所以应该一切照常。实际上，Mary正打算离开Remus，回家过夜——这时门上传来了锤击声。

They both jumped, and Mary let out a strange squeak of terror. Then the door began to open, and they both stood, wands raised, Remus covering as much of Mary as he could. 他们俩都吓了一跳，Mary发出了奇怪的恐惧尖叫。然后门开始打开，他们俩站了起来，举起魔杖，Remus尽可能地遮住Mary。

“Help!” A muffled voice came, and Sirius and Lily pushed their way into the flat, James’s limp form sagging between them, an arm over each of their shoulders. “救命！”一个模糊的声音传来，Sirius和Lily挤进了公寓，James的无力身体垂在他们之间，两人各自搭着他的一只肩膀。

“Christ!” Remus started forward to help, and between them all they got him onto the couch. “What happened?!” “天啊！”Remus向前走去帮助他们，大家一起把James放到沙发上。“发生了什么事？！”

“Remus,” Mary choked, her wand still raised, hand trembling, “The questions…” “Remus，”Mary哽咽着说，魔杖仍然举着，手在颤抖，“问题……”

“Right, fuck, ok, um…” His mind was racing, he couldn’t stop staring at James’s face, pallid and waxy, gleaming with sweat. He looked at Lily, “What did… um.. Who…?” “好的，该死的，呃……”他的脑袋飞快旋转，他无法停止盯着James那苍白蜡黄、汗光闪烁的脸。他看向Lily，“你……呃……谁……？”

“Lily, who was your first kiss?” Mary stepped in, quickly. “Lily，你的第一次吻是谁？”Mary迅速插话道。

“Dirk Cresswell.” Lily said, promptly. Sirius and Remus both gave her a funny look, but there was no time to make a fuss. “Dirk Cresswell。”Lily立即回答道。Sirius和Remus都给了她一个奇怪的眼神，但没时间去制造麻烦了。

“Sirius,” Mary said, redirecting her wand, “Same question.” “Sirius，”Mary说，重新调整了她的魔杖，“同样的问题。”

“I don't know!” Sirius said, exasperated, pulling away James’s robes - there wasn’t any blood, but James’s eyes were closed, the lids deep purple, “One of you go and get McKinnon!” “我不知道！”Sirius恼怒地说，拉开James的袍子——没有血迹，但James的眼睛闭着，眼睑呈深紫色，“你们中的一个去找McKinnon！”

“What do you mean you don’t know?!” Mary rounded on him, “Answer the bloody question, Black!” “你什么意思不知道？！”Mary对他大吼，“回答该死的问题，Black！”

“I can’t, I really don’t know! It was some muggle girl in a cinema! Moony, tell her!” “我不能，我真的不知道！是一个麻瓜女孩在电影院里！Moony，告诉她！”

“He’s telling the truth,” Remus said, his throat dry, “He is, we got into a fight over it. I punched him.” “他说的是真的，”Remus喉咙干涩地说，“他说的是真的，我们为此打了起来。我打了他。”

“Punched you back,” Sirius muttered, scanning James with his wand. “Get Marlene?! Please!” “打回你了，”Sirius嘟囔着，用魔杖扫描James。“去找Marlene？！拜托！”

“I’ll do it,” Mary said, backing out of the room, quickly. The door slammed and they heard a CRACK as she disapparated from the landing. “我来做，”Mary说，快速退回房间外。门猛地关上，他们听到了一声啪嗒，她从楼梯间消失了。

Lily came hurrying in from the bathroom, clutching a damp flannel. She knelt beside James and pressed it to his forehead, Lily从浴室急匆匆地跑进来，捏着一块湿润的毛巾。她跪在James旁边，把毛巾贴在他的额头上，

“Don’t you dare, Potter,” she whispered feverishly into his ear, “Don’t you bloody dare…” “不要这样，Potter，”她急切地在他耳边低语，“你绝对不要这样……”

“What happened?” Remus grabbed Sirius’s shoulder, “An attack?” “发生了什么？”Remus抓住Sirius的肩膀，“是袭击吗？”

“Yeah,” Sirius nodded, sweating and shaking. Remus wished he would sit down, but he knew there was no point saying so, “Ambush. Six death eaters. Someone must have known we’d be there, someone must have told…” “是的，”Sirius点头，满头大汗，浑身发抖。Remus希望他能坐下来，但他知道说也没用，“埋伏。六个食死徒。一定有人知道我们会在那里，一定有人告诉了他们……”

“Sirius!” Lily shrieked, “Look!” “Sirius！”Lily尖叫道，“看！”

She had loosened James’s shirt, and revealed long green coloured streaks, like tree branches stretching out beneath his skin. His breathing was shallow. 她松开了James的衬衫，露出了长长的绿色条纹，就像树枝伸展在他皮肤下。他的呼吸很浅。

“Oh fuck,” Sirius crumbled, falling to his knees beside Lily, “Did you hear what the curse was?” “哦，天呐，”Sirius崩溃了，跪在Lily旁边，“你听到这个诅咒是什么了吗？”

Lily shook her head, tears streaking down her face. James’s breathing grew laboured, rasping in his throat, and he was limp as a rag doll. Lily摇摇头，眼泪顺着脸颊流下。James的呼吸变得困难，喉咙里发出喘息声，他的身体像一只破布娃娃一样软绵绵的。

Remus’s heart began to rattle in his chest, his vision swam and his knees went weak. Not James! He was the very best of them. He was the one who had to make it, no matter what. How could there be a world without James Potter? You might as well picture a world without kindness, or laughter, or mischief. Remus的心开始在胸口剧烈地跳动，他的视线模糊，双腿也变得无力。不是James！他是他们中最优秀的。他是必须活下来的，无论如何。世界怎么能没有James Potter？你不如想象一个没有善良、笑声或顽皮的世界。

“Firewhisky.” Remus said, suddenly, “I’ve got a bottle somewhere.” “火威士忌。”Remus突然说道，“我这里有一瓶。”

“Not now, Moony!” Sirius snapped, his face jagged as a demon’s. Remus recoiled, hurt, “I meant for Prongs! It might help the shock.” “现在别说了，Moony！”Sirius厉声道，他的脸如恶魔般扭曲。Remus后退，受了伤，“我是给Prongs准备的！可能会对冲击有帮助。”

“Try it!” Lily wailed, lifting the cold flannel on James’s forehead to feel his skin. Remus could tell from a metre away that he had a temperature. “Try anything!” “试试！”Lily悲声道，抬起在James额头上的冰冷毛巾去触摸他的皮肤。Remus从一米外就能看出他发烧了。“试试任何东西！”

Remus ran, and while he was in the kitchen looking for a wooden spoon (he’d heard that metal was bad for someone having a fit - they could hurt their teeth. James wasn’t seizing, but better to be safe), Mary returned with Marlene. The whole atmosphere changed. Remus跑了出去，同时在厨房寻找一个木勺（他听说金属对发作中的人不好——他们可能会伤到牙齿。James虽然没有抽搐，但还是小心为好），Mary带着Marlene回来了。整个气氛发生了变化。

“Out of my way, please!” Marlene’s crystal clear voice rang out, its inherent common sense authority restoring order at once. “请让开！”Marlene清晰的声音响起，她天生的常识权威立刻恢复了秩序。

Relieved, Remus came through clutching the firewhisky. Lily was crying harder now, standing back to let Marlene work. Sirius had his arms around her, eyes never leaving James’s face, which was starting to turn a deathly shade of grey. 松了口气的Remus拿着火威士忌走了进来。Lily现在哭得更厉害了，站在一旁让Marlene工作。Sirius把手臂搂住她，眼睛没有离开James的脸，而James的脸色开始变得死灰色。

“Marls,” Sirius said urgently, “Please… please…” “Marls，”Sirius急切地说，“拜托……拜托……”

“I’m doing my best, Black!” Marlene barked, turning to open her bag. Remus caught the flushed look of terror in her face, the shimmer of tears in her eyes. This was bad. “我在尽力，Black！”Marlene大声道，转身打开她的包。Remus看见她脸上泛红的恐惧表情，眼中闪烁的泪光。这情况很糟糕。

It was as if they were all holding their breath. Mary was still in her coat, pressed against the door. 仿佛大家都在屏息以待。Mary仍然穿着外套，靠在门上。

“Is there someone else I can get?” She asked, her voice hoarse. “Tell me, I’ll go anywhere.” “还有其他人我可以去找吗？”她问，声音沙哑。“告诉我，我会去任何地方。”

“I don't know,” Marlene said trembling. “There's no one safe at St Mungo’s, and I don’t know if anyone else in the Order is… Emmeline, maybe, but she's in Hungary or somewhere…” “我不知道，”Marlene颤抖着说。“St Mungo’s没有安全的人，我不知道Order里还有没有其他人……也许Emmeline，但她在匈牙利或者其他地方……”

“You can do it though, Marls?” Lily said, desperately, “You can heal him?”

“I don’t know, I… What was the curse?”

“We don’t know,” Sirius said, “It was wordless.”

“What about a bezoar?” Mary asked.

“That’s for poison,” Sirius shot back. “He was cursed.”

“Yeah, but still, isn’t it worth a try?”

“I don’t have one anyway!” Marlene let out a sob. She was really crying, now, her hands hovering over James’s body, shaking.

His breathing was coming slower and slower, Remus could still hear his heart beating, but that was getting weaker; a long syrupy ‘thwump’. They had to do something.

“Can you describe the curse?” He asked, brain ticking.

“It was wordless!” Sirius repeated, impatiently.

“No, but could you describe it?” Remus persisted, firmly. “A light? Colour? A smell?”

“I’m not like you, Remus, I’m not…” Sirius ran his fingers through his hair, frowning,

“Blue.” Lily said, sniffing, “There was a blue light, wasn’t there Sirius?”

“Yeah!” He nodded, lighting up, “It was blue, and kind of… Jagged? Short, like a dart.”它是藍色的，有點……鋸齒狀？很短，就像飛鏢一樣。

“Yes,” Lily wiped her eyes, looking at Remus as if he was her saviour, “It was like arrows being fired at us; blue arrows.”「是的，」莉莉擦了擦眼睛，看著萊姆斯，彷彿他是她的救世主，「就像箭射向我們；藍色箭頭。

“Ok,” Remus nodded, as if he knew exactly what he was doing. He had never heard of a curse that did that. “Ok, so… blue… er…”

“Remus!” Mary cried, “Blue, isn’t that explosive charms?”

“Yeah,” he jumped on it, eagerly, then frowned, “But he hasn’t…” He looked down at James. He was completely intact - just incredibly weak.

“Maybe they combined it with something?” Lily said, straightening up, folding her arms across her body and putting on her war face. “Magical alchemy, you boys do that all the time.”“也許他們把它與某些東西結合起來了？”莉莉站起身來，雙臂抱在身上，擺出一副戰爭表情。 “魔法煉金術，你們這些小伙子經常這麼做。”

“Or it could have been a mistake,” Sirius said, leaning in, his eyes finally focussing properly, “That happens all the time too.”

“或者這可能是個錯誤，”天狼星傾身說道，他的眼睛終於正確地聚焦了，“這種事也經常發生。”

“Yeah!” Remus agreed, “The death eater might have just really wanted to use a lot of force, that can come out explosive sometimes… oh! Did you have shield charms up?”

“We did,” Lily nodded, the lines in her forehead deepening, “But James - his had just dropped, just for a split second, he was trying to…” she looked down. “我们做了，”Lily点头，她额头上的皱纹加深，“但是James——他的心跳刚刚下降了，只是一瞬间，他正在尝试……”她低下头。

“He was trying to protect me.” Sirius said, very low. “Last thing he did was disarm that fucking Crouch kid, he was about to get me with an unforgivable.” “他是在试图保护我。”Sirius低声说，“他做的最后一件事就是解除那个该死的Crouch小子的武装，他正要用一个不可饶恕的咒语对付我。”

Remus blinked with shock, and then shoved that feeling down, down as far as it would go, because he needed to deal with James now. Remus震惊地眨了眨眼，然后把那种感觉压下去，尽可能地往下压，因为他现在需要处理James的情况。

“Ok,” he swallowed. “Ok, so what if whoever hit James was just a bit slow? Tried to get through the shield charm just the second it went down.” “好的，”他吞了口水。“好的，那如果攻击James的人只是有点慢呢？试图在护盾咒语刚刚消失的那一刻通过。”

“That makes sense,” Lily said, her face bright with tears and sweat and hope, “That accounts for the short bursts!” “这有道理，”Lily说，她的脸上满是泪水、汗水和希望，“这解释了短时间的冲击！”

“Ok, great!” Remus looked down at Marlene, who was staring at him eyes as big as saucers. “好的，太好了！”Remus低头看着Marlene，她的眼睛像碟子一样睁大。

“I… how would that hit him?” Remus asked, agitated - he didn’t know what to do! She was the one with two years training as a Healer! “What would it do?! Think!” “我……那会怎么击中他？”Remus焦急地问——他不知道该怎么办！她可是接受了两年的治疗师培训！“那会有什么效果？！想想！”

“I’m trying!” Marlene said, still shaking. “我在尝试！”Marlene说，仍然在颤抖。

Remus wanted to take her by the shoulders and really shake her - she had to get herself together! This was James! He had a family, and a baby, and Sirius needed him, and Remus needed him, they all did! Marlene just kept staring at them all, frozen. Remus想抓住她的肩膀狠狠地摇晃她——她必须振作起来！这是James！他有一个家庭，一个宝宝，Sirius需要他，Remus需要他，他们都需要！Marlene只是呆呆地看着他们，僵住了。

“Marls,” Mary came over, quickly, squatting down next to her friend. She did take Marlene by the shoulders - but she didn’t shake her. She hugged her, and stroked her hair. “Marls，”Mary迅速走过来，蹲在她的朋友旁边。她确实抓住了Marlene的肩膀——但没有摇晃她。她拥抱了她，抚摸着她的头发。“亲爱的，”她在寂静的房间里低语，“你可以做到的。你是我认识的最聪明的人。如果有人知道该怎么做，那就是你。好吗？”

She began to mutter to herself, and then moved her wand, a warm, soft lilac glow emanating from the point, pooling over James’ prone body, sinking in slowly, like foam. 她开始自言自语，然后移动她的魔杖，点上散发出温暖柔和的紫丁香色光芒，汇集在James的身体上，缓慢地渗透进去，就像泡沫一样。

Mary stayed by Marlene’s side, kneeling on the rug beside the couch, her head bent as if praying. 大家再次屏住呼吸，等待Marlene的治疗。Sirius握着Lily的手，Remus看到她的指关节因为紧握而变白。Mary则留在Marlene身边，跪在沙发旁的地毯上，头低下，仿佛在祈祷。

Remus just clutched his bottle of whisky and felt as though the world was falling out from under him. There was nothing to do but watch and wait, listen to Marlene’s steady muttering, and try to keep perspective. Remus只是紧握着他的威士忌瓶，感觉世界仿佛在他脚下崩溃。他无事可做，只能等待，看着Marlene稳定的低语，并试图保持清醒。

The magic she was using had a sweet, fresh scent, like cut grass, or budding leaves. The smell of springtime, of regeneration. That was a good sign, Remus thought. He wished he had learnt more from the werewolves - their healing techniques had been flawless. But maybe that only worked on other werewolves? 她使用的魔法有一种甜美清新的气味，像割草或发芽的叶子。春天的气息，重生的气息。这是个好兆头，Remus想。他希望自己从狼人那里学到更多——他们的治疗技巧无可挑剔。但也许那只对其他狼人有效？

James’s breathing was getting steadier, his heart rate a bit stronger. Woosh - woosh - woosh - Remus could hear his blood pumping faster already. James的呼吸变得更加稳定，心跳也强了些。哗——哗——哗——Remus已经能听到他的血液在加速流动。

“It’s working!” He said, going a bit closer to hear better. “You’re doing it, Marlene!” “有效了！”他说，走近一点以便更好地听到。“你做到了，Marlene！”

“Oh thank you,” Lily said, covering her eyes with her hands, “Thank you, thank you…” “哦，谢谢你，”Lily说，双手捂住眼睛，“谢谢，谢谢……”

Marlene stopped muttering and felt James’s pulse. She sighed with relief and nodded, “Stable.” She said. Then, looking up, “Might as well give him a bit of that whisky, Remus.” Marlene停止了低语，感受James的脉搏。她松了口气，点了点头，“稳定了。”她说。然后，看向Remus，“不妨给他点威士忌。”

After they’d got a bit of that down him, Marlene gave James a strengthening potion. He was getting a bit of colour back, by then, and his chest was rising and falling evenly. They were out of the woods. Still, Marlene didn’t want him moved, not until he’d regained consciousness. 在他们给James喂了一点威士忌之后，Marlene给他喝了强身药水。他的脸色恢复了一些，他的胸部均匀地起伏着。他们度过了难关。不过，Marlene还是不想让他移动，直到他恢复意识。

“He can stay here,” Remus said, “Of course he can. It’s safe, isn’t it, Padfoot?”

Sirius was watching Remus, across the room. He was thinking, Remus could tell - he had his problem-face on. For some reason, it made Remus go cold. “Padfoot?”

“Yeah…” Sirius said, slowly, “But we thought Diagon Alley was safe enough.”

“Well, he’s here now,” Lily said, getting up from James’s side. “He’s staying. I have to go home - Peter’s looking after Harry, he must be so worried! I’ll be right back…”

“Someone should go and get Dumbledore.” Sirius said, abruptly.

“What for?” Mary asked.

“Just… he ought to know we were attacked. He ought to know somebody told the death eaters where we’d be.”

“Sirius!” Mary stared at him, her mouth open, “Are you saying… someone in the Order?!”

Sirius nodded. He didn’t look at Remus again.

“I’ll go!” Remus offered.

“No!” Sirius said. “You can’t, you… you need to stay here. It’s not safe for werewolves.”

“It doesn’t seem to be safe for anyone!” Marlene retorted, standing up, wiping her forehead. “You go, Sirius, since it’s so important. Remus, Mary and I can stay and look after James.”

Sirius looked at James, and then at Remus - not his face, though, just his general direction.不過不是他的臉，只是他大致的方向。

“Ok,” he said. “I’ll be really quick.” And headed out the door.

The three women looked at Remus awkwardly. Lily came over to squeeze his shoulder, and said gently,

“He’s just upset, love. He blames himself for what happened - James was trying to save him when he got hit. Don’t take it personally, eh?”

“I know,” Remus raised his chin, manfully, squashing down all of the bitter, rotten emotions,，壓制住所有苦澀、腐爛的情緒 “It’s fine. We’re all in shock. It’s fine.”

“I’ve got to go,” Lily said again, “Harry.”

“I’ll come with you,” Mary said, “We should go everywhere in pairs. That’s what Moody would say.”

They both left, and Remus tried not to think about the fact that Sirius had vanished into the night completely alone.

Marlene had collected herself by now, and was bustling about making James comfortable,

“I should have told Lily to bring him some pyjamas… maybe she will anyway,” she said, “Have you got a pillow and some blankets for him, Remus?”

“Yeah, ‘course.” Remus nodded, hurrying to the bedroom, coming back with five blankets and two pillows (they were the only pillows they had, actually; he’d taken them right off the bed).

Marlene was checking James’s pulse again when he came back.

“Is he ok?!”

“Yes,” Marlene nodded, “Still steady. I was just checking…”

They made up a bed on the couch around him. Remus took his shoes off, but they decided to wait until Lily was back to undress him. He looked as though he was just sleeping. Remus smiled,

“I’ve never heard James be so quiet for so long,” he commented, hoping to lighten the mood a bit.

“Ha.” Marlene said, then burst into tears again.

“Hey hey hey!” Remus pulled her to him, “It’s over now! Please don’t cry…”

“I’m - sorry - I’m - just - so - scared -” Marlene sobbed, choking on every breath, “I let - everyone - down!”

“No you didn’t!” Remus felt horribly guilt for shouting at her, “You did an amazing job!”

“Only - because - you lot - helped…”

“Well, obviously,” he kissed the top of her head, “That’s what friends are for.”

* * *

Lily and Mary returned first. Lily cradling Harry in her arms - who was sleeping, mercifully. She went straight to James’s side once more.

“I brought some of Effie’s potions,” She said, harried, “Have a look, Marlene, there might be something useful…” “我带了一些Effie的药水，”她说，显得很忙乱，“看看，Marlene，可能会有用的东西……”

“I don’t want to dose him up too much,” Marlene said, carefully. “Rest and observation is the best thing now, I promise.” She had washed her face and had a nip of whisky, and was considerably calmer now. “我不想给他过多的药，”Marlene说，谨慎地，“现在最好是休息和观察，我保证。”她洗了把脸，喝了一点威士忌，现在已经冷静多了。

“Did you see Wormtail?” Remus asked. “你见到Wormtail了吗？”Remus问。

“Yeah,” Mary said, taking Harry from Lily, so that she could focus on James. “He was really upset - he wanted to go home and check on his mum. Can’t blame him.” “见到了，”Mary说，把Harry从Lily手中接过来，好让她能专注于James。“他真的很伤心——他想回家看看他妈妈。不能怪他。”

“No, of course.” Remus agreed. He’d want his mother, too, if he had one. “当然。”Remus同意了。如果他有妈妈的话，他也会想她的。

He made a strong pot of tea, and everyone took a cup, but nobody drank any. Marlene and Lily poured over James , undressing him and tucking him into bed, plumping up his pillow, while Mary gently rocked Harry in her arms. Remus watched the three of them - like saintly maidens in a church altarpiece - and felt completely useless. 他煮了一壶浓茶，大家都拿了一杯，但没有人喝。Marlene和Lily忙着照顾James，脱下他的衣服，把他安顿到床上，拍松他的枕头，而Mary则温柔地摇着Harry。Remus看着他们三个——像教堂祭坛上的圣女一样——感到自己完全无用。

“Could we move him to the bed?” He said, annoyed he’d only just thought of it, “Then you can sleep next to him, Lily.” “我们可以把他搬到床上去吗？”他说，烦恼自己刚刚才想到，“那样你就可以在他旁边睡了，Lily。”

“Better not for now,” Marlene advised. “现在最好不要，”Marlene建议。

“Right, then I’ll make you up a bed here…” he tried to remember some transfiguration charms - though conjuring furniture was usually something Sirius was better at. “好的，那我会在这里为你准备一张床……”他试图记起一些变形咒语——尽管变出家具通常是Sirius更擅长的事。

“Don’t worry, Remus, I’m not going to sleep.” Lily smiled, tiredly. “别担心，Remus，我不会去睡觉。”Lily疲惫地笑了。

“I don't think any of us will.” Mary said. “I phoned mum. All right if I stay here too, love?” “我想我们谁都不会。”Mary说，“我打电话给妈妈了。我能在这里待吗，亲爱的？”

“Of course.” He nodded. And of course Marlene wouldn’t be going anywhere until she was certain James was going to make a full recovery. “当然。”他点头。同样，Marlene也不会离开，直到她确定James会完全康复。

In the end, they agreed they’d sleep in shifts, and take the bed two at a time. None of them wanted to go first, of course, and they all settled in for a very long night. Remus leaned against the mantlepiece, listening to James’s heart beating across the room. He kept picturing his friend suddenly sitting up, grinning at them all; Alright you lot? Bloody hell, who died?! 最终，他们同意轮流休息，床上两个人一组。自然，没有人愿意第一个去睡，大家都准备迎接一个漫长的夜晚。Remus靠在壁炉架上，听着房间另一边James的心跳。他不断幻想他的朋友突然坐起来，朝他们所有人微笑；“你们好？该死的，谁死了？！”

Finally, Sirius returned with Dumbledore, and any peace they had managed to reclaim was shattered. 最终，Sirius带着Dumbledore回来了，他们好不容易恢复的平静被打破了。

“I need to know everything.” The old headmaster said, his face severe, eyes burning like the blue centre of a flame. “我需要知道一切。”老校长说，他的脸色严峻，眼睛像火焰的蓝色中心一样燃烧。

Sirius and Lily began talking. They explained how everything had been routine - standard; boring, if anything. They’d done a sweep of Diagon Alley, even Knockturn Alley, and found everything perfectly safe and secure. Sirius和Lily开始讲述。他们解释了事情的经过——一切都是例行公事——标准的；如果有的话，还很无聊。他们对对角巷，甚至诺克特恩小巷做了一次巡视，发现一切安全无忧。

Then they’d left, via the Leaky Cauldron exit, and had decided to walk to the check-in point, as it was a nice evening, and not too far. They were supposed to meet Dorcas Meadowes in a muggle café on Tottenham Court Road - but they’d been ambushed before reaching it. 然后他们从破釜酒吧的出口离开，决定步行去登记点，因为那是个好晚上，离得也不远。他们原本应该在托特纳姆法院路上的一家麻瓜咖啡馆见到Dorcas Meadowes——但他们在到达之前就遭到了伏击。

“You couldn’t have been followed?” Dumbledore asked, looking at them both. They shook their heads. “你们不可能被跟踪了吗？”Dumbledore问，盯着他们俩。他们摇了摇头。

“We made sure,” Lily said. “They weren’t behind us, they were ahead - they were waiting for us.” “我们确保了，”Lily说，“他们不在我们身后，他们在前面——他们在等我们。”

“Shit, someone ought to tell Dorcas…” Sirius said, suddenly, “After James got… we had to get out fast, there wasn’t time.” “该死，应该有人告诉Dorcas……”Sirius突然说，“在James……我们得快点离开，没有时间了。”

“It would not have mattered,” Dumbledore waved a hand, “Dorcas Meadowes is dead.” “没关系，”Dumbledore挥了挥手，“Dorcas Meadowes已经死了。”

The room fell silent. Harry woke up and started to cry. Lily took him from Mary at once, clutching her son close to her chest. 房间陷入了沉默。Harry醒来开始哭泣。Lily立刻接过他，把儿子紧紧抱在胸前。

Sirius spoke first. Sirius第一个开口了。

“I'm right, aren't I?” He looked Dumbledore directly in the face, “There’s a spy in the Order.” “我没错，对吧？”他直接看着Dumbledore，“在组织里有间谍。”
