That summer they’d gone to see the same film every day, and met those muggle girls. Had it been summer? Or Christmas? It might have been raining, and someone punched him. James or Remus? Surely Remus; James was never violent, even when Sirius really deserved it.

小天狼星蜷缩在沙发上，双臂抱住双腿。他在看电视。这是一个奇怪的麻瓜发明——有点像他年轻时去过的电影院，只是更小一点……哦不，哦不……这让他想起了詹姆斯。那个夏天他们每天去看同一部电影，还遇到了那些麻瓜女孩。是夏天吗？还是圣诞节？可能在下雨，有人打了他一拳。詹姆斯还是雷穆斯？肯定是雷穆斯；詹姆斯从不暴力，即使小天狼星真的很配受罚。

Sirius shut his eyes to drown out the cold, cruel voices in his head which wanted to drag him back through time, back to the very worst moments. He thought he could taste blood, but when he opened his eyes again, all he saw was the living room, and the silly talking muggle box.
小天狼星闭上眼睛，试图驱散脑海中那些冰冷、残酷的声音，它们想把他拖回过去，回到那些最糟糕的时刻。他觉得自己能尝到血腥味，但当他再次睁开眼睛时，他看到的只是客厅，还有那个傻乎乎的说话的麻瓜盒子。

It was his living room. Or it had been, once. It looked different, and Sirius had a hard time working out whether it was different, or he was just remembering wrong. The walls hadn’t been repainted, the fireplace was there. It didn’t stink of cigarette ash anymore, but there was still a burn mark in the carpet under the windowsill - had that been there before? Or had it happened in the years between?
这是他的客厅。或者曾经是。看起来有些不同，小天狼星很难分辨是客厅不同了，还是他记错了。墙壁没有重新粉刷，壁炉还在。空气中不再有烟灰的味道，但窗台下的地毯上仍然有一个烧痕——以前就有吗？还是在这些年中出现的？

The TV was the worst change; the most noticeable. Sirius had a strong memory of arguing against having one, a long time ago. Noisy, ugly muggle light-boxes. He still thought it was awful, but somehow he couldn’t bring himself to stop watching it. It distracted him. It was a break from thinking; from remembering.
电视是最糟糕的变化；最明显的变化。小天狼星清楚记得很久以前曾争论过是否要有电视。嘈杂、丑陋的麻瓜光箱。他仍然认为它很糟糕，但不知为何他无法让自己停止看电视。这分散了他的注意力。这是一个摆脱思考和回忆的休息。

He had spent too much of his life remembering. Turning over events, over mistakes and half understood conversations. Sifting through it all again and again, until everything in his head was shaken loose in tiny fragments, no structure or narrative. He didn't want to sit and think anymore. He wanted to act. He wanted to do. And no one would let him.
他花了太多的时间在回忆中。翻来覆去地思考事件、错误和半懂的对话。一次又一次地筛选所有内容，直到他脑海中的一切都被打散成微小的碎片，没有结构或叙事。他不想再坐着思考了。他想要行动。他想要做事。但没有人允许他这样做。

He huffed, shifting position, tightening his grip on the arm of the couch. Remus had been invited to a meeting, and Sirius had been told to stay at home with the muggle. It would have been fine if he'd gone as Padfoot, he knew it would have, but no one would listen. They were treating him like a loose cannon, like someone who needed to be contained . As if he hadn't spent a whole year alone, looking out for himself, without any help from anyone.
他嘟囔着，换了个姿势，紧握着沙发的扶手。雷穆斯被邀请参加一个会议，而小天狼星被告知要留在家里和麻瓜待在一起。如果他以Padfoot的身份去，他知道一切都会好的，但没有人愿意听。他们把他当成一个脱缰的炮弹，需要被控制。就好像他没有独自度过整整一年，靠自己照顾自己，没有任何人的帮助。

He wasn't going to be treated like a kid. He wasn't going to let them. Hadn't he earned his place?
他不打算被当作孩子对待。他不打算让他们这样做。他不是已经赢得了自己的位置吗？

But Moony - Remus, he had given Sirius that pained, pleading look, and it shut him up. He hated making Remus uncomfortable, it made him worried he would never get better. He knew he wasn't right in the head, he knew he was going about things all wrong, and that he was not himself. But Sirius had hoped a year would be enough. He was out, now, he was free, everyone who mattered finally knew the truth. It should make a difference. He should be normal again, by now.
但Moony——雷穆斯，他给了小天狼星那种痛苦、恳求的眼神，这让他闭嘴。他讨厌让雷穆斯感到不舒服，这让他担心自己永远不会好起来。他知道自己脑袋不对劲，他知道自己处理事情的方式全错了，而且他不是自己。但小天狼星希望一年足够了。他现在出来了，他是自由的，所有重要的人终于知道了真相。这应该会有所改变。他现在应该恢复正常了。

Remus wasn't helping, Sirius thought, darkly. How could he get his head straight, when everything was so weird? When Remus, his only friend left, could barely look at him without wincing, could barely speak to him without trailing off, glancing away. And the boyfriend. Sirius wondered how quickly that had happened, how soon the muggle had wormed his way in. Infected Remus with his mundanity; made his Moony quiet and cautious. No better than a muggle himself.
小天狼星黑暗地想着，雷穆斯并没有帮助。他怎么能理清头绪，当一切都如此奇怪？当雷穆斯，他唯一剩下的朋友，几乎无法看着他而不面露痛苦，几乎无法与他说话而不支支吾吾，眼神游离。还有那个男朋友。小天狼星想知道这发生得有多快，麻瓜是怎么快速钻进来的。让雷穆斯感染了麻瓜的平凡；让他的Moony变得安静和谨慎。简直和麻瓜没有什么区别。

It was like a light in Remus had dimmed. Sirius looked for signs of the old Moony, but there was none of that wicked, mischievous energy, the blistering strength of Remus Lupin when he had an exciting plan.
就像雷穆斯身上的光芒黯淡了。小天狼星寻找旧Moony的迹象，但没有那种邪恶、顽皮的能量，没有雷穆斯·卢平在有激动计划时那种炽热的力量。

It had taken Sirius ages to convince Remus just to go to the meeting. In the end, he had the impression Remus only went as a favour to him; to keep him calm. That was fine, as long as he went. And when he got back, he would tell Sirius everything, Sirius would make him. It was the least Remus could do.
小天狼星花了很长时间说服雷穆斯去参加会议。最后，他觉得雷穆斯只是为了帮他才去的；让他平静下来。这样就好，只要他去了。当他回来时，他会告诉小天狼星一切，小天狼星会逼迫他。这是雷穆斯能做的最少的事情。

Remus would come around. He would see there was no other way. He would want to do it for Harry.
雷穆斯会慢慢接受的。他会明白别无选择。他会为了哈利愿意这样做。

Sirius couldn't help smiling to himself, thinking about Harry. That incredible, brilliant, brave kid. James would be so proud…
小天狼星忍不住对自己微笑，想到哈利。那个令人难以置信、聪明、勇敢的孩子。詹姆斯一定会非常骄傲……

James, James I'm so sorry….
詹姆斯，詹姆斯，我很抱歉……

He shuddered, shut his eyes again, bracing himself against the cold. He wanted Remus so badly. He didn't want to be alone, not again, please...
他打了个寒颤，再次闭上眼睛，抵御寒冷。他非常想要雷穆斯。他不想再孤单，请不要再这样……

“Orright?” Grant, sauntered the room as if to remind Sirius that he was not alone at all. Grant smiled at him cheerfully as he came in. Sirius watched him warily. Always bloody smiling. Weirdo.
“还好吗？”格兰特悠闲地走进房间，好像要提醒小天狼星他并不孤单。格兰特进来时笑容满面。小天狼星警惕地看着他。总是笑得该死。真怪。

“Good afternoon,” Sirius replied, deliberately accentuating his annunciation to counter Grant’s horrific butchered English.
“小下午好，”小天狼星回答道，故意强调他的发音，以反击格兰特糟糕的英语。

Sirius had spent no time whatsoever with muggles, even before Azkaban, and found them confusing at best; like an alien species. And he hated Grant’s cheerfulness with every inch of his being.
小天狼星在阿兹卡班之前也没有和麻瓜待过，发现他们充其量也只是令人困惑；像是外星人。他对格兰特的快乐感到无比厌恶。

“Feelin’ better?”
“感觉好点了吗？”

Sirius grunted noncommittally. He didn’t see that he owed any kind of explanation to this man. He tolerated him, for Remus’s sake, but that was it.
小天狼星发出不置可否的哼声。他不认为自己对这个人有任何解释的义务。他为了雷穆斯的缘故忍受他，但就这样了。

“Good to hear,” Grant nodded, dimples in his cheeks.
“听到这个很好，”格兰特点了点头，脸颊上出现了酒窝。

Sirius thought he must be incredibly stupid.
小天狼星认为他一定非常愚蠢。

Wipe that inane grin off your face! barked the spectre of Walpurga Black.
擦掉你那愚蠢的笑容！沃尔普加·布莱克的幽灵吼道。

Sirius remembered Grant as a teenager, and he hadn’t even been that good looking then. Fifteen years hadn’t improved on his hairline or his skin. Sirius had no idea what Remus was still doing with Grant at all, and if he was stupid as well as plain looking, then Sirius was even more baffled as to why Moony would want him around.
小天狼星记得格兰特是个青少年时，他当时甚至都不怎么好看。十五年没有改善他的发际线或皮肤。小天狼星完全不知道雷穆斯还和格兰特在一起是为了什么，如果他又愚蠢又平凡，那么小天狼星更加困惑为什么Moony会想让他在身边。

The Remus he knew - his Remus would never suffer a fool.
他认识的雷穆斯——他的雷穆斯永远不会忍受愚蠢的人。

“When he gets back,” Grant was saying, now, still cheerful, still smiling, showing crooked teeth and a white scar in the corner of his mouth, “I’ll go.”
“等他回来，”格兰特现在还在说，依旧愉快，依旧微笑，露出歪斜的牙齿和嘴角的白色伤疤，“我就走。”

“Oh, ok.” Sirius shrugged. He searched for something to say, “...we need milk.”
“哦，好吧。”小天狼星耸耸肩。他找了找话题，“……我们需要牛奶。”

“No,” Grant chuckled, shaking his head lightly. He sat on the coffee table, directly opposite Sirius - so close their knees almost touched - and looked him in the eye, “I’m not popping out to the shops - I mean I’m leaving.”
“没有，”格兰特轻笑着摇摇头。他坐在咖啡桌上，直接对着小天狼星——他们的膝盖几乎碰在一起——直视着他的眼睛，“我不是去商店——我是说我要离开。”

“What?” Sirius frowned, “Why? Did Remus tell you to? Because it wasn’t my idea.”
“什么？”小天狼星皱眉，“为什么？雷穆斯让你这样做的？因为这不是我的主意。”

“It’s my idea,” Grant said, no longer smiling. He had tired eyes, and Sirius realised that though Grant was smiling, he wasn’t happy. He was very, very sad. Sirius didn’t know what to do about it; he had his own problems.
“这是我的主意，”格兰特说道，不再微笑。他的眼神疲惫，小天狼星意识到尽管格兰特在微笑，他并不开心。他非常非常伤心。小天狼星不知道该怎么办；他自己也有问题。

Grant kept talking, “I realised it a while ago. When he came back from the school, all shook up from seeing you again. I think I must’ve known then. Should ‘ave called time, but I couldn’t just leave him alone...”
格兰特继续说，“我早就意识到了。当他从学校回来时，被见到你搞得很震惊。我想我那时就应该知道。应该早点说，但我不能就这样离开他……”

“Look, I don’t know what you think--”
“听着，我不知道你怎么想——”

“I was only ever looking after him for you,” Grant said, raising a hand to keep Sirius quiet, “I was never it for him. That’s been you, all these years.”
“我只是为了你照顾他，”格兰特说，抬手让小天狼星安静，“我从来不是为了他。这是你，这些年来一直是你。”

“And yet here you are.” Sirius muttered. He drew his knees back up, closing inwards. He wanted Grant to just go away, if he was leaving; get lost. He’d have liked to transform into Padfoot, but he knew it wouldn’t help matters and he’d promised Remus not to.
“而你现在还在这里。”小天狼星低声说道。他把膝盖收回，蜷缩起来。他希望格兰特离开，如果他要走的话；快走。他本来想变成Padfoot，但知道这样做不会有帮助，而且他答应了雷穆斯不这样做。

“See, now this is what I wanted to talk about.” Grant said, his brows knitting together. “If I go, then you’ve got to look after him, ok? Not blame him for whatever’s happened to you in the last ten years.”
“看，这就是我想谈的。”格兰特说道，眉头紧锁。“如果我走了，你必须照顾好他，好吗？不要因为过去十年发生在你身上的事而责怪他。”

“Twelve years.” Sirius corrected.
“十二年。”小天狼星纠正道。

“Don’t care,” Grant shrugged, “It’s not been an easy life for any of us, sunshine, you’re not special. Remus is.”
“没关系，”格兰特耸耸肩，“我们的生活都不容易，亲爱的，你并不特别。雷穆斯才是。”

Grant’s voice was suddenly hard and dangerous - almost aggressive “He’s special to me , and if you’re not man enough to be kind to him, then you don’t deserve him. He’s been waiting for you. He’s never stopped waiting. He won’t say it, because Remus doesn’t say stuff like that. But he feels it. He feels everything , you must know that.”
格兰特的声音突然变得严厉而危险——几乎带有攻击性。“他对我很特别，如果你不够男人去善待他，那么你不配拥有他。他一直在等你。他从未停止过等待。他不会说出来，因为雷穆斯不说那种话。但他感受到了。他感受到了所有的，你必须知道。”

Sirius didn’t reply.
小天狼星没有回答。

“He loves you.” Grant said, steadily. “You have to love him back.”
“他爱你。”格兰特坚定地说道。“你必须回报他的爱。”

“I do love hi--”
“我爱他——”

“--No,” Grant was shaking his head again, “No, not like this. You have to be here ; a real, flesh and blood person. Not a dog. Not a ghost.”
“——不，”格兰特再次摇头，“不，不能这样。你必须在这里；一个真实的，有血有肉的人。不是一只狗。不是一个幽灵。”

Sirius couldn’t meet Grant’s eyes anymore, he bowed his head and nodded.
小天狼星再也无法直视格兰特的眼睛，他低下头点了点。

“I will.”
“我会的。”

“Good,” Grant smiled again, his face gentle once more. “Now, when he gets moody - and he will get moody - don’t let him mope, and don’t let him drink. He’ll want it, after a full moon, but it only takes him longer to get well again if he does.”
“好，”格兰特再次微笑，他的脸上重新变得温柔。“现在，当他情绪低落时——他会的——不要让他闷闷不乐，也不要让他喝酒。他会想要的，在满月之后，但如果他这样做，恢复起来会更慢。”

“I know what he needs after a full moon!” Sirius growled, affronted. “I’ve known him since I was eleven, who do you think you are, telling me--”
“我知道他在满月之后需要什么！”小天狼星生气地咆哮，“我从十一岁就认识他，你觉得你是谁，告诉我——”

“I’m the one who’s been here.” Grant returned, shortly. “I don’t think you get how hard it's been. I don’t think you… look; you had him at his best, ok? I had his worst.” He smiled, a little, “And I was glad to do it. I have one part of him. You have the other. Can we agree?”
“我是那个一直在这里的人。”格兰特简短地回道。“我认为你不了解这有多么困难。我认为你……看，你得到了他最好的一面，好吗？我得到了他最糟糕的一面。”他微笑了一下，“我很高兴这样做。我拥有他的一个部分。你拥有另一个部分。我们可以达成一致吗？”

Sirius stared at him a bit longer. Grant held out a hand to shake, and Sirius took it,
小天狼星多看了他一会儿。格兰特伸出手来握手，小天狼星握住了他的手，

“Ok.” he said.
“好。”他说。

“Lovely.” Grant released him, and stood up. He went into the bedroom and came back with a large hold all, which he placed very purposefully by the door. “Going to have to leave a few books and things here for a bit.” He said, “But I'll be back for ‘em when I'm settled. S'pose you don't need a key, eh? Can you get in the magic way?”
“太好了。”格兰特放开他的手，站起身来。他走进卧室，拿出一个大手提袋，特意放在门边。“得把一些书和东西留在这里一会儿。”他说，“但我会在安顿好之后回来拿。估计你不需要钥匙，对吧？你能用魔法进来吗？”

Sirius nodded, struck dumb. He couldn't believe this was happening. He wanted his heart to soar, he wanted to feel finally satisfied - but he couldn't help worrying. Grant had been a nuisance, but he had been a buffer, too. Would Remus blame him for it? Would he convince Grant to stay, or even worse, would he leave Sirius here, alone with the flat and the war and…
小天狼星点了点头，呆若木鸡。他无法相信这正在发生。他希望自己的心情高涨，希望能感到最终的满足——但他忍不住担心。格兰特曾经是个麻烦，但他也充当了缓冲。雷穆斯会责怪他吗？他会说服格兰特留下，还是更糟糕的是，他会把小天狼星留在这里，独自面对公寓和战争……

There was a quiet shuffling noise outside the front door, and Sirius’s ears pricked. Remus was back! His heart began to thrum against his ribcage, he licked his lips and sat up straighter, focussed in the door as it opened.
前门外传来轻微的窸窣声，小天狼星的耳朵竖了起来。雷穆斯回来了！他的心脏开始猛烈跳动，他舔了舔嘴唇，坐直了身子，专注地看着门打开。

Remus entered, head bowed, frowning a bit. Sirius couldn't believe how little Remus had changed, when everything else in the world was so different now. He was greyer, but he was still Moony, he was still completely devastatingly handsome and completely unphased about it.
雷穆斯进来了，低着头，微微皱眉。小天狼星无法相信雷穆斯变化如此之小，而世界上其他一切都变了。他变得更灰了，但他依然是Moony，依然完全魅力四射，对此毫无波动。

He gave Sirius a smile as he came in, which was so like the teenage Remus, it took Sirius right back to Hogwarts - arriving at the breakfast table to find Remus already there, on his third helping of bacon and eggs, grinning at something stupid Sirius had just said. See, he told himself, there are still some good memories left.
他进门时给了小天狼星一个微笑，那笑容与少年时期的雷穆斯如此相似，让小天狼星仿佛回到了霍格沃茨——到达早餐桌时发现雷穆斯已经在那儿，第三份培根和鸡蛋，笑着对小天狼星刚刚说的某件傻事。看，他对自己说，还有一些美好的回忆留下来。

“Hello,” he said, to the room.
“你好，”他说，向房间里的人打招呼。

“Hiya.” Grant replied. “Cup of tea?”
“嗨。”格兰特回答。“来杯茶吗？”

“Ooh, yes please,” Remus nodded, now giving Grant a friendly smile. The muggle went into the kitchen.
“哦，好的。”雷穆斯点头，现在对格兰特露出友好的微笑。麻瓜走进了厨房。

“How did it go?” Sirius asked, already agitated, “Did you see Dumbledore? What did he say?”
“怎么了？”小天狼星问，已经很激动了，“你见到邓布利多了吗？他说了什么？”

“Oh, nothing much. Nothing I haven't heard before. The Order needs a new HQ, we're all supposed to come up with ideas. Look, let's talk about it later?” Remus shot a glance at the kitchen, where Grant was making the tea.
“哦，没什么。没什么我没听过的。秩序需要一个新的总部，我们都应该提出建议。看看，我们稍后再谈？”雷穆斯瞥了一眼厨房，格兰特正在泡茶。

“Did he say anything about me? Dumbledore? How’s Harry?
“邓布利多说了关于我的事吗？哈利怎么样？”

“Harry's perfectly fine, back at his aunt and uncle's for the summer. What's this bag doing here?”
“哈利很好，正在他姨妈和姨父家过夏天。这个包怎么在这里？”

Remus was looking down at the brown hold all packed with Grant's things. He looked at Sirius. Sirius shrugged, slouching down in the sofa. Remus frowned, and called out, “Grant? What's this bag doing?”
雷穆斯低头看着装满格兰特物品的棕色手提袋。他看了看小天狼星。小天狼星耸耸肩，靠在沙发上。雷穆斯皱了皱眉，喊道，“格兰特？这个包怎么了？”

Grant popped his head around the kitchen door, looking sheepish.
格兰特探出头来，从厨房门口看过来，显得有些羞愧。

“Ah. Can I have a quick word?”
“啊。我可以和你说几句话吗？”

Remus paled, visibly, and went into the kitchen.
雷穆斯脸色明显变白，走进了厨房。

 “Where are you going!?” Remus hissed, as he marched into the kitchen. He didn’t want Sirius to hear them fighting, but things didn’t look good at all, from the way Grant was calmly stirring his tea, not making eye contact.

“你要去哪儿！？”雷穆斯嘶声问道，他走进厨房。他不想让小天狼星听到他们争吵，但格兰特平静地搅拌着茶水，不看他，看来情况并不乐观。

“Brighton.” Grant said, “I’ve had a job offer - a really good one. Better pay, and I can help more people, I can really make a difference.”
“布赖顿。”格兰特说，“我收到了一份工作邀请——一份非常好的工作。薪水更高，我可以帮助更多的人，我真的能有所作为。”

“But we live in London.”
“但我们住在伦敦。”

“Remus…”
“雷穆斯……”

“You’re just up and leaving me for a job ?!” Remus was gearing up to start shouting; to shame Grant into staying. Grant just smiled sympathetically and shook his head,
“你就这样为了工作离开我？！”雷穆斯准备开始大喊；想要让格兰特感到羞愧，留下来。格兰特只是同情地微笑着，摇了摇头，

“Don’t be silly, now. You know it’s about more than that.”
“别傻了，你知道这不仅仅是因为那个。”

Remus’s heart was beating hard, he felt sick, woozy, as if the floor was rocking back and forth. “You can’t do this!”
雷穆斯的心跳得很快，他感到恶心，头晕目眩，就像地板在前后摇晃。“你不能这样做！”

“I’m just making things easier for you,” Grant said - and from anyone else that might have sounded bitter. “Haven’t I always tried to do that?”
“我只是想让事情对你更容易些，”格兰特说——如果是别人说这话可能会听起来有些苦涩。“我不一直都在努力做到这一点吗？”

“But I love you!”
“但我爱你！”

“I love you too, my darling, but I’m not sure that’s all there is to it.”
“我也爱你，亲爱的，但我不确定这就是全部。”

“So you’re just making the decision for me?!“
“所以你是在替我做决定？！”

“I’m making a decision for me.” Grant said, very firmly. He looked at Remus now, dead in the eye, and Remus could see there would be no more arguing. “Sirius needs you now, and you’ll go to war, because that’s who you are, you’re mad and brave and incredible. There isn’t a place for me in all that, so I need you to let me go. We’ll always be friends, won’t we? Care home yobs together?”
“这是我为自己做的决定。”格兰特非常坚定地说道。他现在直视雷穆斯，雷穆斯能看出他们不会再争论下去了。“小天狼星现在需要你，而你将要去打仗，因为这就是你，你疯狂、勇敢、不可思议。在这一切中没有我的位置，所以我需要你放手。我们永远是朋友，不是吗？一起在养老院混日子？”

Remus wanted to wail. He wanted to fall to his knees and clutch Grant around the waist and hold him there forever, to beg and plead. He knew that was selfish. Grant was right; Remus had already decided to re-join the Order, he had decided the moment Sirius returned. It wasn’t fair to keep Grant around for that, it was downright dangerous. But he needed him, oh, he really, really needed Grant. Remus wasn’t sure he could do it all alone, not with Sirius the way he was.
雷穆斯想要哀嚎。他想跪下来抱住格兰特的腰，永远地留住他，请求和乞求。他知道这是自私的。格兰特说得对；雷穆斯已经决定重新加入凤凰社，那是小天狼星回来的那一刻。他不应该因为这个而让格兰特留在身边，这样做简直是危险的。但他需要他，哦，他真的非常需要格兰特。雷穆斯不确定自己能否独自完成所有事情，尤其是在小天狼星现在这样的时候。

“You’ll break my heart if you go now.” Remus said, aware he sounded sulky and petulant.
“如果你现在离开，你会伤透我的心。”雷穆斯说道，意识到自己听起来很闹脾气。

Grant shook his head lightly, holding his ground. “I’m sorry, love. But it’s breaking my heart to stay.”
格兰特轻轻摇了摇头，坚定地站着。“对不起，亲爱的。但留下来真的让我心碎。”

And in an instant, Remus understood. He saw Grant properly for the first time, not as his protector, his champion, but as a person who was not so very different from him, who was just as vulnerable to suffering.
瞬间，雷穆斯明白了。他第一次真正看到了格兰特，不再是他的保护者、他的支持者，而是一个和他没什么不同的人，同样容易受苦。

“It’s not a proper goodbye, eh?” Grant said, softly. “You’re not shot of me yet.”
“这不是真正的告别，对吧？”格兰特柔声说道。“你还没有摆脱我。”

“I haven’t always been fair to you.” Remus said. He had wanted to say it for a long time now. He wanted some kind of forgiveness.
“我对你并不总是公平。”雷穆斯说道。他想了很久才说出这句话。他渴望某种宽恕。

“You’ve been fine,” Grant smiled, without a trace of blame. “You’ve been my little bit of magic.”
“你很好，”格兰特笑了笑，没有一丝责备。“你是我一点点魔法。”

Remus made a strangled noise, and tried not to cry. Grant hugged him, and they held each other for the last time.
雷穆斯发出了压抑的声音，努力不让自己哭出来。格兰特抱住了他，他们最后一次拥抱在一起。

Grant left Remus in the kitchen, with two cups of tea - one for Remus, one for Sirius. Remus stood in silence and waited for the door to go. When he heard it shut, he covered his mouth with his hand and closed his eyes. He breathed in and out for a few moments, then walked into the living room. Sirius was still on the couch. He looked anxious, rubbing his hands together.
格兰特把雷穆斯留在厨房，带着两杯茶——一杯给雷穆斯，一杯给小天狼星。雷穆斯默默地站着，等待门声。当他听到门关上的声音时，他用手捂住了嘴巴，闭上了眼睛。他深呼吸了几下，然后走进了客厅。小天狼星仍然坐在沙发上。他看起来很焦虑，搓着手。

“Remus, I--”
“雷穆斯，我——”

“No.” Remus held up his hand, shaking his head, “No, I need a minute.”
“不。”雷穆斯举起手，摇了摇头，“不，我需要一分钟。”

He went into the bedroom and closed the door. He sat on the bed and cried and cried. Once that was done with, he washed his face and went back to Sirius.
他走进卧室，关上了门。他坐在床上哭泣了一阵。完成后，他洗了脸，回到了小天狼星身边。

There was so much work to do.
还有很多工作要做。

Monday 10th July 1995

Things were harder, after Grant left. Remus felt as though he had lost his rock; the person who had kept him safe for thirteen years. The man Remus was left with was practically a stranger; a gaping hole of misery and fear and vengeful rage. Remus was on eggshells, and the war stretched ahead of them - would it always be like this?
格兰特离开后，一切变得更加困难。雷穆斯觉得自己失去了支柱；那个在过去十三年里保护他的那个人。雷穆斯留下来的那个男人简直是个陌生人；一个充满痛苦、恐惧和复仇愤怒的巨大空洞。雷穆斯如履薄冰，战争在他们面前延展——会一直这样下去吗？

They kept focussed on the war, mostly because Remus refused to discuss Grant, or his feelings. It was too much, in those early days. They spent their time working on lists of contacts, getting in touch with the old crowd, digging up old information from the last war. Sirius hooked them back into the floo network, using a secret connection only accessible to the right people, and time and time again the two of them knelt on the hearth rug, speaking into the flames; Sirius explaining his story to each member. Few of them took much convincing. All of them believed that Voldemort was back, and wanted to do something about it.
他们将注意力集中在战争上，主要是因为雷穆斯拒绝讨论格兰特或他的感受。在那些早期的日子里，这太过沉重。他们花时间处理联系人名单，联系老朋友，挖掘上一场战争的旧信息。小天狼星将他们重新接入了火焰网络，使用一个只有正确的人才能访问的秘密连接，一次又一次，他们俩跪在壁炉地毯上，对着火焰说话；小天狼星向每个成员讲述他的故事。他们中的大多数人很容易被说服。他们都相信伏地魔回来了，并且想要做点什么。

When they weren’t working for Dumbledore, Remus put the TV on and more often than not, Sirius would transform into Padfoot and doze off. Remus did all of the cooking - Sirius offered, but Remus wouldn’t allow it. He said he wanted Sirius to rest, to recuperate, but really he just wanted to be in a different room, most of the time. Sirius still slept on the couch, because neither of them were able to broach the subject.
当他们不为邓布利多工作时，雷穆斯会打开电视，更多的时候，小天狼星会变成帕德弗特，打盹。雷穆斯做了所有的饭——小天狼星主动提议，但雷穆斯不允许。他说他想让小天狼星休息、恢复，但实际上他只是大部分时间想待在另一个房间里。小天狼星仍然睡在沙发上，因为他们都无法谈论这个话题。

“Full moon on Wednesday,” Remus said, one afternoon. They’d just signed off with Kingsley - an Auror Moody had brought in, who seemed pretty capable. Remus wasn’t sure what that was worth; he’d seen plenty of capable wizards die.
“周三是满月。”雷穆斯在一个下午说道。他们刚刚和金斯利结束了谈话——一个由穆迪带来的傲罗，看起来很有能力。雷穆斯不确定这有什么用处；他见过许多有能力的巫师死去。

“I know.” Sirius replied, brusquely.
“我知道。”小天狼星冷冷地回答道。

They sat side by side on the couch, blankly watching the TV. It was only the muggle news, but it might as well have been static, for all they cared. Just a reason not to look at each other.
他们并排坐在沙发上，呆呆地看着电视。只是麻瓜新闻，但对他们来说，它可能就像静态一样。他们只是找个理由避免互相看。

“I usually leave an hour or so before sunset,” Remus continued. “Gives me time to clear the area, if I need to.”
“我通常在日落前一个小时左右离开，”雷穆斯继续说道。“这给我时间清理区域，如果需要的话。”

“I remember how it works.” Sirius said.
“我记得是怎么回事。”小天狼星说。

“Ok, sorry.” Remus muttered, irritated. “Just thought you’d want to know. But if you’ve got other plans, then by all means, stay here.”
“好的，对不起。”雷穆斯有些恼怒地嘟囔道。“只是觉得你可能想知道。不过如果你有其他计划，那就留在这里吧。”

Sirius looked at him. “Oh. You want me to come?”
小天狼星看着他。“哦。你想让我来吗？”

“Only if you want to,” Remus said, hurriedly, “I don’t mind either way.”
“只有你愿意的话，”雷穆斯匆忙说道，“无论怎样我都不介意。”

“Dumbledore said I need to stay here at all times…”
“邓布利多说我需要随时待在这里……”

“Fine. Stay here then.” Remus folded his arms tightly across his chest, feeling hurt.
“好吧，那就待在这里。”雷穆斯紧紧抱着手臂，感到受伤。

“No, I’ll come with you.” Sirius said.
“不，我会跟你一起去。”小天狼星说。

“Great.” Remus drawled, sarcastically.
“太好了。”雷穆斯带着讽刺地说道。

It was how almost all of their conversations seemed to go. One of them would deliberately misunderstand, or become unreasonably defensive about a tiny matter. Then the other would bite back, and around and around, until they both just stopped talking and ignored each other. But if Remus got up, or made to leave the room, Sirius would give him that terrified look; “Where are you going??” and Remus would sit back down again, and the whole scene would re-set.
几乎所有的对话都是这样的。总是一个人故意误解，或者对微不足道的事情变得不合理地防御。然后另一个人会反击，来来回回，直到他们都停止交谈，互相忽视。但如果雷穆斯站起来，或准备离开房间，小天狼星就会给他那个害怕的眼神；“你要去哪儿？”雷穆斯就会坐回去，整个场景重新设定。

He thought that bringing up the full moon might cheer Sirius up a bit. Sirius had always loved full moons, and it meant he could leave the flat for once. Can’t you just be normal?! Remus found himself thinking, angrily, I don’t want to live with a stranger, I want my best friend back. I need help.
他想着提到满月可能会让小天狼星开心一点。小天狼星一直喜欢满月，这意味着他可以离开公寓一次。你就不能正常一点吗？！雷穆斯愤怒地想着，我不想和一个陌生人生活，我想要回我的最好的朋友。我需要帮助。

Then he felt guilty. Because obviously Sirius couldn’t help it, and if he really thought about it, they had always been a fractious couple; they were both hotheaded Gryffindors, after all.
然后他感到内疚。因为显然小天狼星无能为力，如果他真的想一想，他们一直都是一个争吵不断的情侣；毕竟他们都是脾气火爆的格兰芬多。

Still. Sirius may not be a complete stranger, but he was certainly strange. Had he always been so watchful, so quick to anger? Or had Azkaban done that to him? Or - worst of all - was it all Remus’s fault?
不过，小天狼星可能不是完全的陌生人，但他确实很奇怪。他一直都这么警惕、容易生气吗？还是阿兹卡班让他变成了这样？或者——最糟糕的是——这一切都是雷穆斯的错？

Without Grant there, Remus began to wonder whether he seemed different himself. Perhaps years of living like a muggle had made him less interesting. He was slower than he’d been as a teenager, more cautious. He rarely laughed.
没有了格兰特，雷穆斯开始怀疑自己是否也变得不同了。也许多年的麻瓜生活让他变得不那么有趣。他比年轻时更慢了，更小心了。他很少笑。

It was stupid, but Remus was even more worried about how he looked. He had never been a vain person; he’d always been very ordinary looking, scarred and a bit gangly, even when Sirius had known him. But at least back then Remus had been young. Now, his hair was grey all over, only a few strands of the original mousey shade left. He had more scars than ever, and sometimes he still smoked, which made him cough like an old coal miner.
这很愚蠢，但雷穆斯甚至更担心自己的外貌。他从未是一个爱慕虚荣的人；他一直看起来非常普通，满身伤疤，有点瘦弱，即使在小天狼星认识他的时候也是这样。但至少那时雷穆斯还年轻。现在，他的头发全是灰色，只剩下几缕原本的鼠灰色。他的伤疤比以前更多，有时候他还抽烟，这让他像个老煤矿工人一样咳嗽。

He was so much less than he had been before.
他远不如以前了。

“This isn’t going to work, is it?” Sirius said, abruptly, breaking Remus’s thoughts.
“这行不通，对吧？”小天狼星突然说道，打断了雷穆斯的思绪。

No tact. Once he had been so silver tongued he could talk anyone into anything; could reel off dirty jokes like they were romantic poetry. But now everything Sirius said was sudden and blunt and full of raw urgency.
毫无圆滑。他曾经口才极佳，能说服任何人做任何事；能像讲情诗一样讲脏话。但现在，小天狼星说的一切都突然而直接，充满了原始的紧迫感。

“What isn't?” Remus asked, shaken. He kept his eyes fixed on the TV.
“什么行不通？”雷穆斯问道，感到震惊。他的目光始终盯着电视。

“This. You and me. In the same room. Trying to act like… trying to be ok with each other. After everything that’s happened, and fourteen years… it's just going to be too much.”
“这。你和我。在同一个房间里。试图表现得……试图和彼此相处好。在发生了所有事情之后，十四年了……这实在是太多了。”

Remus finally turned to look at him, ready to be annoyed again, but found that Sirius was staring down at his hands, twisting them hard in his lap so that the skin pulled and his knuckles whitened. He had scars too, now.
雷穆斯最终转身看着他，准备再次感到恼火，但发现小天狼星正盯着自己的手看，把它们紧紧地扭在大腿上，皮肤被拉紧，关节变白了。他现在也有伤疤了。

He didn’t look so old and strange, then; he just looked like Sirius. And he was frightened.
那样看起来他不那么老和奇怪了；他只是看起来像小天狼星。并且他很害怕。

“Oh, I don’t know,” Remus said softly. He reached over and stilled Sirius’s hands with his own, weaving their scarred bony fingers together. He caught his eye and smiled encouragingly. “You were always too much for me. I never minded.”
“哦，我不知道，”雷穆斯柔声说道。他伸手过去，用自己的手稳住小天狼星的手，将他们那些伤疤满布的骨指交织在一起。他捕捉到小天狼星的目光，鼓励地笑了笑。“你总是对我来说太多了。我从来不介意。”

The look of relief which flooded Sirius’s face was worth every lost moment. It was an entire lifetime. He raised Remus’s hand to his lips, and gently kissed the inside of his palm.
小天狼星脸上充满的释然的神情值得每一个失去的时刻。这是一个整整一生的时刻。他将雷穆斯的手举到嘴唇上，轻轻吻了吻手掌内侧。

They returned to the TV after that, but kept holding hands.
然后他们回到了电视前，但仍然保持着牵手。

* * *

Thursday 14th July

Thankfully, the full moon was a welcome change of pace. They apparated to the Brecon Beacons together, and both transformed on a mountainside. The wolf was thrilled to be reunited with its old companion, and they spent their time chasing foxes through the grasslands, running together for miles and miles. They were better together, in their canine bodies; more natural, more at ease. Perhaps the lack of inhibition, or perhaps the bond forged between them as dog and wolf was not as easily broken.
值得庆幸的是，满月成为了一个受欢迎的变换节奏。他们一起使用隐形术到达布雷肯比肯山脉，并在山坡上变身。狼很高兴能和它的老伙伴重聚，他们在草地上追逐狐狸，跑了好几英里。他们在狗和狼的身体里更加默契，更自然。也许是缺乏抑制，或者是作为狗和狼之间的纽带不容易被打破。

When Remus turned back, at dawn, Padfoot licked his face gleefully, nuzzling into him, and Remus laughed, for the first time since Sirius had returned to London.
当雷穆斯在黎明时分变回人形时，帕德弗特高兴地舔着他的脸，依偎着他，雷穆斯笑了，这是自从小天狼星回到伦敦后第一次笑。

They were still smiling when they got back to the flat, and it felt bigger than before; less of a cage.
他们回到公寓时仍在微笑，这感觉比以前更宽敞；不再像个牢笼。

“I forgot how strong you were,” Sirius beamed, full of energy, “I forgot you were faster than me.”
“小天狼星笑容满面，充满了活力，”我忘了你有多强壮，“我忘了你比我快。”

“Of course you did,” Remus grinned, “Arrogant prick. I could always beat you.”
“当然忘了，”雷穆斯咧嘴一笑，“傲慢的混蛋。我总是能打败你。”

He picked up the post sitting on the doormat and flicked through, as Sirius flung himself onto the couch, sprawling out. It was the first time Remus had seen him look really relaxed in their flat again, and it made him feel warm inside.
他拿起坐在门垫上的邮件翻看，而小天狼星则扑在沙发上，伸展开来。这是雷穆斯第一次看到他在他们的公寓里显得如此放松，这让他感到内心温暖。

Flicking through the bills and takeaway leaflets, Remus stopped short as he reached a postcard. It had Grant’s new address on it. Nothing else, just the address, neatly printed. The needle sharp sting of regret hit Remus, and he sighed, heavily. There was no phone number. Either Grant didn’t have one yet (which seemed very unlikely, as he was barely off it normally, and needed one for work), or he was telling Remus not to get in touch.
翻看账单和外卖传单时，雷穆斯停下了，因为他看到了一张明信片。上面写着格兰特的新地址。别的什么也没有，只是地址，印得很整齐。内心刺痛的遗憾击中了雷穆斯，他重重地叹了口气。上面没有电话号码。要么是格兰特还没有电话号码（这似乎很不可能，因为他通常几乎离不开电话，还需要一个工作用），要么是他在告诉雷穆斯不要联系他。

“What’s up?” Sirius said, from the couch, ever watchful.
“怎么了？”小天狼星在沙发上问，依旧警惕。

“Nothing. Grant’s new address, that’s all.” Remus put it on the mantelpiece. “I really need a lie down, I think I’ll go to bed.”
“没什么。格兰特的新地址，仅此而已。”雷穆斯把它放在壁炉架上。“我真的需要躺下，我想我去睡觉。”

He downed some painkillers - only over the counter stuff, nothing exciting - and went to sleep. Luckily that was easy enough, after a full moon. When he woke up, the bedroom felt cold and empty. It was long after midday, and he could smell bacon cooking, the salty, savoury scent wafting its way through the flat.
他吞下了一些止痛药——只是非处方的，没有什么刺激的——然后去睡觉。幸运的是，满月后这很容易。当他醒来时，卧室感觉冷而空旷。已经过了中午很久，他能闻到培根煎熟的香味，咸咸的、可口的气味在公寓里飘荡。

He got up and followed the scent to the kitchen, where Sirius was standing over the hob, agitating a sizzling pan of bacon and eggs. He turned, seeing Remus and smiled,

“我们都在死去，”小天狼星回答道。

“也许吧。”雷穆斯同意道，手指交缠在一起，“但如果生活能像这样，不应该更持久吗？”

“Oi, watch it! What?”
“喂，小心点！什么事？”

“My mansion! Or it’s mine now, anyway - my parents are both dead, I’m the Black heir! The house will answer to me!”
“我的豪宅！或者说现在是我的——我父母都死了，我是布莱克家族的继承人！这座房子会听我的！”

“Oh, I see,” Remus frowned, turning to look at Sirius properly, “Are you sure? I mean… you really want to go back there?”
“哦，我明白了，”雷穆斯皱起了眉头，转身正视小天狼星，“你确定吗？我意思是……你真的想回到那里吗？”

“Well, no, obviously I don’t. But it’s probably one of the most protected houses in Britain - the Blacks took home security really bloody seriously. There are enough rooms for all the Weasleys and then some - oh merlin, imagine my bitch mother’s face if she knew I’d invited the Weasleys over to stay! It’s something I can do to help, isn’t it?”
“嗯，显然我不想。不过那可能是英国最受保护的房子之一——布莱克家族对家庭安全非常重视。房子里有足够的房间给所有的韦斯利一家，还有更多——哦，梅林，想象一下我那个讨厌的母亲的脸，如果她知道我邀请了韦斯利一家来住！这是我能做的帮助，不是吗？”

“But Sirius, think about it, you’ll be in the home your parents lived in - all their things will be there…”
“但是小天狼星，想想看，你会在你父母曾经住过的家里——他们的所有东西都会在那儿……”

“We’ll chuck it all out,” Sirius waved a hand, “And it’s so safe - a safe place for Harry, Remus.”
“我们会把所有东西都扔掉，”小天狼星挥了挥手，“而且那里非常安全——对哈利来说是一个安全的地方，雷穆斯。”

“It does sound…” Remus thought hard, coming around to the idea. “If you’re sure ?”
“确实听起来……”雷穆斯深思熟虑，渐渐接受了这个想法。“如果你确定的话？”

“Of course I am! And anyway, it won’t be half as grim if I have you there with me, will it?”
“当然确定！而且，即使我有你在那儿，也不会那么阴郁的，不是吗？”

“Ha,” Remus poked him, “Now who’s gone soft?”
“哈，”雷穆斯戳了戳他，“现在谁变软了？”

They got in touch with Dumbledore via the fireplace, and even he sounded impressed with this idea. He wanted to know how to get in, what sort of charms and curses Sirius knew about, how soon he could alert the Order.
他们通过壁炉联系了邓布利多，连他也对这个想法感到印象深刻。他想知道如何进入，了解小天狼星知道的各种咒语和诅咒，以及他什么时候可以通知凤凰社。

“We’ll need to give the place a proper clean,” Sirius said, eagerly, “It’ll be full of junk, but I can help, if I’m going to be there all the time, and no one is better with magical pests than Remus!”
“我们需要对那个地方进行彻底清洁，”小天狼星热切地说，“那里会满是垃圾，但如果我要一直在那儿，我可以帮忙，而没有人比雷穆斯更擅长处理魔法害虫了！”

“An excellent idea, gentlemen,” Dumbledore’s eyes twinkled through the flames, “And right under Voldemort’s nose - in the home of his most loyal supporters! How soon can you both get there?”
“一个很好的主意，先生们，”邓布利多的眼睛在火焰中闪烁，“而且就在伏地魔的鼻子下——在他最忠实的支持者的家中！你们两个人什么时候能到那儿？”

“Tomorrow.” Remus said, quickly, because he knew Sirius had been about to say ‘right now!’ “We’ll go after dark, so it’s less suspicious.”
“明天。”雷穆斯迅速说道，因为他知道小天狼星本来要说‘现在就去！’“我们晚上天黑后去，这样就不那么引人注目了。”

“Good man, Lupin,” Dumbledore said, “In that case I shall await word from you.”
“好样的，雷穆斯，”邓布利多说，“那样的话，我会等你们的消息。”

His face vanished in a puff of smoke.
他的脸在一阵烟雾中消失了。

“Yes, Moony! Sorry, Remus…” Sirius cheered. “Amazing! Let's pack!”
“是的，月亮！抱歉，雷穆斯……”小天狼星欢呼道。“太棒了！我们来打包吧！”

Of course, Sirius had barely anything to pack, and was much too excited to be sensible anyway. That was left up to Remus, who began making a list of all the things they would need - books of course, all the notes from the first war. Clothes, food, bedsheets - Remus didn’t know how long Grimmauld Place had stood empty, he wasn't sure if any of it would be salvageable.
当然，小天狼星几乎没有什么东西需要打包，而且他太兴奋了，无法保持理智。这个任务留给了雷穆斯，他开始列出他们需要的所有东西的清单——当然是书，还有第一次战争的所有笔记。衣物、食物、床单——雷穆斯不知道格里莫德广场空置了多久，他不确定这些东西是否还可以使用。

“I can finally show you my bedroom!” Sirius trilled, “Ooh, teenage me would be so jealous, getting Remus Lupin in my bedroom!”
“我终于可以给你看看我的卧室了！”小天狼星欢呼道，“哦，青少年时期的我会非常嫉妒，能在我的卧室里得到雷穆斯·路平！”

“Ha,” Remus snorted, folding up robes and stuffing them into his trunk.
“哈，”雷穆斯哼了一声，把长袍叠起来塞进他的行李箱里。

“And just wait until Harry arrives! We can sort out a room for him, and when the war's over, it'll be his…”
“等哈利来了再说！我们可以为他安排一个房间，战争结束后，那将是他的……”

Remus smiled and kissed him and agreed it would all be lovely, it would be an adventure, because that was what Sirius needed from him just then. And he was determined to do everything Sirius needed for as long as he could.
雷穆斯微笑着吻了他，同意这一切都会很美好，这将是一次冒险，因为那正是小天狼星此刻需要他的。他决心尽可能满足小天狼星的所有需求。

“I can’t wait to see Andromeda - and her kid! Must be in seventh year now, surely? Hey, imagine if she and Harry fall in love, how completely mental would that be? Then he'd be… what, my second cousin?”
“我迫不及待想见到安德romeda——和她的孩子！现在肯定已经是七年级了吧？嘿，想象一下如果她和哈利坠入爱河，那会多么疯狂？那他会是……什么，我的表亲吗？”

“Once removed, or something like that,” Remus acknowledged, “What are you talking about, anyway, they're almost a decade apart. We were thirteen when Andromeda had that kid.”
“一次移除，或者类似的东西，”雷穆斯确认道，“你到底在说什么，他们差不多有十岁。安德romeda生下那个孩子时我们才十三岁。”

“And Moody, the old codger, and Arthur, and Gideon and…”
“还有穆迪，那老家伙，还有亚瑟，吉迪恩和……”

“Sirius, no,” Remus said, gently, “Remember, Gid and Fab died.”
“小天狼星，不要，”雷穆斯温柔地说，“记住，吉德和法布死了。”

“Oh… oh yeah…” Sirius's face fell, and Remus felt dreadful. Perhaps he couldn't just go along with everything. He touched Sirius's hand, “It's ok, you're already remembering things much better than a few weeks ago.”
“哦……哦，对了……”小天狼星的脸色沉了下来，雷穆斯感到非常难过。也许他不能只是顺应一切。他摸了摸小天狼星的手，“没关系，你的记忆已经比几周前好多了。”

“Maybe.” Sirius said, uncertain. He rubbed his arm. “I think I'll go and have a rest, if that's ok?”
“也许吧。”小天狼星不确定地说。他搓了搓手臂。“我想我去休息一下，没关系吧？”

“Of course.”
“当然。”

Remus finished all of the packing, and when he went back to the living room, Padfoot was curled up on the couch again.
雷穆斯完成了所有的打包，当他回到客厅时，帕德福特又蜷缩在沙发上。

They ate a light meal for dinner, and Remus had the TV on because it was his last night around all of his muggle comforts. They still decided to take all of their old records - though plenty had warped over time, and gave off an unpleasant hissing sound over the music. With everything packed away in trunks and boxes, it felt very final, to Remus. But perhaps that was just nerves.
他们吃了简单的晚餐，雷穆斯开着电视，因为这是他在所有麻瓜舒适设施中度过的最后一晚。他们还是决定带上所有的旧唱片——虽然很多唱片由于时间的推移已经变形，发出不愉快的嘶嘶声。所有东西都打包在行李箱和盒子里，雷穆斯感到一切似乎非常终结。但也许这只是紧张。

He tried to stay calm, watching the sky outside turn a deeper shade of blue, the streetlights turning from pale pink to thick amber, and the stars beginning to show. Light pollution in London meant that stars were rare - you could only make out the very brightest ones.
他努力保持平静，看着外面的天空变成更深的蓝色，街灯从浅粉色变成浓厚的琥珀色，星星开始出现。伦敦的光污染使得星星很稀少——你只能看到最亮的几颗。

Sirius's head was nodding against his shoulder already, as the tv announced the nine o'clock news. Remus yawned and flicked his wand at the screen, turning it off for the last time. “Oi,” he whispered to Sirius, “Come on, let’s go to bed.”
当电视宣布九点新闻时，小天狼星的头已经在他的肩膀上点来点去。雷穆斯打了个哈欠，用魔杖轻轻一挥，关闭了屏幕，“喂，”他对小天狼星低声说，“来吧，我们上床睡觉。”

“Mmph.”
“嗯。”

Remus had to shake him a bit, but finally Sirius staggered up and wandered zombie-like down the hall. Remus brushed his teeth and washed his face, then followed him in.
雷穆斯不得不稍微摇醒他，但最终小天狼星摇摇晃晃地站起来，像僵尸一样在走廊里徘徊。雷穆斯刷牙洗脸，然后跟了进去。

Sirius was standing beside the bed, biting his lip.
小天狼星站在床边，咬着嘴唇。

“Come on,” Remus yawned, climbing under the covers, “What's wrong?”
“快点，”雷穆斯打了个哈欠，爬上被窝，“怎么了？”

“Um. Nothing.” Sirius got in, slowly.
“嗯。没事。”小天狼星慢慢地上了床。

Remus pulled him close, so happy to have him near again. He wrapped his arms around Sirius's body and inhaled the scent of him, and buried his face in that beautiful hair. He felt so good. He felt complete. He kissed Sirius’s cheek, searching for his mouth, “Love you.”
雷穆斯把他紧紧抱住，非常高兴再次把他拥在身边。他环抱着小天狼星的身体，吸入他的气息，把脸埋在那美丽的头发里。他感到非常舒适。感到完整。他吻了吻小天狼星的脸颊，寻找他的嘴唇，“爱你。”

“Love you too.” Sirius returned, though he was very tense, and turned his head away.
“我也爱你。”小天狼星回应道，尽管他非常紧张，转过头去。

“What's wrong?” Remus asked, pulling away, “Am I being too…?”
“怎么了？”雷穆斯问，拉开一点距离，“我是不是太……？”

“No, I just…” Sirius pulled back too. “Sorry, I just don't think I can… you know, any more.”
“不是的，我只是……”小天狼星也后退了一步。“抱歉，我只是觉得我可能……你知道的，再也不行了。”

“Oh.” Remus blinked, “Oh, Jesus, sorry, I didn't mean to… of course not, if you don't want to.”
“哦。”雷穆斯眨了眨眼，“哦，天啊，抱歉，我不是那个意思……当然了，如果你不想的话。”

“No, I want to,” Sirius squirmed, “I'm just not sure I can. Since Azkaban… um. There's not really been a lot ‘going on’, if you know what I mean. I might not… er. I just don't want you to think it's you.”
“不，我想要，”小天狼星扭动道，“我只是没把握。我在阿兹卡班之后……嗯。没有发生太多的事情，如果你懂我的意思。我可能……呃。我只是希望你不要觉得是你的问题。”

“ Oh!” Remus blinked again. He didn't really know what to say, or what to do. This was not a problem he'd ever encountered before. He wanted to be kind. “I’m just glad you're here,” he said, truthfully. “I don't need anything else.”
“哦！”雷穆斯再次眨了眨眼。他真的不知道该说什么，或者该怎么做。这是他从未遇到过的问题。他想要温柔。“我只是很高兴你在这里，”他说，真心话。“我不需要其他任何东西。”

“Really?”
“真的吗？”

“ Really.”
“真的。”

Sirius turned around, and took Remus's face in his hands, and kissed him, long and deep. That would have been enough; truly, honestly. Remus would have been happy with Sirius's lips, Sirius's taste and scent. But after a while, Sirius pulled back, and grinned,
小天狼星转过身来，用手捧住雷穆斯的脸，深情而漫长地吻了他。这已经足够了；真的，诚实地说。雷穆斯会很满足于小天狼星的嘴唇、小天狼星的味道和气息。但过了一会儿，小天狼星退开，露出了笑容，

“Doesn't mean I don't want you to try…”
“这并不意味着我不想让你尝试……”

And Remus just about dissolved.
雷穆斯几乎被融化了。

It took a very long time. There had to be a lot more kissing, a lot more coaxing and gentle caresses and heated whispers; it took hours and hours. But how could Remus complain, when he finally had Sirius sighing in his arms again? It was so tender and so, so beautiful.
这花了很长时间。需要更多的亲吻，更多的劝说和温柔的抚摸和热切的耳语；花了几个小时。但雷穆斯怎么会抱怨呢，当他终于再次抱着小天狼星时，小天狼星在他的怀里叹息。那是如此温柔，如此美丽。

Afterwards they lay exhausted, and hot, and happy. Remus felt as if every hair on his body was singing; every nerve ending humming. Sirius curled into his body, and stroked his scars, like he used to.
之后，他们躺在一起，疲惫、炎热而幸福。雷穆斯感觉到自己身体上的每根汗毛都在歌唱；每根神经末梢都在嗡嗡作响。小天狼星蜷缩在他的身体里，像以前一样抚摸着他的伤疤。

“Hmmm.”
“嗯。”

“Hmmm.”
“嗯。”

“Remus?”
“雷穆斯？”

“Yes?”
“是的？”

“Can I ask you one question?”
“我可以问你一个问题吗？”

“Oh,” Remus smiled, “If you really must.”
“哦，”雷穆斯微笑着，“如果你真的必须的话。”

“What have you been doing all these years, Moon--sorry.”
“这些年来你在做什么，月亮——对不起。”

“No, it’s ok. Call me Moony.”
“没关系。叫我月亮就好。”

“Moony.” he sighed, happily, “What have you been doing? When we called around everybody - they were as surprised to see you as me. They all said they hadn’t seen you for a long time.”
“小天狼星。”他幸福地叹了口气，“你这些年在做什么？当我们给大家打电话时——他们对见到你感到惊讶。他们都说很久没见到你了。”

“Since the war.” Remus confirmed. “Since Lily and James.”
“自从战争以来。”雷穆斯确认道。“自从莉莉和詹姆斯。”

“Why?” Sirius asked, frowning.
“为什么？”小天狼星皱着眉头问。

“I couldn’t bear it.” Remus said, simply. “Being around anyone who knew what had happened. I’ve seen Mary once or twice, but no one else. I wanted to be alone.”
“我无法忍受。”雷穆斯简单地说。“待在知道发生了什么事的人身边。我见过玛丽一两次，但没有其他人。我想要独处。”

Sirius shook his head, looking frustrated. “I don’t understand you, Moony.”
小天狼星摇了摇头，显得有些沮丧。“我不理解你，月亮。”

“No,” Remus smiled softly, “No, you never did, quite.”
“不，”雷穆斯柔和地笑了，“不，你从来没有完全理解过。”

“Fair enough.” Sirius accepted.
“那也够公平的。”小天狼星接受了。

He lay back onto Remus, with his whole weight - though that wasn’t much. It was pathetic, really. Two bony, wiry men, clinging together; both old before their time, and both so lost.
他把身体全力靠在雷穆斯身上——虽然那并不重。真的很可怜。两个骨瘦如柴的男人，紧紧相依；都在时光前显得苍老，都迷失了自我。

They had never understood each other, not really.
他们从未真正理解对方。

“You always tried, though.” Remus said, into Sirius’s hair. He wrapped an arm around him and kissed his head. “You still knew more than anyone else ever has. Ever will.”
“不过你一直在努力。”雷穆斯在小天狼星的头发里说道。他环住他，吻了吻他的头。“你仍然比任何其他人都更了解我。”

“Even though I thought you were--”
“即使我认为你是——”

“We don’t need to talk about that.”
“我们不需要讨论那个。”

Sirius gave half a sigh, and Remus knew he disapproved, but they’d done enough talking, for now. They were quiet for a long time, and Remus closed his eyes.
小天狼星叹了口气，雷穆斯知道他不赞成，但现在他们已经谈够了。他们安静了很久，雷穆斯闭上了眼睛。

Finally, Sirius spoke.
最后，小天狼星开口了。

“Even if we don’t talk about it, don’t you think we ought to try to forgive each other?”
“即使我们不谈论它，你不觉得我们应该尝试原谅彼此吗？”

“You sound like Dumbledore.” Remus snorted.
“你听起来像邓布利多。”雷穆斯哼了一声。

“Ha.” Sirius said. “Yeah, you’re right. Can you believe we’re back following orders from that old fool? I s’pose I don’t really know much about forgiveness.”
“哈。”小天狼星说。“是的，你说得对。你能相信我们又回到听那个老傻瓜的命令了吗？我想我真的不太了解宽恕。”

“Me neither.” Remus sighed.
“我也是。”雷穆斯叹了口气。

“I don’t know if it’s worth anything, really, with lives as short as ours.” Sirius said, sadly, “I think at this point, there’s only love and hate.”
“我不知道这是否真的有价值，考虑到我们如此短暂的生命。”小天狼星悲伤地说，“我认为到这个时候，只有爱和恨。”

“That’s very fatalistic of you.” Remus commented, “I thought I was supposed to be the pessimist.”
“你真是很悲观。”雷穆斯评论道，“我还以为我应该是悲观主义者。”

Sirius shuddered slightly, which Remus took for a laugh. He squeezed him tighter, and kissed his shoulder. “Love and hate.” He murmured, thoughtfully.
小天狼星轻微地颤抖了一下，雷穆斯以为这是在笑。他紧紧握住他，吻了吻他的肩膀。“爱和恨。”他若有所思地喃喃道。

“Love or hate, I s’pose.” Sirius clarified. “You make a choice.”
“我想是爱还是恨。”小天狼星澄清道。“你得做出选择。”

“It’s that simple, then?”
“就这么简单吗？”

“Yeah. I think it is.” Sirius reached for his hand under the duvet. He looked up at Remus, eyes now icy grey, but as piercing as ever. He was asking a question.
“是的。我认为是的。”小天狼星伸手去握雷穆斯的手。他抬起头看着雷穆斯，眼睛现在是冰冷的灰色，但依然犀利。他在问一个问题。

Remus squeezed his hand in answer,
雷穆斯握紧他的手回答，

“Love.” He said.
“爱。”他说。

And then he kissed him.
然后他吻了吻他。
